search.text: In the beginning Elohim created the heavens and the earth.
search.searchText: genesis 1 1 in the beginning elohim created the heavens and the earth

search.text: And the earth was wild and waste, and darkness was over the face of the deep, and the Ruach of Elohim was hovering over the face of the waters.
search.searchText: genesis 1 2 and the earth was wild and waste and darkness was over the face of the deep and the ruach of elohim was hovering over the face of the waters

search.text: Elohim said, “Let there be light,” and there was light.
search.searchText: genesis 1 3 elohim said let there be light and there was light

search.text: Elohim saw the light, and saw that it was good. Elohim divided the light from the darkness.
search.searchText: genesis 1 4 elohim saw the light and saw that it was good elohim divided the light from the darkness

search.text: Elohim called the light “day”, and the darkness Elohim called “night”. There was evening and there was morning, the first day.
search.searchText: genesis 1 5 elohim called the light day and the darkness elohim called night there was evening and there was morning the first day

search.text: Elohim said, “Let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.”
search.searchText: genesis 1 6 elohim said let there be an expanse in the middle of the waters and let it divide the waters from the waters

search.text: Elohim made the expanse, and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse; and it was so.
search.searchText: genesis 1 7 elohim made the expanse and divided the waters which were under the expanse from the waters which were above the expanse and it was so

search.text: Elohim said, “Let the waters under the heavens be gathered together to one place, and let the dry land appear;” and it was so.

search.text: Elohim said, “Let the earth yield grass, herbs yielding seeds, and fruit trees bearing fruit after their kind, with their seeds in it, on the earth;” and it was so.

search.text: The earth yielded grass, herbs yielding seed after their kind, and trees bearing fruit, with their seeds in it, after their kind; and Elohim saw that it was good.

search.text: There was evening and there was morning, a third day.

search.text: Elohim said, “Let there be lights in the expanse of the heavens to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs to mark seasons, days, and years;

search.text: Elohim set them in the expanse of the heavens to give light to the earth,

search.text: There was evening and there was morning, a fourth day.

search.text: Elohim said, “Let the waters abound with living beings, and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the heavens.”
search.searchText: genesis 1 20 elohim said let the waters abound with living beings and let birds fly above the earth in the open expanse of the heavens

search.text: Elohim created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their kind, and every winged bird after its kind. Elohim saw that it was good.

search.text: Elohim blessed them, saying, “Be fruitful, and multiply, and fill the waters in the seas, and let birds multiply on the earth.”

search.text: There was evening and there was morning, a fifth day.

search.text: Elohim said, “Let us make humankind in our image, after our likeness; and let them have dominion over the fish of the sea, and over the birds of the heavens, and over the livestock, and over all the land, and over every creeping thing that creeps on the land.”

search.text: So Elohim created humankind in Elohim’s image; in the image of Elohim Elohim created them; male and female Elohim created them.

search.text: Elohim blessed them. Elohim said to them, “Be fruitful, multiply, fill the land, and subdue it. Have dominion over the fish of the sea, over the birds of the heavens, and over every living thing that moves on the earth.”

search.text: And to every animal of the earth, and to every bird of the heavens, and to everything that creeps on the earth in which there is living breath, I have given every green herb for food.” And it was so.

search.text: These are the generations of the heavens and the earth when they were created, in the day that YHWH Elohim made earth and heavens.

search.text: No shrub of the field was yet in the earth, and no herb of the field had yet sprung up; for YHWH Elohim had not caused it to rain on the earth, and there was no human to till the ground.

search.text: YHWH spoke to Moshe, saying,
search.searchText: numbers 8 1 yhwh spoke to moshe saying

search.text: "Speak to Aharon, and tell him, 'When you light the lamps, the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand.'"
search.searchText: numbers 8 2 speak to aharon and tell him when you light the lamps the seven lamps shall give light in front of the lampstand

search.text: Aharon did so. He lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lampstand, as YHWH commanded Moshe.
search.searchText: numbers 8 3 aharon did so he lit its lamps to light the area in front of the lampstand as yhwh commanded moshe

search.text: This was the workmanship of the lampstand, beaten work of gold. From its base to its flowers, it was beaten work: according to the pattern which YHWH had shown Moshe, so he made the lampstand.
search.searchText: numbers 8 4 this was the workmanship of the lampstand beaten work of gold from its base to its flowers it was beaten work according to the pattern which yhwh had shown moshe so he made the lampstand

search.text: YHWH spoke to Moshe, saying,
search.searchText: numbers 8 5 yhwh spoke to moshe saying

search.text: "Take the Levites from among the children of Israel, and cleanse them.
search.searchText: numbers 8 6 take the levites from among the children of israel and cleanse them

search.text: Thus shall you do to them, to cleanse them: sprinkle the water of cleansing on them, let them shave their whole bodies with a razor, and let them wash their clothes, and cleanse themselves.
search.searchText: numbers 8 7 thus shall you do to them to cleanse them sprinkle the water of cleansing on them let them shave their whole bodies with a razor and let them wash their clothes and cleanse themselves

search.text: Then let them take a young bull, and its meal offering, fine flour mixed with oil; and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering.
search.searchText: numbers 8 8 then let them take a young bull and its meal offering fine flour mixed with oil and another young bull you shall take for a sin offering

search.text: You shall present the Levites before the Tent of Meeting. You shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of Israel.
search.searchText: numbers 8 9 you shall present the levites before the tent of meeting you shall assemble the whole congregation of the children of israel

search.text: You shall present the Levites before YHWH. The children of Israel shall lay their hands on the Levites,
search.searchText: numbers 8 10 you shall present the levites before yhwh the children of israel shall lay their hands on the levites

search.text: and Aharon shall offer the Levites before YHWH for a wave offering, on the behalf of the children of Israel, that it may be theirs to do the service of YHWH.
search.searchText: numbers 8 11 and aharon shall offer the levites before yhwh for a wave offering on the behalf of the children of israel that it may be theirs to do the service of yhwh

search.text: The Levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls, and you shall offer the one for a sin offering, and the other for a burnt offering to YHWH, to make atonement for the Levites.
search.searchText: numbers 8 12 the levites shall lay their hands on the heads of the bulls and you shall offer the one for a sin offering and the other for a burnt offering to yhwh to make atonement for the levites

search.text: You shall set the Levites before Aharon, and before his sons, and offer them as a wave offering to YHWH.
search.searchText: numbers 8 13 you shall set the levites before aharon and before his sons and offer them as a wave offering to yhwh

search.text: Thus you shall separate the Levites from among the children of Israel, and the Levites shall be mine.
search.searchText: numbers 8 14 thus you shall separate the levites from among the children of israel and the levites shall be mine

search.text: "After that, the Levites shall go in to do the service of the Tent of Meeting: and you shall cleanse them, and offer them as a wave offering.
search.searchText: numbers 8 15 after that the levites shall go in to do the service of the tent of meeting and you shall cleanse them and offer them as a wave offering

search.text: For they are wholly given to me from among the children of Israel; instead of all who open the womb, even the firstborn of all the children of Israel, I have taken them to me.
search.searchText: numbers 8 16 for they are wholly given to me from among the children of israel instead of all who open the womb even the firstborn of all the children of israel i have taken them to me

search.text: For all the firstborn among the children of Israel are mine, both man and animal. On the day that I struck all the firstborn in the land of Mitzrayim, I sanctified them for myself.
search.searchText: numbers 8 17 for all the firstborn among the children of israel are mine both man and animal on the day that i struck all the firstborn in the land of mitzrayim i sanctified them for myself

search.text: I have taken the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel.
search.searchText: numbers 8 18 i have taken the levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of israel

search.text: I have given the Levites as a gift to Aharon and to his sons from among the children of Israel, to do the service of the children of Israel in the Tent of Meeting, and to make atonement for the children of Israel; that there be no plague among the children of Israel, when the children of Israel come near to the sanctuary."
search.searchText: numbers 8 19 i have given the levites as a gift to aharon and to his sons from among the children of israel to do the service of the children of israel in the tent of meeting and to make atonement for the children of israel that there be no plague among the children of israel when the children of israel come near to the sanctuary

search.text: Thus did Moshe, and Aharon, and all the congregation of the children of Israel, to the Levites. According to all that YHWH commanded Moshe concerning the Levites, so the children of Israel did to them.
search.searchText: numbers 8 20 thus did moshe and aharon and all the congregation of the children of israel to the levites according to all that yhwh commanded moshe concerning the levites so the children of israel did to them

search.text: The Levites purified themselves from sin, and they werehed their clothes; and Aharon offered them for a wave offering before YHWH; and Aharon made atonement for them to cleanse them.
search.searchText: numbers 8 21 the levites purified themselves from sin and they werehed their clothes and aharon offered them for a wave offering before yhwh and aharon made atonement for them to cleanse them

search.text: After that, the Levites went in to do their service in the Tent of Meeting before Aharon, and before his sons: as YHWH had commanded Moshe concerning the Levites, so they did to them.
search.searchText: numbers 8 22 after that the levites went in to do their service in the tent of meeting before aharon and before his sons as yhwh had commanded moshe concerning the levites so they did to them

search.text: YHWH spoke to Moshe, saying,
search.searchText: numbers 8 23 yhwh spoke to moshe saying

search.text: "This is that which belongs to the Levites: from twenty-five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the Tent of Meeting;
search.searchText: numbers 8 24 this is that which belongs to the levites from twenty five years old and upward they shall go in to wait on the service in the work of the tent of meeting

search.text: and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting on the work, and shall serve no more,
search.searchText: numbers 8 25 and from the age of fifty years they shall cease waiting on the work and shall serve no more

search.text: but shall minister with their brothers in the Tent of Meeting, to keep the charge, and shall do no service. Thus shall you do to the Levites concerning their duties."

search.text: YHWH spoke to Moshe in the wilderness of Sinai, in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of Mitzrayim, saying,
search.searchText: numbers 9 1 yhwh spoke to moshe in the wilderness of sinai in the first month of the second year after they had come out of the land of mitzrayim saying

search.text: "Moreover let the children of Israel keep the Passover in its appointed season.
search.searchText: numbers 9 2 moreover let the children of israel keep the passover in its appointed season

search.text: On the fourteenth day of this month, at evening, you shall keep it in its appointed season--according to all its statutes, and according to all its ordinances, you shall keep it."
search.searchText: numbers 9 3 on the fourteenth day of this month at evening you shall keep it in its appointed season according to all its statutes and according to all its ordinances you shall keep it

search.text: Moshe spoke to the children of Israel, that they should keep the Passover.
search.searchText: numbers 9 4 moshe spoke to the children of israel that they should keep the passover

search.text: They kept the Passover in the first month, on the fourteenth day of the month, at evening, in the wilderness of Sinai. According to all that YHWH commanded Moshe, so the children of Israel did.
search.searchText: numbers 9 5 they kept the passover in the first month on the fourteenth day of the month at evening in the wilderness of sinai according to all that yhwh commanded moshe so the children of israel did

search.text: There were certain men, who were unclean because of the dead body of a person, so that they could not keep the Passover on that day, and they came before Moshe and before Aharon on that day.
search.searchText: numbers 9 6 there were certain men who were unclean because of the dead body of a person so that they could not keep the passover on that day and they came before moshe and before aharon on that day

search.text: Those men said to him, "We are unclean because of the dead body of a person. Why are we kept back, that we may not offer the offering of YHWH in its appointed season among the children of Israel?"
search.searchText: numbers 9 7 those men said to him we are unclean because of the dead body of a person why are we kept back that we may not offer the offering of yhwh in its appointed season among the children of israel

search.text: Moshe answered them, "Wait, that I may hear what YHWH will command concerning you."
search.searchText: numbers 9 8 moshe answered them wait that i may hear what yhwh will command concerning you

search.text: YHWH spoke to Moshe, saying,
search.searchText: numbers 9 9 yhwh spoke to moshe saying

search.text: "Say to the children of Israel, 'If anyone of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body, or is on a journey far away, they shall still keep the Passover to YHWH.
search.searchText: numbers 9 10 say to the children of israel if anyone of you or of your generations is unclean by reason of a dead body or is on a journey far away they shall still keep the passover to yhwh

search.text: In the second month, on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it; they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs.
search.searchText: numbers 9 11 in the second month on the fourteenth day at evening they shall keep it they shall eat it with unleavened bread and bitter herbs

search.text: They shall leave none of it until the morning, nor break a bone of it. According to all the statute of the Passover they shall keep it.
search.searchText: numbers 9 12 they shall leave none of it until the morning nor break a bone of it according to all the statute of the passover they shall keep it

search.text: But the one who is clean, and is not on a journey, and fails to keep the Passover, that soul shall be cut off from their people. Because he didn't offer the offering of YHWH in its appointed season, that man shall bear his sin.
search.searchText: numbers 9 13 but the one who is clean and is not on a journey and fails to keep the passover that soul shall be cut off from their people because he didn t offer the offering of yhwh in its appointed season that man shall bear his sin

search.text: If a foreigner lives among you, and desires to keep the Passover to YHWH; according to the statute of the Passover, and according to its ordinance, so shall he do. You shall have one statute, both for the foreigner, and for the one who is born in the land.'"
search.searchText: numbers 9 14 if a foreigner lives among you and desires to keep the passover to yhwh according to the statute of the passover and according to its ordinance so shall he do you shall have one statute both for the foreigner and for the one who is born in the land

search.text: On the day that the tabernacle was raised up, the cloud covered the tabernacle, even the Tent of the Testimony: and at evening it was over the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire, until morning.
search.searchText: numbers 9 15 on the day that the tabernacle was raised up the cloud covered the tabernacle even the tent of the testimony and at evening it was over the tabernacle as it were the appearance of fire until morning

search.text: So it was continually. The cloud covered it, and the appearance of fire by night.
search.searchText: numbers 9 16 so it was continually the cloud covered it and the appearance of fire by night

search.text: Whenever the cloud was taken up from over the Tent, then after that the children of Israel traveled; and in the place where the cloud remained, there the children of Israel encamped.
search.searchText: numbers 9 17 whenever the cloud was taken up from over the tent then after that the children of israel traveled and in the place where the cloud remained there the children of israel encamped

search.text: At the commandment of YHWH, the children of Israel traveled, and at the commandment of YHWH they encamped. As long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped.
search.searchText: numbers 9 18 at the commandment of yhwh the children of israel traveled and at the commandment of yhwh they encamped as long as the cloud remained on the tabernacle they remained encamped

search.text: When the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days, then the children of Israel kept the charge of YHWH, and didn't travel.
search.searchText: numbers 9 19 when the cloud stayed on the tabernacle many days then the children of israel kept the charge of yhwh and didn t travel

search.text: Sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle; then according to the commandment of YHWH they remained encamped, and according to the commandment of YHWH they traveled.
search.searchText: numbers 9 20 sometimes the cloud was a few days on the tabernacle then according to the commandment of yhwh they remained encamped and according to the commandment of yhwh they traveled

search.text: Sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning; and when the cloud was taken up in the morning, they traveled: or by day and by night, when the cloud was taken up, they traveled.
search.searchText: numbers 9 21 sometimes the cloud was from evening until morning and when the cloud was taken up in the morning they traveled or by day and by night when the cloud was taken up they traveled

search.text: Whether it was two days, or a month, or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle, remaining on it, the children of Israel remained encamped, and didn't travel; but when it was taken up, they traveled.
search.searchText: numbers 9 22 whether it was two days or a month or a year that the cloud stayed on the tabernacle remaining on it the children of israel remained encamped and didn t travel but when it was taken up they traveled

search.text: At the commandment of YHWH they encamped, and at the commandment of YHWH they traveled. They kept the charge of YHWH, at the commandment of YHWH by Moshe.
search.searchText: numbers 9 23 at the commandment of yhwh they encamped and at the commandment of yhwh they traveled they kept the charge of yhwh at the commandment of yhwh by moshe

search.text: YHWH spoke to Moshe, saying,
search.searchText: numbers 10 1 yhwh spoke to moshe saying

search.text: Make you two trumpets of silver; of beaten work shall you make them: and you shall use them for the calling of the congregation, and for the journeying of the camps.
search.searchText: numbers 10 2 make you two trumpets of silver of beaten work shall you make them and you shall use them for the calling of the congregation and for the journeying of the camps

search.text: When they shall blow them, all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the tent of meeting.
search.searchText: numbers 10 3 when they shall blow them all the congregation shall gather themselves to you at the door of the tent of meeting

search.text: If they blow but one, then the princes, the heads of the thousands of Israel, shall gather themselves to you.
search.searchText: numbers 10 4 if they blow but one then the princes the heads of the thousands of israel shall gather themselves to you

search.text: When you blow an alarm, the camps that lie on the east side shall take their journey.
search.searchText: numbers 10 5 when you blow an alarm the camps that lie on the east side shall take their journey

search.text: When you blow an alarm the second time, the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey: they shall blow an alarm for their journeys.
search.searchText: numbers 10 6 when you blow an alarm the second time the camps that lie on the south side shall take their journey they shall blow an alarm for their journeys

search.text: But when the assembly is to be gathered together, you shall blow, but you shall not sound an alarm.
search.searchText: numbers 10 7 but when the assembly is to be gathered together you shall blow but you shall not sound an alarm

search.text: The sons of Aharon, the priests, shall blow the trumpets; and they shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations.
search.searchText: numbers 10 8 the sons of aharon the priests shall blow the trumpets and they shall be to you for a statute forever throughout your generations

search.text: When you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you, then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets; and you shall be remembered before YHWH your God, and you shall be saved from your enemies.
search.searchText: numbers 10 9 when you go to war in your land against the adversary who oppresses you then you shall sound an alarm with the trumpets and you shall be remembered before yhwh your god and you shall be saved from your enemies

search.text: Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings, and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings; and they shall be to you for a memorial before your God: I am YHWH your God.
search.searchText: numbers 10 10 also in the day of your gladness and in your set feasts and in the beginnings of your months you shall blow the trumpets over your burnt offerings and over the sacrifices of your peace offerings and they shall be to you for a memorial before your god i am yhwh your god

search.text: It happened in the second year, in the second month, on the twentieth day of the month, that the cloud was taken up from over the tent of the testimony.
search.searchText: numbers 10 11 it happened in the second year in the second month on the twentieth day of the month that the cloud was taken up from over the tent of the testimony

search.text: The children of Israel set forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of Sinai; and the cloud abode in the wilderness of Paran.
search.searchText: numbers 10 12 the children of israel set forward according to their journeys out of the wilderness of sinai and the cloud abode in the wilderness of paran

search.text: They first took their journey according to the commandment of YHWH by Moshe.
search.searchText: numbers 10 13 they first took their journey according to the commandment of yhwh by moshe

search.text: In the first [place] the standard of the camp of the children of Yehudah set forward according to their armies: and over his army was Nachshon the son of Amminadav.
search.searchText: numbers 10 14 in the first place the standard of the camp of the children of yehudah set forward according to their armies and over his army was nachshon the son of amminadav

search.searchText: numbers 10 17 the tent was taken down and the sons of gershon and the sons of merari who bore the tent set forward

search.text: When someone vows a vow to YHWH, or swears an oath to bind their soul with a bond, they shall not break their word; he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth.
search.searchText: numbers 30 2 when someone vows a vow to yhwh or swears an oath to bind their soul with a bond they shall not break their word he shall do according to all that proceeds out of his mouth

search.text: Also when a woman vows a vow to YHWH, and binds herself by a bond, being in her father's house, in her youth,
search.searchText: numbers 30 3 also when a woman vows a vow to yhwh and binds herself by a bond being in her father s house in her youth

search.text: and her father hears her vow, and her bond with which she has bound her soul, and her father holds his peace at her; then all her vows shall stand, and every bond with which she has bound her soul shall stand.
search.searchText: numbers 30 4 and her father hears her vow and her bond with which she has bound her soul and her father holds his peace at her then all her vows shall stand and every bond with which she has bound her soul shall stand

search.text: But if her father disallow her in the day that he hears, none of her vows, or of her bonds with which she has bound her soul, shall stand: and YHWH will forgive her, because her father disallowed her.
search.searchText: numbers 30 5 but if her father disallow her in the day that he hears none of her vows or of her bonds with which she has bound her soul shall stand and yhwh will forgive her because her father disallowed her

search.text: If she be [married] to a husband, while her vows are on her, or the rash utterance of her lips, with which she has bound her soul,

search.text: and her husband hear it, and hold his peace at her in the day that he hears it; then her vows shall stand, and her bonds with which she has bound her soul shall stand.

search.text: But if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them, then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows, or concerning the bond of her soul, shall not stand: her husband has made them void; and YHWH will forgive her.
search.searchText: numbers 30 12 but if her husband made them null and void in the day that he heard them then whatever proceeded out of her lips concerning her vows or concerning the bond of her soul shall not stand her husband has made them void and yhwh will forgive her

search.text: But if her husband altogether hold his peace at her from day to day, then he establishes all her vows, or all her bonds, which are on her: he has established them, because he held his peace at her in the day that he heard them.

search.searchText: numbers 32 12 save kalev the son of jephunneh the kenizzite and yehoshua the son of nun because they have wholly followed yhwh

search.text: YHWH's anger was kindled against Israel, and YHWH made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years, until all the generation, who had done wrong in the sight of YHWH, was consumed.
search.searchText: numbers 32 13 yhwh s anger was kindled against israel and yhwh made them wander back and forth in the wilderness forty years until all the generation who had done wrong in the sight of yhwh was consumed

search.text: Behold, you are risen up in your fathers' place, an increase of sinful men, to augment yet the fierce anger of YHWH toward Israel.
search.searchText: numbers 32 14 behold you are risen up in your fathers place an increase of sinful men to augment yet the fierce anger of yhwh toward israel

search.text: For if you turn away from after him, he will yet again leave them in the wilderness; and you will destroy all this people.
search.searchText: numbers 32 15 for if you turn away from after him he will yet again leave them in the wilderness and you will destroy all this people

search.text: They came near to him, and said, We will build sheepfolds here for our livestock, and cities for our little ones:
search.searchText: numbers 32 16 they came near to him and said we will build sheepfolds here for our livestock and cities for our little ones

search.text: but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of Israel, until we have brought them to their place: and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land.
search.searchText: numbers 32 17 but we ourselves will be ready armed to go before the children of israel until we have brought them to their place and our little ones shall dwell in the fortified cities because of the inhabitants of the land

search.text: We will not return to our houses, until the children of Israel have inherited everyone their inheritance.
search.searchText: numbers 32 18 we will not return to our houses until the children of israel have inherited everyone their inheritance

search.text: For we will not inherit with them on the other side of the Yarden, and forward; because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side of the Yarden eastward.
search.searchText: numbers 32 19 for we will not inherit with them on the other side of the yarden and forward because our inheritance is fallen to us on this side of the yarden eastward

search.text: Moshe said to them, If you will do this thing, if you will arm yourselves to go before YHWH to the war,
search.searchText: numbers 32 20 moshe said to them if you will do this thing if you will arm yourselves to go before yhwh to the war

search.text: and every armed man of you will pass over the Yarden before YHWH, until YHWH has driven out YHWH’s enemies from before YHWH,
search.searchText: numbers 32 21 and every armed man of you will pass over the yarden before yhwh until yhwh has driven out yhwh s enemies from before yhwh

search.text: and the land is subdued before YHWH; then afterward you shall return, and be guiltless towards YHWH, and towards Israel; and this land shall be to you for a possession before YHWH.
search.searchText: numbers 32 22 and the land is subdued before yhwh then afterward you shall return and be guiltless towards yhwh and towards israel and this land shall be to you for a possession before yhwh

search.text: But if you will not do so, behold, you have sinned against YHWH; and be sure your sin will find you out.
search.searchText: numbers 32 23 but if you will not do so behold you have sinned against yhwh and be sure your sin will find you out

search.text: Build you cities for your little ones, and folds for your sheep; and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth.
search.searchText: numbers 32 24 build you cities for your little ones and folds for your sheep and do that which has proceeded out of your mouth

search.text: The children of Gad and the children of Reuven spoke to Moshe, saying, Your servants will do as my lord commands.
search.searchText: numbers 32 25 the children of gad and the children of reuven spoke to moshe saying your servants will do as my lord commands

search.text: Our little ones, our wives, our flocks, and all our livestock, shall be there in the cities of Gilead;
search.searchText: numbers 32 26 our little ones our wives our flocks and all our livestock shall be there in the cities of gilead

search.text: but your servants will pass over, everyone who is armed for war, before YHWH to battle, as my lord says.
search.searchText: numbers 32 27 but your servants will pass over everyone who is armed for war before yhwh to battle as my lord says

search.text: So Moshe gave charge concerning them to Eleazar the priest, and to Yehoshua the son of Nun, and to the heads of the fathers' [houses] of the tribes of the children of Israel.
search.searchText: numbers 32 28 so moshe gave charge concerning them to eleazar the priest and to yehoshua the son of nun and to the heads of the fathers houses of the tribes of the children of israel

search.text: Moshe said to them, If the children of Gad and the children of Reuven will pass with you over the Yarden, everyone who is armed to battle, before YHWH, and the land shall be subdued before you; then you shall give them the land of Gilead for a possession:
search.searchText: numbers 32 29 moshe said to them if the children of gad and the children of reuven will pass with you over the yarden everyone who is armed to battle before yhwh and the land shall be subdued before you then you shall give them the land of gilead for a possession

search.text: but if they will not pass over with you armed, they shall have possessions among you in the land of Kena'an.
search.searchText: numbers 32 30 but if they will not pass over with you armed they shall have possessions among you in the land of kena an

search.text: The children of Gad and the children of Reuven answered, saying, As YHWH has said to your servants, so will we do.
search.searchText: numbers 32 31 the children of gad and the children of reuven answered saying as yhwh has said to your servants so will we do

search.text: We will pass over armed before YHWH into the land of Kena'an, and the possession of our inheritance [shall remain] with us beyond the Yarden.
search.searchText: numbers 32 32 we will pass over armed before yhwh into the land of kena an and the possession of our inheritance shall remain with us beyond the yarden

search.text: Moshe gave to them, even to the children of Gad, and to the children of Reuven, and to the half-tribe of Menashe the son of Yosef, the kingdom of Sihon king of the Amorites, and the kingdom of Og king of Bashan, the land, according to the cities of it with [their] borders, even the cities of the land round about.
search.searchText: numbers 32 33 moshe gave to them even to the children of gad and to the children of reuven and to the half tribe of menashe the son of yosef the kingdom of sihon king of the amorites and the kingdom of og king of bashan the land according to the cities of it with their borders even the cities of the land round about

search.text: The children of Gad built Dibon, and Ataroth, and Aroer,
search.searchText: numbers 32 34 the children of gad built dibon and ataroth and aroer

search.text: and Atrothshophan, and Jazer, and Jogbehah,
search.searchText: numbers 32 35 and atrothshophan and jazer and jogbehah

search.text: and Beit Nimrah, and Beth Haran: fortified cities, and folds for sheep.
search.searchText: numbers 32 36 and beit nimrah and beth haran fortified cities and folds for sheep

search.text: The children of Reuven built Heshbon, and Elealeh, and Kiriathaim,
search.searchText: numbers 32 37 the children of reuven built heshbon and elealeh and kiriathaim

search.text: and Nebo, and Baal Meon, (their names being changed), and Sibmah: and they gave other names to the cities which they built.
search.searchText: numbers 32 38 and nebo and baal meon their names being changed and sibmah and they gave other names to the cities which they built

search.text: The children of Machir the son of Menashe went to Gilead, and took it, and dispossessed the Amorites who were therein.
search.searchText: numbers 32 39 the children of machir the son of menashe went to gilead and took it and dispossessed the amorites who were therein

search.text: Moshe gave Gilead to Machir the son of Menashe; and he lived therein.
search.searchText: numbers 32 40 moshe gave gilead to machir the son of menashe and he lived therein

search.text: Jair the son of Menashe went and took the towns of it, and called them Havvoth Jair.
search.searchText: numbers 32 41 jair the son of menashe went and took the towns of it and called them havvoth jair

search.text: Nobah went and took Kenath, and the villages of it, and called it Nobah, after his own name.
search.searchText: numbers 32 42 nobah went and took kenath and the villages of it and called it nobah after his own name

search.text: These are the journeys of the children of Israel, when they went forth out of the land of Mitzrayim by their armies under the hand of Moshe and Aharon.
search.searchText: numbers 33 1 these are the journeys of the children of israel when they went forth out of the land of mitzrayim by their armies under the hand of moshe and aharon

search.text: Moshe wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of YHWH: and these are their journeys according to their goings out.
search.searchText: numbers 33 2 moshe wrote their goings out according to their journeys by the commandment of yhwh and these are their journeys according to their goings out

search.text: They traveled from Rameses in the first month, on the fifteenth day of the first month; on the next day after the Passover the children of Israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the Egyptians,
search.searchText: numbers 33 3 they traveled from rameses in the first month on the fifteenth day of the first month on the next day after the passover the children of israel went out with a high hand in the sight of all the egyptians

search.text: while the Egyptians were burying all their firstborn, whom YHWH had struck among them: on their gods also YHWH executed judgments.
search.searchText: numbers 33 4 while the egyptians were burying all their firstborn whom yhwh had struck among them on their gods also yhwh executed judgments

search.searchText: numbers 33 7 they traveled from etham and turned back to pihahiroth which is before baal zephon and they encamped before migdol

search.text: They traveled from before Hahiroth, and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness: and they went three days' journey in the wilderness of Etham, and encamped in Marah.
search.searchText: numbers 33 8 they traveled from before hahiroth and passed through the midst of the sea into the wilderness and they went three days journey in the wilderness of etham and encamped in marah

search.text: They traveled from Marah, and came to Elim: and in Elim were twelve springs of water, and seventy palm trees; and they encamped there.
search.searchText: numbers 33 9 they traveled from marah and came to elim and in elim were twelve springs of water and seventy palm trees and they encamped there

search.searchText: numbers 33 10 they traveled from elim and encamped by the red sea

search.searchText: numbers 33 13 they traveled from dophkah and encamped in alush

search.searchText: numbers 33 29 they traveled from mithkah and encamped in hashmonah

search.searchText: numbers 33 30 they traveled from hashmonah and encamped in moseroth

search.searchText: numbers 33 31 they traveled from moseroth and encamped in bene jaakan

search.searchText: numbers 33 32 they traveled from bene jaakan and encamped in hor haggidgad

search.text: They traveled from Hor Haggidgad, and encamped in Jotbathah.
search.searchText: numbers 33 33 they traveled from hor haggidgad and encamped in jotbathah

search.searchText: numbers 33 34 they traveled from jotbathah and encamped in abronah

search.searchText: numbers 33 35 they traveled from abronah and encamped in ezion geber

search.searchText: numbers 33 36 they traveled from ezion geber and encamped in the wilderness of zin the same is kadesh

search.searchText: numbers 33 37 they traveled from kadesh and encamped in mount hor in the edge of the land of edom

search.text: Aharon the priest went up into Mount Hor at the commandment of YHWH, and died there, in the fortieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Mitzrayim, in the fifth month, on the first day of the month.
search.searchText: numbers 33 38 aharon the priest went up into mount hor at the commandment of yhwh and died there in the fortieth year after the children of israel were come out of the land of mitzrayim in the fifth month on the first day of the month

search.searchText: numbers 33 39 aharon was one hundred twenty three years old when he died in mount hor

search.text: The Canaanite, the king of Arad, who lived in the South in the land of Kena'an, heard of the coming of the children of Israel.
search.searchText: numbers 33 40 the canaanite the king of arad who lived in the south in the land of kena an heard of the coming of the children of israel

search.searchText: numbers 33 48 they traveled from the mountains of abarim and encamped in the plains of moab by the yarden at yericho

search.searchText: numbers 33 49 they encamped by the yarden from beit hayeshimot even to abel shittim in the plains of moab

search.text: YHWH spoke to Moshe in the plains of Moab by the Yarden at Yericho, saying,
search.searchText: numbers 33 50 yhwh spoke to moshe in the plains of moab by the yarden at yericho saying

search.text: Speak to the children of Israel, and tell them, When you pass over the Yarden into the land of Kena'an,
search.searchText: numbers 33 51 speak to the children of israel and tell them when you pass over the yarden into the land of kena an

search.text: then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you, and destroy all their figured [stones], and destroy all their molten images, and demolish all their high places:
search.searchText: numbers 33 52 then you shall drive out all the inhabitants of the land from before you and destroy all their figured stones and destroy all their molten images and demolish all their high places

search.text: and you shall take possession of the land, and dwell therein; for to you have I given the land to possess it.
search.searchText: numbers 33 53 and you shall take possession of the land and dwell therein for to you have i given the land to possess it

search.text: You shall inherit the land by lot according to your families; to the more you shall give the more inheritance, and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance: wherever the lot falls to anyone, that shall be their; according to the tribes of your fathers shall you inherit.
search.searchText: numbers 33 54 you shall inherit the land by lot according to your families to the more you shall give the more inheritance and to the fewer you shall give the less inheritance wherever the lot falls to anyone that shall be their according to the tribes of your fathers shall you inherit

search.text: But if you will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you, then shall those who you let remain of them be as pricks in your eyes, and as thorns in your sides, and they shall vex you in the land in which you dwell.
search.searchText: numbers 33 55 but if you will not drive out the inhabitants of the land from before you then shall those who you let remain of them be as pricks in your eyes and as thorns in your sides and they shall vex you in the land in which you dwell

search.text: It shall happen that as I thought to do to them, so will I do to you.
search.searchText: numbers 33 56 it shall happen that as i thought to do to them so will i do to you

search.text: YHWH spoke to Moshe, saying,
search.searchText: numbers 34 1 yhwh spoke to moshe saying

search.text: Command the children of Israel, and tell them, When you come into the land of Kena'an (this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance, even the land of Kena'an according to the borders of it),
search.searchText: numbers 34 2 command the children of israel and tell them when you come into the land of kena an this is the land that shall fall to you for an inheritance even the land of kena an according to the borders of it

search.text: then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of Zin along by the side of Edom, and your south border shall be from the end of the Salt Sea eastward;
search.searchText: numbers 34 3 then your south quarter shall be from the wilderness of zin along by the side of edom and your south border shall be from the end of the salt sea eastward

search.text: and your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of Akrabbim, and pass along to Zin; and the goings out of it shall be southward of Kadesh Barnea; and it shall go forth to Hazar Addar, and pass along to Azmon;
search.searchText: numbers 34 4 and your border shall turn about southward of the ascent of akrabbim and pass along to zin and the goings out of it shall be southward of kadesh barnea and it shall go forth to hazar addar and pass along to azmon

search.text: and the border shall turn about from Azmon to the brook of Mitzrayim, and the goings out of it shall be at the sea.
search.searchText: numbers 34 5 and the border shall turn about from azmon to the brook of mitzrayim and the goings out of it shall be at the sea

search.text: For the western border, you shall have the great sea and the border [of it]: this shall be your west border.
search.searchText: numbers 34 6 for the western border you shall have the great sea and the border of it this shall be your west border

search.text: This shall be your north border: from the great sea you shall mark out for you Mount Hor;
search.searchText: numbers 34 7 this shall be your north border from the great sea you shall mark out for you mount hor

search.text: from Mount Hor you shall mark out to the entrance of Hamath; and the goings out of the border shall be at Zedad;
search.searchText: numbers 34 8 from mount hor you shall mark out to the entrance of hamath and the goings out of the border shall be at zedad

search.text: and the border shall go forth to Ziphron, and the goings out of it shall be at Hazar Enan: this shall be your north border.
search.searchText: numbers 34 9 and the border shall go forth to ziphron and the goings out of it shall be at hazar enan this shall be your north border

search.text: You shall mark out your east border from Hazar Enan to Shepham;
search.searchText: numbers 34 10 you shall mark out your east border from hazar enan to shepham

search.text: and the border shall go down from Shepham to Riblah, on the east side of Ain; and the border shall go down, and shall reach to the side of the sea of Chinnereth eastward;

search.text: and the border shall go down to the Yarden, and the goings out of it shall be at the Salt Sea. This shall be your land according to the borders of it round about.
search.searchText: numbers 34 12 and the border shall go down to the yarden and the goings out of it shall be at the salt sea this shall be your land according to the borders of it round about

search.text: Moshe commanded the children of Israel, saying, This is the land which you shall inherit by lot, which YHWH has commanded to give to the nine tribes, and to the half-tribe;
search.searchText: numbers 34 13 moshe commanded the children of israel saying this is the land which you shall inherit by lot which yhwh has commanded to give to the nine tribes and to the half tribe

search.text: for the tribe of the children of Reuven according to their fathers' houses, and the tribe of the children of Gad according to their fathers' houses, have received, and the half-tribe of Menashe have received, their inheritance:
search.searchText: numbers 34 14 for the tribe of the children of reuven according to their fathers houses and the tribe of the children of gad according to their fathers houses have received and the half tribe of menashe have received their inheritance

search.text: the two tribes and the half-tribe have received their inheritance beyond the Yarden at Yericho eastward, toward the sunrise.
search.searchText: numbers 34 15 the two tribes and the half tribe have received their inheritance beyond the yarden at yericho eastward toward the sunrise

search.searchText: numbers 34 16 yhwh spoke to moshe saying

search.searchText: numbers 34 17 these are the names of the people who shall divide the land to you for inheritance eleazar the priest and yehoshua the son of nun

search.searchText: numbers 34 18 you shall take one prince of every tribe to divide the land for inheritance

search.searchText: numbers 34 19 these are the names of the men of the tribe of yehudah kalev the son of jephunneh

search.text: Of the tribe of the children of Shim'on, Shemuel the son of Ammihud.

search.text: Of the tribe of Binyamin, Elidad the son of Chislon.

search.searchText: numbers 34 22 of the tribe of the children of dan a prince bukki the son of jogli

search.text: YHWH spoke to Moshe in the plains of Moab by the Yarden at Yericho, saying,
search.searchText: numbers 35 1 yhwh spoke to moshe in the plains of moab by the yarden at yericho saying

search.text: Command the children of Israel that they give to the Levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in; and suburbs for the cities round about them shall you give to the Levites.
search.searchText: numbers 35 2 command the children of israel that they give to the levites of the inheritance of their possession cities to dwell in and suburbs for the cities round about them shall you give to the levites

search.text: The cities shall they have to dwell in; and their suburbs shall be for their livestock, and for their substance, and for all their animals.
search.searchText: numbers 35 3 the cities shall they have to dwell in and their suburbs shall be for their livestock and for their substance and for all their animals

search.text: The suburbs of the cities, which you shall give to the Levites, shall be from the wall of the city and outward one thousand cubits round about.

search.text: The near kinsman said, I can't redeem it for myself, lest I mar my own inheritance: take my right of redemption on you; for I can't redeem it.
search.searchText: ruth 4 6 the near kinsman said i can t redeem it for myself lest i mar my own inheritance take my right of redemption on you for i can t redeem it

search.text: Now this was [the custom] in former time in Israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging, to confirm all things: a person drew off their shoe, and gave it to their neighbor; and this was the [manner of] attestation in Israel.
search.searchText: ruth 4 7 now this was the custom in former time in israel concerning redeeming and concerning exchanging to confirm all things a person drew off their shoe and gave it to their neighbor and this was the manner of attestation in israel

search.text: So the near kinsman said to Boaz, Buy it for yourself. He drew off his shoe.
search.searchText: ruth 4 8 so the near kinsman said to boaz buy it for yourself he drew off his shoe

search.text: Boaz said to the elders, and to all the people, You are witnesses this day, that I have bought all that was Elimelech's, and all that was Chilion's and Mahlon's, of the hand of Naomi.
search.searchText: ruth 4 9 boaz said to the elders and to all the people you are witnesses this day that i have bought all that was elimelech s and all that was chilion s and mahlon s of the hand of naomi

search.text: Moreover Rut the Moabitess, the wife of Mahlon, have I purchased to be my wife, to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance, that the name of the dead not be cut off from among his brothers, and from the gate of his place: you are witnesses this day.
search.searchText: ruth 4 10 moreover rut the moabitess the wife of mahlon have i purchased to be my wife to raise up the name of the dead on his inheritance that the name of the dead not be cut off from among his brothers and from the gate of his place you are witnesses this day

search.text: All the people who were in the gate, and the elders, said, We are witnesses. YHWH make the woman who has come into your house like Rakhel and like Leah, which two built the house of Israel: and do you worthily in Ephrathah, and be famous in Beit Lechem:

search.text: and let your house be like the house of Peretz, whom Tamar bore to Yehudah, of the seed which YHWH shall give you of this young woman.

search.text: The women said to Naomi, Blessed be YHWH, who has not left you this day without a near kinsman; and let his name be famous in Israel.

search.text: He shall be to you a restorer of life, and sustain you in your old age, for your daughter-in-law, who loves you, who is better to you than seven sons, has borne him.
search.searchText: ruth 4 15 he shall be to you a restorer of life and sustain you in your old age for your daughter in law who loves you who is better to you than seven sons has borne him

search.text: Now there was a certain man of Ramathaim Zophim, of the hill country of Efrayim, and his name was Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Elihu, the son of Tohu, the son of Zuph, an Ephraimite:

search.text: and he had two wives; the name of the one was Hannah, and the name of other Peninnah: and Peninnah had children, but Hannah had no children.

search.text: She vowed a vow, and said, YHWH of Armies, if you will indeed look on the affliction of your handmaid, and remember me, and not forget your handmaid, but will give to your handmaid a boy, then I will give him to YHWH all the days of his life, and there shall no razor come on his head.

search.searchText: 1 samuel 1 17 then eli answered go in peace and the god of israel grant your petition that you have asked of him

search.text: For I have told him that I will judge his house forever, for the iniquity which he knew, because his sons did bring a curse on themselves, and he didn't restrain them.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 3 13 for i have told him that i will judge his house forever for the iniquity which he knew because his sons did bring a curse on themselves and he didn t restrain them

search.text: He said, "What is the thing that [YHWH] has spoken to you? Please don't hide it from me. Elohim do so to you, and more also, if you hide anything from me of all the things that he spoke to you."

search.text: When the people were come into the camp, the elders of Israel said, Why has YHWH struck us today before the Philistines? Let us get the ark of the covenant of YHWH out of Shilo to us, that it may come among us, and save us out of the hand of our enemies.

search.text: It happened, when he made mention of the ark of Elohim, that [Eli] fell from off his seat backward by the side of the gate; and his neck broke, and he died: for he was an old man, and heavy. He had judged Israel forty years.

search.text: His daughter-in-law, Pinchas' wife, was with child, near to be delivered: and when she heard the news that the ark of Elohim was taken, and that her father-in-law and her husband were dead, she bowed herself and brought forth; for her pains came on her.

For there was a deadly confusion throughout all the city; the hand of Elohim was very heavy there.
