search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 1 it happened when shmuel was old that he made his sons judges over israel

search.text: Now the name of his firstborn was Joel; and the name of his second, Aviyah: they were judges in Be'er Sheva.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 2 now the name of his firstborn was joel and the name of his second aviyah they were judges in be er sheva

search.text: His sons didn't walk in his ways, but turned aside after lucre, and took bribes, and perverted justice.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 3 his sons didn t walk in his ways but turned aside after lucre and took bribes and perverted justice

search.text: Then all the elders of Israel gathered themselves together, and came to Shmuel to Ramah;
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 4 then all the elders of israel gathered themselves together and came to shmuel to ramah

search.text: and they said to him, Behold, you are old, and your sons don't walk in your ways: now make us a king to judge us like all the nations.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 5 and they said to him behold you are old and your sons don t walk in your ways now make us a king to judge us like all the nations

search.text: But the thing displeased Shmuel, when they said, Give us a king to judge us. Shmuel prayed to YHWH.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 6 but the thing displeased shmuel when they said give us a king to judge us shmuel prayed to yhwh

search.text: YHWH said to Shmuel, Listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you; for they have not rejected you, but they have rejected me, that I should not be king over them.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 7 yhwh said to shmuel listen to the voice of the people in all that they tell you for they have not rejected you but they have rejected me that i should not be king over them

search.text: According to all the works which they have done since the day that I brought them up out of Mitzrayim even to this day, in that they have forsaken me, and served other gods, so do they also to you.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 8 according to all the works which they have done since the day that i brought them up out of mitzrayim even to this day in that they have forsaken me and served other gods so do they also to you

search.text: Now therefore listen to their voice: however you shall protest solemnly to them, and shall show them the manner of the king who shall reign over them.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 9 now therefore listen to their voice however you shall protest solemnly to them and shall show them the manner of the king who shall reign over them

search.text: Shmuel told all the words of YHWH to the people who asked of him a king.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 10 shmuel told all the words of yhwh to the people who asked of him a king

search.text: He said, This will be the manner of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons, and appoint them to him, for his chariots, and to be his horsemen; and they shall run before his chariots;
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 11 he said this will be the manner of the king who shall reign over you he will take your sons and appoint them to him for his chariots and to be his horsemen and they shall run before his chariots

search.text: and he will appoint them to him for captains of thousands, and captains of fifties; and [he will set some] to plow his ground, and to reap his harvest, and to make his instruments of war, and the instruments of his chariots.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 12 and he will appoint them to him for captains of thousands and captains of fifties and he will set some to plow his ground and to reap his harvest and to make his instruments of war and the instruments of his chariots

search.text: He will take your daughters to be perfumers, and to be cooks, and to be bakers.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 13 he will take your daughters to be perfumers and to be cooks and to be bakers

search.text: He will take your fields, and your vineyards, and your olive groves, even the best of them, and give them to his servants.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 14 he will take your fields and your vineyards and your olive groves even the best of them and give them to his servants

search.text: He will take the tenth of your seed, and of your vineyards, and give to his officers, and to his servants.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 15 he will take the tenth of your seed and of your vineyards and give to his officers and to his servants

search.text: He will take your male servants, and your female servants, and your best young people, and your donkeys, and put them to his work.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 16 he will take your male servants and your female servants and your best young people and your donkeys and put them to his work

search.text: He will take the tenth of your flocks: and you shall be his servants.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 17 he will take the tenth of your flocks and you shall be his servants

search.text: You shall cry out in that day because of your king whom you shall have chosen you; and YHWH will not answer you in that day.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 18 you shall cry out in that day because of your king whom you shall have chosen you and yhwh will not answer you in that day

search.text: But the people refused to listen to the voice of Shmuel; and they said, No: but we will have a king over us,
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 19 but the people refused to listen to the voice of shmuel and they said no but we will have a king over us

search.text: that we also may be like all the nations, and that our king may judge us, and go out before us, and fight our battles.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 20 that we also may be like all the nations and that our king may judge us and go out before us and fight our battles

search.text: Shmuel heard all the words of the people, and he rehearsed them in the ears of YHWH.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 21 shmuel heard all the words of the people and he rehearsed them in the ears of yhwh

search.text: YHWH said to Shmuel, Listen to their voice, and make them a king. Shmuel said to the people of Israel, Go you everyone to their city.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 8 22 yhwh said to shmuel listen to their voice and make them a king shmuel said to the people of israel go you everyone to their city

search.text: Now there was a person of Binyamin, whose name was Kish, the son of Abiel, the son of Zeror, the son of Becorath, the son of Aphiah, the son of a Benjamite, a mighty man of valor.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 1 now there was a person of binyamin whose name was kish the son of abiel the son of zeror the son of becorath the son of aphiah the son of a benjamite a mighty man of valor

search.text: He had a son, whose name was Shaul, an impressive young person; and there was not among the children of Israel a better person than he. From his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 2 he had a son whose name was shaul an impressive young person and there was not among the children of israel a better person than he from his shoulders and upward he was higher than any of the people

search.text: The donkeys of Kish, Shaul's father, were lost. Kish said to Shaul his son, Take now one of the servants with you, and arise, go seek the donkeys.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 3 the donkeys of kish shaul s father were lost kish said to shaul his son take now one of the servants with you and arise go seek the donkeys

search.text: He passed through the hill country of Efrayim, and passed through the land of Shalishah, but they didn't find them: then they passed through the land of Shaalim, and there they weren't there: and he passed through the land of the Benjamites, but they didn't find them.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 4 he passed through the hill country of efrayim and passed through the land of shalishah but they didn t find them then they passed through the land of shaalim and there they weren t there and he passed through the land of the benjamites but they didn t find them

search.text: When they had come to the land of Zuph, Shaul said to his servant who was with him, Come, and let us return, lest my father leave off caring for the donkeys, and be anxious for us.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 5 when they had come to the land of zuph shaul said to his servant who was with him come and let us return lest my father leave off caring for the donkeys and be anxious for us

search.text: They said to him, See now, there is in this city a person of Elohim, and they are a person who is held in honor; all that he says comes surely to pass: now let us go there; peradventure he can tell us concerning our journey whereon we go.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 6 they said to him see now there is in this city a person of elohim and they are a person who is held in honor all that he says comes surely to pass now let us go there peradventure he can tell us concerning our journey whereon we go

search.text: Then said Shaul to their servant, But, behold, if we go, what shall we bring the person? for the bread is spent in our vessels, and there is not a present to bring to the person of Elohim: what have we?
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 7 then said shaul to their servant but behold if we go what shall we bring the person for the bread is spent in our vessels and there is not a present to bring to the person of elohim what have we

search.text: The servant answered Shaul again, and said, Behold, I have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver: that will I give to the person of Elohim, to tell us our way.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 8 the servant answered shaul again and said behold i have in my hand the fourth part of a shekel of silver that will i give to the person of elohim to tell us our way

search.text: (In earlier times in Israel, when someone went to inquire of Elohim, thus they said, Come, and let us go to the seer; for the one who is now called a Prophet was before called a Seer.)
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 9 in earlier times in israel when someone went to inquire of elohim thus they said come and let us go to the seer for the one who is now called a prophet was before called a seer

search.text: Then said Shaul to his servant, Well said; come, let us go. So they went to the city where the person of Elohim was.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 10 then said shaul to his servant well said come let us go so they went to the city where the person of elohim was

search.text: As they went up the ascent to the city, they found young maidens going out to draw water, and said to them, Is the seer here?
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 11 as they went up the ascent to the city they found young maidens going out to draw water and said to them is the seer here

search.text: They answered them, and said, He is; behold, [he is] before you: make haste now, for he is come today into the city; for the people have a sacrifice today in the high place:
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 12 they answered them and said he is behold he is before you make haste now for he is come today into the city for the people have a sacrifice today in the high place

search.text: as soon as you are come into the city, you shall immediately find him, before he goes up to the high place to eat; for the people will not eat until he come, because he does bless the sacrifice; [and] afterwards they eat who are invited. Now therefore get you up; for at this time you shall find him.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 13 as soon as you are come into the city you shall immediately find him before he goes up to the high place to eat for the people will not eat until he come because he does bless the sacrifice and afterwards they eat who are invited now therefore get you up for at this time you shall find him

search.text: They went up to the city; [and] as they came within the city, behold, Shmuel came out toward them, to go up to the high place.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 14 they went up to the city and as they came within the city behold shmuel came out toward them to go up to the high place

search.text: Now YHWH had revealed to Shmuel a day before Shaul came, saying,
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 15 now yhwh had revealed to shmuel a day before shaul came saying

search.text: Tomorrow about this time I will send you a person out of the land of Binyamin, and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people Israel; and he shall save my people out of the hand of the Philistines: for I have looked on my people, because their cry is come to me.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 16 tomorrow about this time i will send you a person out of the land of binyamin and you shall anoint him to be prince over my people israel and he shall save my people out of the hand of the philistines for i have looked on my people because their cry is come to me

search.text: When Shmuel saw Shaul, YHWH said to him, Behold, the person of whom I spoke to you! this same shall have authority over my people.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 17 when shmuel saw shaul yhwh said to him behold the person of whom i spoke to you this same shall have authority over my people

search.text: Then Shaul drew near to Shmuel in the gate, and said, Tell me, Please, where the seer's house is.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 18 then shaul drew near to shmuel in the gate and said tell me please where the seer s house is

search.text: Shmuel answered Shaul, and said, I am the seer; go up before me to the high place, for you shall eat with me today: and in the morning I will let you go, and will tell you all that is in your heart.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 19 shmuel answered shaul and said i am the seer go up before me to the high place for you shall eat with me today and in the morning i will let you go and will tell you all that is in your heart

search.text: As for your donkeys who were lost three days ago, don't set your mind on them; for they are found. For whom is all that is desirable in Israel? Is it not for you, and for all your father's house?
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 20 as for your donkeys who were lost three days ago don t set your mind on them for they are found for whom is all that is desirable in israel is it not for you and for all your father s house

search.text: Shaul answered, Am I not a Benjamite, of the smallest of the tribes of Israel? and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of Binyamin? why then speak you to me after this manner?
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 21 shaul answered am i not a benjamite of the smallest of the tribes of israel and my family the least of all the families of the tribe of binyamin why then speak you to me after this manner

search.text: Shmuel took Shaul and his servant, and brought them into the guest room, and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited, who were about thirty persons.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 22 shmuel took shaul and his servant and brought them into the guest room and made them sit in the best place among those who were invited who were about thirty persons

search.text: Shmuel said to the cook, Bring the portion which I gave you, of which I said to you, Set it by you.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 23 shmuel said to the cook bring the portion which i gave you of which i said to you set it by you

search.text: The cook took up the thigh, and that which was on it, and set it before Shaul. [Shmuel] said, Behold, that which has been reserved! set it before you and eat; because to the appointed time has it been kept for you, for I said, I have invited the people. So Shaul ate with Shmuel that day.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 24 the cook took up the thigh and that which was on it and set it before shaul shmuel said behold that which has been reserved set it before you and eat because to the appointed time has it been kept for you for i said i have invited the people so shaul ate with shmuel that day

search.text: When they were come down from the high place into the city, he talked with Shaul on the housetop.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 25 when they were come down from the high place into the city he talked with shaul on the housetop

search.text: They arose early: and it happened about the spring of the day, that Shmuel called to Shaul on the housetop, saying, Up, that I may send you away. Shaul arose, and they went out both of them, he and Shmuel, abroad.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 26 they arose early and it happened about the spring of the day that shmuel called to shaul on the housetop saying up that i may send you away shaul arose and they went out both of them he and shmuel abroad

search.text: As they were going down at the end of the city, Shmuel said to Shaul, Bid the servant pass on before us (and he passed on), but stand you still first, that I may cause you to hear the word of Elohim.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 9 27 as they were going down at the end of the city shmuel said to shaul bid the servant pass on before us and he passed on but stand you still first that i may cause you to hear the word of elohim

search.text: Then Shmuel took the vial of oil, and poured it on his head, and kissed him, and said, Isn't it that YHWH has anointed you to be prince over YHWH’s inheritance?
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 1 then shmuel took the vial of oil and poured it on his head and kissed him and said isn t it that yhwh has anointed you to be prince over yhwh s inheritance

search.text: When you are departed from me today, then you shall find two men by Rakhel's tomb, in the border of Binyamin at Zelzah; and they will tell you, The donkeys which you went to seek are found; and behold, your father has left off caring for the donkeys, and is anxious for you, saying, What shall I do for my son?
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 2 when you are departed from me today then you shall find two men by rakhel s tomb in the border of binyamin at zelzah and they will tell you the donkeys which you went to seek are found and behold your father has left off caring for the donkeys and is anxious for you saying what shall i do for my son

search.text: Then shall you go on forward from there, and you shall come to the oak of Tabor; and there shall meet you there three men going up to Elohim to Beit El, one carrying three kids, and another carrying three loaves of bread, and another carrying a bottle of wine:
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 3 then shall you go on forward from there and you shall come to the oak of tabor and there shall meet you there three men going up to elohim to beit el one carrying three kids and another carrying three loaves of bread and another carrying a bottle of wine

search.text: and they will greet you, and give you two loaves of bread, which you shall receive of their hand.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 4 and they will greet you and give you two loaves of bread which you shall receive of their hand

search.text: After that you shall come to the hill of Elohim, where is the garrison of the Philistines: and it shall happen, when you are come there to the city, that you shall meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery, and a tambourine, and a pipe, and a harp, before them; and they will be prophesying:
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 5 after that you shall come to the hill of elohim where is the garrison of the philistines and it shall happen when you are come there to the city that you shall meet a band of prophets coming down from the high place with a psaltery and a tambourine and a pipe and a harp before them and they will be prophesying

search.text: and the Ruach of YHWH will come mightily on you, and you shall prophesy with them, and shall be turned into another man.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 6 and the ruach of yhwh will come mightily on you and you shall prophesy with them and shall be turned into another man

search.text: Let it be, when these signs are come to you, that you do as occasion shall serve you; for Elohim is with you.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 7 let it be when these signs are come to you that you do as occasion shall serve you for elohim is with you

search.text: You shall go down before me to Gilgal; and behold, I will come down to you, to offer burnt offerings, and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings: seven days shall you wait, until I come to you, and show you what you shall do.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 8 you shall go down before me to gilgal and behold i will come down to you to offer burnt offerings and to sacrifice sacrifices of peace offerings seven days shall you wait until i come to you and show you what you shall do

search.text: It was so, that when he had turned his back to go from Shmuel, Elohim gave him another heart: and all those signs happened that day.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 9 it was so that when he had turned his back to go from shmuel elohim gave him another heart and all those signs happened that day

search.text: When they came there to the hill, behold, a band of prophets met him; and the Ruach of Elohim came mightily on him, and he prophesied among them.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 10 when they came there to the hill behold a band of prophets met him and the ruach of elohim came mightily on him and he prophesied among them

search.text: It happened, when all who knew him before saw that, behold, he prophesied with the prophets, then the people said one to another, What is this that is come to the son of Kish? Is Shaul also among the prophets?
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 11 it happened when all who knew him before saw that behold he prophesied with the prophets then the people said one to another what is this that is come to the son of kish is shaul also among the prophets

search.text: One of the same place answered, Who is their father? Therefore it became a proverb, Is Shaul also among the prophets?
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 12 one of the same place answered who is their father therefore it became a proverb is shaul also among the prophets

search.text: When he had made an end of prophesying, he came to the high place.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 13 when he had made an end of prophesying he came to the high place

search.text: Shaul's uncle said to him and to his servant, Where went you? He said, To seek the donkeys; and when we saw that they were not found, we came to Shmuel.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 14 shaul s uncle said to him and to his servant where went you he said to seek the donkeys and when we saw that they were not found we came to shmuel

search.text: Shaul's uncle said, Tell me, Please, what Shmuel said to you.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 15 shaul s uncle said tell me please what shmuel said to you

search.text: Shaul said to his uncle, He told us plainly that the donkeys were found. But concerning the matter of the kingdom, of which Shmuel spoke, he didn't tell him.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 16 shaul said to his uncle he told us plainly that the donkeys were found but concerning the matter of the kingdom of which shmuel spoke he didn t tell him

search.text: Shmuel called the people together to YHWH to Mizpah;
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 17 shmuel called the people together to yhwh to mizpah

search.text: and he said to the children of Israel, Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, I brought up Israel out of Mitzrayim, and I delivered you out of the hand of the Egyptians, and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you:
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 18 and he said to the children of israel thus says yhwh the god of israel i brought up israel out of mitzrayim and i delivered you out of the hand of the egyptians and out of the hand of all the kingdoms that oppressed you

search.text: but you have this day rejected your God, who saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses; and you have said to YHWH, [No], but set a king over us. Now therefore present yourselves before YHWH by your tribes, and by your thousands.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 19 but you have this day rejected your god who saves you out of all your calamities and your distresses and you have said to yhwh no but set a king over us now therefore present yourselves before yhwh by your tribes and by your thousands

search.text: So Shmuel brought all the tribes of Israel near, and the tribe of Binyamin was taken.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 20 so shmuel brought all the tribes of israel near and the tribe of binyamin was taken

search.text: He brought the tribe of Binyamin near by their families; and the family of the Matrites was taken; and Shaul the son of Kish was taken: but when they sought him, he could not be found.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 21 he brought the tribe of binyamin near by their families and the family of the matrites was taken and shaul the son of kish was taken but when they sought him he could not be found

search.text: Therefore they asked of YHWH further, Is there yet a person to come here? YHWH answered, Behold, he has hid himself among the baggage.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 22 therefore they asked of yhwh further is there yet a person to come here yhwh answered behold he has hid himself among the baggage

search.text: They ran and fetched him there; and when he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 23 they ran and fetched him there and when he stood among the people he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and upward

search.text: Shmuel said to all the people, "You see the one whom YHWH has chosen, that there is none like him among all the people?" All the people shouted, and said, [Long] live the king.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 24 shmuel said to all the people you see the one whom yhwh has chosen that there is none like him among all the people all the people shouted and said long live the king

search.text: Then Shmuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before YHWH. Shmuel sent all the people away, everyone to their house.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 25 then shmuel told the people the manner of the kingdom and wrote it in a book and laid it up before yhwh shmuel sent all the people away everyone to their house

search.text: Shaul also went to his house to Gibeah; and there went with him the army, whose hearts Elohim had touched.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 26 shaul also went to his house to gibeah and there went with him the army whose hearts elohim had touched

search.text: But certain worthless fellows said, How shall this man save us? They despised him, and brought him no present. But he held his peace.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 10 27 but certain worthless fellows said how shall this man save us they despised him and brought him no present but he held his peace

search.text: Then Nahash the Ammonite came up, and encamped against Jabesh Gilead: and all the men of Jabesh said to Nahash, Make a covenant with us, and we will serve you.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 11 1 then nahash the ammonite came up and encamped against jabesh gilead and all the men of jabesh said to nahash make a covenant with us and we will serve you

search.text: Nahash the Ammonite said to them, On this condition will I make it with you, that all your right eyes be put out; and I will lay it for a reproach on all Israel.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 11 2 nahash the ammonite said to them on this condition will i make it with you that all your right eyes be put out and i will lay it for a reproach on all israel

search.text: The elders of Jabesh said to him, Give us seven days' respite, that we may send messengers to all the borders of Israel; and then, if there be none to save us, we will come out to you.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 11 3 the elders of jabesh said to him give us seven days respite that we may send messengers to all the borders of israel and then if there be none to save us we will come out to you

search.text: Then came the messengers to Gibeah of Shaul, and spoke these words in the ears of the people: and all the people lifted up their voice, and wept.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 11 4 then came the messengers to gibeah of shaul and spoke these words in the ears of the people and all the people lifted up their voice and wept

search.text: Behold, Shaul came following the oxen out of the field; and Shaul said, What ails the people that they weep? They told him the words of the men of Jabesh.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 11 5 behold shaul came following the oxen out of the field and shaul said what ails the people that they weep they told him the words of the men of jabesh

search.text: The Ruach of Elohim came mightily on Shaul when he heard those words, and his anger was kindled greatly.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 11 6 the ruach of elohim came mightily on shaul when he heard those words and his anger was kindled greatly

search.text: They took a yoke of oxen, and cut them in pieces, and sent them throughout all the borders of Israel by the hand of messengers, saying, Whoever doesn't come forth after Shaul and after Shmuel, so shall it be done to their oxen. The dread of YHWH fell on the people, and they came out as one man.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 11 7 they took a yoke of oxen and cut them in pieces and sent them throughout all the borders of israel by the hand of messengers saying whoever doesn t come forth after shaul and after shmuel so shall it be done to their oxen the dread of yhwh fell on the people and they came out as one man

search.text: He numbered them in Bezek; and the children of Israel were three hundred thousand, and the people of Yehudah thirty thousand.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 11 8 he numbered them in bezek and the children of israel were three hundred thousand and the people of yehudah thirty thousand

search.text: They said to the messengers who came, Thus shall you tell the men of Jabesh Gilead, Tomorrow, by the time the sun is hot, you shall have deliverance. The messengers came and told the men of Jabesh; and they were glad.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 11 9 they said to the messengers who came thus shall you tell the men of jabesh gilead tomorrow by the time the sun is hot you shall have deliverance the messengers came and told the men of jabesh and they were glad

search.text: Therefore the men of Jabesh said, Tomorrow we will come out to you, and you shall do with us all that seems good to you.
