search.text: Then Achish called Dawid, and said to him, As YHWH lives, you have been upright, and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight; for I have not found wrongdoing in you since the day of your coming to me to this day: nevertheless the lords don't favor you.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 29 6 then achish called dawid and said to him as yhwh lives you have been upright and your going out and your coming in with me in the army is good in my sight for i have not found wrongdoing in you since the day of your coming to me to this day nevertheless the lords don t favor you

search.text: Therefore now return, and go in peace, that you not displease the lords of the Philistines.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 29 7 therefore now return and go in peace that you not displease the lords of the philistines

search.text: Dawid said to Achish, But what have I done? and what have you found in your servant so long as I have been before you to this day, that I may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king?
search.searchText: 1 samuel 29 8 dawid said to achish but what have i done and what have you found in your servant so long as i have been before you to this day that i may not go and fight against the enemies of my lord the king

search.text: Achish answered Dawid, I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of Elohim: notwithstanding the princes of the Philistines have said, He shall not go up with us to the battle.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 29 9 achish answered dawid i know that you are good in my sight as an angel of elohim notwithstanding the princes of the philistines have said he shall not go up with us to the battle

search.text: Therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you; and as soon as you are up early in the morning, and have light, depart.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 29 10 therefore now rise up early in the morning with the servants of your lord who have come with you and as soon as you are up early in the morning and have light depart

search.text: So Dawid rose up early, he and his men, to depart in the morning, to return into the land of the Philistines. The Philistines went up to Jezreel.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 29 11 so dawid rose up early he and his men to depart in the morning to return into the land of the philistines the philistines went up to jezreel

search.text: It happened, when Dawid and his men were come to Ziklag on the third day, that the Amalekites had made a raid on the South, and on Ziklag, and had struck Ziklag, and burned it with fire,
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 1 it happened when dawid and his men were come to ziklag on the third day that the amalekites had made a raid on the south and on ziklag and had struck ziklag and burned it with fire

search.text: and had taken captive the women [and all] who were therein, both small and great: they didn't kill any, but carried them off, and went their way.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 2 and had taken captive the women and all who were therein both small and great they didn t kill any but carried them off and went their way

search.text: When Dawid and his men came to the city, behold, it was burned with fire; and their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, were taken captive.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 3 when dawid and his men came to the city behold it was burned with fire and their wives and their sons and their daughters were taken captive

search.text: Then Dawid and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept, until they had no more power to weep.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 4 then dawid and the people who were with him lifted up their voice and wept until they had no more power to weep

search.text: Dawid's two wives were taken captive, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 5 dawid s two wives were taken captive ahinoam the jezreelitess and abigail the wife of nabal the carmelite

search.text: Dawid was greatly distressed; for the people spoke of stoning him, because the soul of all the people was grieved, everyone for their sons and for their daughters: but Dawid strengthened themselves in YHWH their God.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 6 dawid was greatly distressed for the people spoke of stoning him because the soul of all the people was grieved everyone for their sons and for their daughters but dawid strengthened themselves in yhwh their god

search.text: Dawid said to Evyatar the priest, the son of Ahimelech, Please bring me here the ephod. Evyatar brought there the ephod to Dawid.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 7 dawid said to evyatar the priest the son of ahimelech please bring me here the ephod evyatar brought there the ephod to dawid

search.text: Dawid inquired of YHWH, saying, If I pursue after this troop, shall I overtake them? YHWH answered him, Pursue; for you shall surely overtake [them], and shall without fail recover [all].
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 8 dawid inquired of yhwh saying if i pursue after this troop shall i overtake them yhwh answered him pursue for you shall surely overtake them and shall without fail recover all

search.text: So Dawid went, he and the six hundred people who were with him, and came to the brook Besor, where those who were left behind stayed.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 9 so dawid went he and the six hundred people who were with him and came to the brook besor where those who were left behind stayed

search.text: But Dawid pursued, he and four hundred men; for two hundred stayed behind, who were so faint that they couldn't go over the brook Besor.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 10 but dawid pursued he and four hundred men for two hundred stayed behind who were so faint that they couldn t go over the brook besor

search.text: They found an Egyptian in the field, and brought him to Dawid, and gave him bread, and he ate; and they gave him water to drink.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 11 they found an egyptian in the field and brought him to dawid and gave him bread and he ate and they gave him water to drink

search.text: They gave him a piece of a cake of figs, and two clusters of raisins: and when he had eaten, his spirit came again to him; for he had eaten no bread, nor drunk any water, three days and three nights.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 12 they gave him a piece of a cake of figs and two clusters of raisins and when he had eaten his spirit came again to him for he had eaten no bread nor drunk any water three days and three nights

search.text: Dawid said to him, To whom belong you? and whence are you? He said, I am a young person of Mitzrayim, servant to an Amalekite; and my master left me, because three days ago I fell sick.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 13 dawid said to him to whom belong you and whence are you he said i am a young person of mitzrayim servant to an amalekite and my master left me because three days ago i fell sick

search.text: We made a raid on the South of the Cherethites, and on that which belongs to Yehudah, and on the South of Kalev; and we burned Ziklag with fire.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 14 we made a raid on the south of the cherethites and on that which belongs to yehudah and on the south of kalev and we burned ziklag with fire

search.text: Dawid said to him, Will you bring me down to this troop? He said, Swear to me by Elohim, that you will neither kill me, nor deliver me up into the hands of my master, and I will bring you down to this troop.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 15 dawid said to him will you bring me down to this troop he said swear to me by elohim that you will neither kill me nor deliver me up into the hands of my master and i will bring you down to this troop

search.text: When he had brought him down, behold, they were spread abroad over all the ground, eating and drinking, and dancing, because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the Philistines, and out of the land of Yehudah.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 16 when he had brought him down behold they were spread abroad over all the ground eating and drinking and dancing because of all the great spoil that they had taken out of the land of the philistines and out of the land of yehudah

search.text: Dawid struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day: and there not a person of them escaped, except four hundred young people, who rode on camels and fled.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 17 dawid struck them from the twilight even to the evening of the next day and there not a person of them escaped except four hundred young people who rode on camels and fled

search.text: Dawid recovered all that the Amalekites had taken; and Dawid rescued his two wives.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 18 dawid recovered all that the amalekites had taken and dawid rescued his two wives

search.text: There was nothing lacking to them, neither small nor great, neither sons nor daughters, neither spoil, nor anything that they had taken to them: Dawid brought back all.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 19 there was nothing lacking to them neither small nor great neither sons nor daughters neither spoil nor anything that they had taken to them dawid brought back all

search.text: Dawid took all the flocks and the herds, [which] they drove before those [other] livestock, and said, This is Dawid's spoil.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 20 dawid took all the flocks and the herds which they drove before those other livestock and said this is dawid s spoil

search.text: Dawid came to the two hundred men, who were so faint that they could not follow Dawid, whom also they had made to abide at the brook Besor; and they went forth to meet Dawid, and to meet the people who were with him: and when Dawid came near to the people, he greeted them.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 21 dawid came to the two hundred men who were so faint that they could not follow dawid whom also they had made to abide at the brook besor and they went forth to meet dawid and to meet the people who were with him and when dawid came near to the people he greeted them

search.text: Then answered all the wicked men and base fellows, of those who went with Dawid, and said, Because they didn't go with us, we will not give them anything of the spoil that we have recovered, except to each man his wife and his children, that they may lead them away, and depart.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 22 then answered all the wicked men and base fellows of those who went with dawid and said because they didn t go with us we will not give them anything of the spoil that we have recovered except to each man his wife and his children that they may lead them away and depart

search.text: Then said Dawid, You shall not do so, my brothers, with that which YHWH has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 23 then said dawid you shall not do so my brothers with that which yhwh has given to us who has preserved us and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand

search.text: Who will listen to you in this matter? for as his share is who goes down to the battle, so shall his share be who tarries by the baggage: they shall share alike.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 24 who will listen to you in this matter for as his share is who goes down to the battle so shall his share be who tarries by the baggage they shall share alike

search.text: It was so from that day forward, that he made it a statute and an ordinance for Israel to this day.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 25 it was so from that day forward that he made it a statute and an ordinance for israel to this day

search.text: When Dawid came to Ziklag, he sent of the spoil to the elders of Yehudah, even to his friends, saying, Behold, a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of YHWH:
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 26 when dawid came to ziklag he sent of the spoil to the elders of yehudah even to his friends saying behold a present for you of the spoil of the enemies of yhwh

search.text: To those who were in Beit El, and to those who were in Ramoth of the South, and to those who were in Jattir,
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 27 to those who were in beit el and to those who were in ramoth of the south and to those who were in jattir

search.text: and to those who were in Aroer, and to those who were in Siphmoth, and to those who were in Eshtemoa,
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 28 and to those who were in aroer and to those who were in siphmoth and to those who were in eshtemoa

search.text: and to those who were in Racal, and to those who were in the cities of the Jerahmeelites, and to those who were in the cities of the Kenites,
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 29 and to those who were in racal and to those who were in the cities of the jerahmeelites and to those who were in the cities of the kenites

search.text: and to those who were in Hormah, and to those who were in Borashan, and to those who were in Athach,
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 30 and to those who were in hormah and to those who were in borashan and to those who were in athach

search.text: and to those who were in Chevron, and to all the places where Dawid himself and his men used to stay.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 30 31 and to those who were in chevron and to all the places where dawid himself and his men used to stay

search.text: Now the Philistines fought against Israel: and the people of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain on Mount Gilboa.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 1 now the philistines fought against israel and the people of israel fled from before the philistines and fell down slain on mount gilboa

search.text: The Philistines followed hard on Shaul and on his sons; and the Philistines killed Yonatan, and Abinadab, and Malchishua, the sons of Shaul.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 2 the philistines followed hard on shaul and on his sons and the philistines killed yonatan and abinadab and malchishua the sons of shaul

search.text: The battle went sore against Shaul, and the archers overtook him; and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 3 the battle went sore against shaul and the archers overtook him and he was greatly distressed by reason of the archers

search.text: Then said Shaul to his armor bearer, Draw your sword, and thrust me through therewith, lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through, and abuse me. But his armor bearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Shaul took his sword, and fell on it.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 4 then said shaul to his armor bearer draw your sword and thrust me through therewith lest these uncircumcised come and thrust me through and abuse me but his armor bearer would not for he was sore afraid therefore shaul took his sword and fell on it

search.text: When his armor bearer saw that Shaul was dead, he likewise fell on his sword, and died with him.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 5 when his armor bearer saw that shaul was dead he likewise fell on his sword and died with him

search.text: So Shaul died, and his three sons, and his armor bearer, and all his men, that same day together.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 6 so shaul died and his three sons and his armor bearer and all his men that same day together

search.text: When the people of Israel who were on the other side of the valley, and those who were beyond the Yarden, saw that the people of Israel fled, and that Shaul and his sons were dead, they forsook the cities, and fled; and the Philistines came and lived in them.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 7 when the people of israel who were on the other side of the valley and those who were beyond the yarden saw that the people of israel fled and that shaul and his sons were dead they forsook the cities and fled and the philistines came and lived in them

search.text: It happened on the next day, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Shaul and his three sons fallen on Mount Gilboa.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 8 it happened on the next day when the philistines came to strip the slain that they found shaul and his three sons fallen on mount gilboa

search.text: They cut off his head, and stripped off his armor, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry the news to the house of their idols, and to the people.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 9 they cut off his head and stripped off his armor and sent into the land of the philistines round about to carry the news to the house of their idols and to the people

search.text: They put his armor in the house of the Ashtaroth; and they fastened his body to the wall of Beit She'an.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 10 they put his armor in the house of the ashtaroth and they fastened his body to the wall of beit she an

search.text: When the inhabitants of Jabesh Gilead heard concerning him that which the Philistines had done to Shaul,
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 11 when the inhabitants of jabesh gilead heard concerning him that which the philistines had done to shaul

search.text: all the valiant men arose, and went all night, and took the body of Shaul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of Beit She'an; and they came to Jabesh, and burnt them there.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 12 all the valiant men arose and went all night and took the body of shaul and the bodies of his sons from the wall of beit she an and they came to jabesh and burnt them there

search.text: They took their bones, and buried them under the tamarisk tree in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
search.searchText: 1 samuel 31 13 they took their bones and buried them under the tamarisk tree in jabesh and fasted seven days

search.text: It happened after the death of Shaul, when Dawid was returned from the slaughter of the Amalekites, and Dawid had abode two days in Ziklag;
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 1 it happened after the death of shaul when dawid was returned from the slaughter of the amalekites and dawid had abode two days in ziklag

search.text: it happened on the third day, that behold, a person came out of the camp from Shaul, with their clothes torn, and earth on their head: and so it was, when they came to Dawid, that they fell to the earth, and did obeisance.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 2 it happened on the third day that behold a person came out of the camp from shaul with their clothes torn and earth on their head and so it was when they came to dawid that they fell to the earth and did obeisance

search.text: Dawid said to him, From whence come you? He said to him, Out of the camp of Israel am I escaped.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 3 dawid said to him from whence come you he said to him out of the camp of israel am i escaped

search.text: Dawid said to him, How went the matter? Please tell me. He answered, The people are fled from the battle, and many of the people also are fallen and dead; and Shaul and Yonatan his son are dead also.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 4 dawid said to him how went the matter please tell me he answered the people are fled from the battle and many of the people also are fallen and dead and shaul and yonatan his son are dead also

search.text: Dawid said to the young person who told him, How know you that Shaul and Yonatan their son are dead?
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 5 dawid said to the young person who told him how know you that shaul and yonatan their son are dead

search.text: The young person who told him said, As I happened by chance on Mount Gilboa, behold, Shaul was leaning on their spear; and behold, the chariots and the horsemen followed hard after him.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 6 the young person who told him said as i happened by chance on mount gilboa behold shaul was leaning on their spear and behold the chariots and the horsemen followed hard after him

search.text: When he looked behind him, he saw me, and called to me. I answered, Here am I.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 7 when he looked behind him he saw me and called to me i answered here am i

search.text: He said to me, Who are you? I answered him, I am an Amalekite.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 8 he said to me who are you i answered him i am an amalekite

search.text: He said to me, Stand, I pray you, beside me, and kill me; for anguish has taken hold of me, because my life is yet whole in me.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 9 he said to me stand i pray you beside me and kill me for anguish has taken hold of me because my life is yet whole in me

search.text: So I stood beside him, and killed him, because I was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen: and I took the crown that was on his head, and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 10 so i stood beside him and killed him because i was sure that he could not live after that he was fallen and i took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm and have brought them here to my lord

search.text: Then Dawid took hold on his clothes, and tore them; and likewise all the people who were with him:
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 11 then dawid took hold on his clothes and tore them and likewise all the people who were with him

search.text: and they mourned, and wept, and fasted until even, for Shaul, and for Yonatan his son, and for the people of YHWH, and for the house of Israel; because they were fallen by the sword.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 12 and they mourned and wept and fasted until even for shaul and for yonatan his son and for the people of yhwh and for the house of israel because they were fallen by the sword

search.text: Dawid said to the young person who told him, Whence are you? He answered, I am the son of a foreigner, an Amalekite.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 13 dawid said to the young person who told him whence are you he answered i am the son of a foreigner an amalekite

search.text: Dawid said to him, How were you not afraid to put forth your hand to destroy YHWH's anointed?
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 14 dawid said to him how were you not afraid to put forth your hand to destroy yhwh s anointed

search.text: Dawid called one of the young people, and said, Go near, and fall on him. He struck him, so that he died.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 15 dawid called one of the young people and said go near and fall on him he struck him so that he died

search.text: Dawid said to him, Your blood be on your head; for your mouth has testified against you, saying, I have slain YHWH's anointed.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 16 dawid said to him your blood be on your head for your mouth has testified against you saying i have slain yhwh s anointed

search.text: Dawid lamented with this lamentation over Shaul and over Yonatan his son
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 17 dawid lamented with this lamentation over shaul and over yonatan his son

search.text: (and he bade them teach the children of Yehudah [the song of] the bow: behold, it is written in the book of Jashar):
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 18 and he bade them teach the children of yehudah the song of the bow behold it is written in the book of jashar

search.text: Your glory, Israel, is slain on your high places! How the mighty have fallen!
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 19 your glory israel is slain on your high places how the mighty have fallen

search.text: Don't tell it in Gath. Don't publish it in the streets of Ashqelon, lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice, lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 20 don t tell it in gath don t publish it in the streets of ashqelon lest the daughters of the philistines rejoice lest the daughters of the uncircumcised triumph

search.text: You mountains of Gilboa, let there be no dew nor rain on you, neither fields of offerings; For there the shield of the mighty was vilely cast away, The shield of Shaul was not anointed with oil.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 21 you mountains of gilboa let there be no dew nor rain on you neither fields of offerings for there the shield of the mighty was vilely cast away the shield of shaul was not anointed with oil

search.text: From the blood of the slain, from the fat of the mighty, Yonatan's bow didn't turn back. Shaul's sword didn't return empty.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 22 from the blood of the slain from the fat of the mighty yonatan s bow didn t turn back shaul s sword didn t return empty

search.text: Shaul and Yonatan were lovely and pleasant in their lives. In their death, they were not divided. They were swifter than eagles. They were stronger than lions.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 23 shaul and yonatan were lovely and pleasant in their lives in their death they were not divided they were swifter than eagles they were stronger than lions

search.text: You daughters of Israel, weep over Shaul, who clothed you in scarlet delicately, who put ornaments of gold on your clothing.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 24 you daughters of israel weep over shaul who clothed you in scarlet delicately who put ornaments of gold on your clothing

search.text: How are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle! Yonatan is slain on your high places.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 25 how are the mighty fallen in the midst of the battle yonatan is slain on your high places

search.text: I am distressed for you, my brother Yonatan. You have been very pleasant to me. Your love to me was wonderful, passing the love of women.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 26 i am distressed for you my brother yonatan you have been very pleasant to me your love to me was wonderful passing the love of women

search.text: How are the mighty fallen, and the weapons of war perished!
search.searchText: 2 samuel 1 27 how are the mighty fallen and the weapons of war perished

search.text: It happened after this, that Dawid inquired of YHWH, saying, Shall I go up into any of the cities of Yehudah? YHWH said to him, Go up. Dawid said, Where shall I go up? He said, To Chevron.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 1 it happened after this that dawid inquired of yhwh saying shall i go up into any of the cities of yehudah yhwh said to him go up dawid said where shall i go up he said to chevron

search.text: So Dawid went up there, and his two wives also, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 2 so dawid went up there and his two wives also ahinoam the jezreelitess and abigail the wife of nabal the carmelite

search.text: Their people who were with him did Dawid bring up, everyone with their household: and they lived in the cities of Chevron.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 3 their people who were with him did dawid bring up everyone with their household and they lived in the cities of chevron

search.text: The people of Yehudah came, and there they anointed Dawid king over the house of Yehudah. They told Dawid, saying, The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Shaul.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 4 the people of yehudah came and there they anointed dawid king over the house of yehudah they told dawid saying the men of jabesh gilead were those who buried shaul

search.text: Dawid sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, Blessed be you of YHWH, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Shaul, and have buried him.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 5 dawid sent messengers to the men of jabesh gilead and said to them blessed be you of yhwh that you have shown this kindness to your lord even to shaul and have buried him

search.text: Now YHWH show loving kindness and truth to you: and I also will requite you this kindness, because you have done this thing.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 6 now yhwh show loving kindness and truth to you and i also will requite you this kindness because you have done this thing

search.text: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be you valiant; for Shaul your lord is dead, and also the house of Yehudah have anointed me king over them.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 7 now therefore let your hands be strong and be you valiant for shaul your lord is dead and also the house of yehudah have anointed me king over them

search.text: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Shaul's army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Shaul, and brought him over to Mahanaim;
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 8 now abner the son of ner captain of shaul s army had taken ishbosheth the son of shaul and brought him over to mahanaim

search.text: and he made him king over Gilead, and over the Ashurites, and over Jezreel, and over Efrayim, and over Binyamin, and over all Israel.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 9 and he made him king over gilead and over the ashurites and over jezreel and over efrayim and over binyamin and over all israel

search.text: Ishbosheth, Shaul's son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Yehudah followed Dawid.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 10 ishbosheth shaul s son was forty years old when he began to reign over israel and he reigned two years but the house of yehudah followed dawid

search.text: The time that Dawid was king in Chevron over the house of Yehudah was seven years and six months.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 11 the time that dawid was king in chevron over the house of yehudah was seven years and six months

search.text: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Shaul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 12 abner the son of ner and the servants of ishbosheth the son of shaul went out from mahanaim to gibeon

search.text: Yoav the son of Zeruiah, and the servants of Dawid, went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool, and the other on the other side of the pool.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 13 yoav the son of zeruiah and the servants of dawid went out and met them by the pool of gibeon and they sat down the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool

search.text: Abner said to Yoav, Please let the young people arise and play before us. Yoav said, Let them arise.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 14 abner said to yoav please let the young people arise and play before us yoav said let them arise

search.text: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Binyamin, and for Ishbosheth the son of Shaul, and twelve of the servants of Dawid.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 15 then they arose and went over by number twelve for binyamin and for ishbosheth the son of shaul and twelve of the servants of dawid

search.text: They caught everyone their fellow by the head, and [thrust] their sword in their fellow's side; so they fell down together: therefore that place was called Helkath Hazzurim, which is in Gibeon.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 16 they caught everyone their fellow by the head and thrust their sword in their fellow s side so they fell down together therefore that place was called helkath hazzurim which is in gibeon

search.text: The battle was very severe that day: and Abner was beaten, and the people of Israel, before the servants of Dawid.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 17 the battle was very severe that day and abner was beaten and the people of israel before the servants of dawid

search.text: The three sons of Zeruiah were there, Yoav, and Avishai, and Asahel: and Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 18 the three sons of zeruiah were there yoav and avishai and asahel and asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle

search.text: Asahel pursued after Abner; and in going he didn't turn to the right hand nor to the left from following Abner.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 19 asahel pursued after abner and in going he didn t turn to the right hand nor to the left from following abner

search.text: Then Abner looked behind him, and said, Is it you, Asahel? He answered, It is I.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 20 then abner looked behind him and said is it you asahel he answered it is i

search.text: Abner said to him, Turn you aside to your right hand or to your left, and lay you hold on one of the young people, and take you his armor. But Asahel would not turn aside from following him.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 21 abner said to him turn you aside to your right hand or to your left and lay you hold on one of the young people and take you his armor but asahel would not turn aside from following him

search.text: Abner said again to Asahel, Turn you aside from following me: why should I strike you to the ground? how then should I hold up my face to Yoav your brother?
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 22 abner said again to asahel turn you aside from following me why should i strike you to the ground how then should i hold up my face to yoav your brother

search.text: However he refused to turn aside: therefore Abner with the hinder end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there, and died in the same place: and it happened, that as many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 23 however he refused to turn aside therefore abner with the hinder end of the spear struck him in the body so that the spear came out behind him and he fell down there and died in the same place and it happened that as many as came to the place where asahel fell down and died stood still

search.text: But Yoav and Avishai pursued after Abner: and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 24 but yoav and avishai pursued after abner and the sun went down when they were come to the hill of ammah that lies before giah by the way of the wilderness of gibeon

search.text: The children of Binyamin gathered themselves together after Abner, and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 25 the children of binyamin gathered themselves together after abner and became one band and stood on the top of a hill

search.text: Then Abner called to Yoav, and said, "Shall the sword devour forever? Don't you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long shall it be then, before you bid the people return from following their brothers?"
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 26 then abner called to yoav and said shall the sword devour forever don t you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end how long shall it be then before you bid the people return from following their brothers

search.text: Yoav said, As Elohim lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people had gone away, nor followed everyone their brother.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 27 yoav said as elohim lives if you had not spoken surely then in the morning the people had gone away nor followed everyone their brother

search.text: So Yoav blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still, and pursued after Israel no more, neither fought they any more.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 28 so yoav blew the trumpet and all the people stood still and pursued after israel no more neither fought they any more

search.text: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Yarden, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 29 abner and his men went all that night through the arabah and they passed over the yarden and went through all bithron and came to mahanaim

search.text: Yoav returned from following Abner: and when he had gathered all the people together, there lacked of Dawid's servants nineteen men and Asahel.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 30 yoav returned from following abner and when he had gathered all the people together there lacked of dawid s servants nineteen men and asahel

search.text: But the servants of Dawid had struck of Binyamin, and of Abner's men, [so that] three hundred sixty men died.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 31 but the servants of dawid had struck of binyamin and of abner s men so that three hundred sixty men died

search.text: They took up Asahel, and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Beit Lechem. Yoav and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Chevron.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 2 32 they took up asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father which was in beit lechem yoav and his men went all night and the day broke on them at chevron

search.text: Now there was long war between the house of Shaul and the house of Dawid: and Dawid grew stronger and stronger, but the house of Shaul grew weaker and weaker.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 1 now there was long war between the house of shaul and the house of dawid and dawid grew stronger and stronger but the house of shaul grew weaker and weaker

search.text: To Dawid were sons born in Chevron: and his firstborn was Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess;
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 2 to dawid were sons born in chevron and his firstborn was amnon of ahinoam the jezreelitess

search.text: and his second, Chileab, of Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite; and the third, Avshalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur;
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 3 and his second chileab of abigail the wife of nabal the carmelite and the third avshalom the son of maacah the daughter of talmai king of geshur

search.text: and the fourth, Adoniyahu the son of Haggith; and the fifth, Shephatiah the son of Abital;
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 4 and the fourth adoniyahu the son of haggith and the fifth shephatiah the son of abital

search.text: and the sixth, Ithream, of Eglah, Dawid's wife. These were born to Dawid in Chevron.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 5 and the sixth ithream of eglah dawid s wife these were born to dawid in chevron

search.text: It happened, while there was war between the house of Shaul and the house of Dawid, that Abner made himself strong in the house of Shaul.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 6 it happened while there was war between the house of shaul and the house of dawid that abner made himself strong in the house of shaul

search.text: Now Shaul had a concubine, whose name was Rizpah, the daughter of Aiah: and [Ishbosheth] said to Abner, Why have you gone in to my father's concubine?
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 7 now shaul had a concubine whose name was rizpah the daughter of aiah and ishbosheth said to abner why have you gone in to my father s concubine

search.text: Then was Abner very angry for the words of Ishbosheth, and said, Am I a dog's head that belongs to Yehudah? This day do I show kindness to the house of Shaul your father, to his brothers, and to his friends, and have not delivered you into the hand of Dawid; and yet you charge me this day with a fault concerning this woman.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 8 then was abner very angry for the words of ishbosheth and said am i a dog s head that belongs to yehudah this day do i show kindness to the house of shaul your father to his brothers and to his friends and have not delivered you into the hand of dawid and yet you charge me this day with a fault concerning this woman

search.text: Elohim do so to Abner, and more also, if, as YHWH has sworn to Dawid, I don't do even so to him;
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 9 elohim do so to abner and more also if as yhwh has sworn to dawid i don t do even so to him

search.text: to transfer the kingdom from the house of Shaul, and to set up the throne of Dawid over Israel and over Yehudah, from Dan even to Be'er Sheva.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 10 to transfer the kingdom from the house of shaul and to set up the throne of dawid over israel and over yehudah from dan even to be er sheva

search.text: He could not answer Abner another word, because he feared him.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 11 he could not answer abner another word because he feared him

search.text: Abner sent messengers to Dawid on his behalf, saying, Whose is the land? saying [also], Make your league with me, and behold, my hand shall be with you, to bring about all Israel to you.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 12 abner sent messengers to dawid on his behalf saying whose is the land saying also make your league with me and behold my hand shall be with you to bring about all israel to you

search.text: He said, Well; I will make a league with you; but one thing I require of you: that is, you shall not see my face, except you first bring Michal, Shaul's daughter, when you come to see my face.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 13 he said well i will make a league with you but one thing i require of you that is you shall not see my face except you first bring michal shaul s daughter when you come to see my face

search.text: Dawid sent messengers to Ishbosheth, Shaul's son, saying, Deliver me my wife Michal, whom I pledged to be married to me for one hundred foreskins of the Philistines.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 14 dawid sent messengers to ishbosheth shaul s son saying deliver me my wife michal whom i pledged to be married to me for one hundred foreskins of the philistines

search.text: Ishbosheth sent, and took her from her husband, even from Paltiel the son of Laish.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 15 ishbosheth sent and took her from her husband even from paltiel the son of laish

search.text: Her husband went with her, weeping as he went, and followed her to Bahurim. Then said Abner to him, Go, return: and he returned.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 16 her husband went with her weeping as he went and followed her to bahurim then said abner to him go return and he returned

search.text: Abner had communication with the elders of Israel, saying, In times past you sought for Dawid to be king over you:
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 17 abner had communication with the elders of israel saying in times past you sought for dawid to be king over you

search.text: now then do it; for YHWH has spoken of Dawid, saying, By the hand of my servant Dawid I will save my people Israel out of the hand of the Philistines, and out of the hand of all their enemies.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 18 now then do it for yhwh has spoken of dawid saying by the hand of my servant dawid i will save my people israel out of the hand of the philistines and out of the hand of all their enemies

search.text: Abner also spoke in the ears of Binyamin: and Abner went also to speak in the ears of Dawid in Chevron all that seemed good to Israel, and to the whole house of Binyamin.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 19 abner also spoke in the ears of binyamin and abner went also to speak in the ears of dawid in chevron all that seemed good to israel and to the whole house of binyamin

search.text: So Abner came to Dawid to Chevron, and twenty men with him. Dawid made Abner and the people who were with him a feast.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 20 so abner came to dawid to chevron and twenty men with him dawid made abner and the people who were with him a feast

search.text: Abner said to Dawid, I will arise and go, and will gather all Israel to my lord the king, that they may make a covenant with you, and that you may reign over all that your soul desires. Dawid sent Abner away; and he went in peace.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 21 abner said to dawid i will arise and go and will gather all israel to my lord the king that they may make a covenant with you and that you may reign over all that your soul desires dawid sent abner away and he went in peace

search.text: Behold, the servants of Dawid and Yoav came from a foray, and brought in a great spoil with them: but Abner was not with Dawid in Chevron; for he had sent him away, and he was gone in peace.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 22 behold the servants of dawid and yoav came from a foray and brought in a great spoil with them but abner was not with dawid in chevron for he had sent him away and he was gone in peace

search.text: When Yoav and all the army who was with him had come, they told Yoav, saying, Abner the son of Ner came to the king, and he has sent him away, and he is gone in peace.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 23 when yoav and all the army who was with him had come they told yoav saying abner the son of ner came to the king and he has sent him away and he is gone in peace

search.text: Then Yoav came to the king, and said, What have you done? behold, Abner came to you; why is it that you have sent him away, and he is quite gone?
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 24 then yoav came to the king and said what have you done behold abner came to you why is it that you have sent him away and he is quite gone

search.text: You know Abner the son of Ner, that he came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all that you do.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 25 you know abner the son of ner that he came to deceive you and to know your going out and your coming in and to know all that you do

search.text: When Yoav was come out from Dawid, he sent messengers after Abner, and they brought him back from the well of Sirah: but Dawid didn't know it.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 26 when yoav was come out from dawid he sent messengers after abner and they brought him back from the well of sirah but dawid didn t know it

search.text: When Abner was returned to Chevron, Yoav took him aside into the midst of the gate to speak with him quietly, and struck him there in the body, so that he died, for the blood of Asahel his brother.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 27 when abner was returned to chevron yoav took him aside into the midst of the gate to speak with him quietly and struck him there in the body so that he died for the blood of asahel his brother

search.text: Afterward, when Dawid heard it, he said, I and my kingdom are guiltless before YHWH forever of the blood of Abner the son of Ner:
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 28 afterward when dawid heard it he said i and my kingdom are guiltless before yhwh forever of the blood of abner the son of ner

search.text: let it fall on the head of Yoav, and on all his father's house; and let there not fail from the house of Yoav one who has an issue, or who is a leper, or who leans on a staff, or who falls by the sword, or who lacks bread.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 29 let it fall on the head of yoav and on all his father s house and let there not fail from the house of yoav one who has an issue or who is a leper or who leans on a staff or who falls by the sword or who lacks bread

search.text: So Yoav and Avishai his brother killed Abner, because he had killed their brother Asahel at Gibeon in the battle.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 30 so yoav and avishai his brother killed abner because he had killed their brother asahel at gibeon in the battle

search.text: Dawid said to Yoav, and to all the people who were with him, Tear your clothes, and gird you with sackcloth, and mourn before Abner. King Dawid followed the bier.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 31 dawid said to yoav and to all the people who were with him tear your clothes and gird you with sackcloth and mourn before abner king dawid followed the bier

search.text: They buried Abner in Chevron: and the king lifted up his voice, and wept at the grave of Abner; and all the people wept.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 32 they buried abner in chevron and the king lifted up his voice and wept at the grave of abner and all the people wept

search.text: The king lamented for Abner, and said, Should Abner die as a fool dies?
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 33 the king lamented for abner and said should abner die as a fool dies

search.text: Your hands were not bound, nor your feet put into fetters. As a person falls before the children of iniquity, so you fell. All the people wept again over him.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 34 your hands were not bound nor your feet put into fetters as a person falls before the children of iniquity so you fell all the people wept again over him

search.text: All the people came to cause Dawid to eat bread while it was yet day; but Dawid swore, saying, Elohim do so to me, and more also, if I taste bread, or anything else, until the sun be down.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 35 all the people came to cause dawid to eat bread while it was yet day but dawid swore saying elohim do so to me and more also if i taste bread or anything else until the sun be down

search.text: All the people took notice of it, and it pleased them; as whatever the king did pleased all the people.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 36 all the people took notice of it and it pleased them as whatever the king did pleased all the people

search.text: So all the people and all Israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill Abner the son of Ner.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 37 so all the people and all israel understood that day that it was not of the king to kill abner the son of ner

search.text: The king said to their servants, "Don't you know that there is a prince and a great person has fallen this day in Israel?
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 38 the king said to their servants don t you know that there is a prince and a great person has fallen this day in israel

search.text: I am this day weak, though anointed king; and these men the sons of Zeruiah are too hard for me. May YHWH reward the one who does wrong according to their wickedness."
search.searchText: 2 samuel 3 39 i am this day weak though anointed king and these men the sons of zeruiah are too hard for me may yhwh reward the one who does wrong according to their wickedness

search.text: When [Ishbosheth], Shaul's son, heard that Abner was dead in Chevron, his hands became feeble, and all the Israelites were troubled.

search.text: Now Yonatan, Shaul's son, had a son who was lame of his feet. He was five years old when the news came of Shaul and Yonatan out of Jezreel; and his nurse took him up, and fled: and it happened, as she made haste to flee, that he fell, and became lame. His name was Mephibosheth.

search.text: The sons of Rimmon the Beerothite, Rechab and Baanah, went, and came about the heat of the day to the house of Ishbosheth, as he took his rest at noon.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 4 5 the sons of rimmon the beerothite rechab and baanah went and came about the heat of the day to the house of ishbosheth as he took his rest at noon

search.text: They came there into the midst of the house, as though they would have fetched wheat; and they struck him in the body: and Rechab and Baanah his brother escaped.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 4 6 they came there into the midst of the house as though they would have fetched wheat and they struck him in the body and rechab and baanah his brother escaped

search.text: They brought the head of Ishbosheth to Dawid to Chevron, and said to the king, Behold, the head of Ishbosheth, the son of Shaul, your enemy, who sought your life; and YHWH has avenged my lord the king this day of Shaul, and of his seed.

search.searchText: 2 samuel 4 11 how much more when wicked men have slain a righteous person in their own house on their bed shall i not now require their blood of your hand and take you away from the earth

search.searchText: 2 samuel 5 4 dawid was thirty years old when he began to reign and he reigned forty years

search.text: Dawid inquired of YHWH, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? will you deliver them into my hand? YHWH said to Dawid, Go up; for I will certainly deliver the Philistines into your hand.

search.searchText: 2 samuel 5 20 dawid came to baal perazim and dawid struck them there and he said yhwh has broken my enemies before me like the breach of waters therefore he called the name of that place baal perazim

search.searchText: 2 samuel 5 22 the philistines came up yet again and spread themselves in the valley of rephaim

search.text: When Dawid inquired of YHWH, he said, You shall not go up: make a circuit behind them, and come on them over against the mulberry trees.

search.text: It shall be, when you hear the sound of marching in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then you shall bestir yourself; for then is YHWH gone out before you to strike the army of the Philistines.

search.text: Dawid again gathered together all the chosen people of Israel, thirty thousand.

search.text: Dawid arose, and went with all the people who were with him, from Baale Yehudah, to bring up from there the ark of Elohim, which is called by the Name, even the name of YHWH of Armies who sits [above] the cherubim.

search.searchText: 2 samuel 6 13 it was so that when those who bore the ark of yhwh had gone six paces he sacrificed an ox and a fattened calf

search.text: Dawid danced before YHWH with all his might; and Dawid was girded with a linen ephod.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 6 14 dawid danced before yhwh with all his might and dawid was girded with a linen ephod

search.text: Then Dawid returned to bless his household. Michal the daughter of Shaul came out to meet Dawid, and said, How glorious was the king of Israel today, who uncovered himself today in the eyes of the handmaids of his servants, as one of the vain fellows shamelessly uncovers himself!

search.text: Dawid said to Michal, [It was] before YHWH, who chose me above your father, and above all his house, to appoint me prince over the people of YHWH, over Israel: therefore will I play before YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 6 21 dawid said to michal it was before yhwh who chose me above your father and above all his house to appoint me prince over the people of yhwh over israel therefore will i play before yhwh

search.searchText: 2 samuel 7 7 in all places in which i have walked with all the children of israel spoke i a word with any of the tribes of israel whom i commanded to be shepherd of my people israel saying why have you not built me a house of cedar

search.text: What can Dawid say more to you? for you know your servant, YHWH God.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 7 20 what can dawid say more to you for you know your servant yhwh god

search.text: For your word's sake, and according to your own heart, have you worked all this greatness, to make your servant know it.

search.text: What one nation in the earth is like your people, even like Israel, whom Elohim went to redeem to himself for a people, and to make him a name, and to do great things for you, and awesome things for your land, before your people, whom you redeem to you out of Mitzrayim, [from] the nations and their gods?

search.text: You did establish to yourself your people Israel to be a people to you forever; and you, YHWH, became their God.
search.searchText: 2 samuel 7 24 you did establish to yourself your people israel to be a people to you forever and you yhwh became their god

search.text: Now, YHWH Elohim, the word that you have spoken concerning your servant, and concerning his house, confirm you it forever, and do as you have spoken.

search.searchText: 2 samuel 7 27 for you yhwh of armies the god of israel have revealed to your servant saying i will build you a house therefore has your servant found in his heart to pray this prayer to you

search.text: now therefore let it please you to bless the house of your servant, that it may continue forever before you; for you, YHWH God, have spoken it: and with your blessing let the house of your servant be blessed forever.

search.text: Then the king called to Ziba, Shaul's servant, and said to him, "All that pertained to Shaul and to all his house have I given to your master's son.
