search.searchText: 1 kings 1 42 while he yet spoke behold yonatan the son of evyatar the priest came and adoniyahu said come in for you are a worthy man and bring good news

search.text: Yonatan answered Adoniyahu, Most certainly our lord king Dawid has made Shlomo king:
search.searchText: 1 kings 1 43 yonatan answered adoniyahu most certainly our lord king dawid has made shlomo king

search.text: and the king has sent with him Tzadok the priest, and Natan the prophet, and Benayahu the son of Yehoyada, and the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and they have caused him to ride on the king's mule;
search.searchText: 1 kings 1 44 and the king has sent with him tzadok the priest and natan the prophet and benayahu the son of yehoyada and the cherethites and the pelethites and they have caused him to ride on the king s mule

search.text: and Tzadok the priest and Natan the prophet have anointed him king in Gihon; and they are come up from there rejoicing, so that the city rang again. This is the noise that you have heard.
search.searchText: 1 kings 1 45 and tzadok the priest and natan the prophet have anointed him king in gihon and they are come up from there rejoicing so that the city rang again this is the noise that you have heard

search.text: Also Shlomo sits on the throne of the kingdom.
search.searchText: 1 kings 1 46 also shlomo sits on the throne of the kingdom

search.text: Moreover the king's servants came to bless our lord king Dawid, saying, your God make the name of Shlomo better than your name, and make his throne greater than your throne: and the king bowed himself on the bed.
search.searchText: 1 kings 1 47 moreover the king s servants came to bless our lord king dawid saying your god make the name of shlomo better than your name and make his throne greater than your throne and the king bowed himself on the bed

search.text: Also thus said the king, Blessed be YHWH, the God of Israel, who has given one to sit on my throne this day, my eyes even seeing it.
search.searchText: 1 kings 1 48 also thus said the king blessed be yhwh the god of israel who has given one to sit on my throne this day my eyes even seeing it

search.text: All the guests of Adoniyahu were afraid, and rose up, and went everyone their way.
search.searchText: 1 kings 1 49 all the guests of adoniyahu were afraid and rose up and went everyone their way

search.text: Adoniyahu feared because of Shlomo; and he arose, and went, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
search.searchText: 1 kings 1 50 adoniyahu feared because of shlomo and he arose and went and caught hold on the horns of the altar

search.text: It was told Shlomo, saying, Behold, Adoniyahu fears king Shlomo; for, behold, he has laid hold on the horns of the altar, saying, Let king Shlomo swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword.
search.searchText: 1 kings 1 51 it was told shlomo saying behold adoniyahu fears king shlomo for behold he has laid hold on the horns of the altar saying let king shlomo swear to me first that he will not kill his servant with the sword

search.text: Shlomo said, If he shall show himself a worthy man, there shall not a hair of him fall to the earth; but if wickedness be found in him, he shall die.
search.searchText: 1 kings 1 52 shlomo said if he shall show himself a worthy man there shall not a hair of him fall to the earth but if wickedness be found in him he shall die

search.text: So king Shlomo sent, and they brought him down from the altar. He came and did obeisance to king Shlomo; and Shlomo said to him, Go to your house.
search.searchText: 1 kings 1 53 so king shlomo sent and they brought him down from the altar he came and did obeisance to king shlomo and shlomo said to him go to your house

search.text: Now the days of Dawid drew near that he should die; and he charged Shlomo his son, saying,
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 1 now the days of dawid drew near that he should die and he charged shlomo his son saying

search.text: I am going the way of all the earth: be you strong therefore, and show yourself a person;
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 2 i am going the way of all the earth be you strong therefore and show yourself a person

search.text: and keep the charge of YHWH your God, to walk in YHWH’s ways, to keep YHWH’s statutes, [and] YHWH’s commandments, and YHWH’s ordinances, and YHWH’s testimonies, according to that which is written in the law of Moshe, that you may prosper in all that you do, and wherever you turn yourself.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 3 and keep the charge of yhwh your god to walk in yhwh s ways to keep yhwh s statutes and yhwh s commandments and yhwh s ordinances and yhwh s testimonies according to that which is written in the law of moshe that you may prosper in all that you do and wherever you turn yourself

search.text: That YHWH may establish their word which they spoke concerning me, saying, If your children take heed to their way, to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul, there shall not fail you (said they) a person on the throne of Israel.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 4 that yhwh may establish their word which they spoke concerning me saying if your children take heed to their way to walk before me in truth with all their heart and with all their soul there shall not fail you said they a person on the throne of israel

search.text: Moreover you know also what Yoav the son of Zeruiah did to me, even what he did to the two captains of the armies of Israel, to Abner the son of Ner, and to Amasa the son of Jether, whom he killed, and shed the blood of war in peace, and put the blood of war on his sash that was about his waist, and in his shoes that were on his feet.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 5 moreover you know also what yoav the son of zeruiah did to me even what he did to the two captains of the armies of israel to abner the son of ner and to amasa the son of jether whom he killed and shed the blood of war in peace and put the blood of war on his sash that was about his waist and in his shoes that were on his feet

search.text: Do therefore according to your wisdom, and don't let his gray head go down to Sheol in peace.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 6 do therefore according to your wisdom and don t let his gray head go down to sheol in peace

search.text: But show kindness to the sons of Barzillai the Gileadite, and let them be of those who eat at your table; for so they came to me when I fled from Avshalom your brother.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 7 but show kindness to the sons of barzillai the gileadite and let them be of those who eat at your table for so they came to me when i fled from avshalom your brother

search.text: Behold, there is with you Shimei the son of Gera, the Benjamite, of Bahurim, who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when I went to Mahanaim; but he came down to meet me at the Yarden, and I swore to him by YHWH, saying, I will not put you to death with the sword.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 8 behold there is with you shimei the son of gera the benjamite of bahurim who cursed me with a grievous curse in the day when i went to mahanaim but he came down to meet me at the yarden and i swore to him by yhwh saying i will not put you to death with the sword

search.text: Now therefore don't hold him guiltless, for you are a wise person; and you will know what you ought to do to him, and you shall bring his gray head down to Sheol with blood.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 9 now therefore don t hold him guiltless for you are a wise person and you will know what you ought to do to him and you shall bring his gray head down to sheol with blood

search.text: Dawid slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of Dawid.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 10 dawid slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of dawid

search.text: The days that Dawid reigned over Israel were forty years; seven years reigned he in Chevron, and thirty-three years reigned he in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 11 the days that dawid reigned over israel were forty years seven years reigned he in chevron and thirty three years reigned he in yerushalayim

search.text: Shlomo sat on the throne of Dawid his father; and his kingdom was established greatly.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 12 shlomo sat on the throne of dawid his father and his kingdom was established greatly

search.text: Then Adoniyahu the son of Haggith came to Bat-Sheva the mother of Shlomo. She said, Come you peaceably? He said, Peaceably.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 13 then adoniyahu the son of haggith came to bat sheva the mother of shlomo she said come you peaceably he said peaceably

search.text: He said moreover, I have somewhat to tell you. She said, Say on.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 14 he said moreover i have somewhat to tell you she said say on

search.text: He said, You know that the kingdom was mine, and that all Israel set their faces on me, that I should reign: however the kingdom is turned about, and is become my brother's; for it was his from YHWH.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 15 he said you know that the kingdom was mine and that all israel set their faces on me that i should reign however the kingdom is turned about and is become my brother s for it was his from yhwh

search.text: Now I ask one petition of you; don't deny me. She said to him, Say on.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 16 now i ask one petition of you don t deny me she said to him say on

search.text: He said, "Please speak to Shlomo the king (for he will not tell you 'no'), that he give me Abishag the Shunammite as wife."
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 17 he said please speak to shlomo the king for he will not tell you no that he give me abishag the shunammite as wife

search.text: Bat-Sheva said, Well; I will speak for you to the king.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 18 bat sheva said well i will speak for you to the king

search.text: Bat-Sheva therefore went to king Shlomo, to speak to him for Adoniyahu. The king rose up to meet her, and bowed himself to her, and sat down on his throne, and caused a throne to be set for the king's mother; and she sat on his right hand.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 19 bat sheva therefore went to king shlomo to speak to him for adoniyahu the king rose up to meet her and bowed himself to her and sat down on his throne and caused a throne to be set for the king s mother and she sat on his right hand

search.text: Then she said, I ask one small petition of you; don't deny me. The king said to her, Ask on, my mother; for I will not deny you.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 20 then she said i ask one small petition of you don t deny me the king said to her ask on my mother for i will not deny you

search.text: She said, Let Abishag the Shunammite be given to Adoniyahu your brother as wife.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 21 she said let abishag the shunammite be given to adoniyahu your brother as wife

search.text: King Shlomo answered his mother, Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adoniyahu? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Evyatar the priest, and for Yoav the son of Zeruiah.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 22 king shlomo answered his mother why do you ask abishag the shunammite for adoniyahu ask for him the kingdom also for he is my elder brother even for him and for evyatar the priest and for yoav the son of zeruiah

search.text: Then king Shlomo swore by YHWH, saying, Elohim do so to me, and more also, if Adoniyahu has not spoken this word against his own life.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 23 then king shlomo swore by yhwh saying elohim do so to me and more also if adoniyahu has not spoken this word against his own life

search.text: Now therefore as YHWH lives, who has established me, and set me on the throne of Dawid my father, and who has made me a house, as he promised, surely Adoniyahu shall be put to death this day.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 24 now therefore as yhwh lives who has established me and set me on the throne of dawid my father and who has made me a house as he promised surely adoniyahu shall be put to death this day

search.text: King Shlomo sent by Benayahu the son of Yehoyada; and he fell on him, so that he died.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 25 king shlomo sent by benayahu the son of yehoyada and he fell on him so that he died

search.text: To Evyatar the priest said the king, Get you to Anathoth, to your own fields; for you are worthy of death: but I will not at this time put you to death, because you bear the ark of YHWH God before Dawid my father, and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 26 to evyatar the priest said the king get you to anathoth to your own fields for you are worthy of death but i will not at this time put you to death because you bear the ark of yhwh god before dawid my father and because you were afflicted in all in which my father was afflicted

search.text: So Shlomo thrust out Evyatar from being priest to YHWH, that he might fulfill the word of YHWH, which he spoke concerning the house of Eli in Shilo.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 27 so shlomo thrust out evyatar from being priest to yhwh that he might fulfill the word of yhwh which he spoke concerning the house of eli in shilo

search.text: The news came to Yoav; for Yoav had turned after Adoniyahu, though he didn't turn after Avshalom. Yoav fled to the Tent of YHWH, and caught hold on the horns of the altar.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 28 the news came to yoav for yoav had turned after adoniyahu though he didn t turn after avshalom yoav fled to the tent of yhwh and caught hold on the horns of the altar

search.text: It was told king Shlomo, Yoav is fled to the Tent of YHWH, and behold, he is by the altar. Then Shlomo sent Benayahu the son of Yehoyada, saying, Go, fall on him.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 29 it was told king shlomo yoav is fled to the tent of yhwh and behold he is by the altar then shlomo sent benayahu the son of yehoyada saying go fall on him

search.text: Benayahu came to the Tent of YHWH, and said to him, Thus says the king, Come forth. He said, No; but I will die here. Benayahu brought the king word again, saying, Thus said Yoav, and thus he answered me.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 30 benayahu came to the tent of yhwh and said to him thus says the king come forth he said no but i will die here benayahu brought the king word again saying thus said yoav and thus he answered me

search.text: The king said to him, Do as he has said, and fall on him, and bury him; that you may take away the blood, which Yoav shed without cause, from me and from my father's house.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 31 the king said to him do as he has said and fall on him and bury him that you may take away the blood which yoav shed without cause from me and from my father s house

search.text: YHWH will return his blood on his own head, because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he, and killed them with the sword, and my father Dawid didn't know it, [to wit], Abner the son of Ner, captain of the army of Israel, and Amasa the son of Jether, captain of the army of Yehudah.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 32 yhwh will return his blood on his own head because he fell on two men more righteous and better than he and killed them with the sword and my father dawid didn t know it to wit abner the son of ner captain of the army of israel and amasa the son of jether captain of the army of yehudah

search.text: So shall their blood return on the head of Yoav, and on the head of his seed forever: but to Dawid, and to his seed, and to his house, and to his throne, shall there be peace for ever from YHWH.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 33 so shall their blood return on the head of yoav and on the head of his seed forever but to dawid and to his seed and to his house and to his throne shall there be peace for ever from yhwh

search.text: Then Benayahu the son of Yehoyada went up, and fell on him, and killed him; and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 34 then benayahu the son of yehoyada went up and fell on him and killed him and he was buried in his own house in the wilderness

search.text: The king put Benayahu the son of Yehoyada in his room over the army; and Tzadok the priest did the king put in the room of Evyatar.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 35 the king put benayahu the son of yehoyada in his room over the army and tzadok the priest did the king put in the room of evyatar

search.text: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, Build yourself a house in Yerushalayim, and dwell there, and don't go forth from there any where.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 36 the king sent and called for shimei and said to him build yourself a house in yerushalayim and dwell there and don t go forth from there any where

search.text: For on the day you go out, and pass over the brook Kidron, know you for certain that you shall surely die: your blood shall be on your own head.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 37 for on the day you go out and pass over the brook kidron know you for certain that you shall surely die your blood shall be on your own head

search.text: Shimei said to the king, The saying is good: as my lord the king has said, so will your servant do. Shimei lived in Yerushalayim many days.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 38 shimei said to the king the saying is good as my lord the king has said so will your servant do shimei lived in yerushalayim many days

search.text: It happened at the end of three years, that two of the servants of Shimei ran away to Achish, son of Maacah, king of Gath. They told Shimei, saying, Behold, your servants are in Gath.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 39 it happened at the end of three years that two of the servants of shimei ran away to achish son of maacah king of gath they told shimei saying behold your servants are in gath

search.text: Shimei arose, and saddled his donkey, and went to Gath to Achish, to seek his servants; and Shimei went, and brought his servants from Gath.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 40 shimei arose and saddled his donkey and went to gath to achish to seek his servants and shimei went and brought his servants from gath

search.text: It was told Shlomo that Shimei had gone from Yerushalayim to Gath, and was come again.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 41 it was told shlomo that shimei had gone from yerushalayim to gath and was come again

search.text: The king sent and called for Shimei, and said to him, Didn't I adjure you by YHWH, and protest to you, saying, Know for certain, that on the day you go out, and walk abroad any where, you shall surely die? and you said to me, The saying that I have heard is good.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 42 the king sent and called for shimei and said to him didn t i adjure you by yhwh and protest to you saying know for certain that on the day you go out and walk abroad any where you shall surely die and you said to me the saying that i have heard is good

search.text: Why then have you not kept the oath of YHWH, and the commandment that I have charged you with?
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 43 why then have you not kept the oath of yhwh and the commandment that i have charged you with

search.text: The king said moreover to Shimei, You know all the wickedness which your heart is privy to, that you did to Dawid my father: therefore YHWH shall return your wickedness on your own head.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 44 the king said moreover to shimei you know all the wickedness which your heart is privy to that you did to dawid my father therefore yhwh shall return your wickedness on your own head

search.text: But king Shlomo shall be blessed, and the throne of Dawid shall be established before YHWH forever.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 45 but king shlomo shall be blessed and the throne of dawid shall be established before yhwh forever

search.text: So the king commanded Benayahu the son of Yehoyada; and he went out, and fell on him, so that he died. The kingdom was established in the hand of Shlomo.
search.searchText: 1 kings 2 46 so the king commanded benayahu the son of yehoyada and he went out and fell on him so that he died the kingdom was established in the hand of shlomo

search.text: Shlomo made affinity with Pharaoh king of Mitzrayim, and took Pharaoh's daughter, and brought her into the city of Dawid, until he had made an end of building his own house, and the house of YHWH, and the wall of Yerushalayim round about.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 1 shlomo made affinity with pharaoh king of mitzrayim and took pharaoh s daughter and brought her into the city of dawid until he had made an end of building his own house and the house of yhwh and the wall of yerushalayim round about

search.text: Only the people sacrificed in the high places, because there was no house built for the name of YHWH until those days.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 2 only the people sacrificed in the high places because there was no house built for the name of yhwh until those days

search.text: Shlomo loved YHWH, walking in the statutes of Dawid his father: only he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 3 shlomo loved yhwh walking in the statutes of dawid his father only he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places

search.text: The king went to Gibeon to sacrifice there; for that was the great high place: a thousand burnt offerings did Shlomo offer on that altar.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 4 the king went to gibeon to sacrifice there for that was the great high place a thousand burnt offerings did shlomo offer on that altar

search.text: In Gibeon YHWH appeared to Shlomo in a dream by night; and Elohim said, Ask what I shall give you.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 5 in gibeon yhwh appeared to shlomo in a dream by night and elohim said ask what i shall give you

search.text: Shlomo said, You have shown to your servant Dawid my father great loving kindness, according as he walked before you in truth, and in righteousness, and in uprightness of heart with you; and you have kept for him this great loving kindness, that you have given him a son to sit on his throne, as it is this day.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 6 shlomo said you have shown to your servant dawid my father great loving kindness according as he walked before you in truth and in righteousness and in uprightness of heart with you and you have kept for him this great loving kindness that you have given him a son to sit on his throne as it is this day

search.text: Now, YHWH my God, you have made your servant king instead of Dawid my father: and I am but a little child; I don't know how to go out or come in.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 7 now yhwh my god you have made your servant king instead of dawid my father and i am but a little child i don t know how to go out or come in

search.text: Your servant is in the midst of your people which you have chosen, a great people, that can't be numbered nor counted for multitude.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 8 your servant is in the midst of your people which you have chosen a great people that can t be numbered nor counted for multitude

search.text: Give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people, that I may discern between good and brokenness; for who is able to judge this your great people?
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 9 give your servant therefore an understanding heart to judge your people that i may discern between good and brokenness for who is able to judge this your great people

search.text: The speech pleased YHWH, that Shlomo had asked this thing.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 10 the speech pleased yhwh that shlomo had asked this thing

search.text: Elohim said to him, Because you have asked this thing, and have not asked for yourself long life, neither have asked riches for yourself, nor have asked the life of your enemies, but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice;
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 11 elohim said to him because you have asked this thing and have not asked for yourself long life neither have asked riches for yourself nor have asked the life of your enemies but have asked for yourself understanding to discern justice

search.text: behold, I have done according to your word: behold, I have given you a wise and an understanding heart; so that there has been none like you before you, neither after you shall any arise like you.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 12 behold i have done according to your word behold i have given you a wise and an understanding heart so that there has been none like you before you neither after you shall any arise like you

search.text: I have also given you that which you have not asked, both riches and honor, so that there shall not be any among the kings like you, all your days.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 13 i have also given you that which you have not asked both riches and honor so that there shall not be any among the kings like you all your days

search.text: If you will walk in my ways, to keep my statutes and my commandments, as your father Dawid did walk, then I will lengthen your days.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 14 if you will walk in my ways to keep my statutes and my commandments as your father dawid did walk then i will lengthen your days

search.text: Shlomo awoke; and behold, it was a dream: and he came to Yerushalayim, and stood before the ark of the covenant of YHWH, and offered up burnt offerings, and offered peace offerings, and made a feast to all his servants.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 15 shlomo awoke and behold it was a dream and he came to yerushalayim and stood before the ark of the covenant of yhwh and offered up burnt offerings and offered peace offerings and made a feast to all his servants

search.text: Then there came two women who were prostitutes, to the king, and stood before him.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 16 then there came two women who were prostitutes to the king and stood before him

search.text: The one woman said, Oh, my lord, I and this woman dwell in one house; and I was delivered of a child with her in the house.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 17 the one woman said oh my lord i and this woman dwell in one house and i was delivered of a child with her in the house

search.text: It happened the third day after I was delivered, that this woman was delivered also; and we were together; there was no stranger with us in the house, save we two in the house.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 18 it happened the third day after i was delivered that this woman was delivered also and we were together there was no stranger with us in the house save we two in the house

search.text: This woman's child died in the night, because she lay on it.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 19 this woman s child died in the night because she lay on it

search.text: She arose at midnight, and took my son from beside me, while your handmaid slept, and laid it in her bosom, and laid her dead child in my bosom.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 20 she arose at midnight and took my son from beside me while your handmaid slept and laid it in her bosom and laid her dead child in my bosom

search.text: When I rose in the morning to give my child suck, behold, it was dead; but when I had looked at it in the morning, behold, it was not my son, whom I bore.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 21 when i rose in the morning to give my child suck behold it was dead but when i had looked at it in the morning behold it was not my son whom i bore

search.text: The other woman said, No; but the living is my son, and the dead is your son. This said, No; but the dead is your son, and the living is my son. Thus they spoke before the king.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 22 the other woman said no but the living is my son and the dead is your son this said no but the dead is your son and the living is my son thus they spoke before the king

search.text: Then said the king, The one says, This is my son who lives, and your son is the dead: and the other says, No; but your son is the dead, and my son is the living.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 23 then said the king the one says this is my son who lives and your son is the dead and the other says no but your son is the dead and my son is the living

search.text: The king said, Get me a sword. They brought a sword before the king.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 24 the king said get me a sword they brought a sword before the king

search.text: The king said, Divide the living child in two, and give half to the one, and half to the other.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 25 the king said divide the living child in two and give half to the one and half to the other

search.text: Then spoke the woman whose the living child was to the king, for her heart yearned over her son, and she said, Oh, my lord, give her the living child, and in no way kill it. But the other said, It shall be neither mine nor yours; divide it.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 26 then spoke the woman whose the living child was to the king for her heart yearned over her son and she said oh my lord give her the living child and in no way kill it but the other said it shall be neither mine nor yours divide it

search.text: Then the king answered, Give her the living child, and in no way kill it: she is the mother of it.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 27 then the king answered give her the living child and in no way kill it she is the mother of it

search.text: All Israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged; and they feared the king: for they saw that the wisdom of Elohim was in him, to do justice.
search.searchText: 1 kings 3 28 all israel heard of the judgment which the king had judged and they feared the king for they saw that the wisdom of elohim was in him to do justice

search.text: King Shlomo was king over all Israel.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 1 king shlomo was king over all israel

search.text: These were the princes whom he had: Azaryah the son of Tzadok, the priest;
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 2 these were the princes whom he had azaryah the son of tzadok the priest

search.text: Elihoreph and Ahijah, the sons of Shisha, scribes; Yehoshafat the son of Ahilud, the recorder;
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 3 elihoreph and ahijah the sons of shisha scribes yehoshafat the son of ahilud the recorder

search.text: and Benayahu the son of Yehoyada was over the army; and Tzadok and Evyatar were priests;
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 4 and benayahu the son of yehoyada was over the army and tzadok and evyatar were priests

search.text: and Azaryah the son of Natan was over the officers; and Zabud the son of Natan was chief minister, [and] the king's friend;
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 5 and azaryah the son of natan was over the officers and zabud the son of natan was chief minister and the king s friend

search.text: and Ahishar was over the household; and Adoniram the son of Abda was over the men subject to forced labor.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 6 and ahishar was over the household and adoniram the son of abda was over the men subject to forced labor

search.text: Shlomo had twelve officers over all Israel, who provided food for the king and their household: each person had to make provision for a month in the year.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 7 shlomo had twelve officers over all israel who provided food for the king and their household each person had to make provision for a month in the year

search.text: These are their names: Ben Hur, in the hill country of Efrayim;
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 8 these are their names ben hur in the hill country of efrayim

search.text: Ben Deker, in Makaz, and in Shaalbim, and Beit Shemesh, and Elon Beth Hanan;
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 9 ben deker in makaz and in shaalbim and beit shemesh and elon beth hanan

search.text: Ben Hesed, in Arubboth (to him [pertained] Socoh, and all the land of Hepher);
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 10 ben hesed in arubboth to him pertained socoh and all the land of hepher

search.text: Ben Abinadab, in all the height of Dor (he had Taphath the daughter of Shlomo as wife);
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 11 ben abinadab in all the height of dor he had taphath the daughter of shlomo as wife

search.text: Baana the son of Ahilud, in Taanach and Megiddo, and all Beit She'an which is beside Zarethan, beneath Jezreel, from Beit She'an to Abel Meholah, as far as beyond Jokmeam;
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 12 baana the son of ahilud in taanach and megiddo and all beit she an which is beside zarethan beneath jezreel from beit she an to abel meholah as far as beyond jokmeam

search.text: Ben Geber, in Ramoth Gilead (to him [pertained] the towns of Jair the son of Menashe, which are in Gilead; [even] to him [pertained] the region of Argob, which is in Bashan, sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars);
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 13 ben geber in ramoth gilead to him pertained the towns of jair the son of menashe which are in gilead even to him pertained the region of argob which is in bashan sixty great cities with walls and bronze bars

search.text: Ahinadab the son of Iddo, in Mahanaim;
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 14 ahinadab the son of iddo in mahanaim

search.text: Ahimaaz, in Naphtali (he also took Basemath the daughter of Shlomo as wife);
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 15 ahimaaz in naphtali he also took basemath the daughter of shlomo as wife

search.text: Baana the son of Hushai, in Asher and Bealoth;
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 16 baana the son of hushai in asher and bealoth

search.text: Yehoshafat the son of Paruah, in Yissakhar;
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 17 yehoshafat the son of paruah in yissakhar

search.text: Shimei the son of Ela, in Binyamin;
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 18 shimei the son of ela in binyamin

search.text: Geber the son of Uri, in the land of Gilead, the country of Sihon king of the Amorites and of Og king of Bashan; and [he was] the only officer who was in the land.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 19 geber the son of uri in the land of gilead the country of sihon king of the amorites and of og king of bashan and he was the only officer who was in the land

search.text: Yehudah and Israel were many as the sand which is by the sea in multitude, eating and drinking and making merry.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 20 yehudah and israel were many as the sand which is by the sea in multitude eating and drinking and making merry

search.text: Shlomo ruled over all the kingdoms from the River to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Mitzrayim: they brought tribute, and served Shlomo all the days of his life.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 21 shlomo ruled over all the kingdoms from the river to the land of the philistines and to the border of mitzrayim they brought tribute and served shlomo all the days of his life

search.text: Shlomo's provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour, and sixty measures of meal,
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 22 shlomo s provision for one day was thirty measures of fine flour and sixty measures of meal

search.text: ten fat oxen, and twenty oxen out of the pastures, and one hundred sheep, besides harts, and gazelles, and roebucks, and fattened fowl.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 23 ten fat oxen and twenty oxen out of the pastures and one hundred sheep besides harts and gazelles and roebucks and fattened fowl

search.text: For he had dominion over all [the region] on this side the River, from Tiphsah even to Azzah, over all the kings on this side the River: and he had peace on all sides round about him.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 24 for he had dominion over all the region on this side the river from tiphsah even to azzah over all the kings on this side the river and he had peace on all sides round about him

search.text: Yehudah and Israel lived safely, everyone under their vine and under their fig tree, from Dan even to Be'er Sheva, all the days of Shlomo.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 25 yehudah and israel lived safely everyone under their vine and under their fig tree from dan even to be er sheva all the days of shlomo

search.text: Shlomo had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 26 shlomo had forty thousand stalls of horses for his chariots and twelve thousand horsemen

search.text: Those officers provided food for king Shlomo, and for all who came to king Shlomo's table, everyone in their month; they let nothing be lacking.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 27 those officers provided food for king shlomo and for all who came to king shlomo s table everyone in their month they let nothing be lacking

search.text: Barley also and straw for the horses and swift steeds brought they to the place where [the officers] were, everyone according to their charge.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 28 barley also and straw for the horses and swift steeds brought they to the place where the officers were everyone according to their charge

search.text: Elohim gave Shlomo wisdom and understanding exceeding much, and very great understanding, even as the sand that is on the seashore.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 29 elohim gave shlomo wisdom and understanding exceeding much and very great understanding even as the sand that is on the seashore

search.text: Shlomo's wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east, and all the wisdom of Mitzrayim.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 30 shlomo s wisdom excelled the wisdom of all the children of the east and all the wisdom of mitzrayim

search.text: For he was wiser than all people; than Ethan the Ezrahite, and Heman, and Calcol, and Darda, the sons of Mahol: and his fame was in all the nations round about.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 31 for he was wiser than all people than ethan the ezrahite and heman and calcol and darda the sons of mahol and his fame was in all the nations round about

search.text: He spoke three thousand proverbs; and his songs were one thousand five.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 32 he spoke three thousand proverbs and his songs were one thousand five

search.text: He spoke of trees, from the cedar that is in Levanon even to the hyssop that springs out of the wall; he spoke also of animals, and of birds, and of creeping things, and of fish.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 33 he spoke of trees from the cedar that is in levanon even to the hyssop that springs out of the wall he spoke also of animals and of birds and of creeping things and of fish

search.text: There came of all peoples to hear the wisdom of Shlomo, from all kings of the earth, who had heard of his wisdom.
search.searchText: 1 kings 4 34 there came of all peoples to hear the wisdom of shlomo from all kings of the earth who had heard of his wisdom

search.text: Hiram king of Tzor sent his servants to Shlomo; for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father: for Hiram was ever a lover of Dawid.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 1 hiram king of tzor sent his servants to shlomo for he had heard that they had anointed him king in the room of his father for hiram was ever a lover of dawid

search.text: Shlomo sent to Hiram, saying,
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 2 shlomo sent to hiram saying

search.text: You know how that Dawid my father could not build a house for the name of YHWH his God for the wars which were about him on every side, until YHWH put them under the soles of his feet.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 3 you know how that dawid my father could not build a house for the name of yhwh his god for the wars which were about him on every side until yhwh put them under the soles of his feet

search.text: But now YHWH my God has given me rest on every side; there is neither adversary, nor harmful occurrence.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 4 but now yhwh my god has given me rest on every side there is neither adversary nor harmful occurrence

search.text: Behold, I purpose to build a house for the name of YHWH my God, as YHWH spoke to Dawid my father, saying, Your son, whom I will set on your throne in your room, he shall build the house for my name.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 5 behold i purpose to build a house for the name of yhwh my god as yhwh spoke to dawid my father saying your son whom i will set on your throne in your room he shall build the house for my name

search.text: Now therefore command you that they cut me cedar trees out of Levanon; and my servants shall be with your servants; and I will give you hire for your servants according to all that you shall say: for you know that there is not among us any who knows how to cut timber like the Sidonians.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 6 now therefore command you that they cut me cedar trees out of levanon and my servants shall be with your servants and i will give you hire for your servants according to all that you shall say for you know that there is not among us any who knows how to cut timber like the sidonians

search.text: It happened, when Hiram heard the words of Shlomo, that he rejoiced greatly, and said, Blessed be YHWH this day, who has given to Dawid a wise son over this great people.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 7 it happened when hiram heard the words of shlomo that he rejoiced greatly and said blessed be yhwh this day who has given to dawid a wise son over this great people

search.text: Hiram sent to Shlomo, saying, I have heard [the message] which you have sent to me: I will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar, and concerning timber of fir.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 8 hiram sent to shlomo saying i have heard the message which you have sent to me i will do all your desire concerning timber of cedar and concerning timber of fir

search.text: My servants shall bring them down from Levanon to the sea; and I will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you shall appoint me, and will cause them to be broken up there, and you shall receive them; and you shall accomplish my desire, in giving food for my household.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 9 my servants shall bring them down from levanon to the sea and i will make them into rafts to go by sea to the place that you shall appoint me and will cause them to be broken up there and you shall receive them and you shall accomplish my desire in giving food for my household

search.text: So Hiram gave Shlomo timber of cedar and timber of fir according to all his desire.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 10 so hiram gave shlomo timber of cedar and timber of fir according to all his desire

search.text: Shlomo gave Hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household, and twenty measures of pure oil: thus gave Shlomo to Hiram year by year.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 11 shlomo gave hiram twenty thousand measures of wheat for food to his household and twenty measures of pure oil thus gave shlomo to hiram year by year

search.text: YHWH gave Shlomo wisdom, as he promised him; and there was peace between Hiram and Shlomo; and they two made a league together.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 12 yhwh gave shlomo wisdom as he promised him and there was peace between hiram and shlomo and they two made a league together

search.text: King Shlomo raised a levy out of all Israel; and the levy was thirty thousand men.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 13 king shlomo raised a levy out of all israel and the levy was thirty thousand men

search.text: He sent them to Levanon, ten thousand a month by courses; a month they were in Levanon, and two months at home; and Adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 14 he sent them to levanon ten thousand a month by courses a month they were in levanon and two months at home and adoniram was over the men subject to forced labor

search.text: Shlomo had seventy thousand who bore burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains;
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 15 shlomo had seventy thousand who bore burdens and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains

search.text: besides Shlomo's chief officers who were over the work, three thousand and three hundred, who bore rule over the people who labored in the work.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 16 besides shlomo s chief officers who were over the work three thousand and three hundred who bore rule over the people who labored in the work

search.text: The king commanded, and they hewed out great stones, costly stones, to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 17 the king commanded and they hewed out great stones costly stones to lay the foundation of the house with worked stone

search.text: Shlomo's builders and Hiram's builders and the Gebalites did fashion them, and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house.
search.searchText: 1 kings 5 18 shlomo s builders and hiram s builders and the gebalites did fashion them and prepared the timber and the stones to build the house

search.text: It happened in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of Israel were come out of the land of Mitzrayim, in the fourth year of Shlomo's reign over Israel, in the month Ziv, which is the second month, that he began to build the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 1 it happened in the four hundred and eightieth year after the children of israel were come out of the land of mitzrayim in the fourth year of shlomo s reign over israel in the month ziv which is the second month that he began to build the house of yhwh

search.text: The house which king Shlomo built for YHWH, the length of it was sixty cubits, and the breadth of it twenty [cubits], and the height of it thirty cubits.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 2 the house which king shlomo built for yhwh the length of it was sixty cubits and the breadth of it twenty cubits and the height of it thirty cubits

search.text: The porch before the temple of the house, twenty cubits was the length of it, according to the breadth of the house; [and] ten cubits was the breadth of it before the house.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 3 the porch before the temple of the house twenty cubits was the length of it according to the breadth of the house and ten cubits was the breadth of it before the house

search.text: For the house he made windows of fixed lattice work.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 4 for the house he made windows of fixed lattice work

search.text: Against the wall of the house he built stories round about, against the walls of the house round about, both of the temple and of the oracle; and he made side chambers round about.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 5 against the wall of the house he built stories round about against the walls of the house round about both of the temple and of the oracle and he made side chambers round about

search.text: The nethermost story was five cubits broad, and the middle was six cubits broad, and the third was seven cubits broad; for on the outside he made offsets [in the wall] of the house round about, that [the beams] should not have hold in the walls of the house.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 6 the nethermost story was five cubits broad and the middle was six cubits broad and the third was seven cubits broad for on the outside he made offsets in the wall of the house round about that the beams should not have hold in the walls of the house

search.text: The house, when it was in building, was built of stone made ready at the quarry; and there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house, while it was in building.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 7 the house when it was in building was built of stone made ready at the quarry and there was neither hammer nor axe nor any tool of iron heard in the house while it was in building

search.text: The door for the middle side chambers was in the right side of the house: and they went up by winding stairs into the middle [story], and out of the middle into the third.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 8 the door for the middle side chambers was in the right side of the house and they went up by winding stairs into the middle story and out of the middle into the third

search.text: So he built the house, and finished it; and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 9 so he built the house and finished it and he covered the house with beams and planks of cedar

search.text: He built the stories against all the house, each five cubits high: and they rested on the house with timber of cedar.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 10 he built the stories against all the house each five cubits high and they rested on the house with timber of cedar

search.text: The word of YHWH came to Shlomo, saying,
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 11 the word of yhwh came to shlomo saying

search.text: Concerning this house which you are building, if you will walk in my statutes, and execute my ordinances, and keep all my commandments to walk in them; then will I establish my word with you, which I spoke to Dawid your father.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 12 concerning this house which you are building if you will walk in my statutes and execute my ordinances and keep all my commandments to walk in them then will i establish my word with you which i spoke to dawid your father

search.text: I will dwell among the children of Israel, and will not forsake my people Israel.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 13 i will dwell among the children of israel and will not forsake my people israel

search.text: So Shlomo built the house, and finished it.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 14 so shlomo built the house and finished it

search.text: He built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar: from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling, he covered them on the inside with wood; and he covered the floor of the house with boards of fir.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 15 he built the walls of the house within with boards of cedar from the floor of the house to the walls of the ceiling he covered them on the inside with wood and he covered the floor of the house with boards of fir

search.text: He built twenty cubits on the hinder part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the walls [of the ceiling]: he built [them] for it within, for an oracle, even for the most holy place.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 16 he built twenty cubits on the hinder part of the house with boards of cedar from the floor to the walls of the ceiling he built them for it within for an oracle even for the most holy place

search.text: The house, that is, the temple before [the oracle], was forty cubits [long].
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 17 the house that is the temple before the oracle was forty cubits long

search.text: There was cedar on the house within, carved with buds and open flowers: all was cedar; there was no stone seen.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 18 there was cedar on the house within carved with buds and open flowers all was cedar there was no stone seen

search.text: He prepared an oracle in the midst of the house within, to set there the ark of the covenant of YHWH.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 19 he prepared an oracle in the midst of the house within to set there the ark of the covenant of yhwh

search.text: Within the oracle was [a space of] twenty cubits in length, and twenty cubits in breadth, and twenty cubits in the height of it; and he overlaid it with pure gold: and he covered the altar with cedar.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 20 within the oracle was a space of twenty cubits in length and twenty cubits in breadth and twenty cubits in the height of it and he overlaid it with pure gold and he covered the altar with cedar

search.text: So Shlomo overlaid the house within with pure gold: and he drew chains of gold across before the oracle; and he overlaid it with gold.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 21 so shlomo overlaid the house within with pure gold and he drew chains of gold across before the oracle and he overlaid it with gold

search.text: The whole house he overlaid with gold, until all the house was finished: also the whole altar that belonged to the oracle he overlaid with gold.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 22 the whole house he overlaid with gold until all the house was finished also the whole altar that belonged to the oracle he overlaid with gold

search.text: In the oracle he made two cherubim of olive wood, each ten cubits high.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 23 in the oracle he made two cherubim of olive wood each ten cubits high

search.text: Five cubits was the one wing of the cherub, and five cubits the other wing of the cherub: from the uttermost part of the one wing to the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 24 five cubits was the one wing of the cherub and five cubits the other wing of the cherub from the uttermost part of the one wing to the uttermost part of the other were ten cubits

search.text: The other cherub was ten cubits: both the cherubim were of one measure and one form.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 25 the other cherub was ten cubits both the cherubim were of one measure and one form

search.text: The height of the one cherub was ten cubits, and so was it of the other cherub.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 26 the height of the one cherub was ten cubits and so was it of the other cherub

search.text: He set the cherubim within the inner house; and the wings of the cherubim were stretched forth, so that the wing of the one touched the one wall, and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall; and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 27 he set the cherubim within the inner house and the wings of the cherubim were stretched forth so that the wing of the one touched the one wall and the wing of the other cherub touched the other wall and their wings touched one another in the midst of the house

search.text: He overlaid the cherubim with gold.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 28 he overlaid the cherubim with gold

search.text: He carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers, inside and outside.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 29 he carved all the walls of the house round about with carved figures of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers inside and outside

search.text: The floor of the house he overlaid with gold, inside and outside.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 30 the floor of the house he overlaid with gold inside and outside

search.text: For the entrance of the oracle he made doors of olive wood: the lintel [and] door posts were a fifth part [of the wall].
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 31 for the entrance of the oracle he made doors of olive wood the lintel and door posts were a fifth part of the wall

search.text: So [he made] two doors of olive wood; and he carved on them carvings of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers, and overlaid them with gold; and he spread the gold on the cherubim, and on the palm trees.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 32 so he made two doors of olive wood and he carved on them carvings of cherubim and palm trees and open flowers and overlaid them with gold and he spread the gold on the cherubim and on the palm trees

search.text: So also made he for the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood, out of a fourth part [of the wall];
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 33 so also made he for the entrance of the temple door posts of olive wood out of a fourth part of the wall

search.text: and two doors of fir wood: the two leaves of the one door were folding, and the two leaves of the other door were folding.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 34 and two doors of fir wood the two leaves of the one door were folding and the two leaves of the other door were folding

search.text: He carved [thereon] cherubim and palm trees and open flowers; and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 35 he carved thereon cherubim and palm trees and open flowers and he overlaid them with gold fitted on the engraved work

search.text: He built the inner court with three courses of hewn stone, and a course of cedar beams.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 36 he built the inner court with three courses of hewn stone and a course of cedar beams

search.text: In the fourth year was the foundation of the house of YHWH laid, in the month Ziv.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 37 in the fourth year was the foundation of the house of yhwh laid in the month ziv

search.text: In the eleventh year, in the month Bul, which is the eighth month, was the house finished throughout all the parts of it, and according to all the fashion of it. So was he seven years in building it.
search.searchText: 1 kings 6 38 in the eleventh year in the month bul which is the eighth month was the house finished throughout all the parts of it and according to all the fashion of it so was he seven years in building it

search.text: Shlomo was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished all his house.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 1 shlomo was building his own house thirteen years and he finished all his house

search.text: For he built the house of the forest of Levanon; the length of it was one hundred cubits, and the breadth of it fifty cubits, and the height of it thirty cubits, on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 2 for he built the house of the forest of levanon the length of it was one hundred cubits and the breadth of it fifty cubits and the height of it thirty cubits on four rows of cedar pillars with cedar beams on the pillars

search.text: It was covered with cedar above over the forty-five beams, that were on the pillars; fifteen in a row.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 3 it was covered with cedar above over the forty five beams that were on the pillars fifteen in a row

search.text: There were beams in three rows, and window was over against window in three ranks.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 4 there were beams in three rows and window was over against window in three ranks

search.text: All the doors and posts were made square with beams: and window was over against window in three ranks.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 5 all the doors and posts were made square with beams and window was over against window in three ranks

search.text: He made the porch of pillars; the length of it was fifty cubits, and the breadth of it thirty cubits; and a porch before them; and pillars and a threshold before them.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 6 he made the porch of pillars the length of it was fifty cubits and the breadth of it thirty cubits and a porch before them and pillars and a threshold before them

search.text: He made the porch of the throne where he was to judge, even the porch of judgment: and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 7 he made the porch of the throne where he was to judge even the porch of judgment and it was covered with cedar from floor to floor

search.text: His house where he was to dwell, the other court within the porch, was of the like work. He made also a house for Pharaoh's daughter (whom Shlomo had taken as wife), like this porch.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 8 his house where he was to dwell the other court within the porch was of the like work he made also a house for pharaoh s daughter whom shlomo had taken as wife like this porch

search.text: All these were of costly stones, even of hewn stone, according to measure, sawed with saws, inside and outside, even from the foundation to the coping, and so on the outside to the great court.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 9 all these were of costly stones even of hewn stone according to measure sawed with saws inside and outside even from the foundation to the coping and so on the outside to the great court

search.text: The foundation was of costly stones, even great stones, stones of ten cubits, and stones of eight cubits.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 10 the foundation was of costly stones even great stones stones of ten cubits and stones of eight cubits

search.text: Above were costly stones, even hewn stone, according to measure, and cedar wood.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 11 above were costly stones even hewn stone according to measure and cedar wood

search.text: The great court round about had three courses of hewn stone, and a course of cedar beams; like as the inner court of the house of YHWH, and the porch of the house.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 12 the great court round about had three courses of hewn stone and a course of cedar beams like as the inner court of the house of yhwh and the porch of the house

search.text: King Shlomo sent and fetched Hiram out of Tzor.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 13 king shlomo sent and fetched hiram out of tzor

search.text: He was the son of a widow of the tribe of Naphtali, and his father was a person of Tzor, a worker in brass; and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill, to work all works in brass. He came to king Shlomo, and performed all his work.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 14 he was the son of a widow of the tribe of naphtali and his father was a person of tzor a worker in brass and he was filled with wisdom and understanding and skill to work all works in brass he came to king shlomo and performed all his work

search.text: For he fashioned the two pillars of brass, eighteen cubits high apiece: and a line of twelve cubits compassed either of them about.
search.searchText: 1 kings 7 15 for he fashioned the two pillars of brass eighteen cubits high apiece and a line of twelve cubits compassed either of them about

search.text: Blessed be YHWH, who has given rest to YHWH’s people Israel, according to all that YHWH promised: there has not failed one word of all YHWH’s good promise, which YHWH promised by Moshe YHWH’s servant.

search.text: YHWH our God be with us, as YHWH was with our fathers: let YHWH not leave us, nor forsake us;

search.text: that YHWH may incline our hearts to YHWH, to walk in all YHWH’s ways, and to keep YHWH’s commandments, and YHWH’s statutes, and YHWH’s ordinances, which YHWH commanded our fathers.

search.text: Let these my words, with which I have made supplication before YHWH, be near to YHWH our God day and night, that YHWH maintain the cause of YHWH’s servant, and the cause of YHWH’s people Israel, as every day shall require;
