search.text: Eliyahu said to him, "Please wait here, for YHWH has sent me to the Yarden." He said, "As YHWH lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you." They two went on.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 6 eliyahu said to him please wait here for yhwh has sent me to the yarden he said as yhwh lives and as your soul lives i will not leave you they two went on

search.text: Fifty men of the sons of the prophets went, and stood over against them afar off: and they two stood by the Yarden.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 7 fifty men of the sons of the prophets went and stood over against them afar off and they two stood by the yarden

search.text: Eliyahu took his mantle, and wrapped it together, and struck the waters, and they were divided here and there, so that they two went over on dry ground.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 8 eliyahu took his mantle and wrapped it together and struck the waters and they were divided here and there so that they two went over on dry ground

search.text: It happened, when they had gone over, that Eliyahu said to Elisha, Ask what I shall do for you, before I am taken from you. Elisha said, please let a double portion of your spirit be on me.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 9 it happened when they had gone over that eliyahu said to elisha ask what i shall do for you before i am taken from you elisha said please let a double portion of your spirit be on me

search.text: He said, You have asked a hard thing: [nevertheless], if you see me when I am taken from you, it shall be so to you; but if not, it shall not be so.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 10 he said you have asked a hard thing nevertheless if you see me when i am taken from you it shall be so to you but if not it shall not be so

search.text: It happened, as they still went on, and talked, that behold, [there appeared] a chariot of fire, and horses of fire, which parted them both apart; and Eliyahu went up by a whirlwind into heavens.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 11 it happened as they still went on and talked that behold there appeared a chariot of fire and horses of fire which parted them both apart and eliyahu went up by a whirlwind into heavens

search.text: Elisha saw it, and he cried, My father, my father, the chariots of Israel and the horsemen of it! He saw him no more: and he took hold of his own clothes, and tore them in two pieces.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 12 elisha saw it and he cried my father my father the chariots of israel and the horsemen of it he saw him no more and he took hold of his own clothes and tore them in two pieces

search.text: He took up also the mantle of Eliyahu that fell from him, and went back, and stood by the bank of the Yarden.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 13 he took up also the mantle of eliyahu that fell from him and went back and stood by the bank of the yarden

search.text: He took the mantle of Eliyahu that fell from him, and struck the waters, and said, Where is YHWH, the God of Eliyahu? and when he also had struck the waters, they were divided here and there; and Elisha went over.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 14 he took the mantle of eliyahu that fell from him and struck the waters and said where is yhwh the god of eliyahu and when he also had struck the waters they were divided here and there and elisha went over

search.text: When the sons of the prophets who were at Yericho over against him saw him, they said, The spirit of Eliyahu does rest on Elisha. They came to meet him, and bowed themselves to the ground before him.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 15 when the sons of the prophets who were at yericho over against him saw him they said the spirit of eliyahu does rest on elisha they came to meet him and bowed themselves to the ground before him

search.text: They said to him, See now, there are with your servants fifty strong men; let them go, we pray you, and seek your master, lest the Ruach of YHWH has taken him up, and cast him on some mountain, or into some valley. He said, You shall not send.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 16 they said to him see now there are with your servants fifty strong men let them go we pray you and seek your master lest the ruach of yhwh has taken him up and cast him on some mountain or into some valley he said you shall not send

search.text: When they urged him until he was ashamed, he said, Send. They sent therefore fifty men; and they sought three days, but didn't find him.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 17 when they urged him until he was ashamed he said send they sent therefore fifty men and they sought three days but didn t find him

search.text: They came back to him, while he stayed at Yericho; and he said to them, "Didn't I tell you, 'Don't go?'"
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 18 they came back to him while he stayed at yericho and he said to them didn t i tell you don t go

search.text: The men of the city said to Elisha, Behold, we pray you, the situation of this city is pleasant, as my lord sees: but the water is bad, and the land miscarries.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 19 the men of the city said to elisha behold we pray you the situation of this city is pleasant as my lord sees but the water is bad and the land miscarries

search.text: He said, Bring me a new jar, and put salt therein. They brought it to him.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 20 he said bring me a new jar and put salt therein they brought it to him

search.text: He went forth to the spring of the waters, and cast salt therein, and said, Thus says YHWH, I have healed these waters; there shall not be from there any more death or miscarrying.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 21 he went forth to the spring of the waters and cast salt therein and said thus says yhwh i have healed these waters there shall not be from there any more death or miscarrying

search.text: So the waters were healed to this day, according to the word of Elisha which he spoke.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 22 so the waters were healed to this day according to the word of elisha which he spoke

search.text: He went up from there to Beit El; and as he was going up by the way, some youths came out of the city and mocked him, and said to him, Go up, you baldy; go up, you baldhead.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 23 he went up from there to beit el and as he was going up by the way some youths came out of the city and mocked him and said to him go up you baldy go up you baldhead

search.text: He looked behind him and saw them, and cursed them in the name of YHWH. Two female bears came out of the woods, and mauled forty-two of those youths.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 24 he looked behind him and saw them and cursed them in the name of yhwh two female bears came out of the woods and mauled forty two of those youths

search.text: He went from there to Mount Carmel, and from there he returned to Shomron.
search.searchText: 2 kings 2 25 he went from there to mount carmel and from there he returned to shomron

search.text: Now Yoram the son of Achav began to reign over Israel in Shomron in the eighteenth year of Yehoshafat king of Yehudah, and reigned twelve years.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 1 now yoram the son of achav began to reign over israel in shomron in the eighteenth year of yehoshafat king of yehudah and reigned twelve years

search.text: He did what was broken in the sight of YHWH, but not like his father, and like his mother; for he put away the pillar of Baal that his father had made.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 2 he did what was broken in the sight of yhwh but not like his father and like his mother for he put away the pillar of baal that his father had made

search.text: Nevertheless he cleaved to the sins of Yerovam the son of Nebat, with which he made Israel to sin; he didn't depart from it.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 3 nevertheless he cleaved to the sins of yerovam the son of nebat with which he made israel to sin he didn t depart from it

search.text: Now Mesha king of Moab was a sheep breeder; and he rendered to the king of Israel the wool of one hundred thousand lambs, and of one hundred thousand rams.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 4 now mesha king of moab was a sheep breeder and he rendered to the king of israel the wool of one hundred thousand lambs and of one hundred thousand rams

search.text: But it happened, when Achav was dead, that the king of Moab rebelled against the king of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 5 but it happened when achav was dead that the king of moab rebelled against the king of israel

search.text: King Yoram went out of Shomron at that time, and mustered all Israel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 6 king yoram went out of shomron at that time and mustered all israel

search.text: He went and sent to Yehoshafat the king of Yehudah, saying, The king of Moab has rebelled against me: will you go with me against Moab to battle? He said, I will go up: I am as you are, my people as your people, my horses as your horses.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 7 he went and sent to yehoshafat the king of yehudah saying the king of moab has rebelled against me will you go with me against moab to battle he said i will go up i am as you are my people as your people my horses as your horses

search.text: He said, Which way shall we go up? He answered, The way of the wilderness of Edom.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 8 he said which way shall we go up he answered the way of the wilderness of edom

search.text: So the king of Israel went, and the king of Yehudah, and the king of Edom; and they made a circuit of seven days' journey: and there was no water for the army, nor for the animals that followed them.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 9 so the king of israel went and the king of yehudah and the king of edom and they made a circuit of seven days journey and there was no water for the army nor for the animals that followed them

search.text: The king of Israel said, Alas! for YHWH has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 10 the king of israel said alas for yhwh has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of moab

search.text: But Yehoshafat said, Isn't there here a prophet of YHWH, that we may inquire of YHWH by him? One of the king of Israel's servants answered, Elisha the son of Shaphat is here, who poured water on the hands of Eliyahu.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 11 but yehoshafat said isn t there here a prophet of yhwh that we may inquire of yhwh by him one of the king of israel s servants answered elisha the son of shaphat is here who poured water on the hands of eliyahu

search.text: Yehoshafat said, The word of YHWH is with him. So the king of Israel and Yehoshafat and the king of Edom went down to him.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 12 yehoshafat said the word of yhwh is with him so the king of israel and yehoshafat and the king of edom went down to him

search.text: Elisha said to the king of Israel, What have I to do with you? get you to the prophets of your father, and to the prophets of your mother. The king of Israel said to him, No; for YHWH has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of Moab.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 13 elisha said to the king of israel what have i to do with you get you to the prophets of your father and to the prophets of your mother the king of israel said to him no for yhwh has called these three kings together to deliver them into the hand of moab

search.text: Elisha said, As YHWH of Armies lives, before whom I stand, surely, were it not that I regard the presence of Yehoshafat the king of Yehudah, I would not look toward you, nor see you.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 14 elisha said as yhwh of armies lives before whom i stand surely were it not that i regard the presence of yehoshafat the king of yehudah i would not look toward you nor see you

search.text: But now bring me a minstrel. It happened, when the minstrel played, that the hand of YHWH came on him.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 15 but now bring me a minstrel it happened when the minstrel played that the hand of yhwh came on him

search.text: He said, Thus says YHWH, Make this valley full of trenches.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 16 he said thus says yhwh make this valley full of trenches

search.text: For thus says YHWH, You shall not see wind, neither shall you see rain; yet that valley shall be filled with water, and you shall drink, both you and your livestock and your animals.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 17 for thus says yhwh you shall not see wind neither shall you see rain yet that valley shall be filled with water and you shall drink both you and your livestock and your animals

search.text: This is but a light thing in the sight of YHWH: he will also deliver the Moabites into your hand.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 18 this is but a light thing in the sight of yhwh he will also deliver the moabites into your hand

search.text: You shall strike every fortified city, and every choice city, and shall fell every good tree, and stop all springs of water, and mar every good piece of land with stones.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 19 you shall strike every fortified city and every choice city and shall fell every good tree and stop all springs of water and mar every good piece of land with stones

search.text: It happened in the morning, about the time of offering the offering, that behold, there came water by the way of Edom, and the country was filled with water.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 20 it happened in the morning about the time of offering the offering that behold there came water by the way of edom and the country was filled with water

search.text: Now when all the Moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them, they gathered themselves together, all who were able to put on armor, and upward, and stood on the border.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 21 now when all the moabites heard that the kings had come up to fight against them they gathered themselves together all who were able to put on armor and upward and stood on the border

search.text: They rose up early in the morning, and the sun shone on the water, and the Moabites saw the water over against them as red as blood:
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 22 they rose up early in the morning and the sun shone on the water and the moabites saw the water over against them as red as blood

search.text: and they said, This is blood; the kings are surely destroyed, and they have struck each person their fellow: now therefore, Moab, to the spoil.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 23 and they said this is blood the kings are surely destroyed and they have struck each person their fellow now therefore moab to the spoil

search.text: When they came to the camp of Israel, the Israelites rose up and struck the Moabites, so that they fled before them; and they went forward into the land smiting the Moabites.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 24 when they came to the camp of israel the israelites rose up and struck the moabites so that they fled before them and they went forward into the land smiting the moabites

search.text: They beat down the cities; and on every good piece of land they cast everyone their stone, and filled it; and they stopped all the springs of water, and felled all the good trees, until in Kir Hareseth [only] they left the stones of it; however the men armed with slings went about it, and struck it.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 25 they beat down the cities and on every good piece of land they cast everyone their stone and filled it and they stopped all the springs of water and felled all the good trees until in kir hareseth only they left the stones of it however the men armed with slings went about it and struck it

search.text: When the king of Moab saw that the battle was too severe for him, he took with him seven hundred people who drew sword, to break through to the king of Edom; but they could not.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 26 when the king of moab saw that the battle was too severe for him he took with him seven hundred people who drew sword to break through to the king of edom but they could not

search.text: Then he took his eldest son who would have reigned in his place, and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall. There was great wrath against Israel: and they departed from him, and returned to their own land.
search.searchText: 2 kings 3 27 then he took his eldest son who would have reigned in his place and offered him for a burnt offering on the wall there was great wrath against israel and they departed from him and returned to their own land

search.text: Now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets to Elisha, saying, Your servant my husband is dead; and you know that your servant did revere YHWH: and the creditor is come to take to him my two children to be bondservants.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 1 now there cried a certain woman of the wives of the sons of the prophets to elisha saying your servant my husband is dead and you know that your servant did revere yhwh and the creditor is come to take to him my two children to be bondservants

search.text: Elisha said to her, What shall I do for you? tell me; what have you in the house? She said, Your handmaid has nothing in the house, except a pot of oil.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 2 elisha said to her what shall i do for you tell me what have you in the house she said your handmaid has nothing in the house except a pot of oil

search.text: Then he said, Go, borrow you vessels abroad of all your neighbors, even empty vessels; borrow not a few.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 3 then he said go borrow you vessels abroad of all your neighbors even empty vessels borrow not a few

search.text: You shall go in, and shut the door on you and on your sons, and pour out into all those vessels; and you shall set aside that which is full.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 4 you shall go in and shut the door on you and on your sons and pour out into all those vessels and you shall set aside that which is full

search.text: So she went from him, and shut the door on her and on her sons; they brought [the vessels] to her, and she poured out.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 5 so she went from him and shut the door on her and on her sons they brought the vessels to her and she poured out

search.text: It happened, when the vessels were full, that she said to her son, Bring me yet a vessel. He said to her, There isn't another vessel. The oil stayed.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 6 it happened when the vessels were full that she said to her son bring me yet a vessel he said to her there isn t another vessel the oil stayed

search.text: Then she came and told the person of Elohim. He said, Go, sell the oil, and pay your debt, and live you and your sons of the rest.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 7 then she came and told the person of elohim he said go sell the oil and pay your debt and live you and your sons of the rest

search.text: It fell on a day, that Elisha passed to Shunem, where was a great woman; and she constrained him to eat bread. So it was, that as often as he passed by, he turned in there to eat bread.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 8 it fell on a day that elisha passed to shunem where was a great woman and she constrained him to eat bread so it was that as often as he passed by he turned in there to eat bread

search.text: She said to her husband, See now, I perceive that this is a holy man of Elohim, that passes by us continually.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 9 she said to her husband see now i perceive that this is a holy man of elohim that passes by us continually

search.text: Let us make, Please, a little chamber on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a seat, and a lamp stand: and it shall be, when he comes to us, that he shall turn in there.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 10 let us make please a little chamber on the wall and let us set for him there a bed and a table and a seat and a lamp stand and it shall be when he comes to us that he shall turn in there

search.text: It fell on a day, that he came there, and he turned into the chamber and lay there.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 11 it fell on a day that he came there and he turned into the chamber and lay there

search.text: He said to Gehazi his servant, Call this Shunammite. When he had called her, she stood before him.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 12 he said to gehazi his servant call this shunammite when he had called her she stood before him

search.text: He said to him, Say now to her, Behold, you have been careful for us with all this care; what is to be done for you? would you be spoken for to the king, or to the captain of the army? She answered, I dwell among my own people.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 13 he said to him say now to her behold you have been careful for us with all this care what is to be done for you would you be spoken for to the king or to the captain of the army she answered i dwell among my own people

search.text: He said, What then is to be done for her? Gehazi answered, Most certainly she has no son, and her husband is old.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 14 he said what then is to be done for her gehazi answered most certainly she has no son and her husband is old

search.text: He said, Call her. When he had called her, she stood in the door.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 15 he said call her when he had called her she stood in the door

search.text: He said, At this season, when the time comes round, you shall embrace a son. She said, No, my lord, you man of Elohim, do not lie to your handmaid.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 16 he said at this season when the time comes round you shall embrace a son she said no my lord you man of elohim do not lie to your handmaid

search.text: The woman conceived, and bore a son at that season, when the time came round, as Elisha had said to her.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 17 the woman conceived and bore a son at that season when the time came round as elisha had said to her

search.text: When the child was grown, it fell on a day, that he went out to his father to the reapers.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 18 when the child was grown it fell on a day that he went out to his father to the reapers

search.text: He said to his father, My head, my head. He said to his servant, Carry him to his mother.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 19 he said to his father my head my head he said to his servant carry him to his mother

search.text: When he had taken him, and brought him to his mother, he sat on her knees until noon, and then died.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 20 when he had taken him and brought him to his mother he sat on her knees until noon and then died

search.text: She went up and laid him on the bed of the person of Elohim, and shut [the door] on him, and went out.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 21 she went up and laid him on the bed of the person of elohim and shut the door on him and went out

search.text: She called to her husband, and said, Please send me one of the servants, and one of the donkeys, that I may run to the person of Elohim, and come again.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 22 she called to her husband and said please send me one of the servants and one of the donkeys that i may run to the person of elohim and come again

search.text: He said, Why will you go to him today? it is neither new moon nor Sabbath. She said, It shall be well.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 23 he said why will you go to him today it is neither new moon nor sabbath she said it shall be well

search.text: Then she saddled a donkey, and said to her servant, Drive, and go forward; don't slacken me the riding, except I bid you.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 24 then she saddled a donkey and said to her servant drive and go forward don t slacken me the riding except i bid you

search.text: So she went, and came to the person of Elohim to Mount Carmel. It happened, when the person of Elohim saw her afar off, that they said to Gehazi their servant, Behold, yonder is the Shunammite:
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 25 so she went and came to the person of elohim to mount carmel it happened when the person of elohim saw her afar off that they said to gehazi their servant behold yonder is the shunammite

search.text: please run now to meet her, and ask her, Is it well with you? is it well with your husband? is it well with the child? She answered, It is well.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 26 please run now to meet her and ask her is it well with you is it well with your husband is it well with the child she answered it is well

search.text: When she came to the person of Elohim to the hill, she caught hold of their feet. Gehazi came near to thrust her away; but the person of Elohim said, Let her alone: for her soul is vexed within her; and YHWH has hid it from me, and has not told me.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 27 when she came to the person of elohim to the hill she caught hold of their feet gehazi came near to thrust her away but the person of elohim said let her alone for her soul is vexed within her and yhwh has hid it from me and has not told me

search.text: Then she said, Did I desire a son of my lord? Didn't I say, Do not deceive me?
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 28 then she said did i desire a son of my lord didn t i say do not deceive me

search.text: Then they said to Gehazi, Gird up your waist, and take my staff in your hand, and go your way: if you meet anyone, Don't greet him; and if anyone greets you, don't answer him again: and lay my staff on the face of the child.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 29 then they said to gehazi gird up your waist and take my staff in your hand and go your way if you meet anyone don t greet him and if anyone greets you don t answer him again and lay my staff on the face of the child

search.text: The mother of the child said, As YHWH lives, and as your soul lives, I will not leave you. He arose, and followed her.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 30 the mother of the child said as yhwh lives and as your soul lives i will not leave you he arose and followed her

search.text: Gehazi passed on before them, and laid the staff on the face of the child; but there was neither voice, nor hearing. Therefore he returned to meet him, and told him, saying, The child has not awakened.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 31 gehazi passed on before them and laid the staff on the face of the child but there was neither voice nor hearing therefore he returned to meet him and told him saying the child has not awakened

search.text: When Elisha was come into the house, behold, the child was dead, and laid on his bed.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 32 when elisha was come into the house behold the child was dead and laid on his bed

search.text: He went in therefore, and shut the door on them both, and prayed to YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 33 he went in therefore and shut the door on them both and prayed to yhwh

search.text: He went up, and lay on the child, and put his mouth on his mouth, and his eyes on his eyes, and his hands on his hands: and he stretched himself on him; and the flesh of the child grew warm.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 34 he went up and lay on the child and put his mouth on his mouth and his eyes on his eyes and his hands on his hands and he stretched himself on him and the flesh of the child grew warm

search.text: Then he returned, and walked in the house once back and forth; and went up, and stretched himself on him: and the child sneezed seven times, and the child opened his eyes.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 35 then he returned and walked in the house once back and forth and went up and stretched himself on him and the child sneezed seven times and the child opened his eyes

search.text: He called Gehazi, and said, Call this Shunammite. So he called her. When she was come in to him, he said, Take up your son.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 36 he called gehazi and said call this shunammite so he called her when she was come in to him he said take up your son

search.text: Then she went in, and fell at his feet, and bowed herself to the ground; and she took up her son, and went out.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 37 then she went in and fell at his feet and bowed herself to the ground and she took up her son and went out

search.text: Elisha came again to Gilgal. There was a dearth in the land; and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him; and he said to his servant, Set on the great pot, and boil stew for the sons of the prophets.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 38 elisha came again to gilgal there was a dearth in the land and the sons of the prophets were sitting before him and he said to his servant set on the great pot and boil stew for the sons of the prophets

search.text: One went out into the field to gather herbs, and found a wild vine, and gathered of it wild gourds his lap full, and came and shred them into the pot of stew; for they didn't recognize them.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 39 one went out into the field to gather herbs and found a wild vine and gathered of it wild gourds his lap full and came and shred them into the pot of stew for they didn t recognize them

search.text: So they poured out for the men to eat. It happened, as they were eating of the stew, that they cried out, and said, man of Elohim, there is death in the pot. They could not eat of it.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 40 so they poured out for the men to eat it happened as they were eating of the stew that they cried out and said man of elohim there is death in the pot they could not eat of it

search.text: But he said, Then bring meal. He cast it into the pot; and he said, Pour out for the people, that they may eat. There was no harm in the pot.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 41 but he said then bring meal he cast it into the pot and he said pour out for the people that they may eat there was no harm in the pot

search.text: There came a person from Baal Shalishah, and brought the person of Elohim bread of the first fruits, twenty loaves of barley, and fresh ears of grain in their sack. He said, Give to the people, that they may eat.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 42 there came a person from baal shalishah and brought the person of elohim bread of the first fruits twenty loaves of barley and fresh ears of grain in their sack he said give to the people that they may eat

search.text: His servant said, What, should I set this before a hundred men? But he said, Give the people, that they may eat; for thus says YHWH, They shall eat, and shall leave of it.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 43 his servant said what should i set this before a hundred men but he said give the people that they may eat for thus says yhwh they shall eat and shall leave of it

search.text: So he set it before them, and they ate, and left of it, according to the word of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 kings 4 44 so he set it before them and they ate and left of it according to the word of yhwh

search.text: Now Naaman, captain of the army of the king of Aram, was a great man with his master, and honorable, because by him YHWH had given victory to Aram: he was also a mighty man of valor, [but he was] a leper.

search.text: She said to her mistress, Would that my lord were with the prophet who is in Shomron! then would he recover him of his leprosy.
search.searchText: 2 kings 5 3 she said to her mistress would that my lord were with the prophet who is in shomron then would he recover him of his leprosy

search.text: But Naaman was angry, and went away, and said, Behold, I thought, He will surely come out to me, and stand, and call on the name of YHWH his God, and wave his hand over the place, and recover the leper.

search.text: Now the king was talking with Gehazi the servant of the person of Elohim, saying, Please tell me all the great things that Elisha has done.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 4 now the king was talking with gehazi the servant of the person of elohim saying please tell me all the great things that elisha has done

search.text: It happened, as they were telling the king how they had restored to life the one who was dead, that behold, the woman, whose son they had restored to life, cried to the king for her house and for her land. Gehazi said, My lord, O king, this is the woman, and this is her son, whom Elisha restored to life.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 5 it happened as they were telling the king how they had restored to life the one who was dead that behold the woman whose son they had restored to life cried to the king for her house and for her land gehazi said my lord o king this is the woman and this is her son whom elisha restored to life

search.text: When the king asked the woman, she told him. So the king appointed to her a certain officer, saying, Restore all that was hers, and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land, even until now.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 6 when the king asked the woman she told him so the king appointed to her a certain officer saying restore all that was hers and all the fruits of the field since the day that she left the land even until now

search.text: Elisha came to Dammeseq; and Benhadad the king of Aram was sick; and it was told him, saying, The person of Elohim is come here.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 7 elisha came to dammeseq and benhadad the king of aram was sick and it was told him saying the person of elohim is come here

search.text: The king said to Hazael, Take a present in your hand, and go, meet the person of Elohim, and inquire of YHWH by him, saying, Shall I recover of this sickness?
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 8 the king said to hazael take a present in your hand and go meet the person of elohim and inquire of yhwh by him saying shall i recover of this sickness

search.text: So Hazael went to meet him, and took a present with him, even of every good thing of Dammeseq, forty camels' burden, and came and stood before him, and said, Your son Benhadad king of Aram has sent me to you, saying, Shall I recover of this sickness?
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 9 so hazael went to meet him and took a present with him even of every good thing of dammeseq forty camels burden and came and stood before him and said your son benhadad king of aram has sent me to you saying shall i recover of this sickness

search.text: Elisha said to him, Go, tell him, You shall surely recover; however YHWH has shown me that he shall surely die.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 10 elisha said to him go tell him you shall surely recover however yhwh has shown me that he shall surely die

search.text: They settled their gaze steadfastly [on him], until they were ashamed: and the person of Elohim wept.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 11 they settled their gaze steadfastly on him until they were ashamed and the person of elohim wept

search.text: Hazael said, Why weeps my lord? He answered, Because I know the brokenness that you will do to the children of Israel: their strongholds will you set on fire, and their young people will you kill with the sword, and will dash in pieces their little ones, and rip up their women with child.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 12 hazael said why weeps my lord he answered because i know the brokenness that you will do to the children of israel their strongholds will you set on fire and their young people will you kill with the sword and will dash in pieces their little ones and rip up their women with child

search.text: Hazael said, But what is your servant, who is but a dog, that he should do this great thing? Elisha answered, YHWH has shown me that you shall be king over Aram.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 13 hazael said but what is your servant who is but a dog that he should do this great thing elisha answered yhwh has shown me that you shall be king over aram

search.text: Then he departed from Elisha, and came to his master; who said to him, What said Elisha to you? He answered, He told me that you would surely recover.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 14 then he departed from elisha and came to his master who said to him what said elisha to you he answered he told me that you would surely recover

search.text: It happened on the next day, that he took the coverlet, and dipped it in water, and spread it on his face, so that he died: and Hazael reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 15 it happened on the next day that he took the coverlet and dipped it in water and spread it on his face so that he died and hazael reigned in his place

search.text: In the fifth year of Yoram the son of Achav king of Israel, Yehoshafat being then king of Yehudah, Yoram the son of Yehoshafat king of Yehudah began to reign.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 16 in the fifth year of yoram the son of achav king of israel yehoshafat being then king of yehudah yoram the son of yehoshafat king of yehudah began to reign

search.text: Thirty-two years old was he when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 17 thirty two years old was he when he began to reign and he reigned eight years in yerushalayim

search.text: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Achav: for he had the daughter of Achav as wife; and he did what was broken in the sight of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 18 he walked in the way of the kings of israel as did the house of achav for he had the daughter of achav as wife and he did what was broken in the sight of yhwh

search.text: However YHWH would not destroy Yehudah, for Dawid his servant's sake, as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 19 however yhwh would not destroy yehudah for dawid his servant s sake as he promised him to give to him a lamp for his children always

search.text: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Yehudah, and made a king over themselves.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 20 in his days edom revolted from under the hand of yehudah and made a king over themselves

search.text: Then Yoram passed over to Zair, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, and the captains of the chariots; and the people fled to their tents.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 21 then yoram passed over to zair and all his chariots with him and he rose up by night and struck the edomites who surrounded him and the captains of the chariots and the people fled to their tents

search.text: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Yehudah to this day. Then did Libnah revolt at the same time.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 22 so edom revolted from under the hand of yehudah to this day then did libnah revolt at the same time

search.text: The rest of the acts of Yoram, and all that he did, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yehudah?
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 23 the rest of the acts of yoram and all that he did aren t they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of yehudah

search.text: Yoram slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of Dawid; and Ahaziah his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 24 yoram slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of dawid and ahaziah his son reigned in his place

search.text: In the twelfth year of Yoram the son of Achav king of Israel did Ahaziah the son of Yoram king of Yehudah begin to reign.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 25 in the twelfth year of yoram the son of achav king of israel did ahaziah the son of yoram king of yehudah begin to reign

search.text: Twenty-two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Yerushalayim. His mother's name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri king of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 26 twenty two years old was ahaziah when he began to reign and he reigned one year in yerushalayim his mother s name was athaliah the daughter of omri king of israel

search.text: He walked in the way of the house of Achav, and did what was broken in the sight of YHWH, as did the house of Achav; for he was the son-in-law of the house of Achav.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 27 he walked in the way of the house of achav and did what was broken in the sight of yhwh as did the house of achav for he was the son in law of the house of achav

search.text: He went with Yoram the son of Achav to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead: and the Syrians wounded Yoram.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 28 he went with yoram the son of achav to war against hazael king of aram at ramoth gilead and the syrians wounded yoram

search.text: King Yoram returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Aram. Ahaziah the son of Yoram king of Yehudah went down to see Yoram the son of Achav in Jezreel, because he was sick.
search.searchText: 2 kings 8 29 king yoram returned to be healed in jezreel of the wounds which the syrians had given him at ramah when he fought against hazael king of aram ahaziah the son of yoram king of yehudah went down to see yoram the son of achav in jezreel because he was sick

search.text: Elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets, and said to him, Gird up your waist, and take this vial of oil in your hand, and go to Ramoth Gilead.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 1 elisha the prophet called one of the sons of the prophets and said to him gird up your waist and take this vial of oil in your hand and go to ramoth gilead

search.text: When you come there, look out there Yehu the son of Yehoshafat the son of Nimshi, and go in, and make him arise up from among his brothers, and carry him to an inner chamber.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 2 when you come there look out there yehu the son of yehoshafat the son of nimshi and go in and make him arise up from among his brothers and carry him to an inner chamber

search.text: Then take the vial of oil, and pour it on his head, and say, Thus says YHWH, I have anointed you king over Israel. Then open the door, and flee, and don't wait.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 3 then take the vial of oil and pour it on his head and say thus says yhwh i have anointed you king over israel then open the door and flee and don t wait

search.text: So the young person, even the young person the prophet, went to Ramoth Gilead.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 4 so the young person even the young person the prophet went to ramoth gilead

search.text: When he came, behold, the captains of the army were sitting; and he said, I have an errand to you, captain. Yehu said, To which of us all? He said, To you, O captain.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 5 when he came behold the captains of the army were sitting and he said i have an errand to you captain yehu said to which of us all he said to you o captain

search.text: He arose, and went into the house; and he poured the oil on his head, and said to him, Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, I have anointed you king over the people of YHWH, even over Israel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 6 he arose and went into the house and he poured the oil on his head and said to him thus says yhwh the god of israel i have anointed you king over the people of yhwh even over israel

search.text: You shall strike the house of Achav your master, that I may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets, and the blood of all the servants of YHWH, at the hand of Jezebel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 7 you shall strike the house of achav your master that i may avenge the blood of my servants the prophets and the blood of all the servants of yhwh at the hand of jezebel

search.text: For the whole house of Achav shall perish; and I will cut off from Achav everyone who urinates against a wall, and the one who is shut up and the one who is left at large in Israel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 8 for the whole house of achav shall perish and i will cut off from achav everyone who urinates against a wall and the one who is shut up and the one who is left at large in israel

search.text: I will make the house of Achav like the house of Yerovam the son of Nebat, and like the house of Baasha the son of Ahijah.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 9 i will make the house of achav like the house of yerovam the son of nebat and like the house of baasha the son of ahijah

search.text: The dogs shall eat Jezebel in the portion of Jezreel, and there shall be none to bury her. He opened the door, and fled.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 10 the dogs shall eat jezebel in the portion of jezreel and there shall be none to bury her he opened the door and fled

search.text: Then Yehu came forth to the servants of his lord: and one said to him, Is all well? why came this mad fellow to you? They said to them, You know the person and what their talk was.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 11 then yehu came forth to the servants of his lord and one said to him is all well why came this mad fellow to you they said to them you know the person and what their talk was

search.text: They said, It is false; tell us now. He said, Thus and thus spoke he to me, saying, Thus says YHWH, I have anointed you king over Israel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 12 they said it is false tell us now he said thus and thus spoke he to me saying thus says yhwh i have anointed you king over israel

search.text: Then they hurried, and took everyone their garment, and put it under him on the top of the stairs, and blew the trumpet, saying, Yehu is king.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 13 then they hurried and took everyone their garment and put it under him on the top of the stairs and blew the trumpet saying yehu is king

search.text: So Yehu the son of Yehoshafat the son of Nimshi conspired against Yoram. (Now Yoram was keeping Ramoth Gilead, he and all Israel, because of Hazael king of Aram;
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 14 so yehu the son of yehoshafat the son of nimshi conspired against yoram now yoram was keeping ramoth gilead he and all israel because of hazael king of aram

search.text: but king Yoram was returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which the Syrians had given him, when he fought with Hazael king of Aram.) Yehu said, If this be your mind, then let none escape and go forth out of the city, to go to tell it in Jezreel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 15 but king yoram was returned to be healed in jezreel of the wounds which the syrians had given him when he fought with hazael king of aram yehu said if this be your mind then let none escape and go forth out of the city to go to tell it in jezreel

search.text: So Yehu rode in a chariot, and went to Jezreel; for Yoram lay there. Ahaziah king of Yehudah was come down to see Yoram.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 16 so yehu rode in a chariot and went to jezreel for yoram lay there ahaziah king of yehudah was come down to see yoram

search.text: Now the watchman was standing on the tower in Jezreel, and he spied the company of Yehu as he came, and said, I see a company. Yoram said, Take a horseman, and send to meet them, and let him say, Is it peace?
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 17 now the watchman was standing on the tower in jezreel and he spied the company of yehu as he came and said i see a company yoram said take a horseman and send to meet them and let him say is it peace

search.text: So there went one on horseback to meet him, and said, Thus says the king, Is it peace? Yehu said, What have you to do with peace? turn you behind me. The watchman told, saying, The messenger came to them, but he isn't coming back.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 18 so there went one on horseback to meet him and said thus says the king is it peace yehu said what have you to do with peace turn you behind me the watchman told saying the messenger came to them but he isn t coming back

search.text: Then he sent out a second on horseback, who came to them, and said, Thus says the king, Is it peace? Yehu answered, What have you to do with peace? turn you behind me.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 19 then he sent out a second on horseback who came to them and said thus says the king is it peace yehu answered what have you to do with peace turn you behind me

search.text: The watchman told, saying, He came even to them, and isn't coming back: and the driving is like the driving of Yehu the son of Nimshi; for he drives furiously.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 20 the watchman told saying he came even to them and isn t coming back and the driving is like the driving of yehu the son of nimshi for he drives furiously

search.text: Yoram said, Make ready. They made ready his chariot. Yoram king of Israel and Ahaziah king of Yehudah went out, each in his chariot, and they went out to meet Yehu, and found him in the portion of Naboth the Jezreelite.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 21 yoram said make ready they made ready his chariot yoram king of israel and ahaziah king of yehudah went out each in his chariot and they went out to meet yehu and found him in the portion of naboth the jezreelite

search.text: It happened, when Yoram saw Yehu, that he said, Is it peace, Yehu? He answered, What peace, so long as the prostitution of your mother Jezebel and her witchcraft abound?
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 22 it happened when yoram saw yehu that he said is it peace yehu he answered what peace so long as the prostitution of your mother jezebel and her witchcraft abound

search.text: Yoram turned his hands, and fled, and said to Ahaziah, There is treachery, Ahaziah.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 23 yoram turned his hands and fled and said to ahaziah there is treachery ahaziah

search.text: Yehu drew his bow with his full strength, and struck Yoram between his arms; and the arrow went out at his heart, and he sunk down in his chariot.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 24 yehu drew his bow with his full strength and struck yoram between his arms and the arrow went out at his heart and he sunk down in his chariot

search.text: Then said [Yehu] to Bidkar his captain, Take up, and cast him in the portion of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how that, when I and you rode together after Achav his father, YHWH laid this burden on him:
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 25 then said yehu to bidkar his captain take up and cast him in the portion of the field of naboth the jezreelite for remember how that when i and you rode together after achav his father yhwh laid this burden on him

search.text: Surely I have seen yesterday the blood of Naboth, and the blood of his sons, says YHWH; and I will requite you in this plat, says YHWH. Now therefore take and cast him into the plat [of ground], according to the word of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 26 surely i have seen yesterday the blood of naboth and the blood of his sons says yhwh and i will requite you in this plat says yhwh now therefore take and cast him into the plat of ground according to the word of yhwh

search.text: But when Ahaziah the king of Yehudah saw this, he fled by the way of the garden house. Yehu followed after him, and said, Smite him also in the chariot: [and they struck him] at the ascent of Gur, which is by Ibleam. He fled to Megiddo, and died there.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 27 but when ahaziah the king of yehudah saw this he fled by the way of the garden house yehu followed after him and said smite him also in the chariot and they struck him at the ascent of gur which is by ibleam he fled to megiddo and died there

search.text: His servants carried him in a chariot to Yerushalayim, and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in the city of Dawid.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 28 his servants carried him in a chariot to yerushalayim and buried him in his tomb with his fathers in the city of dawid

search.text: In the eleventh year of Yoram the son of Achav began Ahaziah to reign over Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 29 in the eleventh year of yoram the son of achav began ahaziah to reign over yehudah

search.text: When Yehu was come to Jezreel, Jezebel heard of it; and she painted her eyes, and attired her head, and looked out at the window.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 30 when yehu was come to jezreel jezebel heard of it and she painted her eyes and attired her head and looked out at the window

search.text: As Yehu entered in at the gate, she said, Is it peace, you Zimri, your master's murderer?
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 31 as yehu entered in at the gate she said is it peace you zimri your master s murderer

search.text: He lifted up his face to the window, and said, Who is on my side? who? There looked out to him two or three eunuchs.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 32 he lifted up his face to the window and said who is on my side who there looked out to him two or three eunuchs

search.text: He said, Throw her down. So they threw her down; and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall, and on the horses: and he trod her under foot.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 33 he said throw her down so they threw her down and some of her blood was sprinkled on the wall and on the horses and he trod her under foot

search.text: When he was come in, he ate and drink; and he said, See now to this cursed woman, and bury her; for she is a king's daughter.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 34 when he was come in he ate and drink and he said see now to this cursed woman and bury her for she is a king s daughter

search.text: They went to bury her; but they found no more of her than the skull, and the feet, and the palms of her hands.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 35 they went to bury her but they found no more of her than the skull and the feet and the palms of her hands

search.text: Therefore they came back, and told him. He said, This is the word of YHWH, which YHWH spoke by YHWH’s servant Eliyahu the Tishbite, saying, In the portion of Jezreel shall the dogs eat the flesh of Jezebel;
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 36 therefore they came back and told him he said this is the word of yhwh which yhwh spoke by yhwh s servant eliyahu the tishbite saying in the portion of jezreel shall the dogs eat the flesh of jezebel

search.text: and the body of Jezebel shall be as dung on the face of the field in the portion of Jezreel, so that they shall not say, This is Jezebel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 9 37 and the body of jezebel shall be as dung on the face of the field in the portion of jezreel so that they shall not say this is jezebel

search.searchText: 2 kings 10 1 now achav had seventy sons in shomron yehu wrote letters and sent to shomron to the rulers of jezreel even the elders and to those who brought up the sons of achav saying

search.text: Now as soon as this letter comes to you, seeing your master's sons are with you, and there are with you chariots and horses, a fortified city also, and armor;
search.searchText: 2 kings 10 2 now as soon as this letter comes to you seeing your master s sons are with you and there are with you chariots and horses a fortified city also and armor

search.text: look you out the best and meet of your master's sons, and set him on his father's throne, and fight for your master's house.
search.searchText: 2 kings 10 3 look you out the best and meet of your master s sons and set him on his father s throne and fight for your master s house

search.text: But they were exceedingly afraid, and said, Behold, the two kings didn't stand before him: how then shall we stand?
search.searchText: 2 kings 10 4 but they were exceedingly afraid and said behold the two kings didn t stand before him how then shall we stand

search.text: The one who was over the household, and the one who was over the city, the elders also, and those who brought up [the children], sent to Yehu, saying, We are your servants, and will do all that you shall bid us; we will not make anyone king: you do that which is good in your eyes.
search.searchText: 2 kings 10 5 the one who was over the household and the one who was over the city the elders also and those who brought up the children sent to yehu saying we are your servants and will do all that you shall bid us we will not make anyone king you do that which is good in your eyes

search.text: Then he wrote a letter the second time to them, saying, If you be on my side, and if you will listen to my voice, take the heads of the men your master's sons, and come to me to Jezreel by tomorrow this time. Now the king's sons, being seventy persons, were with the great people of the city, who brought them up.
search.searchText: 2 kings 10 6 then he wrote a letter the second time to them saying if you be on my side and if you will listen to my voice take the heads of the men your master s sons and come to me to jezreel by tomorrow this time now the king s sons being seventy persons were with the great people of the city who brought them up

search.searchText: 2 kings 10 9 it happened in the morning that he went out and stood and said to all the people you are righteous behold i conspired against my master and killed him but who struck all these

search.text: Know now that there shall fall to the earth nothing of the word of YHWH, which YHWH spoke concerning the house of Achav: for YHWH has done that which he spoke by his servant Eliyahu.
search.searchText: 2 kings 10 10 know now that there shall fall to the earth nothing of the word of yhwh which yhwh spoke concerning the house of achav for yhwh has done that which he spoke by his servant eliyahu

search.searchText: 2 kings 10 11 so yehu struck all that remained of the house of achav in jezreel and all his great people and his familiar friends and his priests until he left him none remaining

search.text: Yehu met with the brothers of Ahaziah king of Yehudah, and said, Who are you? They answered, We are the brothers of Ahaziah: and we go down to Greet the children of the king and the children of the queen.
search.searchText: 2 kings 10 13 yehu met with the brothers of ahaziah king of yehudah and said who are you they answered we are the brothers of ahaziah and we go down to greet the children of the king and the children of the queen

search.text: He said, Take them alive. They took them alive, and killed them at the pit of the shearing house, even two and forty men; neither left he any of them.

search.searchText: 2 kings 10 15 when he was departed there he lighted on jehonadab the son of rechab coming to meet him and he greeted him and said to him is your heart right as my heart is with your heart jehonadab answered it is if it be give me your hand he gave him his hand and he took him up to him into the chariot

search.text: Then came Eliakim the son of Hilkiah, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and Joah the son of Asaph the recorder, to Chizkiyahu with their clothes torn, and told him the words of Rabshakeh.
search.searchText: 2 kings 18 37 then came eliakim the son of hilkiah who was over the household and shebna the scribe and joah the son of asaph the recorder to chizkiyahu with their clothes torn and told him the words of rabshakeh

search.text: He sent Eliakim, who was over the household, and Shebna the scribe, and the elders of the priests, covered with sackcloth, to Yeshayahu the prophet the son of Amoz.

search.text: They said to him, Thus says Chizkiyahu, This day is a day of trouble, and of rebuke, and of rejection; for the children are come to the birth, and there is not strength to bring forth.

search.text: It may be YHWH your God will hear all the words of Rabshakeh, whom the king of Ashur his master has sent to defy the living Elohim, and will rebuke the words which YHWH your God has heard. Therefore lift up your prayer for the remnant that is left.

search.text: So the servants of king Chizkiyahu came to Yeshayahu.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 5 so the servants of king chizkiyahu came to yeshayahu

search.text: Yeshayahu said to them, Thus shall you tell your master, Thus says YHWH, Don't be afraid of the words that you have heard, with which the servants of the king of Ashur have blasphemed me.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 6 yeshayahu said to them thus shall you tell your master thus says yhwh don t be afraid of the words that you have heard with which the servants of the king of ashur have blasphemed me

search.text: Behold, I will put a spirit in him, and he shall hear news, and shall return to his own land; and I will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 7 behold i will put a spirit in him and he shall hear news and shall return to his own land and i will cause him to fall by the sword in his own land

search.text: So Rabshakeh returned, and found the king of Ashur warring against Libnah; for he had heard that he was departed from Lachish.

search.text: Thus shall you speak to Chizkiyahu king of Yehudah, saying, Don't let your God in whom you trust deceive you, saying, Yerushalayim shall not be given into the hand of the king of Ashur.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 10 thus shall you speak to chizkiyahu king of yehudah saying don t let your god in whom you trust deceive you saying yerushalayim shall not be given into the hand of the king of ashur

search.text: Behold, you have heard what the kings of Ashur have done to all lands, by destroying them utterly: and shall you be delivered?
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 11 behold you have heard what the kings of ashur have done to all lands by destroying them utterly and shall you be delivered

search.text: Have the gods of the nations delivered them, which my fathers have destroyed, Gozan, and Haran, and Rezeph, and the children of Eden that were in Telassar?
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 12 have the gods of the nations delivered them which my fathers have destroyed gozan and haran and rezeph and the children of eden that were in telassar

search.text: Where is the king of Hamath, and the king of Arpad, and the king of the city of Sepharvaim, of Hena, and Ivvah?
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 13 where is the king of hamath and the king of arpad and the king of the city of sepharvaim of hena and ivvah

search.text: Chizkiyahu received the letter from the hand of the messengers, and read it; and Chizkiyahu went up to the house of YHWH, and spread it before YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 14 chizkiyahu received the letter from the hand of the messengers and read it and chizkiyahu went up to the house of yhwh and spread it before yhwh

search.text: Chizkiyahu prayed before YHWH, and said, YHWH, the God of Israel, who sit [above] the cherubim, you are the Elohim, even you alone, of all the kingdoms of the earth; you have made heavens and earth.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 15 chizkiyahu prayed before yhwh and said yhwh the god of israel who sit above the cherubim you are the elohim even you alone of all the kingdoms of the earth you have made heavens and earth

search.text: Incline your ear, YHWH, and hear; open your eyes, YHWH, and see; and hear the words of Sennacherib, with which he has sent him to defy the living Elohim.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 16 incline your ear yhwh and hear open your eyes yhwh and see and hear the words of sennacherib with which he has sent him to defy the living elohim

search.text: Of a truth, YHWH, the kings of Ashur have laid waste the nations and their lands,
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 17 of a truth yhwh the kings of ashur have laid waste the nations and their lands

search.text: and have cast their gods into the fire; for they were no gods, but the work of people's hands, wood and stone; therefore they have destroyed them.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 18 and have cast their gods into the fire for they were no gods but the work of people s hands wood and stone therefore they have destroyed them

search.text: Now therefore, YHWH our God, save you us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you YHWH are Elohim alone.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 19 now therefore yhwh our god save you us i beg you out of his hand that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you yhwh are elohim alone

search.text: Then Yeshayahu the son of Amoz sent to Chizkiyahu, saying, Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel, Whereas you have prayed to me against Sennacherib king of Ashur, I have heard [you].
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 20 then yeshayahu the son of amoz sent to chizkiyahu saying thus says yhwh the god of israel whereas you have prayed to me against sennacherib king of ashur i have heard you

search.text: This is the word that YHWH has spoken concerning him: The virgin daughter of Tzion has despised you and ridiculed you; the daughter of Yerushalayim has shaken her head at you.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 21 this is the word that yhwh has spoken concerning him the virgin daughter of tzion has despised you and ridiculed you the daughter of yerushalayim has shaken her head at you

search.text: Whom have you defied and blasphemed? and against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high? [even] against the Holy One of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 22 whom have you defied and blasphemed and against whom have you exalted your voice and lifted up your eyes on high even against the holy one of israel

search.text: By your messengers you have defied YHWH, and have said, With the multitude of my chariots am I come up to the height of the mountains, to the innermost parts of Levanon; and I will cut down the tall cedars of it, and the choice fir trees of it; and I will enter into his farthest lodging place, the forest of his fruitful field.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 23 by your messengers you have defied yhwh and have said with the multitude of my chariots am i come up to the height of the mountains to the innermost parts of levanon and i will cut down the tall cedars of it and the choice fir trees of it and i will enter into his farthest lodging place the forest of his fruitful field

search.text: I have dug and drunk strange waters, and with the sole of my feet will I dry up all the rivers of Mitzrayim.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 24 i have dug and drunk strange waters and with the sole of my feet will i dry up all the rivers of mitzrayim

search.text: Haven't you heard how I have done it long ago, and formed it of ancient times? now have I brought it to pass, that it should be yours to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 25 haven t you heard how i have done it long ago and formed it of ancient times now have i brought it to pass that it should be yours to lay waste fortified cities into ruinous heaps

search.text: Therefore their inhabitants were of small power, they were dismayed and confounded; they were as the grass of the field, and as the green herb, as the grass on the housetops, and as grain blasted before it is grown up.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 26 therefore their inhabitants were of small power they were dismayed and confounded they were as the grass of the field and as the green herb as the grass on the housetops and as grain blasted before it is grown up

search.text: But I know your sitting down, and your going out, and your coming in, and your raging against me.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 27 but i know your sitting down and your going out and your coming in and your raging against me

search.text: Because of your raging against me, and because your arrogance is come up into my ears, therefore will I put my hook in your nose, and my bridle in your lips, and I will turn you back by the way by which you came.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 28 because of your raging against me and because your arrogance is come up into my ears therefore will i put my hook in your nose and my bridle in your lips and i will turn you back by the way by which you came

search.text: This shall be the sign to you: You shall eat this year that which grows of itself, and in the second year that which springs of the same; and in the third year sow you, and reap, and plant vineyards, and eat the fruit of it.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 29 this shall be the sign to you you shall eat this year that which grows of itself and in the second year that which springs of the same and in the third year sow you and reap and plant vineyards and eat the fruit of it

search.text: The remnant that has escaped of the house of Yehudah shall again take root downward, and bear fruit upward.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 30 the remnant that has escaped of the house of yehudah shall again take root downward and bear fruit upward

search.text: For out of Yerushalayim shall go forth a remnant, and out of Har Tzion those who shall escape: the zeal of YHWH shall perform this.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 31 for out of yerushalayim shall go forth a remnant and out of har tzion those who shall escape the zeal of yhwh shall perform this

search.text: Therefore thus says YHWH concerning the king of Ashur, He shall not come to this city, nor shoot an arrow there, neither shall he come before it with shield, nor cast up a mound against it.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 32 therefore thus says yhwh concerning the king of ashur he shall not come to this city nor shoot an arrow there neither shall he come before it with shield nor cast up a mound against it

search.text: By the way that he came, by the same shall he return, and he shall not come to this city, says YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 33 by the way that he came by the same shall he return and he shall not come to this city says yhwh

search.text: For I will defend this city to save it, for my own sake, and for my servant Dawid's sake.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 34 for i will defend this city to save it for my own sake and for my servant dawid s sake

search.text: It happened that night, that the angel of YHWH went forth, and struck in the camp of the Assyrians one hundred eighty-five thousand: and when men arose early in the morning, behold, these were all dead bodies.
search.searchText: 2 kings 19 35 it happened that night that the angel of yhwh went forth and struck in the camp of the assyrians one hundred eighty five thousand and when men arose early in the morning behold these were all dead bodies

search.searchText: 2 kings 19 36 so sennacherib king of ashur departed and went and returned and lived at ninveh

search.searchText: 2 kings 19 37 it happened as he was worshipping in the house of nisroch his god that adrammelech and sharezer struck him with the sword and they escaped into the land of ararat esar haddon his son reigned in his place

search.text: Turn back, and tell Chizkiyahu the prince of my people, Thus says YHWH, the God of Dawid your father, I have heard your prayer, I have seen your tears: behold, I will heal you; on the third day you shall go up to the house of YHWH.

search.text: I will add to your days fifteen years; and I will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of Ashur; and I will defend this city for my own sake, and for my servant Dawid's sake.
search.searchText: 2 kings 20 6 i will add to your days fifteen years and i will deliver you and this city out of the hand of the king of ashur and i will defend this city for my own sake and for my servant dawid s sake

search.text: Yeshayahu said, Take a cake of figs. They took and laid it on the boil, and he recovered.
search.searchText: 2 kings 20 7 yeshayahu said take a cake of figs they took and laid it on the boil and he recovered

search.text: Chizkiyahu said to Yeshayahu, What shall be the sign that YHWH will heal me, and that I shall go up to the house of YHWH the third day?
search.searchText: 2 kings 20 8 chizkiyahu said to yeshayahu what shall be the sign that yhwh will heal me and that i shall go up to the house of yhwh the third day

search.text: Yeshayahu said, This shall be the sign to you from YHWH, that YHWH will do the thing that YHWH has spoken: shall the shadow go forward ten steps, or go back ten steps?
search.searchText: 2 kings 20 9 yeshayahu said this shall be the sign to you from yhwh that yhwh will do the thing that yhwh has spoken shall the shadow go forward ten steps or go back ten steps

search.text: Chizkiyahu answered, It is a light thing for the shadow to decline ten steps: nay, but let the shadow return backward ten steps.
search.searchText: 2 kings 20 10 chizkiyahu answered it is a light thing for the shadow to decline ten steps nay but let the shadow return backward ten steps

search.text: Yeshayahu the prophet cried to YHWH; and he brought the shadow ten steps backward, by which it had gone down on the dial of Achaz.
search.searchText: 2 kings 20 11 yeshayahu the prophet cried to yhwh and he brought the shadow ten steps backward by which it had gone down on the dial of achaz

search.text: Chizkiyahu listened to them, and shown them all the house of his precious things, the silver, and the gold, and the spices, and the precious oil, and the house of his armor, and all that was found in his treasures: there was nothing in his house, nor in all his dominion, that Chizkiyahu didn't show them.
search.searchText: 2 kings 20 13 chizkiyahu listened to them and shown them all the house of his precious things the silver and the gold and the spices and the precious oil and the house of his armor and all that was found in his treasures there was nothing in his house nor in all his dominion that chizkiyahu didn t show them

search.text: Then came Yeshayahu the prophet to king Chizkiyahu, and said to him, What said these men? and from whence came they to you? Chizkiyahu said, They are come from a far country, even from Bavel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 20 14 then came yeshayahu the prophet to king chizkiyahu and said to him what said these men and from whence came they to you chizkiyahu said they are come from a far country even from bavel

search.searchText: 2 kings 20 15 he said what have they seen in your house chizkiyahu answered all that is in my house have they seen there is nothing among my treasures that i have not shown them

search.searchText: 2 kings 20 16 yeshayahu said to chizkiyahu hear the word of yhwh

search.text: Behold, the days come, that all that is in your house, and that which your fathers have laid up in store to this day, shall be carried to Bavel: nothing shall be left, says YHWH.

search.searchText: 2 kings 20 18 of your sons who shall issue from you whom you shall father shall they take away and they shall be eunuchs in the palace of the king of bavel

search.text: Then said Chizkiyahu to Yeshayahu, Good is the word of YHWH which you have spoken. He said moreover, Isn't it so, if peace and truth shall be in my days?

search.text: Now the rest of the acts of Chizkiyahu, and all his might, and how he made the pool, and the conduit, and brought water into the city, aren't they written in the book of the chronicles of the kings of Yehudah?

search.searchText: 2 kings 20 21 chizkiyahu slept with his fathers and menashe his son reigned in his place

search.text: Yoshiyahu was eight years old when he began to reign; and he reigned thirty-one years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Jedidah the daughter of Adaiah of Bozkath.
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 1 yoshiyahu was eight years old when he began to reign and he reigned thirty one years in yerushalayim and his mother s name was jedidah the daughter of adaiah of bozkath

search.text: He did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH, and walked in all the way of Dawid his father, and didn't turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 2 he did that which was right in the eyes of yhwh and walked in all the way of dawid his father and didn t turn aside to the right hand or to the left

search.text: It happened in the eighteenth year of king Yoshiyahu, that the king sent Shaphan, the son of Azaliah the son of Meshullam, the scribe, to the house of YHWH, saying,

search.text: Go up to Hilkiah the high priest, that he may sum the money which is brought into the house of YHWH, which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people:
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 4 go up to hilkiah the high priest that he may sum the money which is brought into the house of yhwh which the keepers of the threshold have gathered of the people

search.text: and let them deliver it into the hand of the workmen who have the oversight of the house of YHWH; and let them give it to the workmen who are in the house of YHWH, to repair the breaches of the house,

search.text: to the carpenters, and to the builders, and to the masons, and for buying timber and hewn stone to repair the house.
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 6 to the carpenters and to the builders and to the masons and for buying timber and hewn stone to repair the house

search.text: However there was no reckoning made with them of the money that was delivered into their hand; for they dealt faithfully.

search.text: Hilkiah the high priest said to Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of YHWH. Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan, and he read it.

search.text: Shaphan the scribe came to the king, and brought the king word again, and said, Your servants have emptied out the money that was found in the house, and have delivered it into the hand of the workmen who have the oversight of the house of YHWH.
