search.searchText: 2 kings 22 10 shaphan the scribe told the king saying hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book shaphan read it before the king

search.text: It happened, when the king had heard the words of the book of the law, that he tore his clothes.
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 11 it happened when the king had heard the words of the book of the law that he tore his clothes

search.text: The king commanded Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Achbor the son of Micaiah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king's servant, saying,
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 12 the king commanded hilkiah the priest and ahikam the son of shaphan and achbor the son of micaiah and shaphan the scribe and asaiah the king s servant saying

search.text: Go you, inquire of YHWH for me, and for the people, and for all Yehudah, concerning the words of this book that is found; for great is the wrath of YHWH that is kindled against us, because our fathers have not listened to the words of this book, to do according to all that which is written concerning us.
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 13 go you inquire of yhwh for me and for the people and for all yehudah concerning the words of this book that is found for great is the wrath of yhwh that is kindled against us because our fathers have not listened to the words of this book to do according to all that which is written concerning us

search.text: So Hilkiah the priest, and Ahikam, and Achbor, and Shaphan, and Asaiah, went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tikvah, the son of Harhas, keeper of the wardrobe (now she lived in Yerushalayim in the second quarter); and they talked with her.
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 14 so hilkiah the priest and ahikam and achbor and shaphan and asaiah went to huldah the prophetess the wife of shallum the son of tikvah the son of harhas keeper of the wardrobe now she lived in yerushalayim in the second quarter and they talked with her

search.text: She said to them, Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Tell you the one who sent you to me,
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 15 she said to them thus says yhwh the god of israel tell you the one who sent you to me

search.text: Thus says YHWH, Behold, I will bring harm on this place, and on the inhabitants of it, even all the words of the book which the king of Yehudah has read.
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 16 thus says yhwh behold i will bring harm on this place and on the inhabitants of it even all the words of the book which the king of yehudah has read

search.text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands, therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place, and it shall not be quenched.
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 17 because they have forsaken me and have burned incense to other gods that they might provoke me to anger with all the work of their hands therefore my wrath shall be kindled against this place and it shall not be quenched

search.text: But to the king of Yehudah, who sent you to inquire of YHWH, thus shall you tell him, Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: As touching the words which you have heard,
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 18 but to the king of yehudah who sent you to inquire of yhwh thus shall you tell him thus says yhwh the god of israel as touching the words which you have heard

search.text: because your heart was tender, and you did humble yourself before YHWH, when you heard what I spoke against this place, and against the inhabitants of it, that they should become a desolation and a curse, and have torn your clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard you, says YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 19 because your heart was tender and you did humble yourself before yhwh when you heard what i spoke against this place and against the inhabitants of it that they should become a desolation and a curse and have torn your clothes and wept before me i also have heard you says yhwh

search.text: Therefore, behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, neither shall your eyes see all the calamity which I will bring on this place. They brought the king word again.
search.searchText: 2 kings 22 20 therefore behold i will gather you to your fathers and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace neither shall your eyes see all the calamity which i will bring on this place they brought the king word again

search.text: The king sent, and they gathered to him all the elders of Yehudah and of Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 kings 23 1 the king sent and they gathered to him all the elders of yehudah and of yerushalayim

search.text: The king went up to the house of YHWH, and all the people of Yehudah and all the inhabitants of Yerushalayim with him, and the priests, and the prophets, and all the people, both small and great: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 kings 23 2 the king went up to the house of yhwh and all the people of yehudah and all the inhabitants of yerushalayim with him and the priests and the prophets and all the people both small and great and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant which was found in the house of yhwh

search.text: The king stood by the pillar, and made a covenant before YHWH, to walk after YHWH, and to keep YHWH’s commandments, and YHWH’s testimonies, and YHWH’s statutes, with all [his] heart, and all [his] soul, to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book: and all the people stood to the covenant.
search.searchText: 2 kings 23 3 the king stood by the pillar and made a covenant before yhwh to walk after yhwh and to keep yhwh s commandments and yhwh s testimonies and yhwh s statutes with all his heart and all his soul to confirm the words of this covenant that were written in this book and all the people stood to the covenant

search.text: The king commanded Hilkiah the high priest, and the priests of the second order, and the keepers of the threshold, to bring forth out of the temple of YHWH all the vessels that were made for Baal, and for the Asherah, and for all the army of the heavens, and he burned them outside of Yerushalayim in the fields of the Kidron, and carried the ashes of them to Beit El.
search.searchText: 2 kings 23 4 the king commanded hilkiah the high priest and the priests of the second order and the keepers of the threshold to bring forth out of the temple of yhwh all the vessels that were made for baal and for the asherah and for all the army of the heavens and he burned them outside of yerushalayim in the fields of the kidron and carried the ashes of them to beit el

search.text: He put down the idolatrous priests, whom the kings of Yehudah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of Yehudah, and in the places round about Yerushalayim; those also who burned incense to Baal, to the sun, and to the moon, and to the planets, and to all the army of the heavens.
search.searchText: 2 kings 23 5 he put down the idolatrous priests whom the kings of yehudah had ordained to burn incense in the high places in the cities of yehudah and in the places round about yerushalayim those also who burned incense to baal to the sun and to the moon and to the planets and to all the army of the heavens

search.text: He brought out the Asherah from the house of YHWH, outside of Yerushalayim, to the brook Kidron, and burned it at the brook Kidron, and beat it to dust, and cast the dust of it on the graves of the common people.
search.searchText: 2 kings 23 6 he brought out the asherah from the house of yhwh outside of yerushalayim to the brook kidron and burned it at the brook kidron and beat it to dust and cast the dust of it on the graves of the common people

search.text: He broke down the houses of the sodomites, that were in the house of YHWH, where the women wove hangings for the Asherah.
search.searchText: 2 kings 23 7 he broke down the houses of the sodomites that were in the house of yhwh where the women wove hangings for the asherah

search.searchText: 2 kings 23 8 he brought all the priests out of the cities of yehudah and defiled the high places where the priests had burned incense from geba to be er sheva and they broke down the high places of the gates that were at the entrance of the gate of yehoshua the governor of the city which were on a person s left hand at the gate of the city

search.text: Nevertheless the priests of the high places didn't come up to the altar of YHWH in Yerushalayim, but they ate unleavened bread among their brothers.

search.searchText: 2 kings 23 11 he took away the horses that the kings of yehudah had given to the sun at the entrance of the house of yhwh by the chamber of natan melech the officer who was in the court and he burned the chariots of the sun with fire

search.searchText: 2 kings 23 12 the altars that were on the roof of the upper chamber of achaz which the kings of yehudah had made and the altars which menashe had made in the two courts of the house of yhwh did the king break down and beat them down from there and cast the dust of them into the brook kidron

search.text: The high places that were before Yerushalayim, which were on the right hand of the mountain of corruption, which Shlomo the king of Israel had built for Ashtoreth the abomination of the Sidonians, and for Chemosh the abomination of Moab, and for Milcom the abomination of the children of Ammon, did the king defile.

search.searchText: 2 kings 23 14 he broke in pieces the pillars and cut down the asherim and filled their places with the bones of people

search.text: Moreover the altar that was at Beit El, and the high place which Yerovam the son of Nebat, who made Israel to sin, had made, even that altar and the high place he broke down; and he burned the high place and beat it to dust, and burned the Asherah.

search.text: As Yoshiyahu turned himself, he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain; and they sent, and took the bones out of the tombs, and burned them on the altar, and defiled it, according to the word of YHWH which the person of Elohim proclaimed, who proclaimed these things.
search.searchText: 2 kings 23 16 as yoshiyahu turned himself he spied the tombs that were there in the mountain and they sent and took the bones out of the tombs and burned them on the altar and defiled it according to the word of yhwh which the person of elohim proclaimed who proclaimed these things

search.text: Then he said, What monument is that which I see? The men of the city told him, It is the tomb of the person of Elohim, who came from Yehudah, and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of Beit El.
search.searchText: 2 kings 23 17 then he said what monument is that which i see the men of the city told him it is the tomb of the person of elohim who came from yehudah and proclaimed these things that you have done against the altar of beit el

search.text: He said, Let him be; let no one move their bones. So they let his bones alone, with the bones of the prophet who came out of Shomron.

search.text: All the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of Shomron, which the kings of Israel had made to provoke [YHWH] to anger, Yoshiyahu took away, and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in Beit El.
search.searchText: 2 kings 23 19 all the houses also of the high places that were in the cities of shomron which the kings of israel had made to provoke yhwh to anger yoshiyahu took away and did to them according to all the acts that he had done in beit el

search.searchText: 2 kings 23 21 the king commanded all the people saying keep the passover to yhwh your god as it is written in this book of the covenant

search.searchText: 2 kings 23 22 surely there was not kept such a passover from the days of the judges who judged israel nor in all the days of the kings of israel nor of the kings of yehudah

search.searchText: 2 kings 24 15 he carried away jehoiachin to bavel and the king s mother and the king s wives and his officers and the chief men of the land carried he into captivity from yerushalayim to bavel

search.text: All the men of might, even seven thousand, and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand, all of them strong and apt for war, even them the king of Bavel brought captive to Bavel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 24 16 all the men of might even seven thousand and the craftsmen and the smiths one thousand all of them strong and apt for war even them the king of bavel brought captive to bavel

search.text: The king of Bavel made Mattaniah, [Jehoiachin's] father's brother, king is his place, and changed his name to Tzidkiyahu.
search.searchText: 2 kings 24 17 the king of bavel made mattaniah jehoiachin s father s brother king is his place and changed his name to tzidkiyahu

search.text: Tzidkiyahu was twenty-one years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Hamutal the daughter of Yirmeyahu of Libnah.
search.searchText: 2 kings 24 18 tzidkiyahu was twenty one years old when he began to reign and he reigned eleven years in yerushalayim and his mother s name was hamutal the daughter of yirmeyahu of libnah

search.text: He did what was broken in the sight of YHWH, according to all that Jehoiakim had done.
search.searchText: 2 kings 24 19 he did what was broken in the sight of yhwh according to all that jehoiakim had done

search.text: For through the anger of YHWH did it happen in Yerushalayim and Yehudah, until he had cast them out from his presence. Tzidkiyahu rebelled against the king of Bavel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 24 20 for through the anger of yhwh did it happen in yerushalayim and yehudah until he had cast them out from his presence tzidkiyahu rebelled against the king of bavel

search.text: It happened in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, in the tenth day of the month, that Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel came, he and all his army, against Yerushalayim, and encamped against it; and they built forts against it round about.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 1 it happened in the ninth year of his reign in the tenth month in the tenth day of the month that nebuchadnezzar king of bavel came he and all his army against yerushalayim and encamped against it and they built forts against it round about

search.text: So the city was besieged to the eleventh year of king Tzidkiyahu.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 2 so the city was besieged to the eleventh year of king tzidkiyahu

search.text: On the ninth day of the [fourth] month the famine was sore in the city, so that there was no bread for the people of the land.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 3 on the ninth day of the fourth month the famine was sore in the city so that there was no bread for the people of the land

search.text: Then a breach was made in the city, and all the men of war [fled] by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, which was by the king's garden (now the Chaldeans were against the city round about); and [the king] went by the way of the Arabah.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 4 then a breach was made in the city and all the men of war fled by night by the way of the gate between the two walls which was by the king s garden now the chaldeans were against the city round about and the king went by the way of the arabah

search.text: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued after the king, and overtook him in the plains of Yericho; and all his army was scattered from him.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 5 but the army of the chaldeans pursued after the king and overtook him in the plains of yericho and all his army was scattered from him

search.text: Then they took the king, and carried him up to the king of Bavel to Riblah; and they gave judgment on him.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 6 then they took the king and carried him up to the king of bavel to riblah and they gave judgment on him

search.text: They killed the sons of Tzidkiyahu before his eyes, and put out the eyes of Tzidkiyahu, and bound him in fetters, and carried him to Bavel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 7 they killed the sons of tzidkiyahu before his eyes and put out the eyes of tzidkiyahu and bound him in fetters and carried him to bavel

search.text: Now in the fifth month, on the seventh day of the month, which was the nineteenth year of king Nebuchadnezzar, king of Bavel, came Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard, a servant of the king of Bavel, to Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 8 now in the fifth month on the seventh day of the month which was the nineteenth year of king nebuchadnezzar king of bavel came nebuzaradan the captain of the guard a servant of the king of bavel to yerushalayim

search.text: He burnt the house of YHWH, and the king's house; and all the houses of Yerushalayim, even every great house, burnt he with fire.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 9 he burnt the house of yhwh and the king s house and all the houses of yerushalayim even every great house burnt he with fire

search.text: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were [with] the captain of the guard, broke down the walls of Yerushalayim round about.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 10 all the army of the chaldeans who were with the captain of the guard broke down the walls of yerushalayim round about

search.text: The residue of the people who were left in the city, and those who fell away, who fell to the king of Bavel, and the residue of the multitude, did Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carry away captive.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 11 the residue of the people who were left in the city and those who fell away who fell to the king of bavel and the residue of the multitude did nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carry away captive

search.text: But the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 12 but the captain of the guard left of the poorest of the land to work the vineyards and fields

search.text: The pillars of brass that were in the house of YHWH, and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the house of YHWH, did the Chaldeans break in pieces, and carried the brass of them to Bavel.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 13 the pillars of brass that were in the house of yhwh and the bases and the bronze sea that were in the house of yhwh did the chaldeans break in pieces and carried the brass of them to bavel

search.text: The pots, and the shovels, and the snuffers, and the spoons, and all the vessels of brass with which they ministered, took they away.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 14 the pots and the shovels and the snuffers and the spoons and all the vessels of brass with which they ministered took they away

search.text: The fire pans, and the basins, that which was of gold, in gold, and that which was of silver, in silver, the captain of the guard took away.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 15 the fire pans and the basins that which was of gold in gold and that which was of silver in silver the captain of the guard took away

search.text: The two pillars, the one sea, and the bases, which Shlomo had made for the house of YHWH, the brass of all these vessels was without weight.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 16 the two pillars the one sea and the bases which shlomo had made for the house of yhwh the brass of all these vessels was without weight

search.text: The height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, and a capital of brass was on it; and the height of the capital was three cubits, with network and pomegranates on the capital round about, all of brass: and like to these had the second pillar with network.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 17 the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits and a capital of brass was on it and the height of the capital was three cubits with network and pomegranates on the capital round about all of brass and like to these had the second pillar with network

search.text: The captain of the guard took Seraiah the chief priest, and Zephaniah the second priest, and the three keepers of the threshold:
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 18 the captain of the guard took seraiah the chief priest and zephaniah the second priest and the three keepers of the threshold

search.text: and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war; and five men of those who saw the king's face, who were found in the city; and the scribe, the captain of the army, who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land, who were found in the city.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 19 and out of the city he took an officer who was set over the men of war and five men of those who saw the king s face who were found in the city and the scribe the captain of the army who mustered the people of the land and sixty men of the people of the land who were found in the city

search.text: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Bavel to Riblah.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 20 nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them and brought them to the king of bavel to riblah

search.text: The king of Bavel struck them, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Yehudah was carried away captive out of his land.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 21 the king of bavel struck them and put them to death at riblah in the land of hamath so yehudah was carried away captive out of his land

search.text: As for the people who were left in the land of Yehudah, whom Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel had left, even over them he made Gedaliah the son of Ahikam, the son of Shaphan, governor.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 22 as for the people who were left in the land of yehudah whom nebuchadnezzar king of bavel had left even over them he made gedaliah the son of ahikam the son of shaphan governor

search.text: Now when all the captains of the forces, they and their men, heard that the king of Bavel had made Gedaliah governor, they came to Gedaliah to Mizpah, even Yishmael the son of Nethaniah, and Johanan the son of Kareah, and Seraiah the son of Tanhumeth the Netophathite, and Jaazaniah the son of the Maacathite, they and their men.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 23 now when all the captains of the forces they and their men heard that the king of bavel had made gedaliah governor they came to gedaliah to mizpah even yishmael the son of nethaniah and johanan the son of kareah and seraiah the son of tanhumeth the netophathite and jaazaniah the son of the maacathite they and their men

search.text: Gedaliah swore to them and to their men, and said to them, Don't be afraid because of the servants of the Chaldeans: dwell in the land, and serve the king of Bavel, and it shall be well with you.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 24 gedaliah swore to them and to their men and said to them don t be afraid because of the servants of the chaldeans dwell in the land and serve the king of bavel and it shall be well with you

search.text: But it happened in the seventh month, that Yishmael the son of Nethaniah, the son of Elishama, of the royal seed came, and ten men with him, and struck Gedaliah, so that he died, and the Jews and the Chaldeans that were with him at Mizpah.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 25 but it happened in the seventh month that yishmael the son of nethaniah the son of elishama of the royal seed came and ten men with him and struck gedaliah so that he died and the jews and the chaldeans that were with him at mizpah

search.text: All the people, both small and great, and the captains of the forces, arose, and came to Mitzrayim; for they were afraid of the Chaldeans.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 26 all the people both small and great and the captains of the forces arose and came to mitzrayim for they were afraid of the chaldeans

search.text: It happened in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of Jehoiachin king of Yehudah, in the twelfth month, on the seven and twentieth day of the month, that Evilmerodach king of Bavel, in the year that he began to reign, did lift up the head of Jehoiachin king of Yehudah out of prison;
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 27 it happened in the seven and thirtieth year of the captivity of jehoiachin king of yehudah in the twelfth month on the seven and twentieth day of the month that evilmerodach king of bavel in the year that he began to reign did lift up the head of jehoiachin king of yehudah out of prison

search.text: and he spoke kindly to him, and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in Bavel,
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 28 and he spoke kindly to him and set his throne above the throne of the kings who were with him in bavel

search.text: and changed his prison garments. [Jehoiachin] ate bread before him continually all the days of his life:
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 29 and changed his prison garments jehoiachin ate bread before him continually all the days of his life

search.text: and for his allowance, there was a continual allowance given him of the king, every day a portion, all the days of his life.
search.searchText: 2 kings 25 30 and for his allowance there was a continual allowance given him of the king every day a portion all the days of his life

search.text: Kalev the son of Chetzron became the father of [children] of Azubah [his] wife, and of Jerioth; and these were her sons: Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 18 kalev the son of chetzron became the father of children of azubah his wife and of jerioth and these were her sons jesher and shobab and ardon

search.text: Azubah died, and Kalev took to him Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 19 azubah died and kalev took to him ephrath who bore him hur

search.text: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 20 hur became the father of uri and uri became the father of bezalel

search.text: Afterward Chetzron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he took [as wife] when he was sixty years old; and she bore him Segub.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 21 afterward chetzron went in to the daughter of machir the father of gilead whom he took as wife when he was sixty years old and she bore him segub

search.text: Segub became the father of Jair, who had twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 22 segub became the father of jair who had twenty three cities in the land of gilead

search.text: Geshur and Aram took the towns of Jair from them, with Kenath, and the villages of it, even sixty cities. All these were the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 23 geshur and aram took the towns of jair from them with kenath and the villages of it even sixty cities all these were the sons of machir the father of gilead

search.text: After that Chetzron was dead in Kalev Ephrathah, then Aviyah Chetzron's wife bore him Ashhur the father of Tekoa.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 24 after that chetzron was dead in kalev ephrathah then aviyah chetzron s wife bore him ashhur the father of tekoa

search.text: The sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Chetzron were Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, Ahijah.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 25 the sons of jerahmeel the firstborn of chetzron were ram the firstborn and bunah and oren and ozem ahijah

search.text: Jerahmeel had another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 26 jerahmeel had another wife whose name was atarah she was the mother of onam

search.text: The sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 27 the sons of ram the firstborn of jerahmeel were maaz and jamin and eker

search.text: The sons of Onam were Shammai, and Jada. The sons of Shammai: Nadab, and Abishur.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 28 the sons of onam were shammai and jada the sons of shammai nadab and abishur

search.text: The name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail; and she bore him Ahban, and Molid.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 29 the name of the wife of abishur was abihail and she bore him ahban and molid

search.text: The sons of Nadab: Seled, and Appaim; but Seled died without children.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 30 the sons of nadab seled and appaim but seled died without children

search.text: The sons of Appaim: Ishi. The sons of Ishi: Sheshan. The sons of Sheshan: Ahlai.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 31 the sons of appaim ishi the sons of ishi sheshan the sons of sheshan ahlai

search.text: The sons of Jada the brother of Shammai: Jether, and Yonatan; and Jether died without children.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 32 the sons of jada the brother of shammai jether and yonatan and jether died without children

search.text: The sons of Yonatan: Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 33 the sons of yonatan peleth and zaza these were the sons of jerahmeel

search.text: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 34 now sheshan had no sons but daughters sheshan had a servant an egyptian whose name was jarha

search.text: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant as wife; and she bore him Attai.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 35 sheshan gave his daughter to jarha his servant as wife and she bore him attai

search.text: Attai became the father of Natan, and Natan became the father of Zabad,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 36 attai became the father of natan and natan became the father of zabad

search.text: and Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Oved,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 37 and zabad became the father of ephlal and ephlal became the father of oved

search.text: and Oved became the father of Yehu, and Yehu became the father of Azaryah,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 38 and oved became the father of yehu and yehu became the father of azaryah

search.text: and Azaryah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 39 and azaryah became the father of helez and helez became the father of eleasah

search.text: and Eleasah became the father of Sismai, and Sismai became the father of Shallum,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 40 and eleasah became the father of sismai and sismai became the father of shallum

search.text: and Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 41 and shallum became the father of jekamiah and jekamiah became the father of elishama

search.text: The sons of Kalev the brother of Jerahmeel were Mesha his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Chevron.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 42 the sons of kalev the brother of jerahmeel were mesha his firstborn who was the father of ziph and the sons of mareshah the father of chevron

search.text: The sons of Chevron: Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 43 the sons of chevron korah and tappuah and rekem and shema

search.text: Shema became the father of Raham, the father of Jorkeam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 44 shema became the father of raham the father of jorkeam and rekem became the father of shammai

search.text: The son of Shammai was Maon; and Maon was the father of Beth Zur.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 45 the son of shammai was maon and maon was the father of beth zur

search.text: Ephah, Kalev's concubine, bore Haran, and Moza, and Gazez; and Haran became the father of Gazez.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 46 ephah kalev s concubine bore haran and moza and gazez and haran became the father of gazez

search.text: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, and Jothan, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 47 the sons of jahdai regem and jothan and geshan and pelet and ephah and shaaph

search.text: Maacah, Kalev's concubine, bore Sheber and Tirhanah.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 48 maacah kalev s concubine bore sheber and tirhanah

search.text: She bore also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbena, and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Kalev was Achsah.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 49 she bore also shaaph the father of madmannah sheva the father of machbena and the father of gibea and the daughter of kalev was achsah

search.text: These were the sons of Kalev, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 50 these were the sons of kalev the son of hur the firstborn of ephrathah shobal the father of kiriath jearim

search.text: Salma the father of Beit Lechem, Hareph the father of Beit Gader.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 51 salma the father of beit lechem hareph the father of beit gader

search.text: Shobal the father of Kiriath Jearim had sons: Haroeh, half of the Menuhoth.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 52 shobal the father of kiriath jearim had sons haroeh half of the menuhoth

search.text: The families of Kiriath Jearim: The Ithrites, and the Puthites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zorathites and the Eshtaolites.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 53 the families of kiriath jearim the ithrites and the puthites and the shumathites and the mishraites of them came the zorathites and the eshtaolites

search.text: The sons of Salma: Beit Lechem, and the Netophathites, Atrot Beit Yoav, and half of the Manahathites, the Zorites.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 54 the sons of salma beit lechem and the netophathites atrot beit yoav and half of the manahathites the zorites

search.text: The families of scribes who lived at Jabez: the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, the Sucathites. These are the Kenites who came of Hammath, the father of the house of Rechab.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 2 55 the families of scribes who lived at jabez the tirathites the shimeathites the sucathites these are the kenites who came of hammath the father of the house of rechab

search.text: Now these were the sons of Dawid, who were born to him in Chevron: the firstborn, Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second, Dani'el, of Abigail the Carmelitess;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 1 now these were the sons of dawid who were born to him in chevron the firstborn amnon of ahinoam the jezreelitess the second dani el of abigail the carmelitess

search.text: the third, Avshalom the son of Maacah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur; the fourth, Adoniyahu the son of Haggith;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 2 the third avshalom the son of maacah the daughter of talmai king of geshur the fourth adoniyahu the son of haggith

search.text: the fifth, Shephatiah of Abital; the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife:
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 3 the fifth shephatiah of abital the sixth ithream by eglah his wife

search.text: six were born to him in Chevron; and there he reigned seven years and six months. In Yerushalayim he reigned thirty-three years;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 4 six were born to him in chevron and there he reigned seven years and six months in yerushalayim he reigned thirty three years

search.text: and these were born to him in Yerushalayim: Shimea, and Shobab, and Natan, and Shlomo, four, of Bathshua the daughter of Ammiel;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 5 and these were born to him in yerushalayim shimea and shobab and natan and shlomo four of bathshua the daughter of ammiel

search.text: and Ibhar, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,

search.text: and Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 7 and nogah and nepheg and japhia

search.text: and Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 8 and elishama and eliada and eliphelet nine

search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 9 all these were the sons of dawid besides the sons of the concubines and tamar was their sister

search.text: Achaz his son, Chizkiyahu his son, Menashe his son,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 13 achaz his son chizkiyahu his son menashe his son

search.text: Amon his son, Yoshiyahu his son.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 14 amon his son yoshiyahu his son

search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 15 the sons of yoshiyahu the firstborn johanan the second jehoiakim the third tzidkiyahu the fourth shallum

search.text: The sons of Jehoiakim: Yekhonyahu his son, Tzidkiyahu his son.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 16 the sons of jehoiakim yekhonyahu his son tzidkiyahu his son

search.text: The sons of Yekhonyahu, the captive: She'altiel his son,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 17 the sons of yekhonyahu the captive she altiel his son

search.text: The sons of Pedaiah: Zerubavel, and Shimei. The sons of Zerubavel: Meshullam, and Hananiah; and Shelomith was their sister;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 19 the sons of pedaiah zerubavel and shimei the sons of zerubavel meshullam and hananiah and shelomith was their sister

search.text: and Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab Hesed, five.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 20 and hashubah and ohel and berechiah and hasadiah jushab hesed five

search.text: The sons of Hananiah: Pelatiah, and Jeshaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shecaniah.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 21 the sons of hananiah pelatiah and jeshaiah the sons of rephaiah the sons of arnan the sons of obadiah the sons of shecaniah

search.text: The sons of Shecaniah: Shemaiah. The sons of Shemaiah: Hattush, and Igal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 22 the sons of shecaniah shemaiah the sons of shemaiah hattush and igal and bariah and neariah and shaphat six

search.text: The sons of Neariah: Elioenai, and Hizkiah, and Azrikam, three.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 23 the sons of neariah elioenai and hizkiah and azrikam three

search.text: The sons of Elioenai: Hodaviah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Delaiah, and Anani, seven.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 3 24 the sons of elioenai hodaviah and eliashib and pelaiah and akkub and johanan and delaiah and anani seven

search.text: The sons of Yehudah: Peretz, Chetzron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 1 the sons of yehudah peretz chetzron and carmi and hur and shobal

search.text: Reaiah the son of Shobal became the father of Jahath; and Jahath became the father of Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 2 reaiah the son of shobal became the father of jahath and jahath became the father of ahumai and lahad these are the families of the zorathites

search.text: These were [the sons of] the father of Etam: Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash; and the name of their sister was Hazzelelponi;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 3 these were the sons of the father of etam jezreel and ishma and idbash and the name of their sister was hazzelelponi

search.text: and Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephrathah, the father of Beit Lechem.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 4 and penuel the father of gedor and ezer the father of hushah these are the sons of hur the firstborn of ephrathah the father of beit lechem

search.text: Ashhur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 5 ashhur the father of tekoa had two wives helah and naarah

search.text: Naarah bore him Ahuzzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 6 naarah bore him ahuzzam and hepher and temeni and haahashtari these were the sons of naarah

search.text: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Izhar, and Ethnan.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 7 the sons of helah were zereth izhar and ethnan

search.text: Hakkoz became the father of Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 8 hakkoz became the father of anub and zobebah and the families of aharhel the son of harum

search.text: Jabez was more honorable than his brothers: and his mother named him Jabez, saying, Because I bore him with sorrow.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 9 jabez was more honorable than his brothers and his mother named him jabez saying because i bore him with sorrow

search.text: Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that you would bless me indeed, and enlarge my border, and that your hand might be with me, and that you would keep me from harm, that it not be to my sorrow! Elohim granted him that which he requested.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 10 jabez called on the god of israel saying oh that you would bless me indeed and enlarge my border and that your hand might be with me and that you would keep me from harm that it not be to my sorrow elohim granted him that which he requested

search.text: Chelub the brother of Shuhah became the father of Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 11 chelub the brother of shuhah became the father of mehir who was the father of eshton

search.text: Eshton became the father of Beit Rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir Nahash. These are the men of Recah.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 12 eshton became the father of beit rapha and paseah and tehinnah the father of ir nahash these are the men of recah

search.text: The sons of Kenaz: Othniel, and Seraiah. The sons of Othniel: Hathath.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 13 the sons of kenaz othniel and seraiah the sons of othniel hathath

search.text: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah: and Seraiah became the father of Yoav the father of Ge Harashim; for they were craftsmen.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 14 meonothai became the father of ophrah and seraiah became the father of yoav the father of ge harashim for they were craftsmen

search.text: The sons of Kalev the son of Jephunneh: Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah; and Kenaz.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 15 the sons of kalev the son of jephunneh iru elah and naam and the sons of elah and kenaz

search.text: The sons of Jehallelel: Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asarel.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 16 the sons of jehallelel ziph and ziphah tiria and asarel

search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 17 the sons of ezrah jether and mered and epher and jalon and she bore miryam and shammai and ishbah the father of eshtemoa

search.text: His wife the Jewess bore Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Soco, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered took.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 18 his wife the jewess bore jered the father of gedor and heber the father of soco and jekuthiel the father of zanoah these are the sons of bithiah the daughter of pharaoh whom mered took

search.text: The sons of the wife of Hodiah, the sister of Naham, were the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maacathite.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 19 the sons of the wife of hodiah the sister of naham were the father of keilah the garmite and eshtemoa the maacathite

search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 21 the sons of shelah the son of yehudah er the father of lecah and laadah the father of mareshah and the families of the house of those who worked fine linen of the house of ashbea

search.searchText: 1 chronicles 4 22 and jokim and the men of cozeba and yoash and saraph who had dominion in moab and jashubilehem the records are ancient

search.text: These written by name came in the days of Chizkiyahu king of Yehudah, and struck their tents, and the Meunim who were found there, and destroyed them utterly to this day, and lived in their place; because there was pasture there for their flocks.

search.text: Micah his son, Reaiah his son, Baal his son,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 5 micah his son reaiah his son baal his son

search.text: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath Pilneser king of Ashur carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 6 beerah his son whom tilgath pilneser king of ashur carried away captive he was prince of the reubenites

search.text: His brothers by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned: the chief, Jeiel, and Zekharyah,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 7 his brothers by their families when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned the chief jeiel and zekharyah

search.text: and Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who lived in Aroer, even to Nebo and Baal Meon:
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 8 and bela the son of azaz the son of shema the son of joel who lived in aroer even to nebo and baal meon

search.text: and eastward he lived even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river Perat, because their livestock were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 9 and eastward he lived even to the entrance of the wilderness from the river perat because their livestock were multiplied in the land of gilead

search.text: In the days of Shaul, they made war with the Hagrites, who fell by their hand; and they lived in their tents throughout all the [land] east of Gilead.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 10 in the days of shaul they made war with the hagrites who fell by their hand and they lived in their tents throughout all the land east of gilead

search.text: The sons of Gad lived over against them, in the land of Bashan to Salecah:
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 11 the sons of gad lived over against them in the land of bashan to salecah

search.text: Joel the chief, and Shapham the second, and Janai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 12 joel the chief and shapham the second and janai and shaphat in bashan

search.text: Their brothers of their fathers' houses: Mikha'el, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jacan, and Zia, and Eber, seven.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 13 their brothers of their fathers houses mikha el and meshullam and sheba and jorai and jacan and zia and eber seven

search.text: These were the sons of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Mikha'el, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;

search.text: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of their fathers' houses.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 15 ahi the son of abdiel the son of guni chief of their fathers houses

search.text: They lived in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, as far as their borders.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 16 they lived in gilead in bashan and in its towns and in all the suburbs of sharon as far as their borders

search.text: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Yotam king of Yehudah, and in the days of Yerovam king of Israel.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 17 all these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of yotam king of yehudah and in the days of yerovam king of israel

search.text: The sons of Reuven, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Menashe, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skillful in war, were forty-four thousand seven hundred and sixty, that were able to go forth to war.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 18 the sons of reuven and the gadites and the half tribe of menashe of valiant men men able to bear buckler and sword and to shoot with bow and skillful in war were forty four thousand seven hundred and sixty that were able to go forth to war

search.text: They made war with the Hagrites, with Jetur, and Naphish, and Nodab.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 19 they made war with the hagrites with jetur and naphish and nodab

search.text: They were helped against them, and the Hagrites were delivered into their hand, and all who were with them; for they cried to Elohim in the battle, and he was entreated of them, because they put their trust in him.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 20 they were helped against them and the hagrites were delivered into their hand and all who were with them for they cried to elohim in the battle and he was entreated of them because they put their trust in him

search.text: They took away their livestock; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand, and of donkeys two thousand, and of people one hundred thousand.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 21 they took away their livestock of their camels fifty thousand and of sheep two hundred fifty thousand and of donkeys two thousand and of people one hundred thousand

search.text: For there fell many slain, because the war was of Elohim. They lived in their place until the captivity.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 22 for there fell many slain because the war was of elohim they lived in their place until the captivity

search.text: The children of the half-tribe of Menashe lived in the land: they increased from Bashan to Baal Hermon and Senir and Mount Hermon.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 23 the children of the half tribe of menashe lived in the land they increased from bashan to baal hermon and senir and mount hermon

search.text: These were the heads of their fathers' houses: even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Yirmeyahu, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valor, famous men, heads of their fathers' houses.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 24 these were the heads of their fathers houses even epher and ishi and eliel and azriel and yirmeyahu and hodaviah and jahdiel mighty men of valor famous men heads of their fathers houses

search.text: They trespassed against the God of their fathers, and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land, whom Elohim destroyed before them.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 25 they trespassed against the god of their fathers and played the prostitute after the gods of the peoples of the land whom elohim destroyed before them

search.text: The God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Ashur, and the spirit of Tilgath Pilneser king of Ashur, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Menashe, and brought them to Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river of Gozan, to this day.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 5 26 the god of israel stirred up the spirit of pul king of ashur and the spirit of tilgath pilneser king of ashur and he carried them away even the reubenites and the gadites and the half tribe of menashe and brought them to halah and habor and hara and to the river of gozan to this day

search.text: The sons of Levi: Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

search.text: The children of Amram: Aharon, and Moshe, and Miryam. The sons of Aharon: Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 3 the children of amram aharon and moshe and miryam the sons of aharon nadab and abihu eleazar and ithamar

search.text: Eleazar became the father of Pinchas, Pinchas became the father of Abishua,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 4 eleazar became the father of pinchas pinchas became the father of abishua

search.text: and Abishua became the father of Bukki, and Bukki became the father of Uzzi,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 5 and abishua became the father of bukki and bukki became the father of uzzi

search.text: and Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah, and Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 6 and uzzi became the father of zerahiah and zerahiah became the father of meraioth

search.text: Meraioth became the father of Amariah, and Amariah became the father of Ahitub,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 7 meraioth became the father of amariah and amariah became the father of ahitub

search.text: and Ahitub became the father of Tzadok, and Tzadok became the father of Ahimaaz,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 8 and ahitub became the father of tzadok and tzadok became the father of ahimaaz

search.text: and Ahimaaz became the father of Azaryah, and Azaryah became the father of Johanan,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 9 and ahimaaz became the father of azaryah and azaryah became the father of johanan

search.text: and Johanan became the father of Azaryah, (he it is who executed the priest's office in the house that Shlomo built in Yerushalayim),
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 10 and johanan became the father of azaryah he it is who executed the priest s office in the house that shlomo built in yerushalayim

search.text: and Azaryah became the father of Amariah, and Amariah became the father of Ahitub,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 11 and azaryah became the father of amariah and amariah became the father of ahitub

search.text: and Ahitub became the father of Tzadok, and Tzadok became the father of Shallum,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 12 and ahitub became the father of tzadok and tzadok became the father of shallum

search.text: and Shallum became the father of Hilkiah, and Hilkiah became the father of Azaryah,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 13 and shallum became the father of hilkiah and hilkiah became the father of azaryah

search.text: and Azaryah became the father of Seraiah, and Seraiah became the father of Jehozadak;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 14 and azaryah became the father of seraiah and seraiah became the father of jehozadak

search.text: Jehozadak went [into captivity], when YHWH carried away Yehudah and Yerushalayim by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 6 15 jehozadak went into captivity when yhwh carried away yehudah and yerushalayim by the hand of nebuchadnezzar

search.text: But Aharon and his sons offered on the altar of burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, for all the work of the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, according to all that Moshe the servant of Elohim had commanded.

search.text: The sons of Tola: Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Ibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their fathers' houses, [to wit], of Tola; mighty men of valor in their generations: their number in the days of Dawid was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

search.text: Then said Shaul to his armor bearer, Draw your sword, and thrust me through therewith, lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armor bearer would not; for he was sore afraid. Therefore Shaul took his sword, and fell on it.

search.text: Then all Israel gathered themselves to Dawid to Chevron, saying, Behold, we are your bone and your flesh.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 11 1 then all israel gathered themselves to dawid to chevron saying behold we are your bone and your flesh

search.text: In times past, even when Shaul was king, it was you who led out and brought in Israel: and YHWH your God said to you, You shall be shepherd of my people Israel, and you shall be prince over my people Israel.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 11 2 in times past even when shaul was king it was you who led out and brought in israel and yhwh your god said to you you shall be shepherd of my people israel and you shall be prince over my people israel

search.text: So all the elders of Israel came to the king to Chevron; and Dawid made a covenant with them in Chevron before YHWH; and they anointed Dawid king over Israel, according to the word of YHWH by Shmuel.
