search.text: But Elohim said to me, You shall not build a house for my name, because you are a warrior, and have shed blood.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 3 but elohim said to me you shall not build a house for my name because you are a warrior and have shed blood

search.text: However YHWH, the God of Israel, chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over Israel forever: for he has chosen Yehudah to be prince; and in the house of Yehudah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all Israel;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 4 however yhwh the god of israel chose me out of all the house of my father to be king over israel forever for he has chosen yehudah to be prince and in the house of yehudah the house of my father and among the sons of my father he took pleasure in me to make me king over all israel

search.text: Of all my sons (for YHWH has given me many sons), he has chosen Shlomo my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of YHWH over Israel.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 5 of all my sons for yhwh has given me many sons he has chosen shlomo my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of yhwh over israel

search.text: He said to me, Shlomo your son, he shall build my house and my courts; for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 6 he said to me shlomo your son he shall build my house and my courts for i have chosen him to be my son and i will be his father

search.text: I will establish his kingdom forever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my ordinances, as at this day.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 7 i will establish his kingdom forever if he be constant to do my commandments and my ordinances as at this day

search.text: Now therefore, in the sight of all Israel, the assembly of YHWH, and in the audience of our God, observe and seek out all the commandments of YHWH your God; that you may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 8 now therefore in the sight of all israel the assembly of yhwh and in the audience of our god observe and seek out all the commandments of yhwh your god that you may possess this good land and leave it for an inheritance to your children after you forever

search.text: You, Shlomo my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind; for YHWH searches all hearts, and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts: if you seek him, he will be found of you; but if you forsake him, he will cast you off forever.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 9 you shlomo my son know the god of your father and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind for yhwh searches all hearts and understands all the imaginations of the thoughts if you seek him he will be found of you but if you forsake him he will cast you off forever

search.text: Take heed now; for YHWH has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 10 take heed now for yhwh has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary be strong and do it

search.text: Then Dawid gave to Shlomo his son the pattern of the porch [of the temple], and of the houses of it, and of the treasuries of it, and of the upper rooms of it, and of the inner chambers of it, and of the place of the mercy seat;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 11 then dawid gave to shlomo his son the pattern of the porch of the temple and of the houses of it and of the treasuries of it and of the upper rooms of it and of the inner chambers of it and of the place of the mercy seat

search.text: and the pattern of all that he had by the Ruach, for the courts of the house of YHWH, and for all the surrounding rooms, for the treasuries of the house of Elohim, and for the treasuries of the dedicated things;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 12 and the pattern of all that he had by the ruach for the courts of the house of yhwh and for all the surrounding rooms for the treasuries of the house of elohim and for the treasuries of the dedicated things

search.text: also for the divisions of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of YHWH, and for all the vessels of service in the house of YHWH;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 13 also for the divisions of the priests and the levites and for all the work of the service of the house of yhwh and for all the vessels of service in the house of yhwh

search.text: of gold by weight for the [vessels of] gold, for all vessels of every kind of service; [of silver] for all the vessels of silver by weight, for all vessels of every kind of service;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 14 of gold by weight for the vessels of gold for all vessels of every kind of service of silver for all the vessels of silver by weight for all vessels of every kind of service

search.text: by weight also for the lampstands of gold, and for the lamps of it, of gold, by weight for every lampstand and for the lamps of it; and for the lampstands of silver, [silver] by weight for [every] lampstand and for the lamps of it, according to the use of every lampstand;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 15 by weight also for the lampstands of gold and for the lamps of it of gold by weight for every lampstand and for the lamps of it and for the lampstands of silver silver by weight for every lampstand and for the lamps of it according to the use of every lampstand

search.text: and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread, for every table; and silver for the tables of silver;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 16 and the gold by weight for the tables of show bread for every table and silver for the tables of silver

search.text: and the forks, and the basins, and the cups, of pure gold; and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl; and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 17 and the forks and the basins and the cups of pure gold and for the golden bowls by weight for every bowl and for the silver bowls by weight for every bowl

search.text: and for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot, [even] the cherubim, that spread out [their wings], and covered the ark of the covenant of YHWH.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 18 and for the altar of incense refined gold by weight and gold for the pattern of the chariot even the cherubim that spread out their wings and covered the ark of the covenant of yhwh

search.text: All this, [said Dawid], have I been made to understand in writing from the hand of YHWH, even all the works of this pattern.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 19 all this said dawid have i been made to understand in writing from the hand of yhwh even all the works of this pattern

search.text: Dawid said to Shlomo his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: don't be afraid, nor be dismayed; for YHWH Elohim, even my God, is with you; he will not fail you, nor forsake you, until all the work for the service of the house of YHWH is finished.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 20 dawid said to shlomo his son be strong and of good courage and do it don t be afraid nor be dismayed for yhwh elohim even my god is with you he will not fail you nor forsake you until all the work for the service of the house of yhwh is finished

search.text: Behold, there are the divisions of the priests and the Levites, for all the service of the house of Elohim: and there shall be with you in all manner of work every willing person who has skill, for any manner of service: also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 28 21 behold there are the divisions of the priests and the levites for all the service of the house of elohim and there shall be with you in all manner of work every willing person who has skill for any manner of service also the captains and all the people will be entirely at your command

search.text: Dawid the king said to all the assembly, Shlomo my son, whom alone Elohim has chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for YHWH Elohim.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 1 dawid the king said to all the assembly shlomo my son whom alone elohim has chosen is yet young and tender and the work is great for the palace is not for man but for yhwh elohim

search.text: Now I have prepared with all my might for the house of my God the gold for the [things of] gold, and the silver for the [things of] silver, and the brass for the [things of] brass, the iron for the [things of] iron, and wood for the [things of] wood; onyx stones, and [stones] to be set, stones for inlaid work, and of various colors, and all manner of precious stones, and marble stones in abundance.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 2 now i have prepared with all my might for the house of my god the gold for the things of gold and the silver for the things of silver and the brass for the things of brass the iron for the things of iron and wood for the things of wood onyx stones and stones to be set stones for inlaid work and of various colors and all manner of precious stones and marble stones in abundance

search.text: In addition, because I have set my affection on the house of my God, seeing that I have a treasure of my own of gold and silver, I give it to the house of my God, over and above all that I have prepared for the holy house,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 3 in addition because i have set my affection on the house of my god seeing that i have a treasure of my own of gold and silver i give it to the house of my god over and above all that i have prepared for the holy house

search.text: even three thousand talents of gold, of the gold of Ophir, and seven thousand talents of refined silver, with which to overlay the walls of the houses;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 4 even three thousand talents of gold of the gold of ophir and seven thousand talents of refined silver with which to overlay the walls of the houses

search.text: of gold for the [things of] gold, and of silver for the [things of] silver, and for all manner of work [to be made] by the hands of artificers. Who then offers willingly to consecrate himself this day to YHWH?
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 5 of gold for the things of gold and of silver for the things of silver and for all manner of work to be made by the hands of artificers who then offers willingly to consecrate himself this day to yhwh

search.text: Then the princes of the fathers' [houses], and the princes of the tribes of Israel, and the captains of thousands and of hundreds, with the rulers over the king's work, offered willingly;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 6 then the princes of the fathers houses and the princes of the tribes of israel and the captains of thousands and of hundreds with the rulers over the king s work offered willingly

search.text: and they gave for the service of the house of God of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics, and of silver ten thousand talents, and of brass eighteen thousand talents, and of iron a hundred thousand talents.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 7 and they gave for the service of the house of god of gold five thousand talents and ten thousand darics and of silver ten thousand talents and of brass eighteen thousand talents and of iron a hundred thousand talents

search.text: They with whom [precious] stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of YHWH, under the hand of Jehiel the Gershonite.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 8 they with whom precious stones were found gave them to the treasure of the house of yhwh under the hand of jehiel the gershonite

search.text: Then the people rejoiced, because they offered willingly, because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to YHWH: and Dawid the king also rejoiced with great joy.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 9 then the people rejoiced because they offered willingly because with a perfect heart they offered willingly to yhwh and dawid the king also rejoiced with great joy

search.text: Therefore Dawid blessed YHWH before all the assembly; and Dawid said, You are blessed, YHWH, the God of Israel our father, forever and ever.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 10 therefore dawid blessed yhwh before all the assembly and dawid said you are blessed yhwh the god of israel our father forever and ever

search.text: Yours, YHWH, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty: for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours. Yours is the reign, YHWH, and you are exalted as head above all.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 11 yours yhwh is the greatness the power the glory the victory and the majesty for all that is in the heavens and in the earth is yours yours is the reign yhwh and you are exalted as head above all

search.text: Both riches and honor come of you, and you rule over all; and in your hand is power and might; and it is in your hand to make great, and to give strength to all.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 12 both riches and honor come of you and you rule over all and in your hand is power and might and it is in your hand to make great and to give strength to all

search.text: Now therefore, our God, we thank you, and praise your glorious name.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 13 now therefore our god we thank you and praise your glorious name

search.text: But who am I, and what is my people, that we should be able to offer so willingly as this? For all things come of you, and of your own have we given you.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 14 but who am i and what is my people that we should be able to offer so willingly as this for all things come of you and of your own have we given you

search.text: For we are strangers before you, and foreigners, as all our fathers were: our days on the earth are as a shadow, and there is no abiding.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 15 for we are strangers before you and foreigners as all our fathers were our days on the earth are as a shadow and there is no abiding

search.text: YHWH our God, all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes of your hand, and is all your own.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 16 yhwh our god all this store that we have prepared to build you a house for your holy name comes of your hand and is all your own

search.text: I know also, my God, that you try the heart, and have pleasure in uprightness. As for me, in the uprightness of my heart I have willingly offered all these things: and now have I seen with joy your people, that are present here, offer willingly to you.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 17 i know also my god that you try the heart and have pleasure in uprightness as for me in the uprightness of my heart i have willingly offered all these things and now have i seen with joy your people that are present here offer willingly to you

search.text: YHWH, the God of Avraham, of Yitzhak, and of Israel, our fathers, keep this forever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of your people, and prepare their heart to you;
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 18 yhwh the god of avraham of yitzhak and of israel our fathers keep this forever in the imagination of the thoughts of the heart of your people and prepare their heart to you

search.text: and give to Shlomo my son a perfect heart, to keep your commandments, your testimonies, and your statutes, and to do all these things, and to build the palace, for which I have made provision.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 19 and give to shlomo my son a perfect heart to keep your commandments your testimonies and your statutes and to do all these things and to build the palace for which i have made provision

search.text: Dawid said to all the assembly, Now bless YHWH your God. All the assembly blessed YHWH, the God of their fathers, and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before YHWH and the king.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 20 dawid said to all the assembly now bless yhwh your god all the assembly blessed yhwh the god of their fathers and bowed down their heads and prostrated themselves before yhwh and the king

search.text: They sacrificed sacrifices to YHWH, and offered burnt offerings to YHWH, on the next day after that day, even one thousand bulls, one thousand rams, and one thousand lambs, with their drink offerings, and sacrifices in abundance for all Israel,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 21 they sacrificed sacrifices to yhwh and offered burnt offerings to yhwh on the next day after that day even one thousand bulls one thousand rams and one thousand lambs with their drink offerings and sacrifices in abundance for all israel

search.text: and ate and drink before YHWH on that day with great gladness. They made Shlomo the son of Dawid king the second time, and anointed him to YHWH to be prince, and Tzadok to be priest.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 22 and ate and drink before yhwh on that day with great gladness they made shlomo the son of dawid king the second time and anointed him to yhwh to be prince and tzadok to be priest

search.text: Then Shlomo sat on the throne of YHWH as king instead of Dawid his father, and prospered; and all Israel obeyed him.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 23 then shlomo sat on the throne of yhwh as king instead of dawid his father and prospered and all israel obeyed him

search.text: All the princes, the mighty men, and also all of the sons of king Dawid submitted themselves to Shlomo the king.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 24 all the princes the mighty men and also all of the sons of king dawid submitted themselves to shlomo the king

search.text: YHWH magnified Shlomo exceedingly in the sight of all Israel, and bestowed on him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in Israel.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 25 yhwh magnified shlomo exceedingly in the sight of all israel and bestowed on him such royal majesty as had not been on any king before him in israel

search.text: Now Dawid the son of Yishai reigned over all Israel.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 26 now dawid the son of yishai reigned over all israel

search.text: The time that he reigned over Israel was forty years; he reigned seven years in Chevron, and thirty-three [years] reigned he in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 27 the time that he reigned over israel was forty years he reigned seven years in chevron and thirty three years reigned he in yerushalayim

search.text: He died in a good old age, full of days, riches, and honor: and Shlomo his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 28 he died in a good old age full of days riches and honor and shlomo his son reigned in his place

search.text: Now the acts of Dawid the king, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Shmuel the seer, and in the history of Natan the prophet, and in the history of Gad the seer,
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 29 now the acts of dawid the king first and last behold they are written in the history of shmuel the seer and in the history of natan the prophet and in the history of gad the seer

search.text: with all his reign and his might, and the times that went over him, and over Israel, and over all the kingdoms of the countries.
search.searchText: 1 chronicles 29 30 with all his reign and his might and the times that went over him and over israel and over all the kingdoms of the countries

search.text: Shlomo the son of Dawid was strengthened in his kingdom, and YHWH his God was with him, and magnified him exceedingly.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 1 shlomo the son of dawid was strengthened in his kingdom and yhwh his god was with him and magnified him exceedingly

search.text: Shlomo spoke to all Israel, to the captains of thousands and of hundreds, and to the judges, and to every prince in all Israel, the heads of the fathers' [houses].
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 2 shlomo spoke to all israel to the captains of thousands and of hundreds and to the judges and to every prince in all israel the heads of the fathers houses

search.text: So Shlomo, and all the assembly with him, went to the high place that was at Gibeon; for there was the tent of meeting of Elohim, which Moshe the servant of YHWH had made in the wilderness.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 3 so shlomo and all the assembly with him went to the high place that was at gibeon for there was the tent of meeting of elohim which moshe the servant of yhwh had made in the wilderness

search.text: But Dawid had brought the ark of Elohim up from Kiriath Jearim to the place that Dawid had prepared for it; for he had pitched a tent for it at Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 4 but dawid had brought the ark of elohim up from kiriath jearim to the place that dawid had prepared for it for he had pitched a tent for it at yerushalayim

search.text: Moreover the bronze altar, that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, was there before the tent of YHWH: and Shlomo and the assembly were seeking counsel there.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 5 moreover the bronze altar that bezalel the son of uri the son of hur had made was there before the tent of yhwh and shlomo and the assembly were seeking counsel there

search.text: Shlomo went up there to the bronze altar before YHWH, which was at the tent of meeting, and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 6 shlomo went up there to the bronze altar before yhwh which was at the tent of meeting and offered one thousand burnt offerings on it

search.text: In that night Elohim appeared to Shlomo, and said to him, "Ask what I shall give you."
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 7 in that night elohim appeared to shlomo and said to him ask what i shall give you

search.text: Shlomo said to Elohim, You have shown great loving kindness to Dawid my father, and have made me king in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 8 shlomo said to elohim you have shown great loving kindness to dawid my father and have made me king in his place

search.text: Now, YHWH Elohim, let your promise to Dawid my father be established; for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 9 now yhwh elohim let your promise to dawid my father be established for you have made me king over a people like the dust of the earth in multitude

search.text: Give me now wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this your people, that is so great?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 10 give me now wisdom and knowledge that i may go out and come in before this people for who can judge this your people that is so great

search.text: Elohim said to Shlomo, Because this was in your heart, and you have not asked riches, wealth, or honor, nor the life of those who hate you, neither yet have asked long life; but have asked wisdom and knowledge for yourself, that you may judge my people, over whom I have made you king:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 11 elohim said to shlomo because this was in your heart and you have not asked riches wealth or honor nor the life of those who hate you neither yet have asked long life but have asked wisdom and knowledge for yourself that you may judge my people over whom i have made you king

search.text: wisdom and knowledge is granted to you; and I will give you riches, and wealth, and honor, such as none of the kings have had who have been before you; neither shall there any after you have the like.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 12 wisdom and knowledge is granted to you and i will give you riches and wealth and honor such as none of the kings have had who have been before you neither shall there any after you have the like

search.text: So Shlomo came from the high place that was at Gibeon, from before the tent of meeting, to Yerushalayim; and he reigned over Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 13 so shlomo came from the high place that was at gibeon from before the tent of meeting to yerushalayim and he reigned over israel

search.text: Shlomo gathered chariots and horsemen: and he had one thousand four hundred chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he placed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 14 shlomo gathered chariots and horsemen and he had one thousand four hundred chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he placed in the chariot cities and with the king at yerushalayim

search.text: The king made silver and gold to be in Yerushalayim as stones, and cedars made he to be as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland, for abundance.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 15 the king made silver and gold to be in yerushalayim as stones and cedars made he to be as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland for abundance

search.text: The horses which Shlomo had were brought out of Mitzrayim and from Kue; the king's merchants purchased them from Kue.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 16 the horses which shlomo had were brought out of mitzrayim and from kue the king s merchants purchased them from kue

search.text: They brought up and brought out of Mitzrayim a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver, and a horse for one hundred fifty: and so for all the kings of the Hittites, and the kings of Aram, did they bring them out by their means.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 1 17 they brought up and brought out of mitzrayim a chariot for six hundred pieces of silver and a horse for one hundred fifty and so for all the kings of the hittites and the kings of aram did they bring them out by their means

search.text: Now Shlomo purposed to build a house for the name of YHWH, and a house for his kingdom.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 1 now shlomo purposed to build a house for the name of yhwh and a house for his kingdom

search.text: Shlomo counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens, and eighty thousand people who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 2 shlomo counted out seventy thousand men to bear burdens and eighty thousand people who were stone cutters in the mountains and three thousand and six hundred to oversee them

search.text: Shlomo sent to Huram the king of Tzor, saying, As you dealt with Dawid my father, and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell, [even so deal with me].
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 3 shlomo sent to huram the king of tzor saying as you dealt with dawid my father and sent him cedars to build him a house in which to dwell even so deal with me

search.text: Behold, I am about to build a house for the name of YHWH my God, to dedicate it to him, and to burn before him incense of sweet spices, and for the continual show bread, and for the burnt offerings morning and evening, on the Sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the set feasts of YHWH our God. This is [an ordinance] forever to Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 4 behold i am about to build a house for the name of yhwh my god to dedicate it to him and to burn before him incense of sweet spices and for the continual show bread and for the burnt offerings morning and evening on the sabbaths and on the new moons and on the set feasts of yhwh our god this is an ordinance forever to israel

search.text: The house which I build is great; for great is our God above all gods.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 5 the house which i build is great for great is our god above all gods

search.text: But who is able to build him a house, seeing heavens and the heavens of heavens can't contain him? who am I then, that I should build him a house, save only to burn incense before him?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 6 but who is able to build him a house seeing heavens and the heavens of heavens can t contain him who am i then that i should build him a house save only to burn incense before him

search.text: Now therefore send me a person skillful to work in gold, and in silver, and in brass, and in iron, and in purple, and crimson, and blue, and who knows how to engrave [all manner of] engravings, [to be] with the skillful people who are with me in Yehudah and in Yerushalayim, whom Dawid my father did provide.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 7 now therefore send me a person skillful to work in gold and in silver and in brass and in iron and in purple and crimson and blue and who knows how to engrave all manner of engravings to be with the skillful people who are with me in yehudah and in yerushalayim whom dawid my father did provide

search.text: Send me also cedar trees, fir trees, and algum trees, out of Levanon; for I know that your servants know how to cut timber in Levanon: and behold, my servants shall be with your servants,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 8 send me also cedar trees fir trees and algum trees out of levanon for i know that your servants know how to cut timber in levanon and behold my servants shall be with your servants

search.text: even to prepare me timber in abundance; for the house which I am about to build shall be great and wonderful.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 9 even to prepare me timber in abundance for the house which i am about to build shall be great and wonderful

search.text: Behold, I will give to your servants, the cutters who cut timber, twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat, and twenty thousand measures of barley, and twenty thousand baths of wine, and twenty thousand baths of oil.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 10 behold i will give to your servants the cutters who cut timber twenty thousand measures of beaten wheat and twenty thousand measures of barley and twenty thousand baths of wine and twenty thousand baths of oil

search.text: Then Huram the king of Tzor answered in writing, which he sent to Shlomo, "Because YHWH loves YHWH’s people, YHWH has made you king over them."
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 11 then huram the king of tzor answered in writing which he sent to shlomo because yhwh loves yhwh s people yhwh has made you king over them

search.text: Huram continued, "Blessed be YHWH, the God of Israel, that made heavens and earth, who has given to Dawid the king a wise son, endowed with discretion and understanding, that should build a house for YHWH, and a house for his kingdom.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 12 huram continued blessed be yhwh the god of israel that made heavens and earth who has given to dawid the king a wise son endowed with discretion and understanding that should build a house for yhwh and a house for his kingdom

search.text: Now I have sent a skillful man, endowed with understanding, of Huram my father's,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 13 now i have sent a skillful man endowed with understanding of huram my father s

search.text: the son of a woman of the daughters of Dan; and their father was a person of Tzor, skillful to work in gold, and in silver, in brass, in iron, in stone, and in timber, in purple, in blue, and in fine linen, and in crimson, also to engrave any manner of engraving, and to devise any device; that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men, and with the skillful men of my lord Dawid your father.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 14 the son of a woman of the daughters of dan and their father was a person of tzor skillful to work in gold and in silver in brass in iron in stone and in timber in purple in blue and in fine linen and in crimson also to engrave any manner of engraving and to devise any device that there may be a place appointed to him with your skillful men and with the skillful men of my lord dawid your father

search.text: Shlomo numbered all the foreigners who were in the land of Israel, after the numbering with which Dawid his father had numbered them; and they were found one hundred fifty-three thousand six hundred.

search.text: He set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens, and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains, and three thousand six hundred overseers to set the people at work.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 2 18 he set seventy thousand of them to bear burdens and eighty thousand who were stone cutters in the mountains and three thousand six hundred overseers to set the people at work

search.text: Then Shlomo began to build the house of YHWH at Yerushalayim on Mount Moriah, where [YHWH] appeared to Dawid his father, which he made ready in the place that Dawid had appointed, in the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 1 then shlomo began to build the house of yhwh at yerushalayim on mount moriah where yhwh appeared to dawid his father which he made ready in the place that dawid had appointed in the threshing floor of ornan the jebusite

search.text: He began to build in the second [day] of the second month, in the fourth year of his reign.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 2 he began to build in the second day of the second month in the fourth year of his reign

search.text: Now these are the foundations which Shlomo laid for the building of the house of Elohim. The length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits, and the breadth twenty cubits.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 3 now these are the foundations which shlomo laid for the building of the house of elohim the length by cubits after the first measure was sixty cubits and the breadth twenty cubits

search.text: The porch that was before [the house], the length of it, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and the height one hundred twenty; and he overlaid it within with pure gold.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 4 the porch that was before the house the length of it according to the breadth of the house was twenty cubits and the height one hundred twenty and he overlaid it within with pure gold

search.text: The greater house he made a ceiling with fir wood, which he overlaid with fine gold, and ornamented it with palm trees and chains.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 5 the greater house he made a ceiling with fir wood which he overlaid with fine gold and ornamented it with palm trees and chains

search.text: He garnished the house with precious stones for beauty: and the gold was gold of Parvaim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 6 he garnished the house with precious stones for beauty and the gold was gold of parvaim

search.text: He overlaid also the house, the beams, the thresholds, and the walls of it, and the doors of it, with gold; and engraved cherubim on the walls.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 7 he overlaid also the house the beams the thresholds and the walls of it and the doors of it with gold and engraved cherubim on the walls

search.text: He made the most holy house: the length of it, according to the breadth of the house, was twenty cubits, and the breadth of it twenty cubits; and he overlaid it with fine gold, amounting to six hundred talents.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 8 he made the most holy house the length of it according to the breadth of the house was twenty cubits and the breadth of it twenty cubits and he overlaid it with fine gold amounting to six hundred talents

search.text: The weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold. He overlaid the upper chambers with gold.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 9 the weight of the nails was fifty shekels of gold he overlaid the upper chambers with gold

search.text: In the most holy house he made two cherubim of image work; and they overlaid them with gold.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 10 in the most holy house he made two cherubim of image work and they overlaid them with gold

search.text: The wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long: the wing of the one [cherub] was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was [likewise] five cubits, reaching to the wing of the other cherub.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 11 the wings of the cherubim were twenty cubits long the wing of the one cherub was five cubits reaching to the wall of the house and the other wing was likewise five cubits reaching to the wing of the other cherub

search.text: The wing of the other cherub was five cubits, reaching to the wall of the house; and the other wing was five cubits [also], joining to the wing of the other cherub.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 12 the wing of the other cherub was five cubits reaching to the wall of the house and the other wing was five cubits also joining to the wing of the other cherub

search.text: The wings of these cherubim spread themselves forth twenty cubits: and they stood on their feet, and their faces were toward the house.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 13 the wings of these cherubim spread themselves forth twenty cubits and they stood on their feet and their faces were toward the house

search.text: He made the veil of blue, and purple, and crimson, and fine linen, and ornamented it with cherubim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 14 he made the veil of blue and purple and crimson and fine linen and ornamented it with cherubim

search.text: Also he made before the house two pillars of thirty-five cubits high, and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 15 also he made before the house two pillars of thirty five cubits high and the capital that was on the top of each of them was five cubits

search.text: He made chains in the oracle, and put [them] on the tops of the pillars; and he made one hundred pomegranates, and put them on the chains.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 16 he made chains in the oracle and put them on the tops of the pillars and he made one hundred pomegranates and put them on the chains

search.searchText: 2 chronicles 3 17 he set up the pillars before the temple one on the right hand and the other on the left and called the name of that on the right hand jachin and the name of that on the left boaz

search.text: Then he made an altar of brass, twenty cubits the length of it, and twenty cubits the breadth of it, and ten cubits the height of it.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 4 1 then he made an altar of brass twenty cubits the length of it and twenty cubits the breadth of it and ten cubits the height of it

search.text: Also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim, round in compass; and the height of it was five cubits; and a line of thirty cubits compassed it round about.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 4 2 also he made the molten sea of ten cubits from brim to brim round in compass and the height of it was five cubits and a line of thirty cubits compassed it round about

search.text: Under it was the likeness of oxen, which did compass it round about, for ten cubits, compassing the sea round about. The oxen were in two rows, cast when it was cast.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 4 3 under it was the likeness of oxen which did compass it round about for ten cubits compassing the sea round about the oxen were in two rows cast when it was cast

search.text: It stood on twelve oxen, three looking toward the north, and three looking toward the west, and three looking toward the south, and three looking toward the east: and the sea was set on them above, and all their hinder parts were inward.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 4 4 it stood on twelve oxen three looking toward the north and three looking toward the west and three looking toward the south and three looking toward the east and the sea was set on them above and all their hinder parts were inward

search.text: It was a handbreadth thick; and the brim of it was worked like the brim of a cup, like the flower of a lily: it received and held three thousand baths.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 4 5 it was a handbreadth thick and the brim of it was worked like the brim of a cup like the flower of a lily it received and held three thousand baths

search.text: He made also ten basins, and put five on the right hand, and five on the left, to wash in them; such things as belonged to the burnt offering they werehed in them; but the sea was for the priests to wash in.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 4 6 he made also ten basins and put five on the right hand and five on the left to wash in them such things as belonged to the burnt offering they werehed in them but the sea was for the priests to wash in

search.searchText: 2 chronicles 4 7 he made the ten lampstands of gold according to the ordinance concerning them and he set them in the temple five on the right hand and five on the left

search.text: He made also ten tables, and placed them in the temple, five on the right side, and five on the left. He made one hundred basins of gold.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 4 8 he made also ten tables and placed them in the temple five on the right side and five on the left he made one hundred basins of gold

search.searchText: 2 chronicles 4 9 furthermore he made the court of the priests and the great court and doors for the court and overlaid the doors of them with brass

search.text: Then Shlomo assembled the elders of Israel, and all the heads of the tribes, the princes of the fathers' [houses] of the children of Israel, to Yerushalayim, to bring up the ark of the covenant of YHWH out of the city of Dawid, which is Tzion.

search.searchText: 2 chronicles 5 6 king shlomo and all the congregation of israel that were assembled to him were before the ark sacrificing sheep and oxen that could not be counted nor numbered for multitude

search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 15 who have kept with your servant dawid my father that which you did promise him yes you spoke with your mouth and have fulfilled it with your hand as it is this day

search.text: Now therefore, YHWH, the God of Israel, keep with your servant Dawid my father that which you have promised him, saying, There shall not fail you a person in my sight to sit on the throne of Israel, if only your children take heed to their way, to walk in my law as you have walked before me.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 16 now therefore yhwh the god of israel keep with your servant dawid my father that which you have promised him saying there shall not fail you a person in my sight to sit on the throne of israel if only your children take heed to their way to walk in my law as you have walked before me

search.text: Now therefore, YHWH, the God of Israel, let your word be verified, which you spoke to your servant Dawid.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 17 now therefore yhwh the god of israel let your word be verified which you spoke to your servant dawid
