search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 30 then hear from heavens your dwelling place and forgive and render to everyone according to all their ways whose heart you know for you even you only know the hearts of the children of people

search.text: that they may revere you, to walk in your ways, so long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 31 that they may revere you to walk in your ways so long as they live in the land which you gave to our fathers

search.text: Moreover concerning the foreigner, who is not of your people Israel, when he shall come from a far country for your great name's sake, and your mighty hand, and your outstretched arm; when they shall come and pray toward this house:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 32 moreover concerning the foreigner who is not of your people israel when he shall come from a far country for your great name s sake and your mighty hand and your outstretched arm when they shall come and pray toward this house

search.text: then hear from heavens, even from your dwelling place, and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for; that all the peoples of the earth may know your name, and revere you, as does your people Israel, and that they may know that this house which I have built is called by your name.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 33 then hear from heavens even from your dwelling place and do according to all that the foreigner calls to you for that all the peoples of the earth may know your name and revere you as does your people israel and that they may know that this house which i have built is called by your name

search.text: If your people go out to battle against their enemies, by whatever way you shall send them, and they pray to you toward this city which you have chosen, and the house which I have built for your name;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 34 if your people go out to battle against their enemies by whatever way you shall send them and they pray to you toward this city which you have chosen and the house which i have built for your name

search.text: then hear from heavens their prayer and their supplication, and maintain their cause.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 35 then hear from heavens their prayer and their supplication and maintain their cause

search.text: If they sin against you (for there is no one who doesn't sin), and you are angry with them, and deliver them to the enemy, so that they carry them away captive to a land far off or near;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 36 if they sin against you for there is no one who doesn t sin and you are angry with them and deliver them to the enemy so that they carry them away captive to a land far off or near

search.text: yet if they turn back in the land where they are carried captive, and turn again, and make supplication to you in the land of their captivity, saying, We have sinned, we have done perversely, and have dealt wickedly;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 37 yet if they turn back in the land where they are carried captive and turn again and make supplication to you in the land of their captivity saying we have sinned we have done perversely and have dealt wickedly

search.text: if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity, where they have carried them captive, and pray toward their land, which you gave to their fathers, and the city which you have chosen, and toward the house which I have built for your name:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 38 if they return to you with all their heart and with all their soul in the land of their captivity where they have carried them captive and pray toward their land which you gave to their fathers and the city which you have chosen and toward the house which i have built for your name

search.text: then hear from heavens, even from your dwelling place, their prayer and their petitions, and maintain their cause, and forgive your people who have sinned against you.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 39 then hear from heavens even from your dwelling place their prayer and their petitions and maintain their cause and forgive your people who have sinned against you

search.text: Now, my God, let, I beg you, your eyes be open, and let your ears be attentive, to the prayer that is made in this place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 40 now my god let i beg you your eyes be open and let your ears be attentive to the prayer that is made in this place

search.text: Now therefore arise, YHWH Elohim, into your resting place, you, and the ark of your strength: let your priests, YHWH Elohim, be clothed with salvation, and let your saints rejoice in goodness.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 41 now therefore arise yhwh elohim into your resting place you and the ark of your strength let your priests yhwh elohim be clothed with salvation and let your saints rejoice in goodness

search.text: YHWH Elohim, don't turn away the face of your anointed: remember [your] loving kindnesses to Dawid your servant.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 6 42 yhwh elohim don t turn away the face of your anointed remember your loving kindnesses to dawid your servant

search.text: Now when Shlomo had made an end of praying, the fire came down from heavens, and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices; and the glory of YHWH filled the house.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 1 now when shlomo had made an end of praying the fire came down from heavens and consumed the burnt offering and the sacrifices and the glory of yhwh filled the house

search.text: The priests could not enter into the house of YHWH, because the glory of YHWH filled YHWH's house.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 2 the priests could not enter into the house of yhwh because the glory of yhwh filled yhwh s house

search.text: All the children of Israel looked on, when the fire came down, and the glory of YHWH was on the house; and they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement, and worshiped, and gave thanks to YHWH, [saying], For YHWH is good; for YHWH’s loving kindness endures for ever.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 3 all the children of israel looked on when the fire came down and the glory of yhwh was on the house and they bowed themselves with their faces to the ground on the pavement and worshiped and gave thanks to yhwh saying for yhwh is good for yhwh s loving kindness endures for ever

search.text: Then the king and all the people offered sacrifice before YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 4 then the king and all the people offered sacrifice before yhwh

search.text: King Shlomo offered a sacrifice of twenty-two thousand oxen, and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep. So the king and all the people dedicated the house of Elohim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 5 king shlomo offered a sacrifice of twenty two thousand oxen and a hundred and twenty thousand sheep so the king and all the people dedicated the house of elohim

search.text: The priests stood, according to their offices; the Levites also with instruments of music of YHWH, which Dawid the king had made to give thanks to YHWH, (for YHWH’s loving kindness endures for ever), when Dawid praised by their ministry: and the priests sounded trumpets before them; and all Israel stood.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 6 the priests stood according to their offices the levites also with instruments of music of yhwh which dawid the king had made to give thanks to yhwh for yhwh s loving kindness endures for ever when dawid praised by their ministry and the priests sounded trumpets before them and all israel stood

search.text: Moreover Shlomo made the middle of the court holy that was before the house of YHWH; for there he offered the burnt offerings, and the fat of the peace offerings, because the bronze altar which Shlomo had made was not able to receive the burnt offering, and the meal offering, and the fat.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 7 moreover shlomo made the middle of the court holy that was before the house of yhwh for there he offered the burnt offerings and the fat of the peace offerings because the bronze altar which shlomo had made was not able to receive the burnt offering and the meal offering and the fat

search.text: So Shlomo held the feast at that time seven days, and all Israel with him, a very great assembly, from the entrance of Hamath to the brook of Mitzrayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 8 so shlomo held the feast at that time seven days and all israel with him a very great assembly from the entrance of hamath to the brook of mitzrayim

search.text: On the eighth day they held a solemn assembly: for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days, and the feast seven days.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 9 on the eighth day they held a solemn assembly for they kept the dedication of the altar seven days and the feast seven days

search.text: On the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away to their tents, joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that YHWH had shown to Dawid, and to Shlomo, and to Israel his people.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 10 on the three and twentieth day of the seventh month he sent the people away to their tents joyful and glad of heart for the goodness that yhwh had shown to dawid and to shlomo and to israel his people

search.text: Thus Shlomo finished the house of YHWH, and the king's house: and he successfully completed all that came into Shlomo's heart to make in the house of YHWH, and in his own house.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 11 thus shlomo finished the house of yhwh and the king s house and he successfully completed all that came into shlomo s heart to make in the house of yhwh and in his own house

search.text: YHWH appeared to Shlomo by night, and said to him, I have heard your prayer, and have chosen this place to myself for a house of sacrifice.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 12 yhwh appeared to shlomo by night and said to him i have heard your prayer and have chosen this place to myself for a house of sacrifice

search.text: If I shut up the heavens so that there is no rain, or if I command the locust to devour the land, or if I send pestilence among my people;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 13 if i shut up the heavens so that there is no rain or if i command the locust to devour the land or if i send pestilence among my people

search.text: if my people, who are called by my name, shall humble themselves, and pray, and seek my face, and turn from their wicked ways; then will I hear from heavens, and will forgive their sin, and will heal their land.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 14 if my people who are called by my name shall humble themselves and pray and seek my face and turn from their wicked ways then will i hear from heavens and will forgive their sin and will heal their land

search.text: Now my eyes shall be open, and my ears attentive, to the prayer that is made in this place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 15 now my eyes shall be open and my ears attentive to the prayer that is made in this place

search.text: For now have I chosen and made this house holy, that my name may be there forever; and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 16 for now have i chosen and made this house holy that my name may be there forever and my eyes and my heart shall be there perpetually

search.text: As for you, if you will walk before me as Dawid your father walked, and do according to all that I have commanded you, and will keep my statutes and my ordinances;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 17 as for you if you will walk before me as dawid your father walked and do according to all that i have commanded you and will keep my statutes and my ordinances

search.text: then I will establish the throne of your kingdom, according as I covenanted with Dawid your father, saying, There shall not fail you a person to be ruler in Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 18 then i will establish the throne of your kingdom according as i covenanted with dawid your father saying there shall not fail you a person to be ruler in israel

search.text: But if you turn away, and forsake my statutes and my commandments which I have set before you, and shall go and serve other gods, and worship them;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 19 but if you turn away and forsake my statutes and my commandments which i have set before you and shall go and serve other gods and worship them

search.text: then will I pluck them up by the roots out of my land which I have given them; and this house, which I have made holy for my name, will I cast out of my sight, and I will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 20 then will i pluck them up by the roots out of my land which i have given them and this house which i have made holy for my name will i cast out of my sight and i will make it a proverb and a byword among all peoples

search.text: This house, which is so high, everyone who passes by it shall be astonished, and shall say, Why has YHWH done thus to this land, and to this house?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 21 this house which is so high everyone who passes by it shall be astonished and shall say why has yhwh done thus to this land and to this house

search.text: They shall answer, Because they abandoned YHWH, the God of their fathers, who brought them forth out of the land of Mitzrayim, and laid hold on other gods, and worshiped them, and served them: therefore has he brought all this brokenness on them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 7 22 they shall answer because they abandoned yhwh the god of their fathers who brought them forth out of the land of mitzrayim and laid hold on other gods and worshiped them and served them therefore has he brought all this brokenness on them

search.text: It happened at the end of twenty years, in which Shlomo had built the house of YHWH, and his own house,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 1 it happened at the end of twenty years in which shlomo had built the house of yhwh and his own house

search.text: that the cities which Huram had given to Shlomo, Shlomo built them, and caused the children of Israel to dwell there.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 2 that the cities which huram had given to shlomo shlomo built them and caused the children of israel to dwell there

search.text: Shlomo went to Hamath Zobah, and prevailed against it.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 3 shlomo went to hamath zobah and prevailed against it

search.text: He built Tadmor in the wilderness, and all the storage cities, which he built in Hamath.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 4 he built tadmor in the wilderness and all the storage cities which he built in hamath

search.text: Also he built Beit Horon the upper, and Beit Horon the lower, fortified cities, with walls, gates, and bars;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 5 also he built beit horon the upper and beit horon the lower fortified cities with walls gates and bars

search.text: and Baalath, and all the storage cities that Shlomo had, and all the cities for his chariots, and the cities for his horsemen, and all that Shlomo desired to build for his pleasure in Yerushalayim, and in Levanon, and in all the land of his dominion.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 6 and baalath and all the storage cities that shlomo had and all the cities for his chariots and the cities for his horsemen and all that shlomo desired to build for his pleasure in yerushalayim and in levanon and in all the land of his dominion

search.text: As for all the people who were left of the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites, who were not of Israel;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 7 as for all the people who were left of the hittites and the amorites and the perizzites and the hivites and the jebusites who were not of israel

search.text: of their children who were left after them in the land, whom the children of Israel didn't consume, of them did Shlomo conscripted forced labor to this day.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 8 of their children who were left after them in the land whom the children of israel didn t consume of them did shlomo conscripted forced labor to this day

search.text: But of the children of Israel did Shlomo make no servants for his work; but they were men of war, and chief of his captains, and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 9 but of the children of israel did shlomo make no servants for his work but they were men of war and chief of his captains and rulers of his chariots and of his horsemen

search.text: These were the chief officers of king Shlomo, even two-hundred fifty, who ruled over the people.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 10 these were the chief officers of king shlomo even two hundred fifty who ruled over the people

search.text: Shlomo brought up the daughter of Pharaoh out of the city of Dawid to the house that he had built for her; for he said, My wife shall not dwell in the house of Dawid king of Israel, because the places where the ark of YHWH has come are holy.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 11 shlomo brought up the daughter of pharaoh out of the city of dawid to the house that he had built for her for he said my wife shall not dwell in the house of dawid king of israel because the places where the ark of yhwh has come are holy

search.text: Then Shlomo offered burnt offerings to YHWH on the altar of YHWH, which he had built before the porch,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 12 then shlomo offered burnt offerings to yhwh on the altar of yhwh which he had built before the porch

search.text: even as the duty of every day required, offering according to the commandment of Moshe, on the Sabbaths, and on the new moons, and on the set feasts, three times in the year, [even] in the feast of unleavened bread, and in the feast of weeks, and in the feast of tents.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 13 even as the duty of every day required offering according to the commandment of moshe on the sabbaths and on the new moons and on the set feasts three times in the year even in the feast of unleavened bread and in the feast of weeks and in the feast of tents

search.text: He appointed, according to the ordinance of Dawid his father, the divisions of the priests to their service, and the Levites to their offices, to praise, and to minister before the priests, as the duty of every day required; the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate: for so had Dawid the person of Elohim commanded.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 14 he appointed according to the ordinance of dawid his father the divisions of the priests to their service and the levites to their offices to praise and to minister before the priests as the duty of every day required the doorkeepers also by their divisions at every gate for so had dawid the person of elohim commanded

search.text: They didn't depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and Levites concerning any matter, or concerning the treasures.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 15 they didn t depart from the commandment of the king to the priests and levites concerning any matter or concerning the treasures

search.text: Now all the work of Shlomo was prepared to the day of the foundation of the house of YHWH, and until it was finished. [So] the house of YHWH was completed.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 16 now all the work of shlomo was prepared to the day of the foundation of the house of yhwh and until it was finished so the house of yhwh was completed

search.text: Then went Shlomo to Ezion Geber, and to Eloth, on the seashore in the land of Edom.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 17 then went shlomo to ezion geber and to eloth on the seashore in the land of edom

search.text: Huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants; and they came with the servants of Shlomo to Ophir, and fetched from there four hundred fifty talents of gold, and brought them to king Shlomo.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 8 18 huram sent him ships and servants who had knowledge of the sea by the hands of his servants and they came with the servants of shlomo to ophir and fetched from there four hundred fifty talents of gold and brought them to king shlomo

search.text: When the queen of Sheba heard of the fame of Shlomo, she came to prove Shlomo with hard questions at Yerushalayim, with a very great train, and camels that bore spices, and gold in abundance, and precious stones: and when she was come to Shlomo, she talked with him of all that was in her heart.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 1 when the queen of sheba heard of the fame of shlomo she came to prove shlomo with hard questions at yerushalayim with a very great train and camels that bore spices and gold in abundance and precious stones and when she was come to shlomo she talked with him of all that was in her heart

search.text: Shlomo told her all her questions; and there was not anything hid from Shlomo which he didn't tell her.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 2 shlomo told her all her questions and there was not anything hid from shlomo which he didn t tell her

search.text: When the queen of Sheba had seen the wisdom of Shlomo, and the house that he had built,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 3 when the queen of sheba had seen the wisdom of shlomo and the house that he had built

search.text: and the food of his table, and the sitting of his servants, and the attendance of his ministers, and their clothing, his cup bearers also, and their clothing, and his ascent by which he went up to the house of YHWH; there was no more spirit in her.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 4 and the food of his table and the sitting of his servants and the attendance of his ministers and their clothing his cup bearers also and their clothing and his ascent by which he went up to the house of yhwh there was no more spirit in her

search.text: She said to the king, It was a true report that I heard in my own land of your acts, and of your wisdom.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 5 she said to the king it was a true report that i heard in my own land of your acts and of your wisdom

search.text: However I didn't believe their words, until I came, and my eyes had seen it; and behold, the half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me: you exceed the fame that I heard.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 6 however i didn t believe their words until i came and my eyes had seen it and behold the half of the greatness of your wisdom was not told me you exceed the fame that i heard

search.text: Happy are your men, and happy are these your servants, who stand continually before you, and hear your wisdom.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 7 happy are your men and happy are these your servants who stand continually before you and hear your wisdom

search.text: Blessed be YHWH your God, who delighted in you, to set you on YHWH’s throne, to be king for YHWH your God: because your God loved Israel, to establish them forever, therefore made he you king over them, to do justice and righteousness.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 8 blessed be yhwh your god who delighted in you to set you on yhwh s throne to be king for yhwh your god because your god loved israel to establish them forever therefore made he you king over them to do justice and righteousness

search.text: She gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold, and spices in great abundance, and precious stones: neither was there any such spice as the queen of Sheba gave to king Shlomo.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 9 she gave the king one hundred and twenty talents of gold and spices in great abundance and precious stones neither was there any such spice as the queen of sheba gave to king shlomo

search.text: The servants also of Huram, and the servants of Shlomo, who brought gold from Ophir, brought algum trees and precious stones.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 10 the servants also of huram and the servants of shlomo who brought gold from ophir brought algum trees and precious stones

search.text: The king made of the algum trees terraces for the house of YHWH, and for the king's house, and harps and stringed instruments for the singers: and there were none like these seen before in the land of Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 11 the king made of the algum trees terraces for the house of yhwh and for the king s house and harps and stringed instruments for the singers and there were none like these seen before in the land of yehudah

search.text: King Shlomo gave to the queen of Sheba all her desire, whatever she asked, besides that which she had brought to the king. So she turned, and went to her own land, she and her servants.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 12 king shlomo gave to the queen of sheba all her desire whatever she asked besides that which she had brought to the king so she turned and went to her own land she and her servants

search.text: Now the weight of gold that came to Shlomo in one year was six hundred and sixty-six talents of gold,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 13 now the weight of gold that came to shlomo in one year was six hundred and sixty six talents of gold

search.text: besides that which the traders and merchants brought: and all the kings of Arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to Shlomo.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 14 besides that which the traders and merchants brought and all the kings of arabia and the governors of the country brought gold and silver to shlomo

search.text: King Shlomo made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold; six hundred [shekels] of beaten gold went to one buckler.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 15 king shlomo made two hundred bucklers of beaten gold six hundred shekels of beaten gold went to one buckler

search.text: [he made] three hundred shields of beaten gold; three hundred [shekels] of gold went to one shield: and the king put them in the house of the forest of Levanon.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 16 he made three hundred shields of beaten gold three hundred shekels of gold went to one shield and the king put them in the house of the forest of levanon

search.text: Moreover the king made a great throne of ivory, and overlaid it with pure gold.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 17 moreover the king made a great throne of ivory and overlaid it with pure gold

search.text: And there were six steps to the throne, with a footstool of gold, which were fastened to the throne, and stays on either side by the place of the seat, and two lions standing beside the stays.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 18 and there were six steps to the throne with a footstool of gold which were fastened to the throne and stays on either side by the place of the seat and two lions standing beside the stays

search.text: Twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps: there was nothing like it made in any kingdom.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 19 twelve lions stood there on the one side and on the other on the six steps there was nothing like it made in any kingdom

search.text: All king Shlomo's drinking vessels were of gold, and all the vessels of the house of the forest of Levanon were of pure gold: silver was nothing accounted of in the days of Shlomo.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 20 all king shlomo s drinking vessels were of gold and all the vessels of the house of the forest of levanon were of pure gold silver was nothing accounted of in the days of shlomo

search.text: For the king had ships that went to Tarshish with the servants of Huram; once every three years came the ships of Tarshish, bringing gold, and silver, ivory, and apes, and peacocks.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 21 for the king had ships that went to tarshish with the servants of huram once every three years came the ships of tarshish bringing gold and silver ivory and apes and peacocks

search.text: So king Shlomo exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 22 so king shlomo exceeded all the kings of the earth in riches and wisdom

search.text: All the kings of the earth sought the presence of Shlomo, to hear his wisdom, which Elohim had put in his heart.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 23 all the kings of the earth sought the presence of shlomo to hear his wisdom which elohim had put in his heart

search.text: They brought everyone their tribute, vessels of silver, and vessels of gold, and clothing, armor, and spices, horses, and mules, a rate year by year.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 24 they brought everyone their tribute vessels of silver and vessels of gold and clothing armor and spices horses and mules a rate year by year

search.text: Shlomo had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots, and twelve thousand horsemen, that he stationed in the chariot cities, and with the king at Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 25 shlomo had four thousand stalls for horses and chariots and twelve thousand horsemen that he stationed in the chariot cities and with the king at yerushalayim

search.text: He ruled over all the kings from the River even to the land of the Philistines, and to the border of Mitzrayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 26 he ruled over all the kings from the river even to the land of the philistines and to the border of mitzrayim

search.text: The king made silver to be in Yerushalayim as stones, and he made cedars to be as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland, for abundance.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 27 the king made silver to be in yerushalayim as stones and he made cedars to be as the sycamore trees that are in the lowland for abundance

search.text: They brought horses for Shlomo out of Mitzrayim, and out of all lands.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 28 they brought horses for shlomo out of mitzrayim and out of all lands

search.text: Now the rest of the acts of Shlomo, first and last, aren't they written in the history of Natan the prophet, and in the prophecy of Ahijah the Shilonite, and in the visions of Iddo the seer concerning Yerovam the son of Nebat?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 29 now the rest of the acts of shlomo first and last aren t they written in the history of natan the prophet and in the prophecy of ahijah the shilonite and in the visions of iddo the seer concerning yerovam the son of nebat

search.text: Shlomo reigned in Yerushalayim over all Israel forty years.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 30 shlomo reigned in yerushalayim over all israel forty years

search.text: Shlomo slept with his fathers, and he was buried in the city of Dawid his father: and Rechavam his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 9 31 shlomo slept with his fathers and he was buried in the city of dawid his father and rechavam his son reigned in his place

search.text: Rechavam went to Shekhem; for all Israel were come to Shekhem to make him king.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 1 rechavam went to shekhem for all israel were come to shekhem to make him king

search.text: It happened, when Yerovam the son of Nebat heard of it, (for he was in Mitzrayim, where he had fled from the presence of king Shlomo), that Yerovam returned out of Mitzrayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 2 it happened when yerovam the son of nebat heard of it for he was in mitzrayim where he had fled from the presence of king shlomo that yerovam returned out of mitzrayim

search.text: They sent and called him; and Yerovam and all Israel came, and they spoke to Rechavam, saying,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 3 they sent and called him and yerovam and all israel came and they spoke to rechavam saying

search.text: Your father made our yoke grievous: now therefore make you the grievous service of your father, and his heavy yoke which he put on us, lighter, and we will serve you.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 4 your father made our yoke grievous now therefore make you the grievous service of your father and his heavy yoke which he put on us lighter and we will serve you

search.text: He said to them, Come again to me after three days. The people departed.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 5 he said to them come again to me after three days the people departed

search.text: King Rechavam took counsel with the old men, who had stood before Shlomo his father while he yet lived, saying, What counsel give you me to return answer to this people?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 6 king rechavam took counsel with the old men who had stood before shlomo his father while he yet lived saying what counsel give you me to return answer to this people

search.text: They spoke to him, saying, If you are kind to this people, and please them, and speak good words to them, then they will be your servants forever.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 7 they spoke to him saying if you are kind to this people and please them and speak good words to them then they will be your servants forever

search.text: But he forsook the counsel of the old men which they had given him, and took counsel with the young people who had grown up with him, who stood before him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 8 but he forsook the counsel of the old men which they had given him and took counsel with the young people who had grown up with him who stood before him

search.text: He said to them, What counsel give you, that we may return answer to this people, who have spoken to me, saying, Make the yoke that your father did put on us lighter?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 9 he said to them what counsel give you that we may return answer to this people who have spoken to me saying make the yoke that your father did put on us lighter

search.text: The young people who had grown up with him spoke to him, saying, Thus shall you tell the people who spoke to you, saying, Your father made our yoke heavy, but make you it lighter to us; thus shall you say to them, My little finger is thicker than my father's waist.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 10 the young people who had grown up with him spoke to him saying thus shall you tell the people who spoke to you saying your father made our yoke heavy but make you it lighter to us thus shall you say to them my little finger is thicker than my father s waist

search.text: Now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke, I will add to your yoke: my father chastised you with whips, but I [will chastise you] with scorpions.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 11 now whereas my father did lade you with a heavy yoke i will add to your yoke my father chastised you with whips but i will chastise you with scorpions

search.text: So Yerovam and all the people came to Rechavam the third day, as the king bade, saying, Come to me again the third day.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 12 so yerovam and all the people came to rechavam the third day as the king bade saying come to me again the third day

search.text: The king answered them roughly; and king Rechavam forsook the counsel of the old men,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 13 the king answered them roughly and king rechavam forsook the counsel of the old men

search.text: and spoke to them after the counsel of the young people, saying, My father made your yoke heavy, but I will add thereto: my father chastised you with whips, but I [will chastise you] with scorpions.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 14 and spoke to them after the counsel of the young people saying my father made your yoke heavy but i will add thereto my father chastised you with whips but i will chastise you with scorpions

search.text: So the king didn't listen to the people; for it was brought about of Elohim, that YHWH might establish YHWH’s word, which YHWH spoke by Ahijah the Shilonite to Yerovam the son of Nebat.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 15 so the king didn t listen to the people for it was brought about of elohim that yhwh might establish yhwh s word which yhwh spoke by ahijah the shilonite to yerovam the son of nebat

search.text: When all Israel saw that the king didn't listen to them, the people answered the king, saying, What portion have we in Dawid? neither have we inheritance in the son of Yishai: everyone to your tents, Israel: now see to your own house, Dawid. So all Israel departed to their tents.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 16 when all israel saw that the king didn t listen to them the people answered the king saying what portion have we in dawid neither have we inheritance in the son of yishai everyone to your tents israel now see to your own house dawid so all israel departed to their tents

search.text: But as for the children of Israel who lived in the cities of Yehudah, Rechavam reigned over them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 17 but as for the children of israel who lived in the cities of yehudah rechavam reigned over them

search.text: Then king Rechavam sent Hadoram, who was over the men subject to forced labor; and the children of Israel stoned him to death with stones. King Rechavam made speed to get him up to his chariot, to flee to Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 18 then king rechavam sent hadoram who was over the men subject to forced labor and the children of israel stoned him to death with stones king rechavam made speed to get him up to his chariot to flee to yerushalayim

search.text: So Israel rebelled against the house of Dawid to this day.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 10 19 so israel rebelled against the house of dawid to this day

search.text: When Rechavam was come to Yerushalayim, he assembled the house of Yehudah and Binyamin, one hundred eighty thousand chosen men, who were warriors, to fight against Israel, to bring the kingdom again to Rechavam.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 1 when rechavam was come to yerushalayim he assembled the house of yehudah and binyamin one hundred eighty thousand chosen men who were warriors to fight against israel to bring the kingdom again to rechavam

search.text: But the word of YHWH came to Shemaiah the person of Elohim, saying,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 2 but the word of yhwh came to shemaiah the person of elohim saying

search.text: Speak to Rechavam the son of Shlomo, king of Yehudah, and to all Israel in Yehudah and Binyamin, saying,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 3 speak to rechavam the son of shlomo king of yehudah and to all israel in yehudah and binyamin saying

search.text: Thus says YHWH, You shall not go up, nor fight against your brothers: return everyone to their house; for this thing is of me. So they listened to the words of YHWH, and returned from going against Yerovam.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 4 thus says yhwh you shall not go up nor fight against your brothers return everyone to their house for this thing is of me so they listened to the words of yhwh and returned from going against yerovam

search.text: Rechavam lived in Yerushalayim, and built cities for defense in Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 5 rechavam lived in yerushalayim and built cities for defense in yehudah

search.text: He built Beit Lechem, and Etam, and Tekoa,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 6 he built beit lechem and etam and tekoa

search.text: Beth Zur, and Soco, and Adullam,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 7 beth zur and soco and adullam

search.text: and Gath, and Mareshah, and Ziph,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 8 and gath and mareshah and ziph

search.text: and Adoraim, and Lachish, and Azekah,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 9 and adoraim and lachish and azekah

search.text: and Zorah, and Aijalon, and Chevron, which are in Yehudah and in Binyamin, fortified cities.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 10 and zorah and aijalon and chevron which are in yehudah and in binyamin fortified cities

search.text: He fortified the strongholds, and put captains in them, and stores of food, and oil and wine.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 11 he fortified the strongholds and put captains in them and stores of food and oil and wine

search.text: In every city [he put] shields and spears, and made them exceeding strong. Yehudah and Binyamin belonged to him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 12 in every city he put shields and spears and made them exceeding strong yehudah and binyamin belonged to him

search.text: The priests and the Levites who were in all Israel resorted to him out of all their border.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 13 the priests and the levites who were in all israel resorted to him out of all their border

search.text: For the Levites left their suburbs and their possession, and came to Yehudah and Yerushalayim: for Yerovam and his sons cast them off, that they should not execute the priest's office to YHWH;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 14 for the levites left their suburbs and their possession and came to yehudah and yerushalayim for yerovam and his sons cast them off that they should not execute the priest s office to yhwh

search.text: and he appointed him priests for the high places, and for the male goats, and for the calves which he had made.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 15 and he appointed him priests for the high places and for the male goats and for the calves which he had made

search.text: After them, out of all the tribes of Israel, such as set their hearts to seek YHWH, the God of Israel, came to Yerushalayim to sacrifice to YHWH, the God of their fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 16 after them out of all the tribes of israel such as set their hearts to seek yhwh the god of israel came to yerushalayim to sacrifice to yhwh the god of their fathers

search.text: So they strengthened the kingdom of Yehudah, and made Rechavam the son of Shlomo strong, three years; for they walked three years in the way of Dawid and Shlomo.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 17 so they strengthened the kingdom of yehudah and made rechavam the son of shlomo strong three years for they walked three years in the way of dawid and shlomo

search.text: Rechavam took him a wife, Mahalath the daughter of Jerimoth the son of Dawid, [and of] Abihail the daughter of Eliab the son of Yishai;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 18 rechavam took him a wife mahalath the daughter of jerimoth the son of dawid and of abihail the daughter of eliab the son of yishai

search.text: and she bore him sons: Jeush, and Shemariah, and Zaham.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 19 and she bore him sons jeush and shemariah and zaham

search.text: After her he took Maacah the daughter of Avshalom; and she bore him Aviyah, and Attai, and Ziza, and Shelomith.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 20 after her he took maacah the daughter of avshalom and she bore him aviyah and attai and ziza and shelomith

search.text: Rechavam loved Maacah the daughter of Avshalom above all his wives and his concubines: (for he took eighteen wives, and sixty concubines, and became the father of twenty-eight sons and sixty daughters.)
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 21 rechavam loved maacah the daughter of avshalom above all his wives and his concubines for he took eighteen wives and sixty concubines and became the father of twenty eight sons and sixty daughters

search.text: Rechavam appointed Aviyah the son of Maacah to be chief, [even] the prince among his brothers; for [he was minded] to make him king.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 22 rechavam appointed aviyah the son of maacah to be chief even the prince among his brothers for he was minded to make him king

search.text: He dealt wisely, and dispersed of all his sons throughout all the lands of Yehudah and Binyamin, to every fortified city: and he gave them food in abundance. He sought [for them] many wives.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 11 23 he dealt wisely and dispersed of all his sons throughout all the lands of yehudah and binyamin to every fortified city and he gave them food in abundance he sought for them many wives

search.text: It happened, when the kingdom of Rechavam was established, and he was strong, that he forsook the law of YHWH, and all Israel with him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 1 it happened when the kingdom of rechavam was established and he was strong that he forsook the law of yhwh and all israel with him

search.text: It happened in the fifth year of king Rechavam, that Shishak king of Mitzrayim came up against Yerushalayim, because they had trespassed against YHWH,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 2 it happened in the fifth year of king rechavam that shishak king of mitzrayim came up against yerushalayim because they had trespassed against yhwh

search.text: with twelve hundred chariots, and sixty thousand horsemen. The people were without number who came with him out of Mitzrayim: the Lubim, the Sukkiim, and the Ethiopians.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 3 with twelve hundred chariots and sixty thousand horsemen the people were without number who came with him out of mitzrayim the lubim the sukkiim and the ethiopians

search.text: He took the fortified cities which pertained to Yehudah, and came to Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 4 he took the fortified cities which pertained to yehudah and came to yerushalayim

search.text: Now Shemaiah the prophet came to Rechavam, and to the princes of Yehudah, who were gathered together to Yerushalayim because of Shishak, and said to them, Thus says YHWH, You have forsaken me, therefore have I also left you in the hand of Shishak.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 5 now shemaiah the prophet came to rechavam and to the princes of yehudah who were gathered together to yerushalayim because of shishak and said to them thus says yhwh you have forsaken me therefore have i also left you in the hand of shishak

search.text: Then the princes of Israel and the king humbled themselves; and they said, YHWH is righteous.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 6 then the princes of israel and the king humbled themselves and they said yhwh is righteous

search.text: When YHWH saw that they humbled themselves, the word of YHWH came to Shemaiah, saying, They have humbled themselves: I will not destroy them; but I will grant them some deliverance, and my wrath shall not be poured out on Yerushalayim by the hand of Shishak.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 7 when yhwh saw that they humbled themselves the word of yhwh came to shemaiah saying they have humbled themselves i will not destroy them but i will grant them some deliverance and my wrath shall not be poured out on yerushalayim by the hand of shishak

search.text: Nevertheless they shall be his servants, that they may know my service, and the service of the kingdoms of the countries.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 8 nevertheless they shall be his servants that they may know my service and the service of the kingdoms of the countries

search.text: So Shishak king of Mitzrayim came up against Yerushalayim, and took away the treasures of the house of YHWH, and the treasures of the king's house: he took all away: he took away also the shields of gold which Shlomo had made.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 9 so shishak king of mitzrayim came up against yerushalayim and took away the treasures of the house of yhwh and the treasures of the king s house he took all away he took away also the shields of gold which shlomo had made

search.text: King Rechavam made in their place shields of brass, and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard, who kept the door of the king's house.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 10 king rechavam made in their place shields of brass and committed them to the hands of the captains of the guard who kept the door of the king s house

search.text: It was so, that as often as the king entered into the house of YHWH, the guard came and bore them, and brought them back into the guard chamber.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 11 it was so that as often as the king entered into the house of yhwh the guard came and bore them and brought them back into the guard chamber

search.text: When he humbled himself, the wrath of YHWH turned from him, so as not to destroy him altogether: and moreover in Yehudah there were good things [found].
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 12 when he humbled himself the wrath of yhwh turned from him so as not to destroy him altogether and moreover in yehudah there were good things found

search.text: So king Rechavam strengthened himself in Yerushalayim, and reigned: for Rechavam was forty-one years old when he began to reign, and he reigned seventeen years in Yerushalayim, the city which YHWH had chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, to put YHWH’s name there: and his mother's name was Naamah the Ammonitess.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 13 so king rechavam strengthened himself in yerushalayim and reigned for rechavam was forty one years old when he began to reign and he reigned seventeen years in yerushalayim the city which yhwh had chosen out of all the tribes of israel to put yhwh s name there and his mother s name was naamah the ammonitess

search.text: He did what was broken, because he didn't set his heart to seek YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 14 he did what was broken because he didn t set his heart to seek yhwh

search.text: Now the acts of Rechavam, first and last, aren't they written in the histories of Shemaiah the prophet and of Iddo the seer, after the manner of genealogies? There were wars between Rechavam and Yerovam continually.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 15 now the acts of rechavam first and last aren t they written in the histories of shemaiah the prophet and of iddo the seer after the manner of genealogies there were wars between rechavam and yerovam continually

search.text: Rechavam slept with his fathers, and was buried in the city of Dawid: and Aviyah his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 12 16 rechavam slept with his fathers and was buried in the city of dawid and aviyah his son reigned in his place

search.text: In the eighteenth year of king Yerovam began Aviyah to reign over Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 1 in the eighteenth year of king yerovam began aviyah to reign over yehudah

search.text: Three years reigned he in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Micaiah the daughter of Uriel of Gibeah. There was war between Aviyah and Yerovam.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 2 three years reigned he in yerushalayim and his mother s name was micaiah the daughter of uriel of gibeah there was war between aviyah and yerovam

search.text: Aviyah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war, even four hundred thousand chosen men: and Yerovam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men, who were mighty men of valor.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 3 aviyah joined battle with an army of valiant men of war even four hundred thousand chosen men and yerovam set the battle in array against him with eight hundred thousand chosen men who were mighty men of valor

search.text: Aviyah stood up on Mount Zemaraim, which is in the hill country of Efrayim, and said, Hear me, Yerovam and all Israel:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 4 aviyah stood up on mount zemaraim which is in the hill country of efrayim and said hear me yerovam and all israel

search.text: Ought you not to know that YHWH, the God of Israel, gave the kingdom over Israel to Dawid forever, even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 5 ought you not to know that yhwh the god of israel gave the kingdom over israel to dawid forever even to him and to his sons by a covenant of salt

search.text: Yet Yerovam the son of Nebat, the servant of Shlomo the son of Dawid, rose up, and rebelled against his lord.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 6 yet yerovam the son of nebat the servant of shlomo the son of dawid rose up and rebelled against his lord

search.text: There were gathered to him worthless men, base fellows, who strengthened themselves against Rechavam the son of Shlomo, when Rechavam was young and tender-hearted, and could not withstand them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 7 there were gathered to him worthless men base fellows who strengthened themselves against rechavam the son of shlomo when rechavam was young and tender hearted and could not withstand them

search.text: Now you think to withstand the kingdom of YHWH in the hand of the sons of Dawid; and you are a great multitude, and there are with you the golden calves which Yerovam made you for gods.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 8 now you think to withstand the kingdom of yhwh in the hand of the sons of dawid and you are a great multitude and there are with you the golden calves which yerovam made you for gods

search.text: Haven't you driven out the priests of YHWH, the sons of Aharon, and the Levites, and made you priests after the manner of the peoples of [other] lands? so that whoever comes to consecrate themselves with a young bull and seven rams, the same may be a priest of [those who are] no gods.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 9 haven t you driven out the priests of yhwh the sons of aharon and the levites and made you priests after the manner of the peoples of other lands so that whoever comes to consecrate themselves with a young bull and seven rams the same may be a priest of those who are no gods

search.text: But as for us, YHWH is our God, and we have not forsaken him; and [we have] priests ministering to YHWH, the sons of Aharon, and the Levites in their work:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 10 but as for us yhwh is our god and we have not forsaken him and we have priests ministering to yhwh the sons of aharon and the levites in their work

search.text: and they burn to YHWH every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense: the show bread also [set they] in order on the pure table; and the lampstand of gold with the lamps of it, to burn every evening: for we keep the charge of YHWH our God; but you have forsaken him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 11 and they burn to yhwh every morning and every evening burnt offerings and sweet incense the show bread also set they in order on the pure table and the lampstand of gold with the lamps of it to burn every evening for we keep the charge of yhwh our god but you have forsaken him

search.text: Behold, Elohim is with us at our head, and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you. Children of Israel, don't you fight against YHWH, the God of your fathers; for you shall not prosper.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 12 behold elohim is with us at our head and his priests with the trumpets of alarm to sound an alarm against you children of israel don t you fight against yhwh the god of your fathers for you shall not prosper

search.text: But Yerovam caused an ambush to come about behind them: so they were before Yehudah, and the ambush was behind them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 13 but yerovam caused an ambush to come about behind them so they were before yehudah and the ambush was behind them

search.text: When Yehudah looked back, behold, the battle was before and behind them; and they cried to YHWH, and the priests sounded with the trumpets.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 14 when yehudah looked back behold the battle was before and behind them and they cried to yhwh and the priests sounded with the trumpets

search.text: Then the people of Yehudah gave a shout: and as the people of Yehudah shouted, it happened, that Elohim struck Yerovam and all Israel before Aviyah and Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 15 then the people of yehudah gave a shout and as the people of yehudah shouted it happened that elohim struck yerovam and all israel before aviyah and yehudah

search.text: The children of Israel fled before Yehudah; and Elohim delivered them into their hand.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 16 the children of israel fled before yehudah and elohim delivered them into their hand

search.text: Aviyah and his people killed them with a great slaughter: so there fell down slain of Israel five hundred thousand chosen men.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 17 aviyah and his people killed them with a great slaughter so there fell down slain of israel five hundred thousand chosen men

search.text: Thus the children of Israel were brought under at that time, and the children of Yehudah prevailed, because they relied on YHWH, the God of their fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 18 thus the children of israel were brought under at that time and the children of yehudah prevailed because they relied on yhwh the god of their fathers

search.text: Aviyah pursued after Yerovam, and took cities from him, Beit El with the towns of it, and Jeshanah with the towns of it, and Ephron with the towns of it.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 19 aviyah pursued after yerovam and took cities from him beit el with the towns of it and jeshanah with the towns of it and ephron with the towns of it

search.text: Neither did Yerovam recover strength again in the days of Aviyah: and YHWH struck him, and he died.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 20 neither did yerovam recover strength again in the days of aviyah and yhwh struck him and he died

search.text: But Aviyah grew mighty, and took to himself fourteen wives, and became the father of twenty-two sons, and sixteen daughters.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 21 but aviyah grew mighty and took to himself fourteen wives and became the father of twenty two sons and sixteen daughters

search.text: The rest of the acts of Aviyah, and his ways, and his sayings, are written in the commentary of the prophet Iddo.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 13 22 the rest of the acts of aviyah and his ways and his sayings are written in the commentary of the prophet iddo

search.text: So Aviyah slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of Dawid; and Asa his son reigned in his place. In his days the land was quiet ten years.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 14 1 so aviyah slept with his fathers and they buried him in the city of dawid and asa his son reigned in his place in his days the land was quiet ten years

search.text: Asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of YHWH his God:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 14 2 asa did that which was good and right in the eyes of yhwh his god

search.text: for he took away the foreign altars, and the high places, and broke down the pillars, and hewed down the Asherim,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 14 3 for he took away the foreign altars and the high places and broke down the pillars and hewed down the asherim

search.text: and commanded Yehudah to seek YHWH, the God of their fathers, and to do the law and the commandment.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 14 4 and commanded yehudah to seek yhwh the god of their fathers and to do the law and the commandment

search.text: Also he took away out of all the cities of Yehudah the high places and the sun images: and the kingdom was quiet before him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 14 5 also he took away out of all the cities of yehudah the high places and the sun images and the kingdom was quiet before him

search.text: He built fortified cities in Yehudah; for the land was quiet, and he had no war in those years, because YHWH had given him rest.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 14 6 he built fortified cities in yehudah for the land was quiet and he had no war in those years because yhwh had given him rest

search.text: For he said to Yehudah, Let us build these cities, and make about them walls, and towers, gates, and bars; the land is yet before us, because we have sought YHWH our God; we have sought YHWH, and YHWH has given us rest on every side. So they built and prospered.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 14 7 for he said to yehudah let us build these cities and make about them walls and towers gates and bars the land is yet before us because we have sought yhwh our god we have sought yhwh and yhwh has given us rest on every side so they built and prospered

search.text: Asa had an army that bore bucklers and spears, out of Yehudah three hundred thousand; and out of Binyamin, that bore shields and drew bows, two hundred eighty thousand: all these were mighty men of valor.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 14 8 asa had an army that bore bucklers and spears out of yehudah three hundred thousand and out of binyamin that bore shields and drew bows two hundred eighty thousand all these were mighty men of valor

search.text: There came out against them Zerach the Ethiopian with an army of a million troops, and three hundred chariots; and he came to Mareshah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 14 9 there came out against them zerach the ethiopian with an army of a million troops and three hundred chariots and he came to mareshah

search.text: Then Asa went out to meet him, and they set the battle in array in the valley of Zephathah at Mareshah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 14 10 then asa went out to meet him and they set the battle in array in the valley of zephathah at mareshah

search.text: Asa cried to YHWH their God, and said, YHWH, there is none besides you to help, between the mighty and the one who has no strength: help us, YHWH our God; for we rely on you, and in your name are we come against this multitude. YHWH, you are our God; don't let man prevail against you.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 14 11 asa cried to yhwh their god and said yhwh there is none besides you to help between the mighty and the one who has no strength help us yhwh our god for we rely on you and in your name are we come against this multitude yhwh you are our god don t let man prevail against you

search.text: So YHWH struck the Ethiopians before Asa, and before Yehudah; and the Ethiopians fled.

search.text: The battle increased that day: however the king of Israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the Syrians until the even; and about the time of the going down of the sun he died.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 18 34 the battle increased that day however the king of israel stayed himself up in his chariot against the syrians until the even and about the time of the going down of the sun he died

search.text: Yehoshafat the king of Yehudah returned to his house in peace to Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 19 1 yehoshafat the king of yehudah returned to his house in peace to yerushalayim

search.text: Yehu the son of Hanani the seer went out to meet him, and said to king Yehoshafat, Should you help the wicked, and love those who hate YHWH? for this thing wrath is on you from before YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 19 2 yehu the son of hanani the seer went out to meet him and said to king yehoshafat should you help the wicked and love those who hate yhwh for this thing wrath is on you from before yhwh

search.text: Nevertheless there are good things found in you, in that you have put away the Asheroth out of the land, and have set your heart to seek Elohim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 19 3 nevertheless there are good things found in you in that you have put away the asheroth out of the land and have set your heart to seek elohim

search.text: Yehoshafat lived at Yerushalayim: and he went out again among the people from Be'er Sheva to the hill country of Efrayim, and brought them back to YHWH, the God of their fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 19 4 yehoshafat lived at yerushalayim and he went out again among the people from be er sheva to the hill country of efrayim and brought them back to yhwh the god of their fathers

search.text: He set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of Yehudah, city by city,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 19 5 he set judges in the land throughout all the fortified cities of yehudah city by city

search.text: and said to the judges, Consider what you do: for you don't judge for man, but for YHWH; and [he is] with you in the judgment.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 19 6 and said to the judges consider what you do for you don t judge for man but for yhwh and he is with you in the judgment

search.text: Now therefore let reverence for YHWH be on you; take heed and do it: for there is no iniquity with YHWH our God, nor respect of persons, nor taking of bribes.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 19 7 now therefore let reverence for yhwh be on you take heed and do it for there is no iniquity with yhwh our god nor respect of persons nor taking of bribes

search.text: Moreover in Yerushalayim did Yehoshafat set of the Levites and the priests, and of the heads of the fathers' [houses] of Israel, for the judgment of YHWH, and for controversies. They returned to Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 19 8 moreover in yerushalayim did yehoshafat set of the levites and the priests and of the heads of the fathers houses of israel for the judgment of yhwh and for controversies they returned to yerushalayim

search.text: He charged them, saying, Thus shall you do in reverence for YHWH, faithfully, and with a perfect heart.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 19 9 he charged them saying thus shall you do in reverence for yhwh faithfully and with a perfect heart

search.text: Whenever any controversy shall come to you from your brothers who dwell in their cities, between blood and blood, between law and commandment, statutes and ordinances, you shall warn them, that they not be guilty towards YHWH, and so wrath come on you and on your brothers: this do, and you shall not be guilty.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 19 10 whenever any controversy shall come to you from your brothers who dwell in their cities between blood and blood between law and commandment statutes and ordinances you shall warn them that they not be guilty towards yhwh and so wrath come on you and on your brothers this do and you shall not be guilty

search.text: Behold, Amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of YHWH; and Zebadiah the son of Yishmael, the ruler of the house of Yehudah, in all the king's matters: also the Levites shall be officers before you. Deal courageously, and YHWH be with the good.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 19 11 behold amariah the chief priest is over you in all matters of yhwh and zebadiah the son of yishmael the ruler of the house of yehudah in all the king s matters also the levites shall be officers before you deal courageously and yhwh be with the good

search.text: It happened after this, that the children of Moab, and the children of Ammon, and with them some of the Ammonites, came against Yehoshafat to battle.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 1 it happened after this that the children of moab and the children of ammon and with them some of the ammonites came against yehoshafat to battle

search.text: Then there came some who told Yehoshafat, saying, There comes a great multitude against you from beyond the sea from Aram; and behold, they are in Hazazon Tamar (the same is En Gedi).
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 2 then there came some who told yehoshafat saying there comes a great multitude against you from beyond the sea from aram and behold they are in hazazon tamar the same is en gedi

search.text: Yehoshafat feared, and set himself to seek to YHWH; and he proclaimed a fast throughout all Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 3 yehoshafat feared and set himself to seek to yhwh and he proclaimed a fast throughout all yehudah

search.text: Yehudah gathered themselves together, to seek [help] of YHWH: even out of all the cities of Yehudah they came to seek YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 4 yehudah gathered themselves together to seek help of yhwh even out of all the cities of yehudah they came to seek yhwh

search.text: Yehoshafat stood in the assembly of Yehudah and Yerushalayim, in the house of YHWH, before the new court;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 5 yehoshafat stood in the assembly of yehudah and yerushalayim in the house of yhwh before the new court

search.text: and he said, YHWH, the God of our fathers, aren't you Elohim in heavens? and aren't you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations? and in your hand is power and might, so that none is able to withstand you.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 6 and he said yhwh the god of our fathers aren t you elohim in heavens and aren t you ruler over all the kingdoms of the nations and in your hand is power and might so that none is able to withstand you

search.text: Did not you, our God, drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people Israel, and give it to the seed of Avraham your friend forever?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 7 did not you our god drive out the inhabitants of this land before your people israel and give it to the seed of avraham your friend forever

search.text: They lived therein, and have built you a sanctuary therein for your name, saying,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 8 they lived therein and have built you a sanctuary therein for your name saying

search.text: If calamity comes on us—sword, judgment, pestilence, or famine, we will stand before this house, and before you, (for your name is in this house), and cry to you in our affliction, and you will hear and save.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 9 if calamity comes on us sword judgment pestilence or famine we will stand before this house and before you for your name is in this house and cry to you in our affliction and you will hear and save

search.text: Now, behold, the children of Ammon and Moab and Mount Seir, whom you would not let Israel invade, when they came out of the land of Mitzrayim, but they turned aside from them, and didn't destroy them;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 10 now behold the children of ammon and moab and mount seir whom you would not let israel invade when they came out of the land of mitzrayim but they turned aside from them and didn t destroy them

search.text: behold, how they reward us, to come to cast us out of your possession, which you have given us to inherit.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 11 behold how they reward us to come to cast us out of your possession which you have given us to inherit

search.text: our God, will you not judge them? for we have no might against this great company that comes against us; neither know we what to do: but our eyes are on you.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 12 our god will you not judge them for we have no might against this great company that comes against us neither know we what to do but our eyes are on you

search.text: All Yehudah stood before YHWH, with their little ones, their wives, and their children.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 13 all yehudah stood before yhwh with their little ones their wives and their children

search.text: Then on Jahaziel the son of Zekharyah, the son of Benayahu, the son of Jeiel, the son of Mattaniah, the Levite, of the sons of Asaph, came the Ruach of YHWH in the midst of the assembly;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 14 then on jahaziel the son of zekharyah the son of benayahu the son of jeiel the son of mattaniah the levite of the sons of asaph came the ruach of yhwh in the midst of the assembly

search.text: and he said, Listen you, all Yehudah, and you inhabitants of Yerushalayim, and you king Yehoshafat: Thus says YHWH to you, Don't be afraid you, neither be dismayed by reason of this great multitude; for the battle is not yours, but Elohim's.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 15 and he said listen you all yehudah and you inhabitants of yerushalayim and you king yehoshafat thus says yhwh to you don t be afraid you neither be dismayed by reason of this great multitude for the battle is not yours but elohim s

search.text: Tomorrow go you down against them: behold, they come up by the ascent of Ziz; and you shall find them at the end of the valley, before the wilderness of Jeruel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 16 tomorrow go you down against them behold they come up by the ascent of ziz and you shall find them at the end of the valley before the wilderness of jeruel

search.text: You shall not need to fight in this [battle]: set yourselves, stand you still, and see the salvation of YHWH with you, O Yehudah and Yerushalayim; don't be afraid, nor be dismayed: tomorrow go out against them: for YHWH is with you.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 17 you shall not need to fight in this battle set yourselves stand you still and see the salvation of yhwh with you o yehudah and yerushalayim don t be afraid nor be dismayed tomorrow go out against them for yhwh is with you

search.text: Yehoshafat bowed his head with his face to the ground; and all Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim fell down before YHWH, worshipping YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 18 yehoshafat bowed his head with his face to the ground and all yehudah and the inhabitants of yerushalayim fell down before yhwh worshipping yhwh

search.text: The Levites, of the children of the Kohathites and of the children of the Korahites, stood up to praise YHWH, the God of Israel, with an exceeding loud voice.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 19 the levites of the children of the kohathites and of the children of the korahites stood up to praise yhwh the god of israel with an exceeding loud voice

search.text: They rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Yehoshafat stood and said, Hear me, Yehudah, and you inhabitants of Yerushalayim: believe in YHWH your God, so shall you be established; believe YHWH’s prophets, so shall you prosper.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 20 they rose early in the morning and went forth into the wilderness of tekoa and as they went forth yehoshafat stood and said hear me yehudah and you inhabitants of yerushalayim believe in yhwh your god so shall you be established believe yhwh s prophets so shall you prosper

search.text: When YHWH had taken counsel with the people, YHWH appointed those who should sing to YHWH, and give praise in holy array, as they went out before the army, and say, Give thanks to YHWH; for YHWH’s loving kindness endures forever.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 21 when yhwh had taken counsel with the people yhwh appointed those who should sing to yhwh and give praise in holy array as they went out before the army and say give thanks to yhwh for yhwh s loving kindness endures forever

search.text: When they began to sing and to praise, YHWH set ambushers against the children of Ammon, Moab, and Mount Seir, who had come against Yehudah; and they were struck.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 22 when they began to sing and to praise yhwh set ambushers against the children of ammon moab and mount seir who had come against yehudah and they were struck

search.text: For the children of Ammon and Moab stood up against the inhabitants of Mount Seir, utterly to kill and destroy them: and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of Seir, everyone helped to destroy another.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 23 for the children of ammon and moab stood up against the inhabitants of mount seir utterly to kill and destroy them and when they had made an end of the inhabitants of seir everyone helped to destroy another

search.text: When Yehudah came to the place overlooking the wilderness, they looked at the multitude; and behold, they were dead bodies fallen to the earth, and there were none who escaped.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 24 when yehudah came to the place overlooking the wilderness they looked at the multitude and behold they were dead bodies fallen to the earth and there were none who escaped

search.text: When Yehoshafat and his people came to take the spoil of them, they found among them in abundance both riches and dead bodies, and precious jewels, which they stripped off for themselves, more than they could carry away: and they were three days in taking the spoil, it was so much.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 25 when yehoshafat and his people came to take the spoil of them they found among them in abundance both riches and dead bodies and precious jewels which they stripped off for themselves more than they could carry away and they were three days in taking the spoil it was so much

search.text: On the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of Beracah; for there they blessed YHWH: therefore the name of that place was called The valley of Beracah to this day.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 26 on the fourth day they assembled themselves in the valley of beracah for there they blessed yhwh therefore the name of that place was called the valley of beracah to this day

search.text: Then they returned, everyone of Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and Yehoshafat in the forefront of them, to go again to Yerushalayim with joy; for YHWH had made them to rejoice over their enemies.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 27 then they returned everyone of yehudah and yerushalayim and yehoshafat in the forefront of them to go again to yerushalayim with joy for yhwh had made them to rejoice over their enemies

search.text: They came to Yerushalayim with stringed instruments and harps and trumpets to the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 28 they came to yerushalayim with stringed instruments and harps and trumpets to the house of yhwh

search.text: Reverence for God was on all the kingdoms of the countries, when they heard that YHWH fought against the enemies of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 29 reverence for god was on all the kingdoms of the countries when they heard that yhwh fought against the enemies of israel

search.text: So the realm of Yehoshafat was quiet; for his God gave him rest round about.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 30 so the realm of yehoshafat was quiet for his god gave him rest round about

search.text: Yehoshafat reigned over Yehudah: he was thirty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-five years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Azubah the daughter of Shilhi.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 31 yehoshafat reigned over yehudah he was thirty five years old when he began to reign and he reigned twenty five years in yerushalayim and his mother s name was azubah the daughter of shilhi

search.text: He walked in the way of Asa his father, and didn't turn aside from it, doing that which was right in the eyes of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 32 he walked in the way of asa his father and didn t turn aside from it doing that which was right in the eyes of yhwh

search.text: However the high places were not taken away; neither as yet had the people set their hearts to the God of their fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 33 however the high places were not taken away neither as yet had the people set their hearts to the god of their fathers

search.text: Now the rest of the acts of Yehoshafat, first and last, behold, they are written in the history of Yehu the son of Hanani, which is inserted in the book of the kings of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 34 now the rest of the acts of yehoshafat first and last behold they are written in the history of yehu the son of hanani which is inserted in the book of the kings of israel

search.text: After this did Yehoshafat king of Yehudah join himself with Ahaziah king of Israel; the same did very wickedly:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 35 after this did yehoshafat king of yehudah join himself with ahaziah king of israel the same did very wickedly

search.text: and he joined himself with him to make ships to go to Tarshish; and they made the ships in Ezion Geber.
