search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 36 and he joined himself with him to make ships to go to tarshish and they made the ships in ezion geber

search.text: Then Eliezer the son of Dodavahu of Mareshah prophesied against Yehoshafat, saying, Because you have joined yourself with Ahaziah, YHWH has destroyed your works. The ships were broken, so that they were not able to go to Tarshish.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 20 37 then eliezer the son of dodavahu of mareshah prophesied against yehoshafat saying because you have joined yourself with ahaziah yhwh has destroyed your works the ships were broken so that they were not able to go to tarshish

search.text: Yehoshafat slept with his fathers, and was buried with his fathers in the city of Dawid: and Yoram his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 1 yehoshafat slept with his fathers and was buried with his fathers in the city of dawid and yoram his son reigned in his place

search.text: He had brothers, the sons of Yehoshafat: Azaryah, and Jehiel, and Zekharyah, and Azaryah, and Mikha'el, and Shephatiah; all these were the sons of Yehoshafat king of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 2 he had brothers the sons of yehoshafat azaryah and jehiel and zekharyah and azaryah and mikha el and shephatiah all these were the sons of yehoshafat king of israel

search.text: Their father gave them great gifts, of silver, and of gold, and of precious things, with fortified cities in Yehudah: but the kingdom gave he to Yoram, because he was the firstborn.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 3 their father gave them great gifts of silver and of gold and of precious things with fortified cities in yehudah but the kingdom gave he to yoram because he was the firstborn

search.text: Now when Yoram was risen up over the kingdom of his father, and had strengthened himself, he killed all his brothers with the sword, and various also of the princes of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 4 now when yoram was risen up over the kingdom of his father and had strengthened himself he killed all his brothers with the sword and various also of the princes of israel

search.text: Yoram was thirty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eight years in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 5 yoram was thirty two years old when he began to reign and he reigned eight years in yerushalayim

search.text: He walked in the way of the kings of Israel, as did the house of Achav; for he had the daughter of Achav as wife: and he did what was broken in the sight of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 6 he walked in the way of the kings of israel as did the house of achav for he had the daughter of achav as wife and he did what was broken in the sight of yhwh

search.text: However YHWH would not destroy the house of Dawid, because of the covenant that he had made with Dawid, and as he promised to give a lamp to him and to his children always.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 7 however yhwh would not destroy the house of dawid because of the covenant that he had made with dawid and as he promised to give a lamp to him and to his children always

search.text: In his days Edom revolted from under the hand of Yehudah, and made a king over themselves.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 8 in his days edom revolted from under the hand of yehudah and made a king over themselves

search.text: Then Yoram passed over with his captains, and all his chariots with him: and he rose up by night, and struck the Edomites who surrounded him, along with the captains of the chariots.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 9 then yoram passed over with his captains and all his chariots with him and he rose up by night and struck the edomites who surrounded him along with the captains of the chariots

search.text: So Edom revolted from under the hand of Yehudah to this day: then did Libnah revolt at the same time from under his hand, because he had forsaken YHWH, the God of his fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 10 so edom revolted from under the hand of yehudah to this day then did libnah revolt at the same time from under his hand because he had forsaken yhwh the god of his fathers

search.text: Moreover he made high places in the mountains of Yehudah, and made the inhabitants of Yerushalayim to play the prostitute, and led Yehudah astray.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 11 moreover he made high places in the mountains of yehudah and made the inhabitants of yerushalayim to play the prostitute and led yehudah astray

search.text: There came a writing to him from Eliyahu the prophet, saying, Thus says YHWH, the God of Dawid your father, Because you have not walked in the ways of Yehoshafat your father, nor in the ways of Asa king of Yehudah,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 12 there came a writing to him from eliyahu the prophet saying thus says yhwh the god of dawid your father because you have not walked in the ways of yehoshafat your father nor in the ways of asa king of yehudah

search.text: but have walked in the way of the kings of Israel, and have made Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim to play the prostitute, like as the house of Achav did, and also have slain your brothers of your father's house, who were better than yourself:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 13 but have walked in the way of the kings of israel and have made yehudah and the inhabitants of yerushalayim to play the prostitute like as the house of achav did and also have slain your brothers of your father s house who were better than yourself

search.text: behold, YHWH will strike with a great plague your people, and your children, and your wives, and all your substance;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 14 behold yhwh will strike with a great plague your people and your children and your wives and all your substance

search.text: and you shall have great sickness by disease of your bowels, until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness, day by day.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 15 and you shall have great sickness by disease of your bowels until your bowels fall out by reason of the sickness day by day

search.text: YHWH stirred up against Yoram the spirit of the Philistines, and of the Arabians who are beside the Ethiopians:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 16 yhwh stirred up against yoram the spirit of the philistines and of the arabians who are beside the ethiopians

search.text: and they came up against Yehudah, and broke into it, and carried away all the substance that was found in the king's house, and his sons also, and his wives; so that there was never a son left him, save Jehoahaz, the youngest of his sons.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 17 and they came up against yehudah and broke into it and carried away all the substance that was found in the king s house and his sons also and his wives so that there was never a son left him save jehoahaz the youngest of his sons

search.text: After all this YHWH struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 18 after all this yhwh struck him in his bowels with an incurable disease

search.text: It happened, in process of time, at the end of two years, that his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness, and he died of sore diseases. His people made no burning for him, like the burning of his fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 19 it happened in process of time at the end of two years that his bowels fell out by reason of his sickness and he died of sore diseases his people made no burning for him like the burning of his fathers

search.text: Thirty-two years old was he when he began to reign, and he reigned in Yerushalayim eight years: and he departed without being desired; and they buried him in the city of Dawid, but not in the tombs of the kings.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 21 20 thirty two years old was he when he began to reign and he reigned in yerushalayim eight years and he departed without being desired and they buried him in the city of dawid but not in the tombs of the kings

search.text: The inhabitants of Yerushalayim made Ahaziah his youngest son king in his place; for the band of people who came with the Arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest. So Ahaziah the son of Yoram king of Yehudah reigned.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 1 the inhabitants of yerushalayim made ahaziah his youngest son king in his place for the band of people who came with the arabians to the camp had slain all the eldest so ahaziah the son of yoram king of yehudah reigned

search.text: Forty-two years old was Ahaziah when he began to reign; and he reigned one year in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Athaliah the daughter of Omri.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 2 forty two years old was ahaziah when he began to reign and he reigned one year in yerushalayim and his mother s name was athaliah the daughter of omri

search.text: He also walked in the ways of the house of Achav; for his mother was his counselor to do wickedly.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 3 he also walked in the ways of the house of achav for his mother was his counselor to do wickedly

search.text: He did what was broken in the sight of YHWH, as did the house of Achav; for they were his counselors after the death of his father, to his destruction.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 4 he did what was broken in the sight of yhwh as did the house of achav for they were his counselors after the death of his father to his destruction

search.text: He walked also after their counsel, and went with Yoram the son of Achav king of Israel to war against Hazael king of Aram at Ramoth Gilead: and the Syrians wounded Yoram.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 5 he walked also after their counsel and went with yoram the son of achav king of israel to war against hazael king of aram at ramoth gilead and the syrians wounded yoram

search.text: He returned to be healed in Jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at Ramah, when he fought against Hazael king of Aram. Azaryah the son of Yoram king of Yehudah went down to see Yoram the son of Achav in Jezreel, because he was sick.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 6 he returned to be healed in jezreel of the wounds which they had given him at ramah when he fought against hazael king of aram azaryah the son of yoram king of yehudah went down to see yoram the son of achav in jezreel because he was sick

search.text: Now the destruction of Ahaziah was of Elohim, in that he went to Yoram: for when he was come, he went out with Yoram against Yehu the son of Nimshi, whom YHWH had anointed to cut off the house of Achav.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 7 now the destruction of ahaziah was of elohim in that he went to yoram for when he was come he went out with yoram against yehu the son of nimshi whom yhwh had anointed to cut off the house of achav

search.text: It happened, when Yehu was executing judgment on the house of Achav, that he found the princes of Yehudah, and the sons of the brothers of Ahaziah, ministering to Ahaziah, and killed them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 8 it happened when yehu was executing judgment on the house of achav that he found the princes of yehudah and the sons of the brothers of ahaziah ministering to ahaziah and killed them

search.text: He sought Ahaziah, and they caught him (now he was hiding in Shomron), and they brought him to Yehu, and killed him; and they buried him, for they said, He is the son of Yehoshafat, who sought YHWH with all his heart. The house of Ahaziah had no power to hold the kingdom.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 9 he sought ahaziah and they caught him now he was hiding in shomron and they brought him to yehu and killed him and they buried him for they said he is the son of yehoshafat who sought yhwh with all his heart the house of ahaziah had no power to hold the kingdom

search.text: Now when Athaliah the mother of Ahaziah saw that her son was dead, she arose and destroyed all the royal seed of the house of Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 10 now when athaliah the mother of ahaziah saw that her son was dead she arose and destroyed all the royal seed of the house of yehudah

search.text: But Jehoshabeath, the daughter of the king, took Yoash the son of Ahaziah, and stole him away from among the king's sons who were slain, and put him and his nurse in the bedchamber. So Jehoshabeath, the daughter of king Yoram, the wife of Yehoyada the priest (for she was the sister of Ahaziah), hid him from Athaliah, so that she didn't kill him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 11 but jehoshabeath the daughter of the king took yoash the son of ahaziah and stole him away from among the king s sons who were slain and put him and his nurse in the bedchamber so jehoshabeath the daughter of king yoram the wife of yehoyada the priest for she was the sister of ahaziah hid him from athaliah so that she didn t kill him

search.text: He was with them hid in the house of Elohim six years: and Athaliah reigned over the land.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 22 12 he was with them hid in the house of elohim six years and athaliah reigned over the land

search.text: In the seventh year Yehoyada strengthened himself, and took the captains of hundreds, Azaryah the son of Jeroham, and Yishmael the son of Jehohanan, and Azaryah the son of Oved, and Maaseiah the son of Adaiah, and Elishaphat the son of Zichri, into covenant with him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 1 in the seventh year yehoyada strengthened himself and took the captains of hundreds azaryah the son of jeroham and yishmael the son of jehohanan and azaryah the son of oved and maaseiah the son of adaiah and elishaphat the son of zichri into covenant with him

search.text: They went about in Yehudah, and gathered the Levites out of all the cities of Yehudah, and the heads of fathers' [houses] of Israel, and they came to Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 2 they went about in yehudah and gathered the levites out of all the cities of yehudah and the heads of fathers houses of israel and they came to yerushalayim

search.text: All the assembly made a covenant with the king in the house of Elohim. He said to them, Behold, the king's son shall reign, as YHWH has spoken concerning the sons of Dawid.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 3 all the assembly made a covenant with the king in the house of elohim he said to them behold the king s son shall reign as yhwh has spoken concerning the sons of dawid

search.text: This is the thing that you shall do: a third part of you, who come in on the Sabbath, of the priests and of the Levites, shall be porters of the thresholds;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 4 this is the thing that you shall do a third part of you who come in on the sabbath of the priests and of the levites shall be porters of the thresholds

search.text: and a third part shall be at the king's house; and a third part at the gate of the foundation: and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 5 and a third part shall be at the king s house and a third part at the gate of the foundation and all the people shall be in the courts of the house of yhwh

search.text: But let none come into the house of YHWH, save the priests, and those who minister of the Levites; they shall come in, for they are holy: but all the people shall keep the charge of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 6 but let none come into the house of yhwh save the priests and those who minister of the levites they shall come in for they are holy but all the people shall keep the charge of yhwh

search.text: The Levites shall compass the king round about, everyone with their weapons in their hand; and whoever comes into the house, let him be slain: and be you with the king when they come in, and when they go out.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 7 the levites shall compass the king round about everyone with their weapons in their hand and whoever comes into the house let him be slain and be you with the king when they come in and when they go out

search.text: So the Levites and all Yehudah did according to all that Yehoyada the priest commanded: and they took everyone their men, those who were to come in on the Sabbath; with those who were to go out on the Sabbath; for Yehoyada the priest didn't dismiss the shift.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 8 so the levites and all yehudah did according to all that yehoyada the priest commanded and they took everyone their men those who were to come in on the sabbath with those who were to go out on the sabbath for yehoyada the priest didn t dismiss the shift

search.text: Yehoyada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears, and bucklers, and shields, that had been king Dawid's, which were in the house of Elohim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 9 yehoyada the priest delivered to the captains of hundreds the spears and bucklers and shields that had been king dawid s which were in the house of elohim

search.text: They set all the people, everyone with their weapon in their hand, from the right side of the house to the left side of the house, along by the altar and the house, by the king round about.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 10 they set all the people everyone with their weapon in their hand from the right side of the house to the left side of the house along by the altar and the house by the king round about

search.text: Then they brought out the king's son, and put the crown on him, and [gave him] the testimony, and made him king: and Yehoyada and his sons anointed him; and they said, [Long] live the king.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 11 then they brought out the king s son and put the crown on him and gave him the testimony and made him king and yehoyada and his sons anointed him and they said long live the king

search.text: When Athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king, she came to the people into the house of YHWH:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 12 when athaliah heard the noise of the people running and praising the king she came to the people into the house of yhwh

search.text: and she looked, and, behold, the king stood by his pillar at the entrance, and the captains and the trumpets by the king; and all the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets; the singers also [played] on instruments of music, and led the singing of praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, Treason! treason!
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 13 and she looked and behold the king stood by his pillar at the entrance and the captains and the trumpets by the king and all the people of the land rejoiced and blew trumpets the singers also played on instruments of music and led the singing of praise then athaliah tore her clothes and said treason treason

search.text: Yehoyada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were set over the army, and said to them, Have her forth between the ranks; and whoever follows her, let him be slain with the sword: for the priest said, Don't kill her in the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 14 yehoyada the priest brought out the captains of hundreds who were set over the army and said to them have her forth between the ranks and whoever follows her let him be slain with the sword for the priest said don t kill her in the house of yhwh

search.text: So they made way for her; and she went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king's house: and they killed her there.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 15 so they made way for her and she went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king s house and they killed her there

search.text: Yehoyada made a covenant between himself, and all the people, and the king, that they should be YHWH's people.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 16 yehoyada made a covenant between himself and all the people and the king that they should be yhwh s people

search.text: All the people went to the house of Baal, and broke it down, and broke his altars and his images in pieces, and killed Mattan the priest of Baal before the altars.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 17 all the people went to the house of baal and broke it down and broke his altars and his images in pieces and killed mattan the priest of baal before the altars

search.text: Yehoyada appointed the officers of the house of YHWH under the hand of the priests the Levites, whom Dawid had distributed in the house of YHWH, to offer the burnt offerings of YHWH, as it is written in the law of Moshe, with rejoicing and with singing, according to the order of Dawid.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 18 yehoyada appointed the officers of the house of yhwh under the hand of the priests the levites whom dawid had distributed in the house of yhwh to offer the burnt offerings of yhwh as it is written in the law of moshe with rejoicing and with singing according to the order of dawid

search.text: They set the porters at the gates of the house of YHWH, that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 19 they set the porters at the gates of the house of yhwh that no one who was unclean in anything should enter in

search.text: He took the captains of hundreds, and the nobles, and the governors of the people, and all the people of the land, and brought down the king from the house of YHWH: and they came through the upper gate to the king's house, and set the king on the throne of the kingdom.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 20 he took the captains of hundreds and the nobles and the governors of the people and all the people of the land and brought down the king from the house of yhwh and they came through the upper gate to the king s house and set the king on the throne of the kingdom

search.text: So all the people of the land rejoiced, and the city was quiet. Athaliah they had slain with the sword.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 23 21 so all the people of the land rejoiced and the city was quiet athaliah they had slain with the sword

search.text: Yoash was seven years old when he began to reign; and he reigned forty years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Zibiah, of Be'er Sheva.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 1 yoash was seven years old when he began to reign and he reigned forty years in yerushalayim and his mother s name was zibiah of be er sheva

search.text: Yoash did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH all the days of Yehoyada the priest.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 2 yoash did that which was right in the eyes of yhwh all the days of yehoyada the priest

search.text: Yehoyada took for him two wives; and he became the father of sons and daughters.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 3 yehoyada took for him two wives and he became the father of sons and daughters

search.text: It happened after this, that Yoash was minded to restore the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 4 it happened after this that yoash was minded to restore the house of yhwh

search.text: He gathered together the priests and the Levites, and said to them, Go out to the cities of Yehudah, and gather of all Israel money to repair the house of your God from year to year; and see that you hasten the matter. However the Levites didn't hurry.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 5 he gathered together the priests and the levites and said to them go out to the cities of yehudah and gather of all israel money to repair the house of your god from year to year and see that you hasten the matter however the levites didn t hurry

search.text: The king called for Yehoyada the chief, and said to him, Why haven't you required of the Levites to bring in out of Yehudah and out of Yerushalayim the tax of Moshe the servant of YHWH, and of the assembly of Israel, for the tent of the testimony?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 6 the king called for yehoyada the chief and said to him why haven t you required of the levites to bring in out of yehudah and out of yerushalayim the tax of moshe the servant of yhwh and of the assembly of israel for the tent of the testimony

search.text: For the sons of Athaliah, that wicked woman, had broken up the house of Elohim; and also all the dedicated things of the house of YHWH did they bestow on the Baals.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 7 for the sons of athaliah that wicked woman had broken up the house of elohim and also all the dedicated things of the house of yhwh did they bestow on the baals

search.text: So the king commanded, and they made a chest, and set it outside at the gate of the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 8 so the king commanded and they made a chest and set it outside at the gate of the house of yhwh

search.text: They made a proclamation through Yehudah and Yerushalayim, to bring in for YHWH the tax that Moshe the servant of Elohim laid on Israel in the wilderness.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 9 they made a proclamation through yehudah and yerushalayim to bring in for yhwh the tax that moshe the servant of elohim laid on israel in the wilderness

search.text: All the princes and all the people rejoiced, and brought in, and cast into the chest, until they had made an end.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 10 all the princes and all the people rejoiced and brought in and cast into the chest until they had made an end

search.text: It was so, that whenever the chest was brought to the king's officers by the hand of the Levites, and when they saw that there was much money, the king's scribe and the chief priest's officer came and emptied the chest, and took it, and carried it to its place again. Thus they did day by day, and gathered money in abundance.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 11 it was so that whenever the chest was brought to the king s officers by the hand of the levites and when they saw that there was much money the king s scribe and the chief priest s officer came and emptied the chest and took it and carried it to its place again thus they did day by day and gathered money in abundance

search.text: The king and Yehoyada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of YHWH; and they hired masons and carpenters to restore the house of YHWH, and also such as worked iron and brass to repair the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 12 the king and yehoyada gave it to such as did the work of the service of the house of yhwh and they hired masons and carpenters to restore the house of yhwh and also such as worked iron and brass to repair the house of yhwh

search.text: So the workmen worked, and the work of repairing went forward in their hands, and they set up the house of Elohim in its state, and strengthened it.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 13 so the workmen worked and the work of repairing went forward in their hands and they set up the house of elohim in its state and strengthened it

search.text: When they had made an end, they brought the rest of the money before the king and Yehoyada, of which were made vessels for the house of YHWH, even vessels with which to minister and to offer, and spoons, and vessels of gold and silver. They offered burnt offerings in the house of YHWH continually all the days of Yehoyada.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 14 when they had made an end they brought the rest of the money before the king and yehoyada of which were made vessels for the house of yhwh even vessels with which to minister and to offer and spoons and vessels of gold and silver they offered burnt offerings in the house of yhwh continually all the days of yehoyada

search.text: But Yehoyada grew old and was full of days, and he died; one hundred thirty years old was he when he died.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 15 but yehoyada grew old and was full of days and he died one hundred thirty years old was he when he died

search.text: They buried him in the city of Dawid among the kings, because he had done good in Israel, and toward Elohim and Elohim’s house.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 16 they buried him in the city of dawid among the kings because he had done good in israel and toward elohim and elohim s house

search.text: Now after the death of Yehoyada came the princes of Yehudah, and made obeisance to the king. Then the king listened to them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 17 now after the death of yehoyada came the princes of yehudah and made obeisance to the king then the king listened to them

search.text: They forsook the house of YHWH, the God of their fathers, and served the Asherim and the idols: and wrath came on Yehudah and Yerushalayim for this their guiltiness.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 18 they forsook the house of yhwh the god of their fathers and served the asherim and the idols and wrath came on yehudah and yerushalayim for this their guiltiness

search.text: Yet he sent prophets to them, to bring them again to YHWH; and they testified against them: but they would not give ear.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 19 yet he sent prophets to them to bring them again to yhwh and they testified against them but they would not give ear

search.text: The Ruach of Elohim came on Zekharyah the son of Yehoyada the priest; and he stood above the people, and said to them, Thus says Elohim, Why disobey you the commandments of YHWH, so that you can't prosper? because you have forsaken YHWH, YHWH has also forsaken you.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 20 the ruach of elohim came on zekharyah the son of yehoyada the priest and he stood above the people and said to them thus says elohim why disobey you the commandments of yhwh so that you can t prosper because you have forsaken yhwh yhwh has also forsaken you

search.text: They conspired against him, and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 21 they conspired against him and stoned him with stones at the commandment of the king in the court of the house of yhwh

search.text: Thus Yoash the king didn't remember the kindness which Yehoyada his father had done to him, but killed his son. When he died, he said, YHWH look on it, and require it.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 22 thus yoash the king didn t remember the kindness which yehoyada his father had done to him but killed his son when he died he said yhwh look on it and require it

search.text: It happened at the end of the year, that the army of the Syrians came up against him: and they came to Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people, and sent all the spoil of them to the king of Dammeseq.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 23 it happened at the end of the year that the army of the syrians came up against him and they came to yehudah and yerushalayim and destroyed all the princes of the people from among the people and sent all the spoil of them to the king of dammeseq

search.text: For the army of the Syrians came with a small company of people; and YHWH delivered a very great army into their hand, because they had forsaken YHWH, the God of their fathers. So they executed judgment on Yoash.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 24 for the army of the syrians came with a small company of people and yhwh delivered a very great army into their hand because they had forsaken yhwh the god of their fathers so they executed judgment on yoash

search.text: When they were departed for him (for they left him very sick), his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of Yehoyada the priest, and killed him on his bed, and he died; and they buried him in the city of Dawid, but they didn't bury him in the tombs of the kings.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 25 when they were departed for him for they left him very sick his own servants conspired against him for the blood of the sons of yehoyada the priest and killed him on his bed and he died and they buried him in the city of dawid but they didn t bury him in the tombs of the kings

search.text: These are those who conspired against him: Zabad the son of Shimeath the Ammonitess, and Jehozabad the son of Shimrith the Moabitess.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 26 these are those who conspired against him zabad the son of shimeath the ammonitess and jehozabad the son of shimrith the moabitess

search.text: Now concerning his sons, and the greatness of the burdens [laid] on him, and the rebuilding of the house of Elohim, behold, they are written in the commentary of the book of the kings. Amaziah his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 24 27 now concerning his sons and the greatness of the burdens laid on him and the rebuilding of the house of elohim behold they are written in the commentary of the book of the kings amaziah his son reigned in his place

search.text: Amaziah was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Jehoaddan, of Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 1 amaziah was twenty five years old when he began to reign and he reigned twenty nine years in yerushalayim and his mother s name was jehoaddan of yerushalayim

search.text: He did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH, but not with a perfect heart.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 2 he did that which was right in the eyes of yhwh but not with a perfect heart

search.text: Now it happened, when the kingdom was established to him, that he killed his servants who had killed the king his father.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 3 now it happened when the kingdom was established to him that he killed his servants who had killed the king his father

search.text: But he didn't put their children to death, but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of Moshe, as YHWH commanded, saying, The fathers shall not die for the children, neither shall the children die for the fathers; but everyone shall die for their own sin.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 4 but he didn t put their children to death but did according to that which is written in the law in the book of moshe as yhwh commanded saying the fathers shall not die for the children neither shall the children die for the fathers but everyone shall die for their own sin

search.text: Moreover Amaziah gathered Yehudah together, and ordered them according to their fathers' houses, under captains of thousands and captains of hundreds, even all Yehudah and Binyamin: and he numbered them from twenty years old and upward, and found them three hundred thousand chosen men, able to go forth to war, who could handle spear and shield.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 5 moreover amaziah gathered yehudah together and ordered them according to their fathers houses under captains of thousands and captains of hundreds even all yehudah and binyamin and he numbered them from twenty years old and upward and found them three hundred thousand chosen men able to go forth to war who could handle spear and shield

search.text: He hired also one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of Israel for one hundred talents of silver.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 6 he hired also one hundred thousand mighty men of valor out of israel for one hundred talents of silver

search.text: But there came a person of Elohim to him, saying, O king, don't let the army of Israel go with you; for YHWH is not with Israel, [to wit], with all the children of Efrayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 7 but there came a person of elohim to him saying o king don t let the army of israel go with you for yhwh is not with israel to wit with all the children of efrayim

search.text: But if you will go, do [valiantly], be strong for the battle: Elohim will cast you down before the enemy; for Elohim has power to help, and to cast down.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 8 but if you will go do valiantly be strong for the battle elohim will cast you down before the enemy for elohim has power to help and to cast down

search.text: Amaziah said to the person of Elohim, But what shall we do for the hundred talents which I have given to the army of Israel? The person of Elohim answered, YHWH is able to give you much more than this.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 9 amaziah said to the person of elohim but what shall we do for the hundred talents which i have given to the army of israel the person of elohim answered yhwh is able to give you much more than this

search.text: Then Amaziah separated them, [to wit], the army that had come to him out of Efrayim, to go home again: therefore their anger was greatly kindled against Yehudah, and they returned home in fierce anger.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 10 then amaziah separated them to wit the army that had come to him out of efrayim to go home again therefore their anger was greatly kindled against yehudah and they returned home in fierce anger

search.text: Amaziah took courage, and led forth his people, and went to the Valley of Salt, and struck of the children of Seir ten thousand.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 11 amaziah took courage and led forth his people and went to the valley of salt and struck of the children of seir ten thousand

search.text: [other] ten thousand did the children of Yehudah carry away alive, and brought them to the top of the rock, and cast them down from the top of the rock, so that they all were broken in pieces.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 12 other ten thousand did the children of yehudah carry away alive and brought them to the top of the rock and cast them down from the top of the rock so that they all were broken in pieces

search.text: But the men of the army whom Amaziah sent back, that they should not go with him to battle, fell on the cities of Yehudah, from Shomron even to Beit Horon, and struck of them three thousand, and took much spoil.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 13 but the men of the army whom amaziah sent back that they should not go with him to battle fell on the cities of yehudah from shomron even to beit horon and struck of them three thousand and took much spoil

search.text: Now it happened, after that Amaziah was come from the slaughter of the Edomites, that he brought the gods of the children of Seir, and set them up to be his gods, and bowed down himself before them, and burned incense to them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 14 now it happened after that amaziah was come from the slaughter of the edomites that he brought the gods of the children of seir and set them up to be his gods and bowed down himself before them and burned incense to them

search.text: Therefore the anger of YHWH was kindled against Amaziah, and he sent to him a prophet, who said to him, Why have you sought after the gods of the people, which have not delivered their own people out of your hand?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 15 therefore the anger of yhwh was kindled against amaziah and he sent to him a prophet who said to him why have you sought after the gods of the people which have not delivered their own people out of your hand

search.text: It happened, as he talked with him, that [the king] said to him, Have we made you of the king's counsel? Stop! Why should you be struck down? Then the prophet stopped, and said, I know that Elohim has determined to destroy you, because you have done this, and have not listened to my counsel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 16 it happened as he talked with him that the king said to him have we made you of the king s counsel stop why should you be struck down then the prophet stopped and said i know that elohim has determined to destroy you because you have done this and have not listened to my counsel

search.text: Then Amaziah king of Yehudah took advice, and sent to Yoash, the son of Jehoahaz the son of Yehu, king of Israel, saying, Come, let us look one another in the face.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 17 then amaziah king of yehudah took advice and sent to yoash the son of jehoahaz the son of yehu king of israel saying come let us look one another in the face

search.text: Yoash king of Israel sent to Amaziah king of Yehudah, saying, The thistle that was in Levanon sent to the cedar that was in Levanon, saying, Give your daughter to my son as wife: and there passed by a wild animal that was in Levanon, and trod down the thistle.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 18 yoash king of israel sent to amaziah king of yehudah saying the thistle that was in levanon sent to the cedar that was in levanon saying give your daughter to my son as wife and there passed by a wild animal that was in levanon and trod down the thistle

search.text: You say, Behold, you have struck Edom; and your heart lifts you up to boast: abide now at home; why should you meddle to [your] hurt, that you should fall, even you, and Yehudah with you?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 19 you say behold you have struck edom and your heart lifts you up to boast abide now at home why should you meddle to your hurt that you should fall even you and yehudah with you

search.text: But Amaziah would not hear; for it was of Elohim, that Elohim might deliver them into the hand [of their enemies], because they had sought after the gods of Edom.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 20 but amaziah would not hear for it was of elohim that elohim might deliver them into the hand of their enemies because they had sought after the gods of edom

search.text: So Yoash king of Israel went up; and he and Amaziah king of Yehudah looked one another in the face at Beit Shemesh, which belongs to Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 21 so yoash king of israel went up and he and amaziah king of yehudah looked one another in the face at beit shemesh which belongs to yehudah

search.text: Yehudah was put to the worse before Israel; and they fled everyone to their tent.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 22 yehudah was put to the worse before israel and they fled everyone to their tent

search.text: Yoash king of Israel took Amaziah king of Yehudah, the son of Yoash the son of Jehoahaz, at Beit Shemesh, and brought him to Yerushalayim, and broke down the wall of Yerushalayim from the gate of Efrayim to the corner gate, four hundred cubits.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 23 yoash king of israel took amaziah king of yehudah the son of yoash the son of jehoahaz at beit shemesh and brought him to yerushalayim and broke down the wall of yerushalayim from the gate of efrayim to the corner gate four hundred cubits

search.text: [He took] all the gold and silver, and all the vessels that were found in the house of Elohim with Oved-Edom, and the treasures of the king's house, the hostages also, and returned to Shomron.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 24 he took all the gold and silver and all the vessels that were found in the house of elohim with oved edom and the treasures of the king s house the hostages also and returned to shomron

search.text: Amaziah the son of Yoash king of Yehudah lived after the death of Yoash son of Jehoahaz king of Israel fifteen years.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 25 amaziah the son of yoash king of yehudah lived after the death of yoash son of jehoahaz king of israel fifteen years

search.text: Now the rest of the acts of Amaziah, first and last, behold, aren't they written in the book of the kings of Yehudah and Israel?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 26 now the rest of the acts of amaziah first and last behold aren t they written in the book of the kings of yehudah and israel

search.text: Now from the time that Amaziah did turn away from following YHWH they made a conspiracy against him in Yerushalayim; and he fled to Lachish: but they sent after him to Lachish, and killed him there.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 27 now from the time that amaziah did turn away from following yhwh they made a conspiracy against him in yerushalayim and he fled to lachish but they sent after him to lachish and killed him there

search.text: They brought him on horses, and buried him with his fathers in the city of Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 25 28 they brought him on horses and buried him with his fathers in the city of yehudah

search.text: All the people of Yehudah took Uzziyah, who was sixteen years old, and made him king in the room of his father Amaziah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 1 all the people of yehudah took uzziyah who was sixteen years old and made him king in the room of his father amaziah

search.text: He built Eloth, and restored it to Yehudah, after that the king slept with his fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 2 he built eloth and restored it to yehudah after that the king slept with his fathers

search.text: Sixteen years old was Uzziyah when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-two years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Jechiliah, of Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 3 sixteen years old was uzziyah when he began to reign and he reigned fifty two years in yerushalayim and his mother s name was jechiliah of yerushalayim

search.text: He did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH, according to all that his father Amaziah had done.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 4 he did that which was right in the eyes of yhwh according to all that his father amaziah had done

search.text: He set himself to seek Elohim in the days of Zekharyah, who had understanding in the vision of Elohim: and as long as he sought YHWH, Elohim made him to prosper.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 5 he set himself to seek elohim in the days of zekharyah who had understanding in the vision of elohim and as long as he sought yhwh elohim made him to prosper

search.text: He went forth and warred against the Philistines, and broke down the wall of Gath, and the wall of Jabneh, and the wall of Ashdod; and he built cities in [the country of] Ashdod, and among the Philistines.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 6 he went forth and warred against the philistines and broke down the wall of gath and the wall of jabneh and the wall of ashdod and he built cities in the country of ashdod and among the philistines

search.text: Elohim helped him against the Philistines, and against the Arabians who lived in Gur Baal, and the Meunim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 7 elohim helped him against the philistines and against the arabians who lived in gur baal and the meunim

search.text: The Ammonites gave tribute to Uzziyah: and his name spread abroad even to the entrance of Mitzrayim; for he grew exceeding strong.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 8 the ammonites gave tribute to uzziyah and his name spread abroad even to the entrance of mitzrayim for he grew exceeding strong

search.text: Moreover Uzziyah built towers in Yerushalayim at the corner gate, and at the valley gate, and at the turning [of the wall], and fortified them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 9 moreover uzziyah built towers in yerushalayim at the corner gate and at the valley gate and at the turning of the wall and fortified them

search.text: He built towers in the wilderness, and hewed out many cisterns, for he had much livestock; in the lowland also, and in the plain: [and he had] farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields; for he loved farming.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 10 he built towers in the wilderness and hewed out many cisterns for he had much livestock in the lowland also and in the plain and he had farmers and vineyard keepers in the mountains and in the fruitful fields for he loved farming

search.text: Moreover Uzziyah had an army of fighting men, who went out to war by bands, according to the number of their reckoning made by Jeiel the scribe and Maaseiah the officer, under the hand of Hananiah, one of the king's captains.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 11 moreover uzziyah had an army of fighting men who went out to war by bands according to the number of their reckoning made by jeiel the scribe and maaseiah the officer under the hand of hananiah one of the king s captains

search.text: The whole number of the heads of fathers' [houses], even the mighty men of valor, was two thousand and six hundred.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 12 the whole number of the heads of fathers houses even the mighty men of valor was two thousand and six hundred

search.text: Under their hand was an army, three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred, who made war with mighty power, to help the king against the enemy.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 13 under their hand was an army three hundred thousand and seven thousand and five hundred who made war with mighty power to help the king against the enemy

search.text: Uzziyah prepared for them, even for all the army, shields, and spears, and helmets, and coats of mail, and bows, and stones for slinging.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 14 uzziyah prepared for them even for all the army shields and spears and helmets and coats of mail and bows and stones for slinging

search.text: He made in Yerushalayim engines, invented by skillful men, to be on the towers and on the battlements, with which to shoot arrows and great stones. His name spread far abroad; for he was marvelously helped, until he was strong.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 15 he made in yerushalayim engines invented by skillful men to be on the towers and on the battlements with which to shoot arrows and great stones his name spread far abroad for he was marvelously helped until he was strong

search.text: But when he was strong, his heart was lifted up, so that he did corruptly, and he trespassed against YHWH his God; for he went into the temple of YHWH to burn incense on the altar of incense.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 16 but when he was strong his heart was lifted up so that he did corruptly and he trespassed against yhwh his god for he went into the temple of yhwh to burn incense on the altar of incense

search.text: Azaryah the priest went in after him, and with him eighty priests of YHWH, who were valiant men:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 17 azaryah the priest went in after him and with him eighty priests of yhwh who were valiant men

search.text: and they withstood Uzziyah the king, and said to him, It pertains not to you, Uzziyah, to burn incense to YHWH, but to the priests the sons of Aharon, who are consecrated to burn incense: go out of the sanctuary; for you have trespassed; neither shall it be for your honor from YHWH Elohim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 18 and they withstood uzziyah the king and said to him it pertains not to you uzziyah to burn incense to yhwh but to the priests the sons of aharon who are consecrated to burn incense go out of the sanctuary for you have trespassed neither shall it be for your honor from yhwh elohim

search.text: Then Uzziyah was angry; and he had a censer in his hand to burn incense; and while he was angry with the priests, the leprosy broke forth in his forehead before the priests in the house of YHWH, beside the altar of incense.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 19 then uzziyah was angry and he had a censer in his hand to burn incense and while he was angry with the priests the leprosy broke forth in his forehead before the priests in the house of yhwh beside the altar of incense

search.text: Azaryah the chief priest, and all the priests, looked on him, and behold, he was leprous in his forehead, and they thrust him out quickly from there; yes, himself hurried also to go out, because YHWH had struck him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 20 azaryah the chief priest and all the priests looked on him and behold he was leprous in his forehead and they thrust him out quickly from there yes himself hurried also to go out because yhwh had struck him

search.text: Uzziyah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the house of YHWH: and Yotam his son was over the king's house, judging the people of the land.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 21 uzziyah the king was a leper to the day of his death and lived in a separate house being a leper for he was cut off from the house of yhwh and yotam his son was over the king s house judging the people of the land

search.text: Now the rest of the acts of Uzziyah, first and last, did Yeshayahu the prophet, the son of Amoz, write.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 22 now the rest of the acts of uzziyah first and last did yeshayahu the prophet the son of amoz write

search.text: So Uzziyah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings; for they said, He is a leper: and Yotam his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 26 23 so uzziyah slept with his fathers and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings for they said he is a leper and yotam his son reigned in his place

search.text: Yotam was twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned sixteen years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Jerushah the daughter of Tzadok.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 27 1 yotam was twenty five years old when he began to reign and he reigned sixteen years in yerushalayim and his mother s name was jerushah the daughter of tzadok

search.text: He did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH, according to all that his father Uzziyah had done: however he didn't enter into the temple of YHWH. The people did yet corruptly.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 27 2 he did that which was right in the eyes of yhwh according to all that his father uzziyah had done however he didn t enter into the temple of yhwh the people did yet corruptly

search.text: He built the upper gate of the house of YHWH, and on the wall of Ophel he built much.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 27 3 he built the upper gate of the house of yhwh and on the wall of ophel he built much

search.text: Moreover he built cities in the hill country of Yehudah, and in the forests he built castles and towers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 27 4 moreover he built cities in the hill country of yehudah and in the forests he built castles and towers

search.text: He fought also with the king of the children of Ammon, and prevailed against them. The children of Ammon gave him the same year one hundred talents of silver, and ten thousand measures of wheat, and ten thousand of barley. So much did the children of Ammon render to him, in the second year also, and in the third.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 27 5 he fought also with the king of the children of ammon and prevailed against them the children of ammon gave him the same year one hundred talents of silver and ten thousand measures of wheat and ten thousand of barley so much did the children of ammon render to him in the second year also and in the third

search.text: So Yotam became mighty, because he ordered his ways before YHWH his God.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 27 6 so yotam became mighty because he ordered his ways before yhwh his god

search.text: Now the rest of the acts of Yotam, and all his wars, and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 27 7 now the rest of the acts of yotam and all his wars and his ways behold they are written in the book of the kings of israel and yehudah

search.text: He was five and twenty years old when he began to reign, and reigned sixteen years in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 27 8 he was five and twenty years old when he began to reign and reigned sixteen years in yerushalayim

search.text: Yotam slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city of Dawid: and Achaz his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 27 9 yotam slept with his fathers and they buried him in the city of dawid and achaz his son reigned in his place

search.text: Achaz was twenty years old when he began to reign; and he reigned sixteen years in Yerushalayim: and he didn't do that which was right in the eyes of YHWH, like Dawid his father;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 1 achaz was twenty years old when he began to reign and he reigned sixteen years in yerushalayim and he didn t do that which was right in the eyes of yhwh like dawid his father

search.text: but he walked in the ways of the kings of Israel, and made also molten images for the Baals.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 2 but he walked in the ways of the kings of israel and made also molten images for the baals

search.text: Moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of Hinnom, and burnt his children in the fire, according to the abominations of the nations whom YHWH cast out before the children of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 3 moreover he burnt incense in the valley of the son of hinnom and burnt his children in the fire according to the abominations of the nations whom yhwh cast out before the children of israel

search.text: He sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places, and on the hills, and under every green tree.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 4 he sacrificed and burnt incense in the high places and on the hills and under every green tree

search.text: Therefore YHWH his God delivered him into the hand of the king of Aram; and they struck him, and carried away of his a great multitude of captives, and brought them to Dammeseq. He was also delivered into the hand of the king of Israel, who struck him with a great slaughter.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 5 therefore yhwh his god delivered him into the hand of the king of aram and they struck him and carried away of his a great multitude of captives and brought them to dammeseq he was also delivered into the hand of the king of israel who struck him with a great slaughter

search.text: For Pekah the son of Remaliah killed in Yehudah one hundred twenty thousand in one day, all of them valiant men; because they had forsaken YHWH, the God of their fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 6 for pekah the son of remaliah killed in yehudah one hundred twenty thousand in one day all of them valiant men because they had forsaken yhwh the god of their fathers

search.text: Zichri, a mighty man of Efrayim, killed Maaseiah the king's son, and Azrikam the ruler of the house, and Elkanah who was next to the king.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 7 zichri a mighty man of efrayim killed maaseiah the king s son and azrikam the ruler of the house and elkanah who was next to the king

search.text: The children of Israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand, women, sons, and daughters, and took also away much spoil from them, and brought the spoil to Shomron.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 8 the children of israel carried away captive of their brothers two hundred thousand women sons and daughters and took also away much spoil from them and brought the spoil to shomron

search.text: But a prophet of YHWH was there, whose name was Oded: and he went out to meet the army that came to Shomron, and said to them, Behold, because YHWH, the God of your fathers, was angry with Yehudah, he has delivered them into your hand, and you have slain them in a rage which has reached up to heavens.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 9 but a prophet of yhwh was there whose name was oded and he went out to meet the army that came to shomron and said to them behold because yhwh the god of your fathers was angry with yehudah he has delivered them into your hand and you have slain them in a rage which has reached up to heavens

search.text: Now you purpose to keep under the children of Yehudah and Yerushalayim for bondservants and bondmaids to you: [but] aren't there even with you trespasses of your own against YHWH your God?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 10 now you purpose to keep under the children of yehudah and yerushalayim for bondservants and bondmaids to you but aren t there even with you trespasses of your own against yhwh your god

search.text: Now hear me therefore, and send back the captives, that you have taken captive of your brothers; for the fierce wrath of YHWH is on you.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 11 now hear me therefore and send back the captives that you have taken captive of your brothers for the fierce wrath of yhwh is on you

search.text: Then certain of the heads of the children of Efrayim, Azaryah the son of Johanan, Berechiah the son of Meshillemoth, and Jehizkiah the son of Shallum, and Amasa the son of Hadlai, stood up against those who came from the war,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 12 then certain of the heads of the children of efrayim azaryah the son of johanan berechiah the son of meshillemoth and jehizkiah the son of shallum and amasa the son of hadlai stood up against those who came from the war

search.text: and said to them, You shall not bring in the captives here: for you purpose that which will bring on us a trespass against YHWH, to add to our sins and to our trespass; for our trespass is great, and there is fierce wrath against Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 13 and said to them you shall not bring in the captives here for you purpose that which will bring on us a trespass against yhwh to add to our sins and to our trespass for our trespass is great and there is fierce wrath against israel

search.text: So the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the assembly.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 14 so the armed men left the captives and the spoil before the princes and all the assembly

search.text: The people who have been mentioned by name rose up, and took the captives, and with the spoil clothed all who were naked among them, and arrayed them, and shod them, and gave them to eat and to drink, and anointed them, and carried all the feeble of them on donkeys, and brought them to Yericho, the city of palm trees, to their brothers: then they returned to Shomron.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 15 the people who have been mentioned by name rose up and took the captives and with the spoil clothed all who were naked among them and arrayed them and shod them and gave them to eat and to drink and anointed them and carried all the feeble of them on donkeys and brought them to yericho the city of palm trees to their brothers then they returned to shomron

search.text: At that time did king Achaz send to the kings of Ashur to help him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 16 at that time did king achaz send to the kings of ashur to help him

search.text: For again the Edomites had come and struck Yehudah, and carried away captives.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 17 for again the edomites had come and struck yehudah and carried away captives

search.text: The Philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland, and of the South of Yehudah, and had taken Beit Shemesh, and Aijalon, and Gederoth, and Soco with the towns of it, and Timnah with the towns of it, Gimzo also and the towns of it: and they lived there.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 18 the philistines also had invaded the cities of the lowland and of the south of yehudah and had taken beit shemesh and aijalon and gederoth and soco with the towns of it and timnah with the towns of it gimzo also and the towns of it and they lived there

search.text: For YHWH brought Yehudah low because of Achaz king of Israel; for he had dealt wantonly in Yehudah, and trespassed severely against YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 19 for yhwh brought yehudah low because of achaz king of israel for he had dealt wantonly in yehudah and trespassed severely against yhwh

search.text: Tilgath Pilneser king of Ashur came to him, and distressed him, but didn't strengthen him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 20 tilgath pilneser king of ashur came to him and distressed him but didn t strengthen him

search.text: For Achaz took away a portion out of the house of YHWH, and out of the house of the king and of the princes, and gave it to the king of Ashur: but it didn't help him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 21 for achaz took away a portion out of the house of yhwh and out of the house of the king and of the princes and gave it to the king of ashur but it didn t help him

search.text: In the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against YHWH, this same king Achaz.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 22 in the time of his distress did he trespass yet more against yhwh this same king achaz

search.text: For he sacrificed to the gods of Dammeseq, which struck him; and he said, Because the gods of the kings of Aram helped them, [therefore] will I sacrifice to them, that they may help me. But they were the ruin of him, and of all Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 23 for he sacrificed to the gods of dammeseq which struck him and he said because the gods of the kings of aram helped them therefore will i sacrifice to them that they may help me but they were the ruin of him and of all israel

search.text: Achaz gathered together the vessels of the house of Elohim, and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of Elohim, and shut up the doors of the house of YHWH; and he made him altars in every corner of Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 24 achaz gathered together the vessels of the house of elohim and cut in pieces the vessels of the house of elohim and shut up the doors of the house of yhwh and he made him altars in every corner of yerushalayim

search.text: In every city of Yehudah he made high places to burn incense to other gods, and provoked to anger YHWH, the God of his fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 25 in every city of yehudah he made high places to burn incense to other gods and provoked to anger yhwh the god of his fathers

search.text: Now the rest of his acts, and all his ways, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Yehudah and Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 26 now the rest of his acts and all his ways first and last behold they are written in the book of the kings of yehudah and israel

search.text: Achaz slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the city, even in Yerushalayim; for they didn't bring him into the tombs of the kings of Israel: and Chizkiyahu his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 28 27 achaz slept with his fathers and they buried him in the city even in yerushalayim for they didn t bring him into the tombs of the kings of israel and chizkiyahu his son reigned in his place

search.text: Chizkiyahu began to reign when he was twenty-five years old; and he reigned twenty-nine years in Yerushalayim: and his mother's name was Aviyah, the daughter of Zekharyah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 1 chizkiyahu began to reign when he was twenty five years old and he reigned twenty nine years in yerushalayim and his mother s name was aviyah the daughter of zekharyah

search.text: He did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH, according to all that Dawid his father had done.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 2 he did that which was right in the eyes of yhwh according to all that dawid his father had done

search.text: He in the first year of his reign, in the first month, opened the doors of the house of YHWH, and repaired them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 3 he in the first year of his reign in the first month opened the doors of the house of yhwh and repaired them

search.text: He brought in the priests and the Levites, and gathered them together into the broad place on the east,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 4 he brought in the priests and the levites and gathered them together into the broad place on the east

search.text: and said to them, Hear me, you Levites; now sanctify yourselves, and sanctify the house of YHWH, the God of your fathers, and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 5 and said to them hear me you levites now sanctify yourselves and sanctify the house of yhwh the god of your fathers and carry forth the filthiness out of the holy place

search.text: For our fathers have trespassed, and done what was broken in the sight of YHWH our God, and have forsaken him, and have turned away their faces from the habitation of YHWH, and turned their backs.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 6 for our fathers have trespassed and done what was broken in the sight of yhwh our god and have forsaken him and have turned away their faces from the habitation of yhwh and turned their backs

search.text: Also they have shut up the doors of the porch, and put out the lamps, and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the God of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 7 also they have shut up the doors of the porch and put out the lamps and have not burned incense nor offered burnt offerings in the holy place to the god of israel

search.text: Therefore the wrath of YHWH was on Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth, to be an astonishment, and a hissing, as you see with your eyes.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 8 therefore the wrath of yhwh was on yehudah and yerushalayim and he has delivered them to be tossed back and forth to be an astonishment and a hissing as you see with your eyes

search.text: For, behold, our fathers have fallen by the sword, and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 9 for behold our fathers have fallen by the sword and our sons and our daughters and our wives are in captivity for this

search.text: Now it is in my heart to make a covenant with YHWH, the God of Israel, that YHWH’s fierce anger may turn away from us.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 10 now it is in my heart to make a covenant with yhwh the god of israel that yhwh s fierce anger may turn away from us

search.text: My sons, don't be negligent now; for YHWH has chosen you to stand before him, to minister to him, and that you should be his ministers, and burn incense.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 11 my sons don t be negligent now for yhwh has chosen you to stand before him to minister to him and that you should be his ministers and burn incense

search.text: Then the Levites arose, Mahath, the son of Amasai, and Joel the son of Azaryah, of the sons of the Kohathites; and of the sons of Merari, Kish the son of Abdi, and Azaryah the son of Jehallelel; and of the Gershonites, Joah the son of Zimmah, and Eden the son of Joah;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 12 then the levites arose mahath the son of amasai and joel the son of azaryah of the sons of the kohathites and of the sons of merari kish the son of abdi and azaryah the son of jehallelel and of the gershonites joah the son of zimmah and eden the son of joah

search.text: and of the sons of Elizaphan, Shimri and Jeuel; and of the sons of Asaph, Zekharyah and Mattaniah;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 13 and of the sons of elizaphan shimri and jeuel and of the sons of asaph zekharyah and mattaniah

search.text: and of the sons of Heman, Jehuel and Shimei; and of the sons of Jeduthun, Shemaiah and Uzziel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 14 and of the sons of heman jehuel and shimei and of the sons of jeduthun shemaiah and uzziel

search.text: They gathered their brothers, and sanctified themselves, and went in, according to the commandment of the king by the words of YHWH, to cleanse the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 15 they gathered their brothers and sanctified themselves and went in according to the commandment of the king by the words of yhwh to cleanse the house of yhwh

search.text: The priests went in to the inner part of the house of YHWH, to cleanse it, and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of YHWH into the court of the house of YHWH. The Levites took it, to carry it out abroad to the brook Kidron.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 16 the priests went in to the inner part of the house of yhwh to cleanse it and brought out all the uncleanness that they found in the temple of yhwh into the court of the house of yhwh the levites took it to carry it out abroad to the brook kidron

search.text: Now they began on the first [day] of the first month to sanctify, and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of YHWH; and they sanctified the house of YHWH in eight days: and on the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 17 now they began on the first day of the first month to sanctify and on the eighth day of the month came they to the porch of yhwh and they sanctified the house of yhwh in eight days and on the sixteenth day of the first month they made an end

search.text: Then they went in to Chizkiyahu the king within [the palace], and said, We have cleansed all the house of YHWH, and the altar of burnt offering, with all the vessels of it, and the table of show bread, with all the vessels of it.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 18 then they went in to chizkiyahu the king within the palace and said we have cleansed all the house of yhwh and the altar of burnt offering with all the vessels of it and the table of show bread with all the vessels of it

search.text: Moreover all the vessels, which king Achaz in his reign did cast away when he trespassed, have we prepared and sanctified; and behold, they are before the altar of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 19 moreover all the vessels which king achaz in his reign did cast away when he trespassed have we prepared and sanctified and behold they are before the altar of yhwh

search.text: Then Chizkiyahu the king arose early, and gathered the princes of the city, and went up to the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 20 then chizkiyahu the king arose early and gathered the princes of the city and went up to the house of yhwh

search.text: They brought seven bulls, and seven rams, and seven lambs, and seven male goats, for a sin offering for the kingdom and for the sanctuary and for Yehudah. He commanded the priests the sons of Aharon to offer them on the altar of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 21 they brought seven bulls and seven rams and seven lambs and seven male goats for a sin offering for the kingdom and for the sanctuary and for yehudah he commanded the priests the sons of aharon to offer them on the altar of yhwh

search.text: So they killed the bulls, and the priests received the blood, and sprinkled it on the altar: and they killed the rams, and sprinkled the blood on the altar: they killed also the lambs, and sprinkled the blood on the altar.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 22 so they killed the bulls and the priests received the blood and sprinkled it on the altar and they killed the rams and sprinkled the blood on the altar they killed also the lambs and sprinkled the blood on the altar

search.text: They brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly; and they laid their hands on them:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 23 they brought near the male goats for the sin offering before the king and the assembly and they laid their hands on them

search.text: and the priests killed them, and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar, to make atonement for all Israel; for the king commanded [that] the burnt offering and the sin offering [should be made] for all Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 24 and the priests killed them and they made a sin offering with their blood on the altar to make atonement for all israel for the king commanded that the burnt offering and the sin offering should be made for all israel

search.text: He set the Levites in the house of YHWH with cymbals, with stringed instruments, and with harps, according to the commandment of Dawid, and of Gad the king's seer, and Natan the prophet; for the commandment was of YHWH by YHWH’s prophets.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 25 he set the levites in the house of yhwh with cymbals with stringed instruments and with harps according to the commandment of dawid and of gad the king s seer and natan the prophet for the commandment was of yhwh by yhwh s prophets

search.text: The Levites stood with the instruments of Dawid, and the priests with the trumpets.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 26 the levites stood with the instruments of dawid and the priests with the trumpets

search.text: Chizkiyahu commanded to offer the burnt offering on the altar. When the burnt offering began, the song of YHWH began also, and the trumpets, together with the instruments of Dawid king of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 27 chizkiyahu commanded to offer the burnt offering on the altar when the burnt offering began the song of yhwh began also and the trumpets together with the instruments of dawid king of israel

search.text: All the assembly worshiped, and the singers sang, and the trumpeters sounded; all this [continued] until the burnt offering was finished.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 28 all the assembly worshiped and the singers sang and the trumpeters sounded all this continued until the burnt offering was finished

search.text: When they had made an end of offering, the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 29 when they had made an end of offering the king and all who were present with him bowed themselves and worshiped

search.text: Moreover Chizkiyahu the king and the princes commanded the Levites to sing praises to YHWH with the words of Dawid, and of Asaph the seer. They sang praises with gladness, and they bowed their heads and worshiped.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 30 moreover chizkiyahu the king and the princes commanded the levites to sing praises to yhwh with the words of dawid and of asaph the seer they sang praises with gladness and they bowed their heads and worshiped

search.text: Then Chizkiyahu answered, Now you have consecrated yourselves to YHWH; come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of YHWH. The assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings; and as many as were of a willing heart [brought] burnt offerings.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 31 then chizkiyahu answered now you have consecrated yourselves to yhwh come near and bring sacrifices and thank offerings into the house of yhwh the assembly brought in sacrifices and thank offerings and as many as were of a willing heart brought burnt offerings

search.text: The number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls, one hundred rams, and two hundred lambs: all these were for a burnt offering to YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 32 the number of the burnt offerings which the assembly brought was seventy bulls one hundred rams and two hundred lambs all these were for a burnt offering to yhwh

search.text: The consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 33 the consecrated things were six hundred oxen and three thousand sheep

search.text: But the priests were too few, so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings: therefore their brothers the Levites helped them, until the work was ended, and until the priests had sanctified themselves; for the Levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests.
