search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 34 but the priests were too few so that they could not flay all the burnt offerings therefore their brothers the levites helped them until the work was ended and until the priests had sanctified themselves for the levites were more upright in heart to sanctify themselves than the priests

search.text: Also the burnt offerings were in abundance, with the fat of the peace offerings, and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering. So the service of the house of YHWH was set in order.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 35 also the burnt offerings were in abundance with the fat of the peace offerings and with the drink offerings for every burnt offering so the service of the house of yhwh was set in order

search.text: Chizkiyahu rejoiced, and all the people, because of that which Elohim had prepared for the people: for the thing was done suddenly.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 29 36 chizkiyahu rejoiced and all the people because of that which elohim had prepared for the people for the thing was done suddenly

search.text: Chizkiyahu sent to all Israel and Yehudah, and wrote letters also to Efrayim and Menashe, that they should come to the house of YHWH at Yerushalayim, to keep the Passover to YHWH, the God of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 1 chizkiyahu sent to all israel and yehudah and wrote letters also to efrayim and menashe that they should come to the house of yhwh at yerushalayim to keep the passover to yhwh the god of israel

search.text: For the king had taken counsel, and his princes, and all the assembly in Yerushalayim, to keep the Passover in the second month.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 2 for the king had taken counsel and his princes and all the assembly in yerushalayim to keep the passover in the second month

search.text: For they could not keep it at that time, because the priests had not sanctified themselves in sufficient number, neither had the people gathered themselves together to Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 3 for they could not keep it at that time because the priests had not sanctified themselves in sufficient number neither had the people gathered themselves together to yerushalayim

search.text: The thing was right in the eyes of the king and of all the assembly.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 4 the thing was right in the eyes of the king and of all the assembly

search.text: So they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all Israel, from Be'er Sheva even to Dan, that they should come to keep the Passover to YHWH, the God of Israel, at Yerushalayim: for they had not kept it in great numbers in such sort as it is written.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 5 so they established a decree to make proclamation throughout all israel from be er sheva even to dan that they should come to keep the passover to yhwh the god of israel at yerushalayim for they had not kept it in great numbers in such sort as it is written

search.text: So the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all Israel and Yehudah, and according to the commandment of the king, saying, You children of Israel, turn again to YHWH, the God of Avraham, Yitzhak, and Israel, that he may return to the remnant that have escaped of you out of the hand of the kings of Ashur.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 6 so the posts went with the letters from the king and his princes throughout all israel and yehudah and according to the commandment of the king saying you children of israel turn again to yhwh the god of avraham yitzhak and israel that he may return to the remnant that have escaped of you out of the hand of the kings of ashur

search.text: Don't be you like your fathers, and like your brothers, who trespassed against YHWH, the God of their fathers, so that YHWH gave them up to desolation, as you see.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 7 don t be you like your fathers and like your brothers who trespassed against yhwh the god of their fathers so that yhwh gave them up to desolation as you see

search.text: Now don't you be stiff-necked, as your fathers were; but yield yourselves to YHWH, and enter into YHWH’s sanctuary, which YHWH has sanctified forever, and serve YHWH your God, that YHWH’s fierce anger may turn away from you.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 8 now don t you be stiff necked as your fathers were but yield yourselves to yhwh and enter into yhwh s sanctuary which yhwh has sanctified forever and serve yhwh your god that yhwh s fierce anger may turn away from you

search.text: For if you turn again to YHWH, your brothers and your children shall find compassion before those who led them captive, and shall come again into this land: for YHWH your God is gracious and merciful, and will not turn away YHWH’s face from you, if you return to YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 9 for if you turn again to yhwh your brothers and your children shall find compassion before those who led them captive and shall come again into this land for yhwh your god is gracious and merciful and will not turn away yhwh s face from you if you return to yhwh

search.text: So the posts passed from city to city through the country of Efrayim and Menashe, even to Zevulun: but they ridiculed them, and mocked them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 10 so the posts passed from city to city through the country of efrayim and menashe even to zevulun but they ridiculed them and mocked them

search.text: Nevertheless certain men of Asher and Menashe and of Zevulun humbled themselves, and came to Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 11 nevertheless certain men of asher and menashe and of zevulun humbled themselves and came to yerushalayim

search.text: Also on Yehudah came the hand of Elohim to give them one heart, to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by the word of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 12 also on yehudah came the hand of elohim to give them one heart to do the commandment of the king and of the princes by the word of yhwh

search.text: There assembled at Yerushalayim much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month, a very great assembly.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 13 there assembled at yerushalayim much people to keep the feast of unleavened bread in the second month a very great assembly

search.text: They arose and took away the altars that were in Yerushalayim, and all the altars for incense took they away, and cast them into the brook Kidron.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 14 they arose and took away the altars that were in yerushalayim and all the altars for incense took they away and cast them into the brook kidron

search.text: Then they killed the Passover on the fourteenth [day] of the second month: and the priests and the Levites were ashamed, and sanctified themselves, and brought burnt offerings into the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 15 then they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the second month and the priests and the levites were ashamed and sanctified themselves and brought burnt offerings into the house of yhwh

search.text: They stood in their place after their order, according to the law of Moshe the person of Elohim: the priests sprinkled the blood [which they received] of the hand of the Levites.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 16 they stood in their place after their order according to the law of moshe the person of elohim the priests sprinkled the blood which they received of the hand of the levites

search.text: For there were many in the assembly who had not sanctified themselves: therefore the Levites had the charge of killing the Passovers for everyone who was not clean, to sanctify them to YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 17 for there were many in the assembly who had not sanctified themselves therefore the levites had the charge of killing the passovers for everyone who was not clean to sanctify them to yhwh

search.text: For a multitude of the people, even many of Efrayim and Menashe, Yissakhar and Zevulun, had not cleansed themselves, yet did they eat the Passover otherwise than it is written. For Chizkiyahu had prayed for them, saying, The good YHWH pardon everyone
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 18 for a multitude of the people even many of efrayim and menashe yissakhar and zevulun had not cleansed themselves yet did they eat the passover otherwise than it is written for chizkiyahu had prayed for them saying the good yhwh pardon everyone

search.text: who sets his heart to seek Elohim, YHWH, the God of his fathers, though not [cleansed] according to the purification of the sanctuary.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 19 who sets his heart to seek elohim yhwh the god of his fathers though not cleansed according to the purification of the sanctuary

search.text: YHWH listened to Chizkiyahu, and healed the people.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 20 yhwh listened to chizkiyahu and healed the people

search.text: The children of Israel who were present at Yerushalayim kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness; and the Levites and the priests praised YHWH day by day, [singing] with loud instruments to YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 21 the children of israel who were present at yerushalayim kept the feast of unleavened bread seven days with great gladness and the levites and the priests praised yhwh day by day singing with loud instruments to yhwh

search.text: Chizkiyahu spoke comfortably to all the Levites who had good understanding [in the service] of YHWH. So they ate throughout the feast for the seven days, offering sacrifices of peace offerings, and making confession to YHWH, the God of their fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 22 chizkiyahu spoke comfortably to all the levites who had good understanding in the service of yhwh so they ate throughout the feast for the seven days offering sacrifices of peace offerings and making confession to yhwh the god of their fathers

search.text: The whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days; and they kept [other] seven days with gladness.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 23 the whole assembly took counsel to keep other seven days and they kept other seven days with gladness

search.text: For Chizkiyahu king of Yehudah did give to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep; and the princes gave to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep: and a great number of priests sanctified themselves.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 24 for chizkiyahu king of yehudah did give to the assembly for offerings one thousand bulls and seven thousand sheep and the princes gave to the assembly a thousand bulls and ten thousand sheep and a great number of priests sanctified themselves

search.text: All the assembly of Yehudah, with the priests and the Levites, and all the assembly who came out of Israel, and the foreigners who came out of the land of Israel, and who lived in Yehudah, rejoiced.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 25 all the assembly of yehudah with the priests and the levites and all the assembly who came out of israel and the foreigners who came out of the land of israel and who lived in yehudah rejoiced

search.text: So there was great joy in Yerushalayim; for since the time of Shlomo the son of Dawid king of Israel there was not the like in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 26 so there was great joy in yerushalayim for since the time of shlomo the son of dawid king of israel there was not the like in yerushalayim

search.text: Then the priests the Levites arose and blessed the people: and their voice was heard, and their prayer came up to his holy habitation, even to heavens.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 30 27 then the priests the levites arose and blessed the people and their voice was heard and their prayer came up to his holy habitation even to heavens

search.text: Now when all this was finished, all Israel who were present went out to the cities of Yehudah, and broke in pieces the pillars, and hewed down the Asherim, and broke down the high places and the altars out of all Yehudah and Binyamin, in Efrayim also and Menashe, until they had destroyed them all. Then all the children of Israel returned, everyone to their possession, into their own cities.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 1 now when all this was finished all israel who were present went out to the cities of yehudah and broke in pieces the pillars and hewed down the asherim and broke down the high places and the altars out of all yehudah and binyamin in efrayim also and menashe until they had destroyed them all then all the children of israel returned everyone to their possession into their own cities

search.text: Chizkiyahu appointed the divisions of the priests and the Levites after their divisions, everyone according to their service, both the priests and the Levites, for burnt offerings and for peace offerings, to minister, and to give thanks, and to praise in the gates of the camp of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 2 chizkiyahu appointed the divisions of the priests and the levites after their divisions everyone according to their service both the priests and the levites for burnt offerings and for peace offerings to minister and to give thanks and to praise in the gates of the camp of yhwh

search.text: [He appointed] also the king's portion of his substance for the burnt offerings, [to wit], for the morning and evening burnt offerings, and the burnt offerings for the Sabbaths, and for the new moons, and for the set feasts, as it is written in the law of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 3 he appointed also the king s portion of his substance for the burnt offerings to wit for the morning and evening burnt offerings and the burnt offerings for the sabbaths and for the new moons and for the set feasts as it is written in the law of yhwh

search.text: Moreover he commanded the people who lived in Yerushalayim to give the portion of the priests and the Levites, that they might give themselves to the law of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 4 moreover he commanded the people who lived in yerushalayim to give the portion of the priests and the levites that they might give themselves to the law of yhwh

search.text: As soon as the commandment came abroad, the children of Israel gave in abundance the first fruits of grain, new wine, and oil, and honey, and of all the increase of the field; and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 5 as soon as the commandment came abroad the children of israel gave in abundance the first fruits of grain new wine and oil and honey and of all the increase of the field and the tithe of all things brought they in abundantly

search.text: The children of Israel and Yehudah, who lived in the cities of Yehudah, they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep, and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated to YHWH their God, and laid them by heaps.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 6 the children of israel and yehudah who lived in the cities of yehudah they also brought in the tithe of oxen and sheep and the tithe of dedicated things which were consecrated to yhwh their god and laid them by heaps

search.text: In the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps, and finished them in the seventh month.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 7 in the third month they began to lay the foundation of the heaps and finished them in the seventh month

search.text: When Chizkiyahu and the princes came and saw the heaps, they blessed YHWH, and YHWH’s people Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 8 when chizkiyahu and the princes came and saw the heaps they blessed yhwh and yhwh s people israel

search.text: Then Chizkiyahu questioned the priests and the Levites concerning the heaps.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 9 then chizkiyahu questioned the priests and the levites concerning the heaps

search.text: Azaryah the chief priest, of the house of Tzadok, answered him and said, Since [the people] began to bring the offerings into the house of YHWH, we have eaten and had enough, and have left plenty: for YHWH has blessed YHWH’s people; and that which is left is this great store.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 10 azaryah the chief priest of the house of tzadok answered him and said since the people began to bring the offerings into the house of yhwh we have eaten and had enough and have left plenty for yhwh has blessed yhwh s people and that which is left is this great store

search.text: Then Chizkiyahu commanded to prepare chambers in the house of YHWH; and they prepared them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 11 then chizkiyahu commanded to prepare chambers in the house of yhwh and they prepared them

search.text: They brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully: and over them Conaniah the Levite was ruler, and Shimei his brother was second.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 12 they brought in the offerings and the tithes and the dedicated things faithfully and over them conaniah the levite was ruler and shimei his brother was second

search.text: Jehiel, and Azaziah, and Nahath, and Asahel, and Jerimoth, and Jozabad, and Eliel, and Ismachiah, and Mahath, and Benayahu, were overseers under the hand of Conaniah and Shimei his brother, by the appointment of Chizkiyahu the king, and Azaryah the ruler of the house of Elohim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 13 jehiel and azaziah and nahath and asahel and jerimoth and jozabad and eliel and ismachiah and mahath and benayahu were overseers under the hand of conaniah and shimei his brother by the appointment of chizkiyahu the king and azaryah the ruler of the house of elohim

search.text: Kore the son of Imnah the Levite, the porter at the east [gate], was over the freewill offerings of Elohim, to distribute the offerings of YHWH, and the most holy things.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 14 kore the son of imnah the levite the porter at the east gate was over the freewill offerings of elohim to distribute the offerings of yhwh and the most holy things

search.text: Under him were Eden, and Miniamin, and Jeshua, and Shemaiah, Amariah, and Shecaniah, in the cities of the priests, in their office of trust, to give to their brothers by divisions, as well to the great as to the small:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 15 under him were eden and miniamin and jeshua and shemaiah amariah and shecaniah in the cities of the priests in their office of trust to give to their brothers by divisions as well to the great as to the small

search.text: besides those who were reckoned by genealogy of males, from three years old and upward, even everyone who entered into the house of YHWH, as the duty of every day required, for their service in their offices according to their divisions;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 16 besides those who were reckoned by genealogy of males from three years old and upward even everyone who entered into the house of yhwh as the duty of every day required for their service in their offices according to their divisions

search.text: and those who were reckoned by genealogy of the priests by their fathers' houses, and the Levites from twenty years old and upward, in their offices by their divisions;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 17 and those who were reckoned by genealogy of the priests by their fathers houses and the levites from twenty years old and upward in their offices by their divisions

search.text: and those who were reckoned by genealogy of all their little ones, their wives, and their sons, and their daughters, through all the congregation: for in their office of trust they sanctified themselves in holiness.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 18 and those who were reckoned by genealogy of all their little ones their wives and their sons and their daughters through all the congregation for in their office of trust they sanctified themselves in holiness

search.text: Also for the sons of Aharon the priests, who were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities, in every city, there were people who were mentioned by name, to give portions to all the males among the priests, and to all who were reckoned by genealogy among the Levites.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 19 also for the sons of aharon the priests who were in the fields of the suburbs of their cities in every city there were people who were mentioned by name to give portions to all the males among the priests and to all who were reckoned by genealogy among the levites

search.text: Thus did Chizkiyahu throughout all Yehudah; and he worked that which was good and right and faithful before YHWH his God.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 20 thus did chizkiyahu throughout all yehudah and he worked that which was good and right and faithful before yhwh his god

search.text: In every work that he began in the service of the house of Elohim, and in the law, and in the commandments, to seek his God, he did it with all his heart, and prospered.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 31 21 in every work that he began in the service of the house of elohim and in the law and in the commandments to seek his god he did it with all his heart and prospered

search.text: After these things, and this faithfulness, Sennacherib king of Ashur came, and entered into Yehudah, and encamped against the fortified cities, and thought to win them for himself.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 1 after these things and this faithfulness sennacherib king of ashur came and entered into yehudah and encamped against the fortified cities and thought to win them for himself

search.text: When Chizkiyahu saw that Sennacherib was come, and that he was purposed to fight against Yerushalayim,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 2 when chizkiyahu saw that sennacherib was come and that he was purposed to fight against yerushalayim

search.text: he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the springs which were outside of the city; and they helped him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 3 he took counsel with his princes and his mighty men to stop the waters of the springs which were outside of the city and they helped him

search.text: So there was gathered much people together, and they stopped all the springs, and the brook that flowed through the midst of the land, saying, Why should the kings of Ashur come, and find much water?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 4 so there was gathered much people together and they stopped all the springs and the brook that flowed through the midst of the land saying why should the kings of ashur come and find much water

search.text: He took courage, and built up all the wall that was broken down, and raised [it] up to the towers, and the other wall outside, and strengthened Millo [in] the city of Dawid, and made weapons and shields in abundance.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 5 he took courage and built up all the wall that was broken down and raised it up to the towers and the other wall outside and strengthened millo in the city of dawid and made weapons and shields in abundance

search.text: He set captains of war over the people, and gathered them together to him in the broad place at the gate of the city, and spoke comfortably to them, saying,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 6 he set captains of war over the people and gathered them together to him in the broad place at the gate of the city and spoke comfortably to them saying

search.text: Be strong and of good courage, don't be afraid nor dismayed for the king of Ashur, nor for all the multitude who is with him; for there is a greater with us than with him:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 7 be strong and of good courage don t be afraid nor dismayed for the king of ashur nor for all the multitude who is with him for there is a greater with us than with him

search.text: with him is an arm of flesh; but with us is YHWH our God to help us, and to fight our battles. The people rested themselves on the words of Chizkiyahu king of Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 8 with him is an arm of flesh but with us is yhwh our god to help us and to fight our battles the people rested themselves on the words of chizkiyahu king of yehudah

search.text: After this did Sennacherib king of Ashur send his servants to Yerushalayim, (now he was before Lachish, and all his power with him), to Chizkiyahu king of Yehudah, and to all Yehudah who were at Yerushalayim, saying,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 9 after this did sennacherib king of ashur send his servants to yerushalayim now he was before lachish and all his power with him to chizkiyahu king of yehudah and to all yehudah who were at yerushalayim saying

search.text: Thus says Sennacherib king of Ashur, Whereon do you trust, that you abide the siege in Yerushalayim?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 10 thus says sennacherib king of ashur whereon do you trust that you abide the siege in yerushalayim

search.text: Does not Chizkiyahu persuade you, to give you over to die by famine and by thirst, saying, YHWH our God will deliver us out of the hand of the king of Ashur?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 11 does not chizkiyahu persuade you to give you over to die by famine and by thirst saying yhwh our god will deliver us out of the hand of the king of ashur

search.text: Has not the same Chizkiyahu taken away his high places and his altars, and commanded Yehudah and Yerushalayim, saying, You shall worship before one altar, and on it shall you burn incense?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 12 has not the same chizkiyahu taken away his high places and his altars and commanded yehudah and yerushalayim saying you shall worship before one altar and on it shall you burn incense

search.text: Don't you know what I and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands? Were the gods of the nations of the lands in any wise able to deliver their land out of my hand?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 13 don t you know what i and my fathers have done to all the peoples of the lands were the gods of the nations of the lands in any wise able to deliver their land out of my hand

search.text: Who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed, that could deliver his people out of my hand, that your God should be able to deliver you out of my hand?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 14 who was there among all the gods of those nations which my fathers utterly destroyed that could deliver his people out of my hand that your god should be able to deliver you out of my hand

search.text: Now therefore don't let Chizkiyahu deceive you, nor persuade you after this manner, neither believe you him; for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand, and out of the hand of my fathers: how much less shall your God deliver you out of my hand?
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 15 now therefore don t let chizkiyahu deceive you nor persuade you after this manner neither believe you him for no god of any nation or kingdom was able to deliver his people out of my hand and out of the hand of my fathers how much less shall your god deliver you out of my hand

search.text: His servants spoke yet more against YHWH Elohim, and against YHWH’s servant Chizkiyahu.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 16 his servants spoke yet more against yhwh elohim and against yhwh s servant chizkiyahu

search.text: He wrote also letters, to rail on YHWH, the God of Israel, and to speak against YHWH, saying, As the gods of the nations of the lands, which have not delivered their people out of my hand, so shall the God of Chizkiyahu not deliver YHWH’s people out of my hand.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 17 he wrote also letters to rail on yhwh the god of israel and to speak against yhwh saying as the gods of the nations of the lands which have not delivered their people out of my hand so shall the god of chizkiyahu not deliver yhwh s people out of my hand

search.text: They cried with a loud voice in the Jews' language to the people of Yerushalayim who were on the wall, to frighten them, and to trouble them; that they might take the city.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 18 they cried with a loud voice in the jews language to the people of yerushalayim who were on the wall to frighten them and to trouble them that they might take the city

search.text: They spoke of the God of Yerushalayim, as of the gods of the peoples of the earth, which are the work of people's hands.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 19 they spoke of the god of yerushalayim as of the gods of the peoples of the earth which are the work of people s hands

search.text: Chizkiyahu the king, and Yeshayahu the prophet the son of Amoz, prayed because of this, and cried to heavens.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 20 chizkiyahu the king and yeshayahu the prophet the son of amoz prayed because of this and cried to heavens

search.text: YHWH sent an angel, who cut off all the mighty men of valor, and the leaders and captains, in the camp of the king of Ashur. So he returned with shame of face to his own land. When he was come into the house of his god, those who came forth from his own bowels killed him there with the sword.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 21 yhwh sent an angel who cut off all the mighty men of valor and the leaders and captains in the camp of the king of ashur so he returned with shame of face to his own land when he was come into the house of his god those who came forth from his own bowels killed him there with the sword

search.text: Thus YHWH saved Chizkiyahu and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim from the hand of Sennacherib the king of Ashur, and from the hand of all [others], and guided them on every side.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 22 thus yhwh saved chizkiyahu and the inhabitants of yerushalayim from the hand of sennacherib the king of ashur and from the hand of all others and guided them on every side

search.text: Many brought gifts to YHWH to Yerushalayim, and precious things to Chizkiyahu king of Yehudah; so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations from thenceforth.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 23 many brought gifts to yhwh to yerushalayim and precious things to chizkiyahu king of yehudah so that he was exalted in the sight of all nations from thenceforth

search.text: In those days Chizkiyahu was sick even to death: and he prayed to YHWH; and he spoke to him, and gave him a sign.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 24 in those days chizkiyahu was sick even to death and he prayed to yhwh and he spoke to him and gave him a sign

search.text: But Chizkiyahu didn't render again according to the benefit done to him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath on him, and on Yehudah and Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 25 but chizkiyahu didn t render again according to the benefit done to him for his heart was lifted up therefore there was wrath on him and on yehudah and yerushalayim

search.text: Notwithstanding Chizkiyahu humbled himself for the pride of his heart, both he and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, so that the wrath of YHWH didn't come on them in the days of Chizkiyahu.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 26 notwithstanding chizkiyahu humbled himself for the pride of his heart both he and the inhabitants of yerushalayim so that the wrath of yhwh didn t come on them in the days of chizkiyahu

search.text: Chizkiyahu had exceeding much riches and honor: and he provided him treasuries for silver, and for gold, and for precious stones, and for spices, and for shields, and for all manner of goodly vessels;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 27 chizkiyahu had exceeding much riches and honor and he provided him treasuries for silver and for gold and for precious stones and for spices and for shields and for all manner of goodly vessels

search.text: storehouses also for the increase of grain and new wine and oil; and stalls for all manner of animals, and flocks in folds.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 28 storehouses also for the increase of grain and new wine and oil and stalls for all manner of animals and flocks in folds

search.text: Moreover he provided him cities, and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance; for Elohim had given him very much substance.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 29 moreover he provided him cities and possessions of flocks and herds in abundance for elohim had given him very much substance

search.text: This same Chizkiyahu also stopped the upper spring of the waters of Gihon, and brought them straight down on the west side of the city of Dawid. Chizkiyahu prospered in all his works.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 30 this same chizkiyahu also stopped the upper spring of the waters of gihon and brought them straight down on the west side of the city of dawid chizkiyahu prospered in all his works

search.text: However in [the business of] the ambassadors of the princes of Bavel, who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land, Elohim left him, to try him, that he might know all that was in his heart.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 31 however in the business of the ambassadors of the princes of bavel who sent to him to inquire of the wonder that was done in the land elohim left him to try him that he might know all that was in his heart

search.text: Now the rest of the acts of Chizkiyahu, and his good deeds, behold, they are written in the vision of Yeshayahu the prophet the son of Amoz, in the book of the kings of Yehudah and Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 32 now the rest of the acts of chizkiyahu and his good deeds behold they are written in the vision of yeshayahu the prophet the son of amoz in the book of the kings of yehudah and israel

search.text: Chizkiyahu slept with his fathers, and they buried him in the ascent of the tombs of the sons of Dawid: and all Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim did him honor at his death. Menashe his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 32 33 chizkiyahu slept with his fathers and they buried him in the ascent of the tombs of the sons of dawid and all yehudah and the inhabitants of yerushalayim did him honor at his death menashe his son reigned in his place

search.text: Menashe was twelve years old when he began to reign; and he reigned fifty-five years in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 1 menashe was twelve years old when he began to reign and he reigned fifty five years in yerushalayim

search.text: He did what was broken in the sight of YHWH, after the abominations of the nations whom YHWH cast out before the children of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 2 he did what was broken in the sight of yhwh after the abominations of the nations whom yhwh cast out before the children of israel

search.text: For he built again the high places which Chizkiyahu his father had broken down; and he reared up altars for the Baals, and made Asheroth, and worshiped all the army of the heavens, and served them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 3 for he built again the high places which chizkiyahu his father had broken down and he reared up altars for the baals and made asheroth and worshiped all the army of the heavens and served them

search.text: He built altars in the house of YHWH, of which YHWH said, In Yerushalayim shall my name be forever.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 4 he built altars in the house of yhwh of which yhwh said in yerushalayim shall my name be forever

search.text: He built altars for all the army of the heavens in the two courts of the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 5 he built altars for all the army of the heavens in the two courts of the house of yhwh

search.text: He also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of Hinnom; and he practiced sorcery, and used enchantments, and practiced sorcery, and dealt with those who had familiar spirits, and with wizards: he did much wrong in the sight of YHWH, to provoke YHWH to anger.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 6 he also made his children to pass through the fire in the valley of the son of hinnom and he practiced sorcery and used enchantments and practiced sorcery and dealt with those who had familiar spirits and with wizards he did much wrong in the sight of yhwh to provoke yhwh to anger

search.text: He set the engraved image of the idol, which he had made, in the house of Elohim, of which Elohim said to Dawid and to Shlomo his son, In this house, and in Yerushalayim, which I have chosen out of all the tribes of Israel, will I put my name forever:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 7 he set the engraved image of the idol which he had made in the house of elohim of which elohim said to dawid and to shlomo his son in this house and in yerushalayim which i have chosen out of all the tribes of israel will i put my name forever

search.text: neither will I any more remove the foot of Israel from off the land which I have appointed for your fathers, if only they will observe to do all that I have commanded them, even all the law and the statutes and the ordinances [given] by Moshe.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 8 neither will i any more remove the foot of israel from off the land which i have appointed for your fathers if only they will observe to do all that i have commanded them even all the law and the statutes and the ordinances given by moshe

search.text: Menashe seduced Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, so that they did wrong more than did the nations whom YHWH destroyed before the children of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 9 menashe seduced yehudah and the inhabitants of yerushalayim so that they did wrong more than did the nations whom yhwh destroyed before the children of israel

search.text: YHWH spoke to Menashe, and to his people; but they gave no heed.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 10 yhwh spoke to menashe and to his people but they gave no heed

search.text: Therefore YHWH brought on them the captains of the army of the king of Ashur, who took Menashe in chains, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Bavel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 11 therefore yhwh brought on them the captains of the army of the king of ashur who took menashe in chains and bound him with fetters and carried him to bavel

search.text: When he was in distress, he begged YHWH his God, and humbled himself greatly before the God of his fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 12 when he was in distress he begged yhwh his god and humbled himself greatly before the god of his fathers

search.text: He prayed to him; and he was entreated of him, and heard his supplication, and brought him again to Yerushalayim into his kingdom. Then Menashe knew that YHWH was Elohim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 13 he prayed to him and he was entreated of him and heard his supplication and brought him again to yerushalayim into his kingdom then menashe knew that yhwh was elohim

search.text: Now after this he built an outer wall to the city of Dawid, on the west side of Gihon, in the valley, even to the entrance at the fish gate; and he compassed Ophel about [with it], and raised it up to a very great height: and he put valiant captains in all the fortified cities of Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 14 now after this he built an outer wall to the city of dawid on the west side of gihon in the valley even to the entrance at the fish gate and he compassed ophel about with it and raised it up to a very great height and he put valiant captains in all the fortified cities of yehudah

search.text: He took away the foreign gods, and the idol out of the house of YHWH, and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of the house of YHWH, and in Yerushalayim, and cast them out of the city.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 15 he took away the foreign gods and the idol out of the house of yhwh and all the altars that he had built in the mountain of the house of yhwh and in yerushalayim and cast them out of the city

search.text: He built up the altar of YHWH, and offered thereon sacrifices of peace offerings and of thanksgiving, and commanded Yehudah to serve YHWH, the God of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 16 he built up the altar of yhwh and offered thereon sacrifices of peace offerings and of thanksgiving and commanded yehudah to serve yhwh the god of israel

search.text: Nevertheless the people sacrificed still in the high places, but only to YHWH their God.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 17 nevertheless the people sacrificed still in the high places but only to yhwh their god

search.text: Now the rest of the acts of Menashe, and his prayer to his God, and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of YHWH, the God of Israel, behold, they are written among the acts of the kings of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 18 now the rest of the acts of menashe and his prayer to his god and the words of the seers who spoke to him in the name of yhwh the god of israel behold they are written among the acts of the kings of israel

search.text: His prayer also, and how [Elohim] was entreated of him, and all his sin and his trespass, and the places in which he built high places, and set up the Asherim and the engraved images, before he humbled himself: behold, they are written in the history of Hozai.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 19 his prayer also and how elohim was entreated of him and all his sin and his trespass and the places in which he built high places and set up the asherim and the engraved images before he humbled himself behold they are written in the history of hozai

search.text: So Menashe slept with his fathers, and they buried him in his own house: and Amon his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 20 so menashe slept with his fathers and they buried him in his own house and amon his son reigned in his place

search.text: Amon was twenty-two years old when he began to reign; and he reigned two years in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 21 amon was twenty two years old when he began to reign and he reigned two years in yerushalayim

search.text: He did what was broken in the sight of YHWH, as did Menashe his father; and Amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which Menashe his father had made, and served them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 22 he did what was broken in the sight of yhwh as did menashe his father and amon sacrificed to all the engraved images which menashe his father had made and served them

search.text: He didn't humble himself before YHWH, as Menashe his father had humbled himself; but this same Amon trespassed more and more.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 23 he didn t humble himself before yhwh as menashe his father had humbled himself but this same amon trespassed more and more

search.text: His servants conspired against him, and put him to death in his own house.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 24 his servants conspired against him and put him to death in his own house

search.text: But the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against king Amon; and the people of the land made Yoshiyahu his son king in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 33 25 but the people of the land killed all those who had conspired against king amon and the people of the land made yoshiyahu his son king in his place

search.text: Yoshiyahu was eight years old when he began to reign; and he reigned thirty-one years in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 1 yoshiyahu was eight years old when he began to reign and he reigned thirty one years in yerushalayim

search.text: He did that which was right in the eyes of YHWH, and walked in the ways of Dawid his father, and didn't turn aside to the right hand or to the left.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 2 he did that which was right in the eyes of yhwh and walked in the ways of dawid his father and didn t turn aside to the right hand or to the left

search.text: For in the eighth year of his reign, while he was yet young, he began to seek after the God of Dawid his father; and in the twelfth year he began to purge Yehudah and Yerushalayim from the high places, and the Asherim, and the engraved images, and the molten images.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 3 for in the eighth year of his reign while he was yet young he began to seek after the god of dawid his father and in the twelfth year he began to purge yehudah and yerushalayim from the high places and the asherim and the engraved images and the molten images

search.text: They broke down the altars of the Baals in his presence; and the incense altars that were on high above them he hewed down; and the Asherim, and the engraved images, and the molten images, he broke in pieces, and made dust of them, and strewed it on the graves [of those] who had sacrificed to them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 4 they broke down the altars of the baals in his presence and the incense altars that were on high above them he hewed down and the asherim and the engraved images and the molten images he broke in pieces and made dust of them and strewed it on the graves of those who had sacrificed to them

search.text: He burnt the bones of the priests on their altars, and purged Yehudah and Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 5 he burnt the bones of the priests on their altars and purged yehudah and yerushalayim

search.text: [So did he] in the cities of Menashe and Efrayim and Shim'on, even to Naphtali, in their ruins round about.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 6 so did he in the cities of menashe and efrayim and shim on even to naphtali in their ruins round about

search.text: He broke down the altars, and beat the Asherim and the engraved images into powder, and hewed down all the incense altars throughout all the land of Israel, and returned to Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 7 he broke down the altars and beat the asherim and the engraved images into powder and hewed down all the incense altars throughout all the land of israel and returned to yerushalayim

search.text: Now in the eighteenth year of his reign, when he had purged the land and the house, he sent Shaphan the son of Azaliah, and Maaseiah the governor of the city, and Joah the son of Joahaz the recorder, to repair the house of YHWH his God.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 8 now in the eighteenth year of his reign when he had purged the land and the house he sent shaphan the son of azaliah and maaseiah the governor of the city and joah the son of joahaz the recorder to repair the house of yhwh his god

search.text: They came to Hilkiah the high priest, and delivered the money that was brought into the house of Elohim, which the Levites, the keepers of the threshold, had gathered of the hand of Menashe and Efrayim, and of all the remnant of Israel, and of all Yehudah and Binyamin, and of the inhabitants of Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 9 they came to hilkiah the high priest and delivered the money that was brought into the house of elohim which the levites the keepers of the threshold had gathered of the hand of menashe and efrayim and of all the remnant of israel and of all yehudah and binyamin and of the inhabitants of yerushalayim

search.text: They delivered it into the hand of the workmen who had the oversight of the house of YHWH; and the workmen who labored in the house of YHWH gave it to mend and repair the house;
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 10 they delivered it into the hand of the workmen who had the oversight of the house of yhwh and the workmen who labored in the house of yhwh gave it to mend and repair the house

search.text: even to the carpenters and to the builders gave they it, to buy hewn stone, and timber for couplings, and to make beams for the houses which the kings of Yehudah had destroyed.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 11 even to the carpenters and to the builders gave they it to buy hewn stone and timber for couplings and to make beams for the houses which the kings of yehudah had destroyed

search.text: The men did the work faithfully: and the overseers of them were Jahath and Obadiah, the Levites, of the sons of Merari; and Zekharyah and Meshullam, of the sons of the Kohathites, to set it forward; and [others of] the Levites, all who were skillful with instruments of music.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 12 the men did the work faithfully and the overseers of them were jahath and obadiah the levites of the sons of merari and zekharyah and meshullam of the sons of the kohathites to set it forward and others of the levites all who were skillful with instruments of music

search.text: Also they were over the bearers of burdens, and set forward all who did the work in every manner of service: and of the Levites there were scribes, and officers, and porters.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 13 also they were over the bearers of burdens and set forward all who did the work in every manner of service and of the levites there were scribes and officers and porters

search.text: When they brought out the money that was brought into the house of YHWH, Hilkiah the priest found the book of the law of YHWH [given] by Moshe.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 14 when they brought out the money that was brought into the house of yhwh hilkiah the priest found the book of the law of yhwh given by moshe

search.text: Hilkiah answered Shaphan the scribe, I have found the book of the law in the house of YHWH. Hilkiah delivered the book to Shaphan.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 15 hilkiah answered shaphan the scribe i have found the book of the law in the house of yhwh hilkiah delivered the book to shaphan

search.text: Shaphan carried the book to the king, and moreover brought back word to the king, saying, All that was committed to your servants, they are doing.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 16 shaphan carried the book to the king and moreover brought back word to the king saying all that was committed to your servants they are doing

search.text: They have emptied out the money that was found in the house of YHWH, and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers, and into the hand of the workmen.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 17 they have emptied out the money that was found in the house of yhwh and have delivered it into the hand of the overseers and into the hand of the workmen

search.text: Shaphan the scribe told the king, saying, Hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book. Shaphan read therein before the king.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 18 shaphan the scribe told the king saying hilkiah the priest has delivered me a book shaphan read therein before the king

search.text: It happened, when the king had heard the words of the law, that he tore his clothes.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 19 it happened when the king had heard the words of the law that he tore his clothes

search.text: The king commanded Hilkiah, and Ahikam the son of Shaphan, and Abdon the son of Micah, and Shaphan the scribe, and Asaiah the king's servant, saying,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 20 the king commanded hilkiah and ahikam the son of shaphan and abdon the son of micah and shaphan the scribe and asaiah the king s servant saying

search.text: Go you, inquire of YHWH for me, and for those who are left in Israel and in Yehudah, concerning the words of the book that is found; for great is the wrath of YHWH that is poured out on us, because our fathers have not kept the word of YHWH, to do according to all that is written in this book.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 21 go you inquire of yhwh for me and for those who are left in israel and in yehudah concerning the words of the book that is found for great is the wrath of yhwh that is poured out on us because our fathers have not kept the word of yhwh to do according to all that is written in this book

search.text: So Hilkiah, and they whom the king [had commanded], went to Huldah the prophetess, the wife of Shallum the son of Tokhath, the son of Hasrah, keeper of the wardrobe; (now she lived in Yerushalayim in the second quarter;) and they spoke to her to that effect.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 22 so hilkiah and they whom the king had commanded went to huldah the prophetess the wife of shallum the son of tokhath the son of hasrah keeper of the wardrobe now she lived in yerushalayim in the second quarter and they spoke to her to that effect

search.text: She said to them, Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: Tell you the one who sent you to me,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 23 she said to them thus says yhwh the god of israel tell you the one who sent you to me

search.text: Thus says YHWH, Behold, I will bring harm on this place, and on the inhabitants of it, even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 24 thus says yhwh behold i will bring harm on this place and on the inhabitants of it even all the curses that are written in the book which they have read before the king of yehudah

search.text: Because they have forsaken me, and have burned incense to other gods, that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands; therefore is my wrath poured out on this place, and it shall not be quenched.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 25 because they have forsaken me and have burned incense to other gods that they might provoke me to anger with all the works of their hands therefore is my wrath poured out on this place and it shall not be quenched

search.text: But to the king of Yehudah, who sent you to inquire of YHWH, thus shall you tell him, Thus says YHWH, the God of Israel: As touching the words which you have heard,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 26 but to the king of yehudah who sent you to inquire of yhwh thus shall you tell him thus says yhwh the god of israel as touching the words which you have heard

search.text: because your heart was tender, and you did humble yourself before Elohim, when you heard his words against this place, and against the inhabitants of it, and have humbled yourself before me, and have torn your clothes, and wept before me; I also have heard you, says YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 27 because your heart was tender and you did humble yourself before elohim when you heard his words against this place and against the inhabitants of it and have humbled yourself before me and have torn your clothes and wept before me i also have heard you says yhwh

search.text: Behold, I will gather you to your fathers, and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace, neither shall your eyes see all the calamity that I will bring on this place, and on the inhabitants of it. They brought back word to the king.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 28 behold i will gather you to your fathers and you shall be gathered to your grave in peace neither shall your eyes see all the calamity that i will bring on this place and on the inhabitants of it they brought back word to the king

search.text: Then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of Yehudah and Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 29 then the king sent and gathered together all the elders of yehudah and yerushalayim

search.text: The king went up to the house of YHWH, and all the people of Yehudah and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim, and the priests, and the Levites, and all the people, both great and small: and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 30 the king went up to the house of yhwh and all the people of yehudah and the inhabitants of yerushalayim and the priests and the levites and all the people both great and small and he read in their ears all the words of the book of the covenant that was found in the house of yhwh

search.text: The king stood in his place, and made a covenant before YHWH, to walk after YHWH, and to keep YHWH’s commandments, and YHWH’s testimonies, and YHWH’s statutes, with all his heart, and with all his soul, to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 31 the king stood in his place and made a covenant before yhwh to walk after yhwh and to keep yhwh s commandments and yhwh s testimonies and yhwh s statutes with all his heart and with all his soul to perform the words of the covenant that were written in this book

search.text: He caused all who were found in Yerushalayim and Binyamin to stand [to it]. The inhabitants of Yerushalayim did according to the covenant of Elohim, the God of their fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 32 he caused all who were found in yerushalayim and binyamin to stand to it the inhabitants of yerushalayim did according to the covenant of elohim the god of their fathers

search.text: Yoshiyahu took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of Israel, and made all who were found in Israel to serve, even to serve YHWH their God. All his days they didn't depart from following YHWH, the God of their fathers.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 34 33 yoshiyahu took away all the abominations out of all the countries that pertained to the children of israel and made all who were found in israel to serve even to serve yhwh their god all his days they didn t depart from following yhwh the god of their fathers

search.text: Yoshiyahu kept a Passover to YHWH in Yerushalayim: and they killed the Passover on the fourteenth [day] of the first month.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 1 yoshiyahu kept a passover to yhwh in yerushalayim and they killed the passover on the fourteenth day of the first month

search.text: He set the priests in their offices, and encouraged them to the service of the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 2 he set the priests in their offices and encouraged them to the service of the house of yhwh

search.text: He said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who were holy to YHWH, Put the holy ark in the house which Shlomo the son of Dawid king of Israel did build; there shall no more be a burden on your shoulders: now serve YHWH your God, and YHWH’s people Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 3 he said to the levites who taught all israel who were holy to yhwh put the holy ark in the house which shlomo the son of dawid king of israel did build there shall no more be a burden on your shoulders now serve yhwh your god and yhwh s people israel

search.text: Prepare yourselves after your fathers' houses by your divisions, according to the writing of Dawid king of Israel, and according to the writing of Shlomo his son.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 4 prepare yourselves after your fathers houses by your divisions according to the writing of dawid king of israel and according to the writing of shlomo his son

search.text: Stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers' houses of your brothers the children of the people, and [let there be for each] a portion of a fathers' house of the Levites.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 5 stand in the holy place according to the divisions of the fathers houses of your brothers the children of the people and let there be for each a portion of a fathers house of the levites

search.text: Kill the Passover, and sanctify yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to the word of YHWH by Moshe.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 6 kill the passover and sanctify yourselves and prepare for your brothers to do according to the word of yhwh by moshe

search.text: Yoshiyahu gave to the children of the people, of the flock, lambs and kids, all of them for the Passover offerings, to all who were present, to the number of thirty thousand, and three thousand bulls: these were of the king's substance.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 7 yoshiyahu gave to the children of the people of the flock lambs and kids all of them for the passover offerings to all who were present to the number of thirty thousand and three thousand bulls these were of the king s substance

search.text: His princes gave for a freewill offering to the people, to the priests, and to the Levites. Hilkiah and Zekharyah and Jehiel, the rulers of the house of Elohim, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings two thousand and six hundred [small livestock], and three hundred oxen.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 8 his princes gave for a freewill offering to the people to the priests and to the levites hilkiah and zekharyah and jehiel the rulers of the house of elohim gave to the priests for the passover offerings two thousand and six hundred small livestock and three hundred oxen

search.text: Conaniah also, and Shemaiah and Nethanel, his brothers, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, the chiefs of the Levites, gave to the Levites for the Passover offerings five thousand [small livestock], and five hundred oxen.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 9 conaniah also and shemaiah and nethanel his brothers and hashabiah and jeiel and jozabad the chiefs of the levites gave to the levites for the passover offerings five thousand small livestock and five hundred oxen

search.text: So the service was prepared, and the priests stood in their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the king's commandment.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 10 so the service was prepared and the priests stood in their place and the levites by their divisions according to the king s commandment

search.text: They killed the Passover, and the priests sprinkled [the blood which they received] of their hand, and the Levites flayed them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 11 they killed the passover and the priests sprinkled the blood which they received of their hand and the levites flayed them

search.text: They removed the burnt offerings, that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers' houses of the children of the people, to offer to YHWH, as it is written in the book of Moshe. So did they with the oxen.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 12 they removed the burnt offerings that they might give them according to the divisions of the fathers houses of the children of the people to offer to yhwh as it is written in the book of moshe so did they with the oxen

search.text: They roasted the Passover with fire according to the ordinance: and the holy offerings boiled they in pots, and in caldrons, and in pans, and carried them quickly to all the children of the people.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 13 they roasted the passover with fire according to the ordinance and the holy offerings boiled they in pots and in caldrons and in pans and carried them quickly to all the children of the people

search.text: Afterward they prepared for themselves, and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aharon [were busied] in offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night: therefore the Levites prepared for themselves, and for the priests the sons of Aharon.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 14 afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests because the priests the sons of aharon were busied in offering the burnt offerings and the fat until night therefore the levites prepared for themselves and for the priests the sons of aharon

search.text: The singers the sons of Asaph were in their place, according to the commandment of Dawid, and Asaph, and Heman, and Jeduthun the king's seer; and the porters were at every gate: they didn't need to depart from their service; for their brothers the Levites prepared for them.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 15 the singers the sons of asaph were in their place according to the commandment of dawid and asaph and heman and jeduthun the king s seer and the porters were at every gate they didn t need to depart from their service for their brothers the levites prepared for them

search.text: So all the service of YHWH was prepared the same day, to keep the Passover, and to offer burnt offerings on the altar of YHWH, according to the commandment of king Yoshiyahu.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 16 so all the service of yhwh was prepared the same day to keep the passover and to offer burnt offerings on the altar of yhwh according to the commandment of king yoshiyahu

search.text: The children of Israel who were present kept the Passover at that time, and the feast of unleavened bread seven days.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 17 the children of israel who were present kept the passover at that time and the feast of unleavened bread seven days

search.text: There was no Passover like that kept in Israel from the days of Shmuel the prophet; neither did any of the kings of Israel keep such a Passover as Yoshiyahu kept, and the priests, and the Levites, and all Yehudah and Israel who were present, and the inhabitants of Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 18 there was no passover like that kept in israel from the days of shmuel the prophet neither did any of the kings of israel keep such a passover as yoshiyahu kept and the priests and the levites and all yehudah and israel who were present and the inhabitants of yerushalayim

search.text: In the eighteenth year of the reign of Yoshiyahu was this Passover kept.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 19 in the eighteenth year of the reign of yoshiyahu was this passover kept

search.text: After all this, when Yoshiyahu had prepared the temple, Neco king of Mitzrayim went up to fight against Carchemish by the Perat: and Yoshiyahu went out against him.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 20 after all this when yoshiyahu had prepared the temple neco king of mitzrayim went up to fight against carchemish by the perat and yoshiyahu went out against him

search.text: But he sent ambassadors to him, saying, What have I to do with you, you king of Yehudah? [I come] not against you this day, but against the house with which I have war; and Elohim has commanded me to make haste: forbear you from [meddling with] Elohim, who is with me, that Elohim not destroy you.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 21 but he sent ambassadors to him saying what have i to do with you you king of yehudah i come not against you this day but against the house with which i have war and elohim has commanded me to make haste forbear you from meddling with elohim who is with me that elohim not destroy you

search.text: Nevertheless Yoshiyahu would not turn his face from him, but disguised himself, that he might fight with him, and didn't listen to the words of Neco from the mouth of Elohim, and came to fight in the valley of Megiddo.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 22 nevertheless yoshiyahu would not turn his face from him but disguised himself that he might fight with him and didn t listen to the words of neco from the mouth of elohim and came to fight in the valley of megiddo

search.text: The archers shot at king Yoshiyahu; and the king said to his servants, Have me away; for I am sore wounded.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 23 the archers shot at king yoshiyahu and the king said to his servants have me away for i am sore wounded

search.text: So his servants took him out of the chariot, and put him in the second chariot that he had, and brought him to Yerushalayim; and he died, and was buried in the tombs of his fathers. All Yehudah and Yerushalayim mourned for Yoshiyahu.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 24 so his servants took him out of the chariot and put him in the second chariot that he had and brought him to yerushalayim and he died and was buried in the tombs of his fathers all yehudah and yerushalayim mourned for yoshiyahu

search.text: Yirmeyahu lamented for Yoshiyahu: and all the singing men and singing women spoke of Yoshiyahu in their lamentations to this day; and they made them an ordinance in Israel: and behold, they are written in the lamentations.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 25 yirmeyahu lamented for yoshiyahu and all the singing men and singing women spoke of yoshiyahu in their lamentations to this day and they made them an ordinance in israel and behold they are written in the lamentations

search.text: Now the rest of the acts of Yoshiyahu, and his good deeds, according to that which is written in the law of YHWH,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 26 now the rest of the acts of yoshiyahu and his good deeds according to that which is written in the law of yhwh

search.text: and his acts, first and last, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Yehudah.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 35 27 and his acts first and last behold they are written in the book of the kings of israel and yehudah

search.text: Then the people of the land took Jehoahaz the son of Yoshiyahu, and made him king in his father's place in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 1 then the people of the land took jehoahaz the son of yoshiyahu and made him king in his father s place in yerushalayim

search.text: Joahaz was twenty-three years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 2 joahaz was twenty three years old when he began to reign and he reigned three months in yerushalayim

search.text: The king of Mitzrayim deposed him at Yerushalayim, and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 3 the king of mitzrayim deposed him at yerushalayim and fined the land one hundred talents of silver and a talent of gold

search.text: The king of Mitzrayim made Eliakim his brother king over Yehudah and Yerushalayim, and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Neco took Joahaz his brother, and carried him to Mitzrayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 4 the king of mitzrayim made eliakim his brother king over yehudah and yerushalayim and changed his name to jehoiakim neco took joahaz his brother and carried him to mitzrayim

search.text: Jehoiakim was Twenty-five years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Yerushalayim: and he did what was broken in the sight of YHWH his God.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 5 jehoiakim was twenty five years old when he began to reign and he reigned eleven years in yerushalayim and he did what was broken in the sight of yhwh his god

search.text: Against him came up Nebuchadnezzar king of Bavel, and bound him in fetters, to carry him to Bavel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 6 against him came up nebuchadnezzar king of bavel and bound him in fetters to carry him to bavel

search.text: Nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of YHWH to Bavel, and put them in his temple at Bavel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 7 nebuchadnezzar also carried of the vessels of the house of yhwh to bavel and put them in his temple at bavel

search.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jehoiakim, and his abominations which he did, and that which was found in him, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Yehudah: and Jehoiachin his son reigned in his place.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 8 now the rest of the acts of jehoiakim and his abominations which he did and that which was found in him behold they are written in the book of the kings of israel and yehudah and jehoiachin his son reigned in his place

search.text: Jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign; and he reigned three months and ten days in Yerushalayim: and he did what was broken in the sight of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 9 jehoiachin was eight years old when he began to reign and he reigned three months and ten days in yerushalayim and he did what was broken in the sight of yhwh

search.text: At the return of the year king Nebuchadnezzar sent, and brought him to Bavel, with the goodly vessels of the house of YHWH, and made Tzidkiyahu his brother king over Yehudah and Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 10 at the return of the year king nebuchadnezzar sent and brought him to bavel with the goodly vessels of the house of yhwh and made tzidkiyahu his brother king over yehudah and yerushalayim

search.text: Tzidkiyahu was twenty-one years old when he began to reign; and he reigned eleven years in Yerushalayim:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 11 tzidkiyahu was twenty one years old when he began to reign and he reigned eleven years in yerushalayim

search.text: and he did what was broken in the sight of YHWH his God; he didn't humble himself before Yirmeyahu the prophet [speaking] from the mouth of YHWH.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 12 and he did what was broken in the sight of yhwh his god he didn t humble himself before yirmeyahu the prophet speaking from the mouth of yhwh

search.text: He also rebelled against king Nebuchadnezzar, who had made him swear by Elohim: but he stiffened his neck, and hardened his heart against turning to YHWH, the God of Israel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 13 he also rebelled against king nebuchadnezzar who had made him swear by elohim but he stiffened his neck and hardened his heart against turning to yhwh the god of israel

search.text: Moreover all the chiefs of the priests, and the people, trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the nations; and they polluted the house of YHWH which YHWH had made holy in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 14 moreover all the chiefs of the priests and the people trespassed very greatly after all the abominations of the nations and they polluted the house of yhwh which yhwh had made holy in yerushalayim

search.text: YHWH, the God of their fathers, sent to them by YHWH’s messengers, rising up early and sending, because YHWH had compassion on YHWH’s people, and on YHWH’s dwelling place:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 15 yhwh the god of their fathers sent to them by yhwh s messengers rising up early and sending because yhwh had compassion on yhwh s people and on yhwh s dwelling place

search.text: but they mocked the messengers of Elohim, and despised Elohim’s words, and scoffed at Elohim’s prophets, until the wrath of YHWH arose against YHWH’s people, until there was no remedy.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 16 but they mocked the messengers of elohim and despised elohim s words and scoffed at elohim s prophets until the wrath of yhwh arose against yhwh s people until there was no remedy

search.text: Therefore he brought on them the king of the Chaldeans, who killed their young people with the sword in the house of their sanctuary, and had no compassion on young person or virgin, old man or gray-headed: he gave them all into his hand.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 17 therefore he brought on them the king of the chaldeans who killed their young people with the sword in the house of their sanctuary and had no compassion on young person or virgin old man or gray headed he gave them all into his hand

search.text: All the vessels of the house of Elohim, great and small, and the treasures of the house of YHWH, and the treasures of the king, and of his princes, all these he brought to Bavel.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 18 all the vessels of the house of elohim great and small and the treasures of the house of yhwh and the treasures of the king and of his princes all these he brought to bavel

search.text: They burnt the house of Elohim, and broke down the wall of Yerushalayim, and burnt all the palaces of it with fire, and destroyed all the goodly vessels of it.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 19 they burnt the house of elohim and broke down the wall of yerushalayim and burnt all the palaces of it with fire and destroyed all the goodly vessels of it

search.text: He carried those who had escaped from the sword away to Bavel; and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of Paras:
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 20 he carried those who had escaped from the sword away to bavel and they were servants to him and his sons until the reign of the kingdom of paras

search.text: to fulfill the word of YHWH by the mouth of Yirmeyahu, until the land had enjoyed its Sabbaths: [for] as long as it lay desolate it kept Sabbath, to fulfill seventy years.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 21 to fulfill the word of yhwh by the mouth of yirmeyahu until the land had enjoyed its sabbaths for as long as it lay desolate it kept sabbath to fulfill seventy years

search.text: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Paras, that the word of YHWH by the mouth of Yirmeyahu might be accomplished, YHWH stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Paras, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and [put it] also in writing, saying,
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 22 now in the first year of cyrus king of paras that the word of yhwh by the mouth of yirmeyahu might be accomplished yhwh stirred up the spirit of cyrus king of paras so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom and put it also in writing saying

search.text: Thus says Cyrus king of Paras, All the kingdoms of the earth has YHWH, the God of heavens, given me; and he has charged me to build him a house in Yerushalayim, which is in Yehudah. Whoever there is among you of all their people, YHWH their God be with him, and let him go up.
search.searchText: 2 chronicles 36 23 thus says cyrus king of paras all the kingdoms of the earth has yhwh the god of heavens given me and he has charged me to build him a house in yerushalayim which is in yehudah whoever there is among you of all their people yhwh their god be with him and let him go up

search.text: Now in the first year of Cyrus king of Paras, that the word of YHWH by the mouth of Yirmeyahu might be accomplished, YHWH stirred up the spirit of Cyrus king of Paras, so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom, and [put it] also in writing, saying,
search.searchText: ezra 1 1 now in the first year of cyrus king of paras that the word of yhwh by the mouth of yirmeyahu might be accomplished yhwh stirred up the spirit of cyrus king of paras so that he made a proclamation throughout all his kingdom and put it also in writing saying

search.text: Thus says Cyrus king of Paras, All the kingdoms of the earth has YHWH, the God of heavens, given me; and YHWH has charged me to build a house for YHWH in Yerushalayim, which is in Yehudah.
search.searchText: ezra 1 2 thus says cyrus king of paras all the kingdoms of the earth has yhwh the god of heavens given me and yhwh has charged me to build a house for yhwh in yerushalayim which is in yehudah

search.text: Whoever there is among you of all their people, their God be with him, and let him go up to Yerushalayim, which is in Yehudah, and build the house of YHWH, the God of Israel (they are Elohim), which is in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: ezra 1 3 whoever there is among you of all their people their god be with him and let him go up to yerushalayim which is in yehudah and build the house of yhwh the god of israel they are elohim which is in yerushalayim

search.text: Whoever is left, in any place where they sojourns, let the men of their place help him with silver, and with gold, and with goods, and with animals, besides the freewill offering for the house of Elohim which is in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: ezra 1 4 whoever is left in any place where they sojourns let the men of their place help him with silver and with gold and with goods and with animals besides the freewill offering for the house of elohim which is in yerushalayim
