search.text: Then rose up the heads of fathers' [houses] of Yehudah and Binyamin, and the priests, and the Levites, even all whose spirit Elohim had stirred to go up to build the house of YHWH which is in Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: ezra 1 5 then rose up the heads of fathers houses of yehudah and binyamin and the priests and the levites even all whose spirit elohim had stirred to go up to build the house of yhwh which is in yerushalayim

search.text: All those who were round about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver, with gold, with goods, and with animals, and with precious things, besides all that was willingly offered.
search.searchText: ezra 1 6 all those who were round about them strengthened their hands with vessels of silver with gold with goods and with animals and with precious things besides all that was willingly offered

search.text: Also Cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of YHWH, which Nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of Yerushalayim, and had put in the house of his gods;
search.searchText: ezra 1 7 also cyrus the king brought forth the vessels of the house of yhwh which nebuchadnezzar had brought forth out of yerushalayim and had put in the house of his gods

search.text: even those did Cyrus king of Paras bring forth by the hand of Mithredath the treasurer, and numbered them to Sheshbazzar, the prince of Yehudah.
search.searchText: ezra 1 8 even those did cyrus king of paras bring forth by the hand of mithredath the treasurer and numbered them to sheshbazzar the prince of yehudah

search.text: This is the number of them: thirty platters of gold, one thousand platters of silver, twenty-nine knives,
search.searchText: ezra 1 9 this is the number of them thirty platters of gold one thousand platters of silver twenty nine knives

search.text: thirty bowls of gold, silver bowls of a second sort four hundred and ten, and other vessels one thousand.
search.searchText: ezra 1 10 thirty bowls of gold silver bowls of a second sort four hundred and ten and other vessels one thousand

search.text: All the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred. All these did Sheshbazzar bring up, when they of the captivity were brought up from Bavel to Yerushalayim.
search.searchText: ezra 1 11 all the vessels of gold and of silver were five thousand and four hundred all these did sheshbazzar bring up when they of the captivity were brought up from bavel to yerushalayim

search.text: Now these are the children of the province, who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away, whom Nebuchadnezzar the king of Bavel had carried away to Bavel, and who returned to Yerushalayim and Yehudah, everyone to their city;
search.searchText: ezra 2 1 now these are the children of the province who went up out of the captivity of those who had been carried away whom nebuchadnezzar the king of bavel had carried away to bavel and who returned to yerushalayim and yehudah everyone to their city

search.text: She weeps sore in the night, and her tears are on her cheeks; among all her lovers she has none to comfort her: All her friends have dealt treacherously with her; they are become her enemies.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 2 she weeps sore in the night and her tears are on her cheeks among all her lovers she has none to comfort her all her friends have dealt treacherously with her they are become her enemies

search.text: Yehudah is gone into captivity because of affliction, and because of great servitude; she dwells among the nations, she finds no rest: all her persecutors overtook her within the straits.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 3 yehudah is gone into captivity because of affliction and because of great servitude she dwells among the nations she finds no rest all her persecutors overtook her within the straits

search.text: The ways of Tzion do mourn, because none come to the solemn assembly; all her gates are desolate, her priests do sigh: her virgins are afflicted, and she herself is in bitterness.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 4 the ways of tzion do mourn because none come to the solemn assembly all her gates are desolate her priests do sigh her virgins are afflicted and she herself is in bitterness

search.text: Her adversaries are become the head, her enemies prosper; for YHWH has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions: her young children are gone into captivity before the adversary.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 5 her adversaries are become the head her enemies prosper for yhwh has afflicted her for the multitude of her transgressions her young children are gone into captivity before the adversary

search.text: From the daughter of Tzion all her majesty is departed: her princes are become like harts that find no pasture, they are gone without strength before the pursuer.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 6 from the daughter of tzion all her majesty is departed her princes are become like harts that find no pasture they are gone without strength before the pursuer

search.text: Yerushalayim remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old: when her people fell into the hand of the adversary, and none did help her, The adversaries saw her, they did mock at her desolations.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 7 yerushalayim remembers in the days of her affliction and of her miseries all her pleasant things that were from the days of old when her people fell into the hand of the adversary and none did help her the adversaries saw her they did mock at her desolations

search.text: Yerushalayim has grievously sinned; therefore she is become as an unclean thing; all who honored her despise her, because they have seen her nakedness: yes, she sighs, and turns backward.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 8 yerushalayim has grievously sinned therefore she is become as an unclean thing all who honored her despise her because they have seen her nakedness yes she sighs and turns backward

search.text: Her filthiness was in her skirts; she didn't remember her latter end; therefore is she come down wonderfully; she has no comforter: see, YHWH, my affliction; for the enemy has magnified himself.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 9 her filthiness was in her skirts she didn t remember her latter end therefore is she come down wonderfully she has no comforter see yhwh my affliction for the enemy has magnified himself

search.text: The adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things: for she has seen that the nations are entered into her sanctuary, concerning whom you did command that they should not enter into your assembly.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 10 the adversary has spread out his hand on all her pleasant things for she has seen that the nations are entered into her sanctuary concerning whom you did command that they should not enter into your assembly

search.text: All her people sigh, they seek bread; they have given their pleasant things for food to refresh the soul: look, YHWH, and see; for I am become abject.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 11 all her people sigh they seek bread they have given their pleasant things for food to refresh the soul look yhwh and see for i am become abject

search.text: Is it nothing to you, all you who pass by? Look, and see if there be any sorrow like my sorrow, which is brought on me, With which YHWH has afflicted [me] in the day of his fierce anger.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 12 is it nothing to you all you who pass by look and see if there be any sorrow like my sorrow which is brought on me with which yhwh has afflicted me in the day of his fierce anger

search.text: From on high has he sent fire into my bones, and it prevails against them; He has spread a net for my feet, he has turned me back: He has made me desolate and faint all the day.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 13 from on high has he sent fire into my bones and it prevails against them he has spread a net for my feet he has turned me back he has made me desolate and faint all the day

search.text: The yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand; They are knit together, they are come up on my neck; he has made my strength to fail: YHWH has delivered me into their hands, against whom I am not able to stand.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 14 the yoke of my transgressions is bound by his hand they are knit together they are come up on my neck he has made my strength to fail yhwh has delivered me into their hands against whom i am not able to stand

search.text: YHWH has set at nothing all my mighty men in the midst of me; YHWH has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young people: YHWH has trodden as in a winepress the virgin daughter of Yehudah.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 15 yhwh has set at nothing all my mighty men in the midst of me yhwh has called a solemn assembly against me to crush my young people yhwh has trodden as in a winepress the virgin daughter of yehudah

search.text: For these things I weep; my eye, my eye runs down with water; Because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me: My children are desolate, because the enemy has prevailed.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 16 for these things i weep my eye my eye runs down with water because the comforter who should refresh my soul is far from me my children are desolate because the enemy has prevailed

search.text: Tzion spreads forth her hands; there is none to comfort her; YHWH has commanded concerning Ya'akov, that those who are round about him should be his adversaries: Yerushalayim is among them as an unclean thing.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 17 tzion spreads forth her hands there is none to comfort her yhwh has commanded concerning ya akov that those who are round about him should be his adversaries yerushalayim is among them as an unclean thing

search.text: YHWH is righteous; for I have rebelled against YHWH’s commandment: Please hear all you peoples, and see my sorrow: My virgins and my young people are gone into captivity.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 18 yhwh is righteous for i have rebelled against yhwh s commandment please hear all you peoples and see my sorrow my virgins and my young people are gone into captivity

search.text: I called for my lovers, [but] they deceived me: My priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city, While they sought them food to refresh their souls.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 19 i called for my lovers but they deceived me my priests and my elders gave up the spirit in the city while they sought them food to refresh their souls

search.text: See, YHWH; for I am in distress; my heart is troubled; My heart is turned within me; for I have grievously rebelled: Abroad the sword bereaves, at home there is as death.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 20 see yhwh for i am in distress my heart is troubled my heart is turned within me for i have grievously rebelled abroad the sword bereaves at home there is as death

search.text: They have heard that I sigh; there is none to comfort me; All my enemies have heard of my trouble; they are glad that you have done it: You will bring the day that you have proclaimed, and they shall be like me.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 21 they have heard that i sigh there is none to comfort me all my enemies have heard of my trouble they are glad that you have done it you will bring the day that you have proclaimed and they shall be like me

search.text: Let all their wickedness come before you; Do to them, as you have done to me for all my transgressions: For my sighs are many, and my heart is faint.
search.searchText: lamentations 1 22 let all their wickedness come before you do to them as you have done to me for all my transgressions for my sighs are many and my heart is faint

search.text: How has YHWH covered the daughter of Tzion with a cloud in YHWH’s anger! YHWH has cast down from heaven to the earth the beauty of Israel, And hasn't remembered YHWH’s footstool in the day of YHWH’s anger.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 1 how has yhwh covered the daughter of tzion with a cloud in yhwh s anger yhwh has cast down from heaven to the earth the beauty of israel and hasn t remembered yhwh s footstool in the day of yhwh s anger

search.text: YHWH has swallowed up all the habitations of Ya'akov, and has not pitied: YHWH has thrown down the strongholds of the daughter of Yehudah in wrath, brought them down to the ground, and profaned the kingdom and the princes of it.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 2 yhwh has swallowed up all the habitations of ya akov and has not pitied yhwh has thrown down the strongholds of the daughter of yehudah in wrath brought them down to the ground and profaned the kingdom and the princes of it

search.text: YHWH has cut off in fierce anger all the horn of Israel; YHWH has drawn back YHWH’s right hand from before the enemy: YHWH has burned up Ya'akov like a flaming fire, which devours round about.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 3 yhwh has cut off in fierce anger all the horn of israel yhwh has drawn back yhwh s right hand from before the enemy yhwh has burned up ya akov like a flaming fire which devours round about

search.text: YHWH has bent YHWH’s bow like an enemy, YHWH has stood with YHWH’s right hand as an adversary, Has killed all that were pleasant to the eye: In the tent of the daughter of Tzion YHWH has poured out YHWH’s wrath like fire.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 4 yhwh has bent yhwh s bow like an enemy yhwh has stood with yhwh s right hand as an adversary has killed all that were pleasant to the eye in the tent of the daughter of tzion yhwh has poured out yhwh s wrath like fire

search.text: YHWH is become as an enemy, YHWH has swallowed up Israel; YHWH has swallowed up all her palaces, YHWH has destroyed his strongholds; YHWH has multiplied in the daughter of Yehudah mourning and lamentation.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 5 yhwh is become as an enemy yhwh has swallowed up israel yhwh has swallowed up all her palaces yhwh has destroyed his strongholds yhwh has multiplied in the daughter of yehudah mourning and lamentation

search.text: YHWH has violently taken away YHWH’s tent, as if it were of a garden; YHWH has destroyed YHWH’s place of assembly: YHWH has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Tzion, Has despised in the indignation of YHWH’s anger the king and the priest.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 6 yhwh has violently taken away yhwh s tent as if it were of a garden yhwh has destroyed yhwh s place of assembly yhwh has caused solemn assembly and sabbath to be forgotten in tzion has despised in the indignation of yhwh s anger the king and the priest

search.text: YHWH has cast off YHWH’s altar, YHWH has abhorred YHWH’s sanctuary; YHWH has given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces: They have made a noise in the house of YHWH, as in the day of a solemn assembly.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 7 yhwh has cast off yhwh s altar yhwh has abhorred yhwh s sanctuary yhwh has given up into the hand of the enemy the walls of her palaces they have made a noise in the house of yhwh as in the day of a solemn assembly

search.text: YHWH has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of Tzion; YHWH has stretched out the line, has not withdrawn the hand from destroying, and has made the rampart and wall to lament; they languish together.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 8 yhwh has purposed to destroy the wall of the daughter of tzion yhwh has stretched out the line has not withdrawn the hand from destroying and has made the rampart and wall to lament they languish together

search.text: Her gates are sunk into the ground; he has destroyed and broken her bars: Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not; Yes, her prophets find no vision from YHWH.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 9 her gates are sunk into the ground he has destroyed and broken her bars her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not yes her prophets find no vision from yhwh

search.text: The elders of the daughter of Tzion sit on the ground, they keep silence; They have cast up dust on their heads; they have girded themselves with sackcloth: The virgins of Yerushalayim hang down their heads to the ground.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 10 the elders of the daughter of tzion sit on the ground they keep silence they have cast up dust on their heads they have girded themselves with sackcloth the virgins of yerushalayim hang down their heads to the ground

search.text: My eyes do fail with tears, my heart is troubled; My liver is poured on the earth, because of the destruction of the daughter of my people, Because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 11 my eyes do fail with tears my heart is troubled my liver is poured on the earth because of the destruction of the daughter of my people because the young children and the infants swoon in the streets of the city

search.text: They tell their mothers, Where is grain and wine? When they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city, When their soul is poured out into their mothers' bosom.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 12 they tell their mothers where is grain and wine when they swoon as the wounded in the streets of the city when their soul is poured out into their mothers bosom

search.text: What shall I testify to you? what shall I liken to you, daughter of Yerushalayim? What shall I compare to you, that I may comfort you, virgin daughter of Tzion? For your breach is great like the sea: who can heal you?
search.searchText: lamentations 2 13 what shall i testify to you what shall i liken to you daughter of yerushalayim what shall i compare to you that i may comfort you virgin daughter of tzion for your breach is great like the sea who can heal you

search.text: Your prophets have seen for you false and foolish visions; They have not uncovered your iniquity, to bring back your captivity, But have seen for you false oracles and causes of banishment.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 14 your prophets have seen for you false and foolish visions they have not uncovered your iniquity to bring back your captivity but have seen for you false oracles and causes of banishment

search.text: All that pass by clap their hands at you; They hiss and wag their head at the daughter of Yerushalayim, [saying], Is this the city that men called The perfection of beauty, The joy of the whole earth?
search.searchText: lamentations 2 15 all that pass by clap their hands at you they hiss and wag their head at the daughter of yerushalayim saying is this the city that men called the perfection of beauty the joy of the whole earth

search.text: All your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you; They hiss and gnash the teeth; they say, We have swallowed her up; Certainly this is the day that we looked for; we have found, we have seen it.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 16 all your enemies have opened their mouth wide against you they hiss and gnash the teeth they say we have swallowed her up certainly this is the day that we looked for we have found we have seen it

search.text: YHWH has done that which YHWH purposed; YHWH has fulfilled YHWH’s word that YHWH commanded in the days of old; YHWH has thrown down, and has not pitied: YHWH has caused the enemy to rejoice over you; YHWH has exalted the horn of your adversaries.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 17 yhwh has done that which yhwh purposed yhwh has fulfilled yhwh s word that yhwh commanded in the days of old yhwh has thrown down and has not pitied yhwh has caused the enemy to rejoice over you yhwh has exalted the horn of your adversaries

search.text: Their heart cried to YHWH: wall of the daughter of Tzion, let tears run down like a river day and night; Give yourself no respite; don't let the apple of your eye cease.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 18 their heart cried to yhwh wall of the daughter of tzion let tears run down like a river day and night give yourself no respite don t let the apple of your eye cease

search.text: Arise, cry out in the night, at the beginning of the watches; Pour out your heart like water before the face of YHWH: Lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children, that faint for hunger at the head of every street.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 19 arise cry out in the night at the beginning of the watches pour out your heart like water before the face of yhwh lift up your hands toward him for the life of your young children that faint for hunger at the head of every street

search.text: Look, YHWH, and see to whom you have done thus! Shall the women eat their fruit, the children that are dandled in the hands? Shall the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of YHWH?
search.searchText: lamentations 2 20 look yhwh and see to whom you have done thus shall the women eat their fruit the children that are dandled in the hands shall the priest and the prophet be killed in the sanctuary of yhwh

search.text: The youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets; My virgins and my young people are fallen by the sword: You have killed them in the day of your anger; you have slaughtered, [and] not pitied.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 21 the youth and the old man lie on the ground in the streets my virgins and my young people are fallen by the sword you have killed them in the day of your anger you have slaughtered and not pitied

search.text: You have called, as in the day of a solemn assembly, my terrors on every side; There was none that escaped or remained in the day of YHWH's anger: Those that I have dandled and brought up has my enemy consumed.
search.searchText: lamentations 2 22 you have called as in the day of a solemn assembly my terrors on every side there was none that escaped or remained in the day of yhwh s anger those that i have dandled and brought up has my enemy consumed

search.text: I am the person that has seen affliction by the rod of their wrath.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 1 i am the person that has seen affliction by the rod of their wrath

search.text: He has led me and caused me to walk in darkness, and not in light.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 2 he has led me and caused me to walk in darkness and not in light

search.searchText: lamentations 3 3 surely against me he turns his hand again and again all the day

search.searchText: lamentations 3 4 my flesh and my skin has he made old he has broken my bones

search.text: He has built against me, and compassed me with gall and travail.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 5 he has built against me and compassed me with gall and travail

search.text: He has made me to dwell in dark places, as those that have been long dead.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 6 he has made me to dwell in dark places as those that have been long dead

search.text: He has walled me about, that I can't go forth; he has made my chain heavy.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 7 he has walled me about that i can t go forth he has made my chain heavy

search.text: Yes, when I cry, and call for help, he shuts out my prayer.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 8 yes when i cry and call for help he shuts out my prayer

search.searchText: lamentations 3 9 he has walled up my ways with hewn stone he has made my paths crooked

search.text: He is to me as a bear lying in wait, as a lion in secret places.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 10 he is to me as a bear lying in wait as a lion in secret places

search.text: He has turned aside my ways, and pulled me in pieces; he has made me desolate.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 11 he has turned aside my ways and pulled me in pieces he has made me desolate

search.text: He has bent his bow, and set me as a mark for the arrow.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 12 he has bent his bow and set me as a mark for the arrow

search.text: He has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 13 he has caused the shafts of his quiver to enter into my kidneys

search.searchText: lamentations 3 14 i am become a derision to all my people and their song all the day

search.searchText: lamentations 3 15 he has filled me with bitterness he has sated me with wormwood

search.text: He has also broken my teeth with gravel stones; he has covered me with ashes.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 16 he has also broken my teeth with gravel stones he has covered me with ashes

search.text: You have removed my soul far off from peace; I forgot prosperity.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 17 you have removed my soul far off from peace i forgot prosperity

search.text: I said, My strength is perished, and my expectation from YHWH.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 18 i said my strength is perished and my expectation from yhwh

search.searchText: lamentations 3 19 remember my affliction and my misery the wormwood and the gall

search.text: My soul still remembers them, and is bowed down within me.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 20 my soul still remembers them and is bowed down within me

search.text: This I recall to my mind; therefore have I hope.
search.searchText: lamentations 3 21 this i recall to my mind therefore have i hope

search.text: Let him put his mouth in the dust, if so be there may be hope.

search.text: Let him give their cheek to the one who strikes him; let him be filled full with reproach.

search.searchText: lamentations 3 32 for though he cause grief yet he will have compassion according to the multitude of his loving kindnesses

search.text: To crush under foot all the prisoners of the earth,

search.text: I will give her vineyards from there, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope; and she will respond there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Mitzrayim.
search.searchText: hosea 2 15 i will give her vineyards from there and the valley of achor for a door of hope and she will respond there as in the days of her youth and as in the day when she came up out of the land of mitzrayim

search.text: It will be in that day," says YHWH, "that you will call me 'my husband,' and no longer call me 'my master.'
search.searchText: hosea 2 16 it will be in that day says yhwh that you will call me my husband and no longer call me my master

search.text: For I will take away the names of the Baals out of her mouth, and they will no longer be mentioned by name.
search.searchText: hosea 2 17 for i will take away the names of the baals out of her mouth and they will no longer be mentioned by name

search.text: In that day I will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field, and with the birds of the sky, and with the creeping things of the ground. I will break the bow, the sword, and the battle out of the land, and will make them lie down safely.
search.searchText: hosea 2 18 in that day i will make a covenant for them with the animals of the field and with the birds of the sky and with the creeping things of the ground i will break the bow the sword and the battle out of the land and will make them lie down safely

search.text: I will betroth you to me forever. Yes, I will betroth you to me in righteousness, in justice, in loving kindness, and in compassion.
search.searchText: hosea 2 19 i will betroth you to me forever yes i will betroth you to me in righteousness in justice in loving kindness and in compassion

search.text: I will even betroth you to me in faithfulness; and you shall know YHWH.
search.searchText: hosea 2 20 i will even betroth you to me in faithfulness and you shall know yhwh

search.text: It will happen in that day, I will respond," says YHWH, "I will respond to the heavens, and they will respond to the earth;
search.searchText: hosea 2 21 it will happen in that day i will respond says yhwh i will respond to the heavens and they will respond to the earth

search.text: and the earth will respond to the grain, and the new wine, and the oil; and they will respond to Jezreel.
search.searchText: hosea 2 22 and the earth will respond to the grain and the new wine and the oil and they will respond to jezreel

search.text: I will sow her to me in the earth; and I will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy; and I will tell those who were not my people, 'You are my people;' and they will say, 'my God!'"
search.searchText: hosea 2 23 i will sow her to me in the earth and i will have mercy on her who had not obtained mercy and i will tell those who were not my people you are my people and they will say my god

search.text: YHWH said to me, "Go again, love a woman loved by another, and an adulteress, even as YHWH loves the children of Israel, though they turn to other gods, and love cakes of raisins."
search.searchText: hosea 3 1 yhwh said to me go again love a woman loved by another and an adulteress even as yhwh loves the children of israel though they turn to other gods and love cakes of raisins

search.text: So I bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley.
search.searchText: hosea 3 2 so i bought her for myself for fifteen pieces of silver and a homer and a half of barley

search.text: I said to her, "You shall stay with me many days. You shall not play the prostitute, and you shall not be with any other man. I will also be so toward you."
search.searchText: hosea 3 3 i said to her you shall stay with me many days you shall not play the prostitute and you shall not be with any other man i will also be so toward you

search.text: For the children of Israel shall abide many days without king, and without prince, and without sacrifice, and without sacred stone, and without ephod or idols.
search.searchText: hosea 3 4 for the children of israel shall abide many days without king and without prince and without sacrifice and without sacred stone and without ephod or idols

search.text: Afterward the children of Israel shall return, and seek YHWH their God, and Dawid their king, and shall come with trembling to YHWH and to YHWH’s blessings in the last days.
search.searchText: hosea 3 5 afterward the children of israel shall return and seek yhwh their god and dawid their king and shall come with trembling to yhwh and to yhwh s blessings in the last days

search.text: Hear the word of YHWH, you children of Israel; for YHWH has a charge against the inhabitants of the land: "Indeed there is no truth, nor goodness, nor knowledge of Elohim in the land.
search.searchText: hosea 4 1 hear the word of yhwh you children of israel for yhwh has a charge against the inhabitants of the land indeed there is no truth nor goodness nor knowledge of elohim in the land

search.text: There is cursing, lying, murder, stealing, and committing adultery; they break boundaries, and bloodshed causes bloodshed.
search.searchText: hosea 4 2 there is cursing lying murder stealing and committing adultery they break boundaries and bloodshed causes bloodshed

search.text: Therefore the land will mourn, and everyone who dwells therein will waste away. all living things in her, even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky; yes, the fish of the sea also die.
search.searchText: hosea 4 3 therefore the land will mourn and everyone who dwells therein will waste away all living things in her even the animals of the field and the birds of the sky yes the fish of the sea also die

search.text: "Yet let no one bring a charge, neither let anyone accuse; For your people are like those who bring charges against a priest.
search.searchText: hosea 4 4 yet let no one bring a charge neither let anyone accuse for your people are like those who bring charges against a priest

search.text: You will stumble in the day, and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night; and I will destroy your mother.
search.searchText: hosea 4 5 you will stumble in the day and the prophet will also stumble with you in the night and i will destroy your mother

search.text: My people are destroyed for lack of knowledge. Because you have rejected knowledge, I will also reject you, that you may be no priest to me. Because you have forgotten your God's law, I will also forget your children.
search.searchText: hosea 4 6 my people are destroyed for lack of knowledge because you have rejected knowledge i will also reject you that you may be no priest to me because you have forgotten your god s law i will also forget your children

search.text: As they were multiplied, so they sinned against me. I will change their glory into shame.
search.searchText: hosea 4 7 as they were multiplied so they sinned against me i will change their glory into shame

search.text: They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.
search.searchText: hosea 4 8 they feed on the sin of my people and set their heart on their iniquity

search.text: It will be, like people, like priest; and I will punish them for their ways, and will repay them for their deeds.
search.searchText: hosea 4 9 it will be like people like priest and i will punish them for their ways and will repay them for their deeds

search.text: They will eat, and not have enough. They will play the prostitute, and will not increase; because they have abandoned giving to YHWH.
search.searchText: hosea 4 10 they will eat and not have enough they will play the prostitute and will not increase because they have abandoned giving to yhwh

search.text: Prostitution, wine, and new wine take away understanding.
search.searchText: hosea 4 11 prostitution wine and new wine take away understanding

search.text: My people consult with their wooden idol, and answer to a stick of wood. Indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray, and they have been unfaithful to their God.
search.searchText: hosea 4 12 my people consult with their wooden idol and answer to a stick of wood indeed the spirit of prostitution has led them astray and they have been unfaithful to their god

search.text: They sacrifice on the tops of the mountains, and burn incense on the hills, under oaks and poplars and terebinths, because its shade is good. Therefore your daughters play the prostitute, and your brides commit adultery.
search.searchText: hosea 4 13 they sacrifice on the tops of the mountains and burn incense on the hills under oaks and poplars and terebinths because its shade is good therefore your daughters play the prostitute and your brides commit adultery

search.text: I will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute, nor your brides when they commit adultery; because the men consort with prostitutes, and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes; so the people without understanding will come to ruin.
search.searchText: hosea 4 14 i will not punish your daughters when they play the prostitute nor your brides when they commit adultery because the men consort with prostitutes and they sacrifice with the shrine prostitutes so the people without understanding will come to ruin

search.text: "Though you, Israel, play the prostitute, yet don't let Yehudah offend; and don't come to Gilgal, neither go up to Beit Aven, nor swear, 'As YHWH lives.'
search.searchText: hosea 4 15 though you israel play the prostitute yet don t let yehudah offend and don t come to gilgal neither go up to beit aven nor swear as yhwh lives

search.text: For Israel has behaved extremely stubbornly, like a stubborn heifer. Then how will YHWH feed them like a lamb in a meadow.
search.searchText: hosea 4 16 for israel has behaved extremely stubbornly like a stubborn heifer then how will yhwh feed them like a lamb in a meadow

search.text: Efrayim is joined to idols. Leave him alone!
search.searchText: hosea 4 17 efrayim is joined to idols leave him alone

search.text: Their drink has become sour. They play the prostitute continually. Her rulers dearly love their shameful way.
search.searchText: hosea 4 18 their drink has become sour they play the prostitute continually her rulers dearly love their shameful way

search.text: The wind has wrapped her up in its wings; and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices.
search.searchText: hosea 4 19 the wind has wrapped her up in its wings and they shall be disappointed because of their sacrifices

search.text: "Listen to this, you priests! Listen, house of Israel, and give ear, house of the king! For the judgment is against you; for you have been a snare at Mizpah, and a net spread on Tabor.
search.searchText: hosea 5 1 listen to this you priests listen house of israel and give ear house of the king for the judgment is against you for you have been a snare at mizpah and a net spread on tabor

search.text: The rebels are deep in slaughter; but I discipline all of them.
search.searchText: hosea 5 2 the rebels are deep in slaughter but i discipline all of them

search.text: I know Efrayim, and Israel is not hidden from me; for now, Efrayim, you have played the prostitute. Israel is defiled.
search.searchText: hosea 5 3 i know efrayim and israel is not hidden from me for now efrayim you have played the prostitute israel is defiled

search.text: Their deeds won't allow them to turn to their God; for the spirit of prostitution is within them, and they don't know YHWH.
search.searchText: hosea 5 4 their deeds won t allow them to turn to their god for the spirit of prostitution is within them and they don t know yhwh

search.text: The pride of Israel testifies to his face. Therefore Israel and Efrayim will stumble in their iniquity. Yehudah also will stumble with them.
search.searchText: hosea 5 5 the pride of israel testifies to his face therefore israel and efrayim will stumble in their iniquity yehudah also will stumble with them

search.text: They will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek YHWH; but they won't find YHWH. YHWH has withdrawn from them.
search.searchText: hosea 5 6 they will go with their flocks and with their herds to seek yhwh but they won t find yhwh yhwh has withdrawn from them

search.text: They are unfaithful to YHWH; for they have borne illegitimate children. Now the new moon will devour them with their fields.
search.searchText: hosea 5 7 they are unfaithful to yhwh for they have borne illegitimate children now the new moon will devour them with their fields

search.text: "Blow the cornet in Gibeah, and the trumpet in Ramah! Sound a battle cry at Beit Aven, behind you, Binyamin!
search.searchText: hosea 5 8 blow the cornet in gibeah and the trumpet in ramah sound a battle cry at beit aven behind you binyamin

search.text: Efrayim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke. Among the tribes of Israel, I have made known that which will surely be.
search.searchText: hosea 5 9 efrayim will become a desolation in the day of rebuke among the tribes of israel i have made known that which will surely be

search.text: The princes of Yehudah are like those who remove a landmark. I will pour out my wrath on them like water.
search.searchText: hosea 5 10 the princes of yehudah are like those who remove a landmark i will pour out my wrath on them like water

search.text: Efrayim is oppressed, he is crushed in judgment; Because he is intent in his pursuit of idols.
search.searchText: hosea 5 11 efrayim is oppressed he is crushed in judgment because he is intent in his pursuit of idols

search.text: Therefore I am to Efrayim like a moth, and to the house of Yehudah like rottenness.
search.searchText: hosea 5 12 therefore i am to efrayim like a moth and to the house of yehudah like rottenness

search.text: "When Efrayim saw his sickness, and Yehudah his wound, Then Efrayim went to Ashur, and sent to king Jareb: but he is not able to heal you, neither will he cure you of your wound.
search.searchText: hosea 5 13 when efrayim saw his sickness and yehudah his wound then efrayim went to ashur and sent to king jareb but he is not able to heal you neither will he cure you of your wound

search.text: For I will be to Efrayim like a lion, and like a young lion to the house of Yehudah. I myself will tear in pieces and go away. I will carry off, and there will be no one to deliver.
search.searchText: hosea 5 14 for i will be to efrayim like a lion and like a young lion to the house of yehudah i myself will tear in pieces and go away i will carry off and there will be no one to deliver

search.text: I will go and return to my place, until they acknowledge their offense, and seek my face. In their affliction they will seek me earnestly."
search.searchText: hosea 5 15 i will go and return to my place until they acknowledge their offense and seek my face in their affliction they will seek me earnestly

search.text: "Come, and let us return to YHWH; for YHWH has torn us to pieces and will heal us; YHWH has injured us and will bind up our wounds.
search.searchText: hosea 6 1 come and let us return to yhwh for yhwh has torn us to pieces and will heal us yhwh has injured us and will bind up our wounds

search.text: After two days he will revive us. On the third day he will raise us up, and we will live before him.
search.searchText: hosea 6 2 after two days he will revive us on the third day he will raise us up and we will live before him

search.text: Let us acknowledge YHWH. Let us press on to know YHWH. As surely as the sun rises, YHWH will appear. YHWH will come to us like the rain, like the spring rain that waters the earth."
search.searchText: hosea 6 3 let us acknowledge yhwh let us press on to know yhwh as surely as the sun rises yhwh will appear yhwh will come to us like the rain like the spring rain that waters the earth

search.text: "Efrayim, what shall I do to you? Yehudah, what shall I do to you? For your love is like a morning cloud, and like the dew that disappears early.
search.searchText: hosea 6 4 efrayim what shall i do to you yehudah what shall i do to you for your love is like a morning cloud and like the dew that disappears early

search.text: Therefore I have cut them to pieces with the prophets; I killed them with the words of my mouth. Your judgments are like a flash of lightning.
search.searchText: hosea 6 5 therefore i have cut them to pieces with the prophets i killed them with the words of my mouth your judgments are like a flash of lightning

search.text: For I desire mercy, and not sacrifice; and the knowledge of Elohim more than burnt offerings.
search.searchText: hosea 6 6 for i desire mercy and not sacrifice and the knowledge of elohim more than burnt offerings

search.text: But they, like Adam, have broken the covenant. They were unfaithful to me, there.
search.searchText: hosea 6 7 but they like adam have broken the covenant they were unfaithful to me there

search.text: Gilead is a city of those who work iniquity; it is stained with blood.
search.searchText: hosea 6 8 gilead is a city of those who work iniquity it is stained with blood

search.text: As gangs of robbers wait to ambush a person, so the company of priests murder in the way toward Shekhem, committing shameful crimes.
search.searchText: hosea 6 9 as gangs of robbers wait to ambush a person so the company of priests murder in the way toward shekhem committing shameful crimes

search.text: In the house of Israel I have seen a horrible thing. There is prostitution in Efrayim. Israel is defiled.
search.searchText: hosea 6 10 in the house of israel i have seen a horrible thing there is prostitution in efrayim israel is defiled

search.text: "Also, Yehudah, there is a harvest appointed for you, when I restore the fortunes of my people.
search.searchText: hosea 6 11 also yehudah there is a harvest appointed for you when i restore the fortunes of my people

search.text: When I would heal Israel, then the iniquity of Efrayim is uncovered, also the wickedness of Shomron; for they commit falsehood, and the thief enters in, and the gang of robbers ravages outside.
search.searchText: hosea 7 1 when i would heal israel then the iniquity of efrayim is uncovered also the wickedness of shomron for they commit falsehood and the thief enters in and the gang of robbers ravages outside

search.text: They don't consider in their hearts that I remember all their wickedness. Now their own deeds have engulfed them. They are before my face.
search.searchText: hosea 7 2 they don t consider in their hearts that i remember all their wickedness now their own deeds have engulfed them they are before my face

search.text: They make the king glad with their wickedness, and the princes with their lies.
search.searchText: hosea 7 3 they make the king glad with their wickedness and the princes with their lies

search.text: They are all adulterers. They are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring, from the kneading of the dough, until it is leavened.
search.searchText: hosea 7 4 they are all adulterers they are burning like an oven that the baker stops stirring from the kneading of the dough until it is leavened

search.text: On the day of our king, the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine. He joined his hand with mockers.
search.searchText: hosea 7 5 on the day of our king the princes made themselves sick with the heat of wine he joined his hand with mockers

search.text: For they have made ready their heart like an oven, while they lie in wait. Their baker sleeps all the night. In the morning it burns as a flaming fire.
search.searchText: hosea 7 6 for they have made ready their heart like an oven while they lie in wait their baker sleeps all the night in the morning it burns as a flaming fire

search.text: They are all hot as an oven, and devour their judges. All their kings have fallen. There is no one among them who calls to me.
search.searchText: hosea 7 7 they are all hot as an oven and devour their judges all their kings have fallen there is no one among them who calls to me

search.text: Efrayim, he mixes himself among the nations. Efrayim is a pancake not turned over.
search.searchText: hosea 7 8 efrayim he mixes himself among the nations efrayim is a pancake not turned over

search.text: Strangers have devoured his strength, and he doesn't realize it. Indeed, gray hairs are here and there on him, and he doesn't realize it.
search.searchText: hosea 7 9 strangers have devoured his strength and he doesn t realize it indeed gray hairs are here and there on him and he doesn t realize it

search.text: The pride of Israel testifies to his face; yet they haven't returned to YHWH their God, nor sought YHWH, for all this.
search.searchText: hosea 7 10 the pride of israel testifies to his face yet they haven t returned to yhwh their god nor sought yhwh for all this

search.text: "Efrayim is like an easily deceived dove, without understanding. They call to Mitzrayim. They go to Ashur.
search.searchText: hosea 7 11 efrayim is like an easily deceived dove without understanding they call to mitzrayim they go to ashur

search.text: When they go, I will spread my net on them. I will bring them down like the birds of the sky. I will chastise them, as their congregation has heard.
search.searchText: hosea 7 12 when they go i will spread my net on them i will bring them down like the birds of the sky i will chastise them as their congregation has heard

search.text: Woe to them! For they have wandered from me. Destruction to them! For they have trespassed against me. Though I would redeem them, yet they have spoken lies against me.
search.searchText: hosea 7 13 woe to them for they have wandered from me destruction to them for they have trespassed against me though i would redeem them yet they have spoken lies against me

search.text: They haven't cried to me with their heart, but they howl on their beds. They assemble themselves for grain and new wine. They turn away from me.
search.searchText: hosea 7 14 they haven t cried to me with their heart but they howl on their beds they assemble themselves for grain and new wine they turn away from me

search.text: Though I have taught and strengthened their arms, yet they plot harm against me.
search.searchText: hosea 7 15 though i have taught and strengthened their arms yet they plot harm against me

search.text: They return, but not to the Most High. They are like a faulty bow. Their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue. This will be their derision in the land of Mitzrayim.
search.searchText: hosea 7 16 they return but not to the most high they are like a faulty bow their princes will fall by the sword for the rage of their tongue this will be their derision in the land of mitzrayim

search.text: "Put the trumpet to your lips! Something like an eagle is over YHWH's house, because they have broken my covenant, and rebelled against my law.
search.searchText: hosea 8 1 put the trumpet to your lips something like an eagle is over yhwh s house because they have broken my covenant and rebelled against my law

search.text: They cry to me, 'my God, we Israel acknowledge you!'
search.searchText: hosea 8 2 they cry to me my god we israel acknowledge you

search.text: Israel has cast off that which is good. The enemy will pursue him.
search.searchText: hosea 8 3 israel has cast off that which is good the enemy will pursue him

search.text: They have set up kings, but not by me. They have made princes, and I didn't approve. Of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols, that they may be cut off.
search.searchText: hosea 8 4 they have set up kings but not by me they have made princes and i didn t approve of their silver and their gold they have made themselves idols that they may be cut off

search.text: Let Shomron throw out his calf idol! My anger burns against them! How long will it be until they are capable of purity?
search.searchText: hosea 8 5 let shomron throw out his calf idol my anger burns against them how long will it be until they are capable of purity

search.text: For this is even from Israel! The workman made it, and it is no Elohim; indeed, the calf of Shomron shall be broken in pieces.
search.searchText: hosea 8 6 for this is even from israel the workman made it and it is no elohim indeed the calf of shomron shall be broken in pieces

search.text: For they sow the wind, and they will reap the whirlwind. He has no standing grain. The stalk will yield no head. If it does yield, strangers will swallow it up.
search.searchText: hosea 8 7 for they sow the wind and they will reap the whirlwind he has no standing grain the stalk will yield no head if it does yield strangers will swallow it up

search.text: Israel is swallowed up. Now they are among the nations like a worthless thing.
search.searchText: hosea 8 8 israel is swallowed up now they are among the nations like a worthless thing

search.text: For they have gone up to Ashur, like a wild donkey wandering alone. Efrayim has hired lovers for himself.
search.searchText: hosea 8 9 for they have gone up to ashur like a wild donkey wandering alone efrayim has hired lovers for himself

search.text: But although they sold themselves among the nations, I will now gather them; and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones.
search.searchText: hosea 8 10 but although they sold themselves among the nations i will now gather them and they begin to waste away because of the oppression of the king of mighty ones

search.text: Because Efrayim has multiplied altars for sinning, they became for him altars for sinning.
search.searchText: hosea 8 11 because efrayim has multiplied altars for sinning they became for him altars for sinning

search.text: I wrote for him the many things of my law; but they were regarded as a strange thing.
search.searchText: hosea 8 12 i wrote for him the many things of my law but they were regarded as a strange thing

search.text: As for the sacrifices of my offerings, they sacrifice flesh and eat it; But YHWH doesn't accept them. Now he will remember their iniquity, and punish their sins. They will return to Mitzrayim.
search.searchText: hosea 8 13 as for the sacrifices of my offerings they sacrifice flesh and eat it but yhwh doesn t accept them now he will remember their iniquity and punish their sins they will return to mitzrayim

search.text: For Israel has forgotten his Maker and built palaces; and Yehudah has multiplied fortified cities; but I will send a fire on his cities, and it will devour its fortresses."
search.searchText: hosea 8 14 for israel has forgotten his maker and built palaces and yehudah has multiplied fortified cities but i will send a fire on his cities and it will devour its fortresses

search.text: Don't rejoice, Israel, to jubilation like the nations; for you were unfaithful to your God. You love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor.
search.searchText: hosea 9 1 don t rejoice israel to jubilation like the nations for you were unfaithful to your god you love the wages of a prostitute at every grain threshing floor

search.text: The threshing floor and the winepress won't feed them, and the new wine will fail her.
search.searchText: hosea 9 2 the threshing floor and the winepress won t feed them and the new wine will fail her

search.text: They won't dwell in YHWH's land; but Efrayim will return to Mitzrayim, and they will eat unclean food in Ashur.
search.searchText: hosea 9 3 they won t dwell in yhwh s land but efrayim will return to mitzrayim and they will eat unclean food in ashur

search.text: They won't pour out wine offerings to YHWH, neither will they be pleasing to him. Their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners; all who eat of it will be polluted; for their bread will be for their appetite. It will not come into the house of YHWH.
search.searchText: hosea 9 4 they won t pour out wine offerings to yhwh neither will they be pleasing to him their sacrifices will be to them like the bread of mourners all who eat of it will be polluted for their bread will be for their appetite it will not come into the house of yhwh

search.text: What will you do in the day of solemn assembly, and in the day of the feast of YHWH?
search.searchText: hosea 9 5 what will you do in the day of solemn assembly and in the day of the feast of yhwh

search.text: For, behold, they have gone away from destruction. Mitzrayim will gather them up. Memphis will bury them. Nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver. Thorns will be in their tents.
search.searchText: hosea 9 6 for behold they have gone away from destruction mitzrayim will gather them up memphis will bury them nettles will possess their pleasant things of silver thorns will be in their tents

search.text: The days of visitation have come. The days of reckoning have come. Israel will consider the prophet to be a fool, and the one who is inspired to be insane, because of the abundance of your sins, and because your hostility is great.
search.searchText: hosea 9 7 the days of visitation have come the days of reckoning have come israel will consider the prophet to be a fool and the one who is inspired to be insane because of the abundance of your sins and because your hostility is great

search.text: A prophet watches over Efrayim with my God. A fowler's snare is on all of his paths, and hostility in the house of his God.
search.searchText: hosea 9 8 a prophet watches over efrayim with my god a fowler s snare is on all of his paths and hostility in the house of his god

search.text: They have deeply corrupted themselves, as in the days of Gibeah. He will remember their iniquity. He will punish them for their sins.
search.searchText: hosea 9 9 they have deeply corrupted themselves as in the days of gibeah he will remember their iniquity he will punish them for their sins

search.text: I found Israel like grapes in the wilderness. I saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season; but they came to Baal Peor, and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing, and became abominable like that which they loved.
search.searchText: hosea 9 10 i found israel like grapes in the wilderness i saw your fathers as the first ripe in the fig tree at its first season but they came to baal peor and consecrated themselves to the shameful thing and became abominable like that which they loved

search.text: As for Efrayim, their glory will fly away like a bird. There will be no birth, none with child, and no conception.
search.searchText: hosea 9 11 as for efrayim their glory will fly away like a bird there will be no birth none with child and no conception

search.text: Though they bring up their children, yet I will bereave them, so that not a person shall be left. Indeed, woe also to them when I depart from them!
search.searchText: hosea 9 12 though they bring up their children yet i will bereave them so that not a person shall be left indeed woe also to them when i depart from them
